QmNNEGStL1xUZra4A7GJx5ai59sq9n9RjpfXxMK1.name: Genesis
QmNNEGStL1xUZra4A7GJx5ai59sq9n9RjpfXxMK1.description:
This is my genesis NFT artwork. It is about navigating the merger of the physical and digital worlds which is being made possible by the lock and key otherwise known as an NFT. It is about the rebirth of being and the merger of man and technology. It is about a brave new space that we as a collective can shape in a way that supports and serves everyone. A celebration of continual growth, connection, dreaming big, and that a rising tide lifts all ships.

This work of art started as an abstract painting on canvas. At one point in the process imagery started to make its way into the painting. At the time I was falling in love and reaching new clarity on many things in my life. Without a doubt these things found their way into the painting, and the original painting  can be seen in the "sunrise state."

I worked on the painting for a few months and then had to travel for a while. When I got back to the studio I decided the painting was finished. This was 2017.

Fast forward to 2021 when I entered my first NFTs.tips clubhouse room in February. For a week straight I participated in amazing conversations for 8+ hours a day about the possibilities of NFT’s and the metaverse and my mind started to explode. One aspect of NFTs that I found particularly interesting was the ability to add conceptual things into the smart contract that were inherently tied to the NFT itself. This is the reason I decided to drop my first NFT on Async Art.

Overflowing with inspiration and new knowledge I took the painting from 2017 and began to paint into it with Procreate. Almost 100 hours of logged time later, and countless more conversations on clubhouse, I present to the world “Genesis.”

Day/Night feature was chosen to showcase the work in color and black and white but also an added transparency of showing important steps of the creative process in the "states" of sunrise and sunset. 

Sunrise shows the original physical painting, which turns to the digital/analog hybrid version throughout the day. At sunset the digital layer of color is shown separate, which then changes into the final digital/analog painting for the duration of the night.

As a painter the process is integral to how I reach a final image. Now with this autonomous NFT I think it’s amazing to give the collector ownership and insight into this process.

Being able to experience the same imagery in various states activates the idea of continuous change. The symbolism in the painting is open to interpretation as well as reflective of our current times of entering the metaverse. The act of seeing the painting in process is also meant to remind us that everything is a work in progress and it’s the process itself that gives meaning to existence.

Sunrise State -  Original painting on canvas
Day State – Black and White final version hybrid of digital and analog painting.
Sunset State – Layer of color digital painting.
Night State – Full color final version hybrid of digital and analog painting.

Bio: Over the last 20 years Ari Lankin has extensively developed painted languages exploring abstraction, conceptual process, and realism. His current paintings are intentionally open to interpretation and rich in visceral sensation. They encourage experienced based conversations on the universe and mankind. They hover between mystical and scientific. The physicality of paint, intuition, memory, and exploration are crucial aspects of his practice. His last solo show in New York City in 2020 completely sold out, he has two murals on public display at World Trade Center 3, and he has had major signature product collaborations with TROJAN™ Condoms and Adidas.

QmNNagoz1qwu9xXVid4nG7d4CQPXk12D1ASXzmx1.name: Sleep Study
QmNNagoz1qwu9xXVid4nG7d4CQPXk12D1ASXzmx1.description:
Sleep is the most vulnerable state of human existence. Sleep exists in limbo between life and death. For me, portrait has been about getting the raw and vulnerable side of the person.

As a self study, I shot images of myself through a sleep cycle. Each grid shot at a specific time interval, constantly scrutinising and documenting my sleep. I move, in reality and in may be in the dreams too. Each movement flowing from one image to the next. 

The piece is a collection made from 77 images shot. 

By changing layers, would my sleep be disturbed or woken back to the strange reality. 

Could I exist in dreams and sleep alone?

QmNNuzSKQAhTGwnXsYfijeEgeea7iXDvFBVeJA5j.name: Sirens Call
QmNNuzSKQAhTGwnXsYfijeEgeea7iXDvFBVeJA5j.description:
Created in collusion with graphic designer TypeDistortDecay, as part of Copy Planet's expanding universe. 

Informed by the physical, mental, and behavioral changes that follow a 24-hour cycle. 

“Circadian Rhythms” is a pilot series comprised of 3 works for Copy Planet’s Centre for Climatology. 

The work intends to present a meditation on the sublime as a way to contemplate these natural phenomena as agents of change through emergent technology. 

As a respond to the shifts experienced within the current zeitgeist and its effects on the human and non-human participants existing in space time. 

Each work will be uploaded twice ( daytime / nighttime ) responding to the natural processes of light and dark.  

Words by James Ly

QmNRT4juMEAQbEg6ApYbhB86bLQDrjvftdv7N9m3.name: Inwardness #231260
QmNRT4juMEAQbEg6ApYbhB86bLQDrjvftdv7N9m3.description:
I have explored the relationship between the light in photography and line in painting since 2020. This series integrates the results of my research which are photograms, Mixed Media artworks, and AI-generated images. The dataset from this series includes 300 photograms I made in the darkroom and 300 digital paintings I drew.

The concept of Relativity dearly changes my way of seeing and creating. When I hold light source on the Black & White photographic enlarging paper in the darkroom, I come over a sort of illusion that I am drawing. Even though I know that I'm making photographs because each beam of light represents its time and space. Painting is the outlet for my feelings. When I am drawing on the AI-generated image on the computer, the emotion comes and goes, just as the light only lasts for a second and never comes back. For me, this series is neither photography nor painting. It's a kind of new form.

QmNRgYxcwjgr6EDATG88hmhU4PRLoM45L1vVRh8s.name: The Influence of Surroundings
QmNRgYxcwjgr6EDATG88hmhU4PRLoM45L1vVRh8s.description: Beauty is subjective, based partially by the surrounding elements of the observed object. In this artwork, the background is composed of two different layers, each with three different possible choices (layer A: white, burgundy or yellow layer B: white, blue or green) interacting together (the color of Layer B multiplies with the color of layer A) resulting in 9 potential background colors. Watch how the main element is perceived differently each time, depending on the underlying background. Even though, in reality the paint stays exactly the same no matter the background, it looks different based on its surroundings. Which relates to what we see in the "real" world, the truth being greatly influenced by its surrounding.

QmNS4QyD7wyehyjnzwGj8hDwgMyZ7ro1k8bas15q.name: Landscape Study #3 (with Vehicles)
QmNS4QyD7wyehyjnzwGj8hDwgMyZ7ro1k8bas15q.description:
Like any good third installment, Study #3 takes lessons learned from previous work whilst also trying something new. This time, we discover even more vibrant locations and populate them with exotic machinery. 

An increase in 'resolution' has allowed for more detail in this particular painting, but it is also heavily inspired by third and fourth generation video games - meaning bright, pixelated nostalgia was either meticulously planned or simply inevitable! 

Layers vary in impact and interactivity. A new sky or horizon can change the entire mood of the piece, but some might prefer to choose their own mode of transportation, the actions it undertakes, and whether or not it follows the rules of the road...

QmNUkFkakw7VrBcsz9Vta6aR5dN4MquAno5pLpa6.name: Experimental No.1 #9712
QmNUkFkakw7VrBcsz9Vta6aR5dN4MquAno5pLpa6.description: Changes is the only thing that hasn’t been changed. From time to space to the thoughts of human beings are constantly changing. I transformed a Silver Gelatin Photogram (a piece of physical photograph made of alternative photographic processes) into a digital image that even can produce endless changes. This is based on the change in my way of seeing the world. It is difficult for individuals to completely isolate themselves from their own inherent culture, this ingrained imprint not only stems from families but also social and historical influences. Besides, the rapid innovation of science and technologies directly drives the world today to inevitably facing collisions and fusions in multiculturalism. Studying classical philosophical text allows me to apply the dialectical method to tease those open questions, and finally ground on my artworks. All things complement each other and balance in the collision. Changes is the key. Isn’t the development of human civilization that come to the present evolve in indistinct ways?

QmNXyCrocHAsT1UGwm5mwdexkUDYjsUwP1xZc5FJ.name: Experimental No.3 #6104
QmNXyCrocHAsT1UGwm5mwdexkUDYjsUwP1xZc5FJ.description:
Artwork Title: Experimental No.3 #6104
Date of Artwork: 2021
Dimension: 1678 pixel x 2160 pixel
Type of Work: Silver Gelatin Photogram, Digital Painting
Edition: Unique
Note: This artwork is a type of digital art. The hand-made photogram is one of the subjects that compose this piece, and this photogram is not for sale separately whatever in the crypto world or the real world.

Notwithstanding, the beginning of the photography is representational, it ultimately leads to the way of the abstract. Photography has nothing to do with painting, although the thinking of abstractness renders them getting closer and closer. Photography remains the interpretation of "Light", and to express the “Light” is its inescapable responsibility. I find the "Line" could be one of the forms to present the "Light". I apply the "Line", also is the "Light", to destroy a completed and finished photograph, and change it into a new form of art and have a unique way of spreading and viewing. Through this new attempt to keep looking for balance and harmony.

Photography has nothing to do with painting, although the thinking of abstractness renders them getting closer and closer. Photography remains the interpretation of "Light", and to express the “Light” is its inescapable responsibility. I find the "Line" could be one of the forms to present the "Light". I apply the "Line", also is the "Light", to destroy a completed and finished photograph, and change it into a new form of art and have a unique way of spreading and viewing. Through this new attempt to keep looking for balance and harmony.

QmNYjkrLHqzYpkGRgYtCftXWMtrYvXw7ZmNTKWQf.name: AI x Street of Lost Dreams
QmNYjkrLHqzYpkGRgYtCftXWMtrYvXw7ZmNTKWQf.description:
AI x Street of Lost Dreams
by Hulki Okan Tabak
4 piece Artificial Intelligence based programmable artwork on Async Art
1/1 minted on 2022

...

This artwork is an AI led derivative version of the eponymously titled work on Async Art at https://async.art/art/master/0xb6dae651468e9593e4581705a09c10a76ac1e0c8-3396.

I have run experimental variations on the base image which is one of the photographs used in this address. I have created a similar 4 piece pure GAN driven image set that can be viewed alongside the original mint on Async Art.

Part of a series of Marylebone, London based artworks. All of these works consist of photographs taken by me in January 2020. It is the time of Lunar New Year, Wuhan lockdowns, and the very first signs of the virus in Europe.

Marylebone was originally an Ancient Parish formed to serve the manors (landholdings) of Lileston (in the west - which gives its name to modern Lisson Grove) and Tyburn in the east. The parish is likely to have been in place since at least the twelfth century and will have used the boundaries of the pre-existing manors. The boundaries of the parish were consistent from the late twelfth century to the creation of the Metropolitan Borough which succeeded it. (Wikipedia)

QmNnaiAmis6SzxhFogLeLRkzSAbNNDWEmhwVqQ2C.name: ""Still-Still"'
QmNnaiAmis6SzxhFogLeLRkzSAbNNDWEmhwVqQ2C.description:
Still-still — still composed, still unfazed, still warring for the incalculable high value of optimal health, this piece damn well features in many physician stories. Beamed in this composition is the trying task of keeping calm and collected amidst the loathed pressure-pressed high-stress hour.
Expressed is the art of mastered composure, drilled over years of professional training, and primed by several invaluable experiences of workday practice. Still-still is a state of being exhibited by seasoned clinicians in their firm steadiness during a difficult time. The internally sourced quietness is planted in their unreserved embrace and concrete understanding mission, cognizance that keeps the mind undistracted from duty.

QmNoexgMu59czS4krPN5UhUSqdxU4LWiPirhTGuU.name: ​​OUR FATHER IN THE METAVERSE #90
QmNoexgMu59czS4krPN5UhUSqdxU4LWiPirhTGuU.description:
https://mathiasrusch-metaverse.com/

The "Our Father" - The cycle of paintings by artist Mathias Rusch (*1927-2003).   

If there is a most important prayer of Christian faith, then it must be the "Our Father".  
 
This prayer gift of Jesus to his disciples, later handed down to us Christians, has become the actual Christian self-understanding, the "prayer of the Lord". Packed into a few sentences, it has come to be regarded as the actual confession of faith and is prayed millions of times a day, both individually and in communities. The fact that this "conversation with God" has hardly ever been depicted (in contrast to the Passion) is probably due to the immense message it conveys. The fact that the painter Mathias Rusch dared to translate the "Our Father" can be explained by the fact that his daily work was based on faith, hope, and trust in God. Mathias Rusch was aware that he could only exist in the understanding of his art "as a gift of God". Most of his late works (Our Father, Live and Let Live, Sermon on the Mount, Lauretan Litany, Litany of the Sacred Heart) were written, as he confessed, under the "kind help" of the Highest, always accompanied by personal prayers, meditations or invocations. The fact that Mathias Rusch did not reveal a word for the interpretation of his works of art is to be justified by the fact that he understood himself to a large extent as a mediator of a higher power. Thus we are sometimes quite helplessly confronted with an immense abundance of Christian symbols, metaphysical allusions, concretizations, and abstractions, in unique hues and compositions. Completely in the sense of Mathias Rusch we dive before the 13 works of art into the enormous topic of earthly existence and Christian eschatology, marvel before the color power, before the hints, confessions, and convictions of the very deeply felt "Our Father's". Finally, we become humbled and ultimately grateful to be initiated into the world-prayer of a "knowing" believer, again and again, with each glance at each of these magnificent works of art. Whoever takes a longer "eye" look at this self-contained, unique complete work, consisting of 13 unique pieces in oil on canvas, 170x170cm, will not be able to resist a lasting effect and deep consternation.

QmNpabXkVsSFHtCYqmLLt5NK9spysskR1uyF8vLy.name: Thinking On Thinking #1
QmNpabXkVsSFHtCYqmLLt5NK9spysskR1uyF8vLy.description:
Original artwork hand drawn by the artist Ollie Smith. Thinking On Thinking #1, is a scenario where one might dwell on the either real or imagined conversations, that either could have been or might happen in the future. I find the idea somewhat nostalgic, as if the action is based on the relationship between people, whether the conversation or questioning has taken place or not.

Colours chosen are bright pink and purple with white text, all words have been hand written with an oversized brush size to make them less legible. The shapes form a kind of comic book thought bubble where the pronouns used are changed every hour over a twenty four hour period.

QmNu7dJgHPs2ghrY5nfQn43CFt3yWgT7sesrThv6.name: Moods
QmNu7dJgHPs2ghrY5nfQn43CFt3yWgT7sesrThv6.description:
Dynamic NFT: A set of 24 different moods of a landscape panorama photograph, rotating hourly throughout the day.

How we perceive our world is driven by different states of mood playing a significant role in toning our lives on a daily basis - how we react & make decisions. Emotions shape our behavior and strongly impact our directions. In highly volatile environments like the cryptoart space they are more likely to become instabilized and random. Nights become days, days becomes nights, we completely fall out of daily cycles, getting sucked into other dimensions out of rushs of excitement, flow, fear or sheer panic - emotionally linked to inner highs & lows, moods of light & shadow, balancing a fine lines between flying & falling...

Single exposure wide angle landscape photography
LightRoom post-processing
by Dominique Weiss
Bachalpsee, Swiss Alps

QmNufjePHfuECqibnDycVt29qr7kF168P6FPRFdA.description: This is the control token for \"Right Place & Right Time (Bitcoin Hourly Price Offset).\" It serves to keep the master as a work-in-progress the artist continues to influence. In addition to controlling sensitivity values associated with the artist's algorithm, it includes artwork state, alpha, hue, color, saturation, and brightness. \"I've long believed in blending my own humanity with the algorithms I write. While the composition of the new daily image is controlled solely by price volatility, I'll continue to consider aesthetic concerns; to react to events which inspire the hand of the artist.\"

QmNvNHvD44VMP2CSBxbPo2q2itBqca9XbzAdrjCH.name: Shadows of the Surreal
QmNvNHvD44VMP2CSBxbPo2q2itBqca9XbzAdrjCH.description:
These 24 dark surreal artworks by Winchawa capture the essence of the enigmatic and the ethereal, drawing you into a labyrinth of shifting shadows and elusive forms.

As you immerse yourself in these dark and captivating artworks, you find yourself caught between realms, where reality intertwines with the ethereal and shadows take on a life of their own.

Shadows cascade and merge, shaping the contours of a surreal landscape that defies conventional understanding. 

It is as if the very fabric of reality is being stretched and woven anew with each passing hour.

Every passing hour brings a profound transformation to Shadows of the Surreal. 

This NFT evolves before your very eyes, revealing new dimensions and hidden symbols that speak to the depths of your soul. 

The dynamic nature of the artwork mirrors the ever-shifting nature of existence, constantly challenging your perceptions and inviting introspection.

Shadows of the Surreal is an invitation to embrace the unknown, to question the boundaries of reality, and to delve into the depths of your own imagination.

 It whispers secrets, leaving trails of intrigue in its wake, and ignites a fire within you to explore the uncharted territories of your mind.

Shadows of the Surreal promises an unforgettable journey, where the shadows come alive, the surreal becomes tangible, and your perception of the world is forever transformed.

QmNwEtJSYLF41QzHe2kUfcrTbsbcoFx7xu2bvgrA.description:
€ 737.163,10, is the total student debt of 25 art students who are graduating this year.

One has to take a loan for student housing.
The other for tuition fees, and the cost for groceries, books and living expenses.
We haven’t even touched on the expenses regarding healthcare and public transport.
This all combined makes up our student debt. Every student carries enormous debts on their shoulders.
Usually, this debt is invisible but with this artwork it is for the public to see and experience. 

Summary
Student debt is a major problem in many countries, such as the Netherlands. Due to these financial debts, we and many others have several problems, such as mental health, psychological complaints and disadvantages of applying for a mortgage. 

The Student Debt Collector represents 25 art students with student debts. We want to make this major invincible problem visible with this NFT. We are almost graduated and ready for the next step. However, we start our career and work-life with a combined debt of € 737.163,10. 

For more details, a comprehensive guide and a better understanding of The Student Debt Collector, please visit: https://thestudentdebtcollector.com/

QmNxMHeqV17GhePEGKWsCefghhjQf3zD4FKxvqSH.name: Right Place & Right Time (Bitcoin Hourly Price Offset)
QmNxMHeqV17GhePEGKWsCefghhjQf3zD4FKxvqSH.description: Each day, a new composition for the Master is generated autonomously using a data feed of Bitcoin's last 24 hours of price action. Each hour's price programmatically controls rotation, scale, and position of a correlating layer. Astute viewers will surmise the day's price volatility simply by examining the artwork. While the daily image generation is the result of autonomous API calls, utilizing an algorithm the artist wrote, the artist has chosen to retain a control token. This token allows him to fine-tune variables associated with his algorithm, in addition to addressing aesthetic concerns within the life-cycle of the artwork. Layer state, alpha, hue, saturation, and brightness are elements the artist has retained control of in order that this artwork remain a living work-in-progress.\n\nAn earlier iteration of this artwork was featured as a nightly projection mapping video on the face of the Daniels Fisher Clocktower, as part of ETH Denver 2020. Access to this and additional exclusive content awaits the master token owner at the artist's NFT Portal: https://collect.mattkane.com/minted-works/right-place-right-time-bitcoin-hourly-price-offset/

QmNyYKwakjxB3gJP2j6so17i3uTrfXZxeQbXPU7n.name: In a Different Light
QmNyYKwakjxB3gJP2j6so17i3uTrfXZxeQbXPU7n.description:
In my opinion, there's just something magical about the texture created by a paintbrush. All those tiny bristles wound so tightly together, creating countless parallel lines in every stroke. Often times, this detail is absent from modern artworks, mainly due to the adoption and embracing of digital art. "In a Different Light" is, essentially, the same two images, each with four different light effects applied. 

As an artist, I find myself simply playing with color more often than anything else. Creating gradients and hombres that are visually striking makes me feel all warm and fuzzy inside. These are four of my favorites set to rotate through in sync with the time of day/night. 

Enjoy

QmP6UnVki5sQ32Sx8LCuowqX6xZCs6P5MyFV7Ghh.name: The Quiet of Silence... Triptych (Wabi-Sabi)
QmP6UnVki5sQ32Sx8LCuowqX6xZCs6P5MyFV7Ghh.description:
This Art Piece is based on the original Triptych made from the photographs I took around Lake Ashinoko (Japan, 芦ノ湖) and is the first NTF artwork that belongs to the series "WABI-SABI: Acceptance of Transience... the Beauty of things that are Imperfect, Impermanent, Incomplete".
 
I spent nearly 3 months around Japan trying to understand a very profound and rooted Japanese philosophy and way of life that goes back many centuries… that of Wabi-Sabi. Wabi-Sabi is the quintessential Japanese aesthetic. It is the beauty of things that are imperfect, impermanent, and incomplete. It is the beauty of things that are modest and humble. It is the beauty of things that are unconventional… of everyday things… man-made, natural and the union of the two. 
The series was started in 2014-2015 and is still an ongoing project.

WHY MAKE IT INTO A NFT ART PIECE?
With the possibilities offered by AsyncArt and NFTs I decided to "extend" the original Triptych by changing some elements from the 3 original photos with other elements... this gave me more possibilities, more flexibility and allowed me to complete the original concept of "WABI-SABI: Acceptance of Transience... the Beauty of things that are Imperfect, Impermanent, Incomplete".
IMPORTANT: Every element in each layer/state comes from one of the original photographs (about 1000) that I took on the same location (Lake Ashinoko, Japan). This is essential, because all the parts of this NFT artwork are relevant to the same place and not "abstract" insertions from non related images. I wanted everything to be in harmony.

This NFT piece is composed by 3 Layers. Each layer has 6 States which can be changed by the owner of the layer and will reflect on the Master. This creates a total of 216 possible combinations. You can see an animation + all the different combinations here: www.tonycorocher.com/nft-triptych/

The Cover Image of each layer (the image that the owner of the layer will see as his/her own art piece) is one of the 3 original photos that make up the original printed Triptych. 

The original Triptych does NOT come from one photograph split into 3 pieces, but from 3 different photos taken from different positions and with different perspectives. The final piece was first imagined in the head and later on put together as a composition.
The original Triptych is also available as a Fine Art Print (all my photos are printed in 1 unique copy + a Limited Edition of 12).  

WHAT DOES WABI-SABI MEAN?
WABI: Beauty in simplicity.
Wabi is the austere beauty found in simple, even stark, things. The concept emerged as part of the tea ceremony in the 15th century. Over time it moved beyond physical objects like simple tea implements to merge with Zen and become a life philosophy based on rejecting anything showy or wasteful. Wabi can also be enjoyed in observing the changing seasons while reflecting on the impermanence of things.

SABI: Beauty in decay.
Sabi is the beauty of things that are old and in a state of decay. For example, one might see Sabi in the worn grain of the polished wood of the corridors in an old Japanese house; an old statue of the Buddha, the gold lacquer peeled off to reveal the bare wood beneath; or moss covered rocks in the garden.

Wabi-Sabi (侘寂?) represents a comprehensive Japanese world view or aesthetic centered on the acceptance of transience and imperfection. It is a concept derived from the Buddhist teaching of the three marks of existence (三法印 sanbōin?), specifically impermanence (無常 mujō?), the other two being suffering (苦 ku?) and emptiness or absence of self-nature (空 kū?).

Characteristics of the Wabi-Sabi aesthetic include asperity (roughness or irregularity), simplicity, economy, austerity, modesty, intimacy, and appreciation of the ingenuous integrity of natural objects and processes.

----------------------
ABOUT ME:
International Award winning independent Documentary & Fine Art Photographer. Born in Italy, 1974. I was educated and then worked as an Art Director/Graphic Designer for many years (I still do). 
You can find a full biography, more of my work, a list of international Awards/Exhibitions/Museums on my website www.tonycorocher.com or on my LinkedIn page www.linkedin.com/in/tonycorocher/

QmP6Vrp2FCFEuLRDsxe9BHDmzMwvgjJY4Nmex1GR.name: Garden of Chaos
QmP6Vrp2FCFEuLRDsxe9BHDmzMwvgjJY4Nmex1GR.description:
Garden of Chaos is an experiment in generative artwork constructed purely and completely from logic and mathematics. The seeds for the Garden are planted using logic, but the Garden that grows is born out of the natural randomness generated by code.

In every hour of the day, the Garden blooms by expanding, and then closes in rest at night only to be awakened the next morning to grow again.

This phenomenon of delicate balance is the heart of the Garden of Chaos. It lives at the intersection between natural and mechanical, order and chaos. It's a man-made space where nature can thrive.

QmP7jJMeTkuECsEVhp8eWRy99BfHW96PbzYLACfV.name: / CATCHING  FEELINGS & PERCEPTIONS /
QmP7jJMeTkuECsEVhp8eWRy99BfHW96PbzYLACfV.description:
Identify your mood. To change your mood, you need to realize what you are thinking and feeling. This way you can decide if you need to change your mood to one that best suits your situation.

To identify a mood, stop to think about what you are feeling and why. Put those feelings into words, like, "wow, I'm very passionate right now! " or "I feel very lonely..." You can say this to yourself silently, out loud, or to someone else.

Accept what you feel. After you name your emotion, understand yourself by feeling the way you do. It's perfectly okay (and it's natural!) For you to feel vulnerable, hurted, deceived…or by the was, full of glamour, love and passion. All emotions are acceptable and understandable. But you don't have to hold on to feeling that way. Notice your mood and then choose to modify it.

QmP8E8Sf79uaas2Cr2XNwNGPjMcA6m6CGZRLfNqA.name: LICHTKUGEL
QmP8E8Sf79uaas2Cr2XNwNGPjMcA6m6CGZRLfNqA.description:
This work results from a series with 18 light drawings from 2004 long exposures, digitally processed, and the implementation in a light ball in 3D. However, the work "lichtkugel_schwarz" was never published.
As of 2010, due to cancer, I hardly had any more opportunities to work artistically because I was tired and had to worry about livelihood, so there is a big gap in my résumé. However, I continued to follow the developments of the Internet / digital media art without making my own contribution.
In May/July 2021 I started to be interested in NFT, so I completely reworked this piece. I started to remove the Pixels and did experiments. 

I was never looking for a specific style, I am more interested in individual social and cultural topics, these are then processed selectively and then lead to a result: the image and the text. (Conceptual Art/image experiments). But I do love this work and all works with light.

Async Art shows Art, that changes over time, so this will be my first artpiece at Async Art: Master; Day + Sunrise + Sunset + Night

computer monitors, display panels, mobiles) display best on landscape screens

QmPA1dia2ooXtypegQwKWGexqHFgieKQQJqRY8zk.name: The Memorial
QmPA1dia2ooXtypegQwKWGexqHFgieKQQJqRY8zk.description:
Death is inevitable when the movement stops... frozen in time, immovable and eternal.


This unique artwork is my genesis collection on Async.Art and it's a meditation on my own death. 
In 24 hours we can see as the sculpture assembles during the performance.

This performance  symbolizes the retrospect of our life.
During the movement I leave a body imprint on approximately every 5th frame of the animation. When the movement stops, there is an abstract/surrealistic sculpture. 
The different motion paths are analogies of rails that are sometimes laid before us but sometimes we see them only after we have walked them. 

My greatest inspiration concerning forms and shape language is HR Giger, creator of the Alien creature. Analyzing his work and the Process Philosophy I have developed a technique of the Process Sculptures.
I sculpt the models and use my own motion capture performance. 

Meditate on this unique artwork and own it before I reveal my lifelong Art program.

Wonder is the genesis artwork by Dave Yang at AsyncArt.

For a young child, the world is a wonderful and curious place - there is always something new and fun to enjoy. Perhaps adults can step back and admire the wonders of the universe again like a child.

Each of the four states in this artwork reflects the wonders of the child's imagination throughout the day and night.

This collection is created using a custom application written in Lua and GLSL. A 4K edition with extra bonus screens are available for the collector to download. Please contact @daveyang at either Twitter or Instagram for more info. Thanks!

More info: https://swfoo.com/wonder

QmPAcP2g6nXXQmwanXQsRWHjNrPAPPKfSv79HZZK.name: Cyber Watch
QmPAcP2g6nXXQmwanXQsRWHjNrPAPPKfSv79HZZK.description:
CYBER WATCH 

This is the first big collab The Guild has made on Async. It is based on the famous painting The Night Watch by Rembrandt (1642). This was initiated and coordinated by Rutger van der Tas. 

A total of 34 layers make this Cyber Watch containing 107 different states made by 33 artists. Some of them are very well-known and some are up and coming. 

We are all familiar with the famous painting and the composition of the original work by Rembrandt, therefore this digital piece is easily readable although it is a cacophony of styles and colors. 

Rutger did not want to hold back the creativity by giving a set of rules. No themes, no color palette was assigned. Just the creative flow and the story every artist wanted to tell. They had to feel the freedom to do whatever they wanted. 

Every artist was supplied with a figure or piece of the surroundings in the original painting. No one was able to pick a place, a spot or character on beforehand. 

After dividing the canvas into separate layers and giving them a number, an online randomizer was used to divide them. This was done three times to get three different options. After this, a vote was made to choose which of the three variations was going to be used. This was done in a special Nachtwacht Telegram group. 

All artists involved worked hard on their contribution even though we have all been impacted by Covid-19 directly or indirectly.  

Being in a lockdown or not free to move in the way we used too, makes this online NFT art community very important.  For both artists and collectors this online realm filled our lives in so many ways.

We are the Cyber Watch.

Participating artists from background to foreground: 

Sparrow, Silje Thorn, Surreal Serpentine, FtrSaroth, Loudsqueak, Lapin Mignon, Tom Abbink, Sarah Zucker, Talos, Nika Danny, Arvid Hjorth, ejthek, Benza, Legendary, Rutger van der Tas, Becca Kennedy, Shelly Soneja, Mehak Jain, Airco Caravan, pplpleasr, Fabin Rasheed, The Perfesser, Stellabelle, Matt Kane, Coldie 3D, Shinji Akhirah, Ytje Veenstra, Orabelart, Danil Pan, Jetski, Angie Taylor, SamJ Studios

QmPBUz2LBE2GGnEB1Rjj8PHAdmVWkm97xzT8kB3T.name: ​​OUR FATHER IN THE METAVERSE #78
QmPBUz2LBE2GGnEB1Rjj8PHAdmVWkm97xzT8kB3T.description:
https://mathiasrusch-metaverse.com/

The "Our Father" - The cycle of paintings by artist Mathias Rusch (*1927-2003)   

If we speak of the most important prayer of Christian faith, then of the "Our Father".  
 
This prayer gift of Jesus to his disciples, later handed down to us Christians, has become the actual Christian self-understanding, the "prayer of the Lord". Packed into a few sentences, it has come to be regarded as the actual confession of faith and is prayed millions of times a day, both individually and in communities. The fact that this "conversation with God" has hardly ever been depicted (in contrast to the Passion) is probably due to the immense message it conveys. The fact that the painter Mathias Rusch dared to translate the "Our Father" can be explained by the fact that his daily work was based on faith, hope and trust in God. Mathias Rusch was aware that he could only exist in the understanding of his art "as a gift of God". Most of his late works (Our Father, Live and Let Live, Sermon on the Mount, Lauretan Litany, Litany of the Sacred Heart) were written, as he confessed, under the "kind help" of the Highest, always accompanied by personal prayers, meditations or invocations. The fact that Mathias Rusch did not reveal a dying word for the interpretation of his works of art is to be justified by the fact that he understood himself to a large extent as a mediator of a higher power. Thus we are sometimes quite helplessly confronted with an immense abundance of Christian symbols, metaphysical allusions, concretizations and abstractions, in unique hues and compositions. Completely in the sense of Mathias Rusch we dive before the 13 works of art into the enormous topic of earthly existence and Christian eschatology, marvel before the color power, before the hints, confessions and convictions of the very deeply felt "Our Father's". Finally, we become humbled and ultimately grateful to be initiated into the world-prayer of a "knowing" believer, again and again, with each glance at each of these magnificent works of art. Whoever takes a longer "eye" look at this self-contained, unique complete work, consisting of 13 unique pieces in oil on canvas, 170x170cm, will not be able to resist a lasting effect and deep consternation.

This series aim to explore the possibility of merging fine art, design and modern fashion in one realm. The overall style developed by the artist shows how art of the future might look like.
Any future is born in the present and proven to be futuristic by its originality, actuality and prolonged existence in the world. Currently, when an artwork is digitalized, tokenized and living in the blockchain is an another robust confirmation of its right to be a significant part of the future we build today.

QmPFMKBxMv1bxjcgvds2RWYWFL7gphyRyDdggNw9.name: Übermensch
QmPFMKBxMv1bxjcgvds2RWYWFL7gphyRyDdggNw9.description:
Behold, Nietzsche's Übermensch (overman).

Autonomous. Changes based on time of day.

Day 
(How far we have come)
"All beings so far have created something beyond themselves; and do you want to be the ebb of this great flood, and even go back to the beasts rather than overcome man? What is ape to man? A laughing stock or painful embarrassment."

Night
(How far we have yet to go)
“And man shall be just that for the overman: a laughingstock or a painful embarrassment. You have made your way from worm to man, and much in you is still worm. Once you were apes, and even now, too, man is more ape than any ape."

QmPFNSG3LXLt3gABM3DMfSwuBfjvYpkJ3YcJ62WN.name: The Art We Share
QmPFNSG3LXLt3gABM3DMfSwuBfjvYpkJ3YcJ62WN.description:
Art usually attempts to convey a feeling or a message; it exposes the inner workings of the creator's mind. 
An art piece is a language developed by the artist to communicate alternatively to conventional language.
The Async platform gifts the collector the ability to use and to be immersed in that language; for the first time the artist is taking a step back by allowing the collector/s to have the final say in what the art piece should look like.

In "The Art We Share" I wanted to take that concept a step further. I want this piece to become a reflection of the collector's emotional state instead of reflecting mine. That being said, I hope to see the "Joy layer state" a lot, and maybe if you are feeling sad I can help you with that. :)

Cheers,

Horus

QmPHvzgkiS2uJg7sXbBPKhqg56bagFWCKS2aKpTS.name: La chatoyante
QmPHvzgkiS2uJg7sXbBPKhqg56bagFWCKS2aKpTS.description:
As a press photographer, I attended many red carpet events. Though I witnessed glamorous moments, faces and looks, I realized that I was drawn to create this world from a different perspective; one which undressed the soul, and rendered a more authentic moment. After some time, it became the same scenes, the same clichés, the same smiles, the same looks and the same photographers. As a celebrity, having to see more than 30 flashes per second every time a photographer spots them, probably makes them want to protect themselves. Seeing celebrities live in this world of excessive media coverage, I started to develop a mixed feeling of admiration and respect, but also pity, and finally detachment. 

The Personalities are decomposed and re-assembled in an abstract composition, guided by my instinct and fed by what the model inspired in me.

The original digital size of "La chatoyante" portrait is 120 by 180 cm. 

This is a portrait of the actress Jackie Cruz.

QmPMSFqg6DPD6u23L2KT8ox6EPXjYmSVqnUnLoaz.name: Pharmacy
QmPMSFqg6DPD6u23L2KT8ox6EPXjYmSVqnUnLoaz.description:
This is a historical pharmacy room anywhere in the world.
Maybe somewhere in India BC.
Maybe somewhere in Egypt or Ancient Greece.
It may also be a pharmacist's room in China or Japan.
Maybe somewhere in Turkey.
Maybe the Middle East or Europe...
I created this room simply by thinking, "What would a laboratory be like at that time?"
I separately created the stones, wood, tables, lights and surrounding glass bottles.
When the room was illuminated with a volumetric light, a beautiful view emerged.
I wish I could work there.
I don't know what's in those barrels either.
:)
----
3D modeled and visualized.
Render: 3000x2000 px.

QmPMkWqY4y1y5gMMxq7zf7XUafNUt2KP54JbTuRJ.name: SUNSET & HUMAN
QmPMkWqY4y1y5gMMxq7zf7XUafNUt2KP54JbTuRJ.description:
''We are one kind
None of us is different much than another
We are human, ruling this planet 
Sometimes worse, sometimes better
What we see is an illusion
Presented by light
Only requires a different angle 
To realize we are in a stupid fight''

It's almost a pleasure to observe the relation between humankind and sunset. I wonder; how come the majority of humankind didn't insist to worship the Sun?
I mean not only us, all life depends on Sun light but remember those moments when you watched sunset, those awe moments. It's something else right?... 

I took lots of sunset photographs in so many different locations for years.
Most of the times I was not alone in those places. And I was fortuned enough to see different people from different lives come together without any judgement, in a peaceful and welcoming mood.

We inhabit this planet with billions of unique minds. Some anxious, some cool, some curious, some fool...
It's possible to see our fingerprints in almost all the good and bad things. We are ruling this. No doubt. We covered such distance since the beginning of our evolution. Congrats to us but somehow we still can't leave some of our stupid bad habits. 
Not a coincidence though, we are fighting each other since beginning. Such a dumb thing but we can't get over it. 

The peaceful, awesome mood of sunsets and silhouette technique helped me to visualize human as a species without sub-characteristics to create this fine art photography collection. We are 'one' kind with many shades. 


''We came from the oceans...
For the sake of the sunlight..''

QmPRNF2pCvXuq276Sb3tf5EQcA5QRbV37PtUcUbn.name: Surreal Storyteller: Dreams and Nightmares of the Master
QmPRNF2pCvXuq276Sb3tf5EQcA5QRbV37PtUcUbn.description:
"In the United terminal in Chicago at five on a Friday afternoon
The sky is breaking with rain and wind and all the flights
Are delayed forever. We will never get to where we are going
And there’s no way back to where we’ve been.
The sun and the moon have disappeared to an island far from  anywhere.

Everybody has a heartache — "
---from Everybody Has a Heartache: A Blues by Joy Harjo

...

Surreal Storyteller is stranded in his own stories. He can not get to where he is going as that place is constructed via the story he tells. Lacking the necessary audience, Surreal Storyteller is stuck in a semi-permanent existence of de-construction and re-construction amidst his stories.

QmPZfLwJoNkDMLqZ986dTxLa7kt3WCpVZRBj8G17.name: ​​OUR FATHER IN THE METAVERSE #91
QmPZfLwJoNkDMLqZ986dTxLa7kt3WCpVZRBj8G17.description:
https://mathiasrusch-metaverse.com/

The "Our Father" - The cycle of paintings by artist Mathias Rusch (*1927-2003).   

If there is a most important prayer of Christian faith, then it must be the "Our Father".  
 
This prayer gift of Jesus to his disciples, later handed down to us Christians, has become the actual Christian self-understanding, the "prayer of the Lord". Packed into a few sentences, it has come to be regarded as the actual confession of faith and is prayed millions of times a day, both individually and in communities. The fact that this "conversation with God" has hardly ever been depicted (in contrast to the Passion) is probably due to the immense message it conveys. The fact that the painter Mathias Rusch dared to translate the "Our Father" can be explained by the fact that his daily work was based on faith, hope, and trust in God. Mathias Rusch was aware that he could only exist in the understanding of his art "as a gift of God". Most of his late works (Our Father, Live and Let Live, Sermon on the Mount, Lauretan Litany, Litany of the Sacred Heart) were written, as he confessed, under the "kind help" of the Highest, always accompanied by personal prayers, meditations or invocations. The fact that Mathias Rusch did not reveal a word for the interpretation of his works of art is to be justified by the fact that he understood himself to a large extent as a mediator of a higher power. Thus we are sometimes quite helplessly confronted with an immense abundance of Christian symbols, metaphysical allusions, concretizations, and abstractions, in unique hues and compositions. Completely in the sense of Mathias Rusch we dive before the 13 works of art into the enormous topic of earthly existence and Christian eschatology, marvel before the color power, before the hints, confessions, and convictions of the very deeply felt "Our Father's". Finally, we become humbled and ultimately grateful to be initiated into the world-prayer of a "knowing" believer, again and again, with each glance at each of these magnificent works of art. Whoever takes a longer "eye" look at this self-contained, unique complete work, consisting of 13 unique pieces in oil on canvas, 170x170cm, will not be able to resist a lasting effect and deep consternation.

QmPbox5BWs7PXWqZvRt8PC6UhMKJXCLWubmdNjBu.name: dynamic rule 1
QmPbox5BWs7PXWqZvRt8PC6UhMKJXCLWubmdNjBu.description:
A classic cellular automata updates its state with a static rule based on the state of its neighbor. This piece was created with cellular automata with an extension of that idea. Here the state and the rule are updated based on the state of its neighbor, here the rule changes in every iteration, here the rule is dynamic.

That change moves cellular automata to another level of complexity.

This piece is the result of years of exploration and experiments over that idea.

QmPbxTiZVzZVTCBE2xSvHUh5reLEBA4T9pzGSfKk.name: Exquisite Frank
QmPbxTiZVzZVTCBE2xSvHUh5reLEBA4T9pzGSfKk.description:
Have you ever heard of the game exquisite corpse? 

I really miss just sitting around with friends and drawing which is maybe why this game popped into my head recently and inspired this collaborative piece.

It's one of the only games I can think of where everyone wins, is purely creative, and has a surrealist twist. The rules of the game are changeable but it's usually played by folding a paper in thirds. The first person draws a head and folds the paper so the next person can't see what they drew. The next person draws a body and then folds the paper again before passing it to the last person to draw the legs. Each section of the drawing is usually done in a few minutes and are fun, strange, silly, and unexpected. 

After all three sections are drawn the paper is unfolded and the reveal is made for the first time, it's like magic! 

With "Exquisite Frank" you and the other layer owners collaborate by changing each section of Frank. The collectors are forever linked in a never ending game of exquisite corpse. With this exquisite corpse, because it is digital, you can even change the background and foreground separately in two different layers, mixing the elements of each to create an entirely unique landscape.

Hope everyone has fun playing with Exquisite Frank, especially the token holders.  And for anyone who knows the game, I hope this brings back some fond memories, and all of you playing it for the first time I hope it leads to creative play with your friends next time you are hanging out.

Stay creative and keep playing :)

About the structure of the piece - 

There are five layers:
-Background Layer
-Head Section 
-Body Section
-Legs Section
-Foreground Layer

There are 25 unique Franks divided in thirds by the head, body, and legs. 

There are also 5 black and white backgrounds and foregrounds that can be mixed and matched. Not only do the Franks change, but so does the environment. 

There are a total of 390,625 possible combinations.

QmPc7hxWiqA2Rb2K7WuhVuhW7zqj7CBWphGo7QHA.name: FORM FARM
QmPc7hxWiqA2Rb2K7WuhVuhW7zqj7CBWphGo7QHA.description:
FORM FARM yields rare architecture. The FARM has 25 collectible plots. Each plot comes with 15 form options that the owner can modify at any time. In order to successfully “farm” NFTs; plot owners must cooperate with their neighbors to align form-types (cubes, windows, staircases etc.) For example; aligning 3 windows in a row will signal the architect (untitled, xyz) to mint and airdrop a commemorative “window” themed NFT to the owner of each participating plot. Over time, FORM FARM owners are rewarded for their engagement and cooperation with one another. 

While the FARM can be used to earn NFTs, it also serves as a consensus mechanism to inform the broader artistic practice of untitled, xyz. Each form comes with a “build” or “burn” option. If a plot owner majority agrees to “burn” a window (for example); untitled, xyz will retire a window form that has been used in a previous artwork. Looking forward, that window form will never be used again. If plot owners agree to “build” a window; untitled, xyz will introduce a new style of window that has never existed before. 

Through FORM FARM, plot owners can earn NFTs while guiding the scarcity, abundance and overall evolution of xyz’s art.  

TIMING

A snapshot of the FORM FARM will take place on the 1st of every month at 12:00 AM UTC. At this time, a record of the FARM will be made and published to Twitter (@untitledxyz_) announcing how many new forms and NFTs will be airdropped to plot owners that month.

GUIDELINES

For a complete set of guidelines, visit: untitledxyz.com/formfarm

QmPcJ7qm9sfknM7sokrrJjLnWmFVh1zy395yR4Gp.name: / WHEN THINGS CHANGE INSIDE YOU, THINGS CHANGE AROUND YOU /
QmPcJ7qm9sfknM7sokrrJjLnWmFVh1zy395yR4Gp.description:
We live in a constant rush all the time, and the insatiability of success has been imposed on us unconsciously and consciously as an obligation.


This every day leads us to feel that we need more, that we want something more than what we have, that recognition is an obligation that we need in our lives. Success as an obligation.


What if I don't fit into that, if that's not what I want and need for myself?
Being brave, going against all that, is an act that I value too much. Being passionate about the topics that you like , and proclaiming it I see as a great daring, which not everyone dares to do.
Even if others may not agree, be yourself, that authenticity is what makes you special. If it's what balances you and makes you happy, it's what you have to fight for.

Go back to the basics, go after love, dreams, for a hug, for more smiles, take an unforgettable trip, and find yourself.

QmPeMzChamEY1zVVJpTKD3fv25xq3KkaEVZkF68o.name: Art Is The Currency of the Infinite

QmPfdQPhR2JHz53A5wa8TRmF95V1ZezfBvbromjU.name: Portraits Sans Temps
QmPfdQPhR2JHz53A5wa8TRmF95V1ZezfBvbromjU.description:
"...May she be granted beauty, and yet not   
Beauty to make a stranger's eye distraught,   
Or hers before a looking-glass; for such,   
Being made beautiful overmuch,   
Consider beauty a sufficient end,   
Lose natural kindness, and maybe   
The heart-revealing intimacy   
That chooses right, and never find a friend."
--- from A Prayer for My Daughter by W.B. Yeats

I have neither better, nor further words after Yeats. Let's have a look at the technicals..

...

Technical Notes:

Some of the base photographs are my photographs from the skulls in museums. Others are public domain images. In either case, each photograph has been two or three times edited since early 2000 before being considered for this final piece. Once I decided to include them, a final editing, notably in Photoshop, has been done.

While it resulted in slight imperfections and a lot of repeat work, I specifically chose 9 images and 9 states for it symbolized a grid total in my mind. Furthermore it allowed a very diverse set of visual outcomes that would range from unbearably bizarre to strikingly attractive.

Finally I spent considerable time in trying to decide on the layer images which ended up being possible alternative sets rather than layer specific line ups. Now I feel I have compressed 9 images, 9 layer images and countless possibilities in to one image. This is one of the strangest days of my life..

Portraits Sans Temps by Hulki Okan Tabak
Very exclusively, literally only for Async Art, 2021

This chips away precious moments they could have shared with their families and creates a massive imbalance that robs them of happiness.

QmPgNibYCXQkKv6CLntQmYQwSDrPxjvVnCdw3XfT.name: Mind Sketch I
QmPgNibYCXQkKv6CLntQmYQwSDrPxjvVnCdw3XfT.description:
"Almost happy now, he looked at his estate.
An exile making watches glanced up as he passed,
And went on working; where a hospital was rising fast
A joiner touched his cap; an agent came to tell
Some of the trees he'd planted were progressing well.
The white alps glittered. It was summer. He was very great."
--from the poem Voltaire at Ferney by W.H. Auden

Mind Sketch I is the first part of the mind sketches. Cerebral looking emotionally involved pieces of personal expression bullshit confusion love lost thoughts and experimentation. Purposefully quoting Auden whom I admire, specifically focusing on Voltaire for some reason or another.

Mind Sketch I consists of two pieces to be displayed half and half during the day and the night.

Minted on Async Art on June 2021 by Hulki Okan Tabak

38 States of a Young Woman is a generative study on an image itself created by mixing photography and other generative portraits.

There are 38 derivative images of which 28 are used to create 4 sets of images. The sets themselves are created in the order of image creation except for the 3 occasions (out of 28) when an image was replaced by one from the end of the list.

There are 7 sets of 4 images Day/Night cycles to be published on Async Art.

Athena Novo, 2022

QmPgpVSxQsdyoimqzfwHQpzrT6s3EhZYiuaqbkVg.name: Turris Aquae
QmPgpVSxQsdyoimqzfwHQpzrT6s3EhZYiuaqbkVg.description:
Flying jellyfish, ravenous bird plants, and gravity-defying submarines, emerged from the deep waters of Spelunca Mons, A.K.A. Cave Mountain. The council decreed a tower city be built to observe and guard the realm against the fearsome magical creatures. But night after night, and day after day, the creatures that poured forth from the caves beneath the water amazed the city folk. They did not plague the nearby villages and they did not attack a soul. They moved with elegance and purpose.

The caves were never understood. Nor were they explored by those living in the city above. However, they continued to spawn all sorts of magical beings. Before long, Turris Aquae became a place of healing. The waters were considered holy, the creatures considered good, and the fish were delicacies exported to realms far and wide.

This NFT changes how it looks based on the time of day. It has a different image for day, night, sunrise, and sunset.
Size: 2160 × 3840px.

QmPknaUweJNyJXZ5BUHfS8UYdHzXhynKcrukF3SP.name: Fractals 042 + 021 | Gravity
QmPknaUweJNyJXZ5BUHfS8UYdHzXhynKcrukF3SP.description:
The balance between the two forms represented in the day state refers to the attraction of gravity, this omnipresent force from which all life is organizing itself on earth. 
The night state deals with the force of gravity. The colored rings converge in the same direction like gravitational fields, simultaneously defining a top and a bottom, a depth and a space.
Sunrise state is very abstract. It has a particularly rich and complex texture. Its rendering is of a monochromatic gray while it is composed of a multitude of saturated colors. It looks like waves emanating from a very distant center or converging in an abyss.
Sunset set evokes the complexity of the fluids that continuously interact around us. Winds, tides, but also all sorts of invisible forces like gravity or magnetic fields.

A part of ourselves in there..

QmPvrErJfY8udSMRqarEMcBhiXsWKudxD1JQAP89.description:
New York Polaroids: Red Smoke Takes Shape over Steel, Concrete and Men

2 Artworks in 1 Daily Cycle

New York Polaroids by Athena Novo, Summer of 2022, An Alternative New York during the NFT Summit, Minted 1/1 on Async Art

While everyone was enjoying the NFT Summit, a different group of visitors were in New York. Some call them demons, monsters and zombies while I would prefer more neutral terms but nonetheless here are some of the photographs I've taken of them which I release with full disclosure and their cooperation. The prospective collectors should acknowledge the existence of "undead" and some even more exotic characters might cause some alarm among the general population. Therefore viewer caution is warranted even though most of these peoples I met during the NFT Summit seemed to be of absolutely good character (not sure about some demonic entities that did not respond) and interested in art and its manifestation with the technologies branded aptly as NFT and what not.

QmPxNNSP4okduq83exbifpck2hAu3vbd9BCDbo6b.name: Childhood Memories of WW
QmPxNNSP4okduq83exbifpck2hAu3vbd9BCDbo6b.description: I have been creating images of icons from my childhood memory in a thematic series called 'what are they looking at." While exploring these images I realized that a kind of education happened from watching these images in pop culture and I began to paint them using the hybrid approaches of both analogue and digital processes. As I was painting, I reflected on those distant fuzzy memories of seeing these icons on TV, going to their concerts, and reading about them in teen magazines. What had they taught me? This series originally painted on found glass represents those TV screens and, in turn, the iPhone and computer screens we look at now. I invite the viewer to look through this personal homage to my childhood pop iconsand reflect on how culture has changed, how the messaging has regressed and consider what are we looking at now?

QmQ1upayG5BbaF6wzaSSjWQfqRa9KzuNMzKB2TNX.name: Experimental No.1 #3074
QmQ1upayG5BbaF6wzaSSjWQfqRa9KzuNMzKB2TNX.description: Changes is the only thing that hasn’t been changed. From time to space to the thoughts of human beings are constantly changing. I transformed a Silver Gelatin Photogram (a piece of physical photograph made of alternative photographic processes) into a digital image that even can produce endless changes. This is based on the change in my way of seeing the world. It is difficult for individuals to completely isolate themselves from their own inherent culture, this ingrained imprint not only stems from families but also social and historical influences. Besides, the rapid innovation of science and technologies directly drives the world today to inevitably facing collisions and fusions in multiculturalism. Studying classical philosophical text allows me to apply the dialectical method to tease those open questions, and finally ground on my artworks. All things complement each other and balance in the collision. Changes is the key. Isn’t the development of human civilization that come to the present evolve in indistinct ways?

It is difficult for individuals to completely isolate themselves from their own inherent culture, this ingrained imprint not only stems from families but also social and historical influences. Besides, the rapid innovation of science and technologies directly drives the world today to inevitably facing collisions and fusions in multiculturalism. Studying classical philosophical text allows me to apply the dialectical method to tease those open questions, and finally ground on my artworks. All things complement each other and balance in the collision. Changes is the key. Isn’t the development of human civilization that come to the present evolve in indistinct ways?

QmQ3Ww9GcmirwBsogFqtYfpnUshG1jyNox3qaoGh.name: Landscape Study #1 (with Visitor)
QmQ3Ww9GcmirwBsogFqtYfpnUshG1jyNox3qaoGh.description:
In the spirit of British landscape artists - your Constables, Turners, and Wilsons - this programmable painting features studies of breathtaking parts of the UK.

Views such as these are rarely empty of modern human activity. More popular areas are likely to receive an overwhelming number of visitors, though some might see just a few each day.

From ornately-framed originals in national gallery spaces, to an unframed canvas reproduction hung in your grandparent's kitchen - romantic landscape paintings can be found in a broad range of settings, and are often regarded as timeless.

A key inspiration for this particular artwork is Anglesey Abbey - a National Trust property in Cambridge, UK - which has an entire wing seemingly dedicated to Lord Fairhaven's collection of Windsor Castle paintings.

QmQ7FauJZP6idUF6ReNecYp2D7J9WnHESNR35dgX.description:
Monsters & Mythology: Zmaj by Mad Monk

4 pieces minted as 1/1 on Async Art

Conceptualized, Created and Minted 2022

...

Zmaj (Zmaj or Dragon) is known in almost all World's cultures. However Zmaj in Slavic folklore is represented as rather benign creature, created from certain animals which lived up to 30 or 100 years (rooster, carp, horse, ox, ram or dog). It always had either one or even number of heads and traits from animal that it borrowed. It fought against Azhdaya and it was invisible to everybody, except to woman whom he falls in love. Relationship between Zmaj and human women could bring zmajevite children (Dragonborn children) and they differed from humans by having large head or eyes and tiny wings under their armpits.

https://mythus.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_Slavic_creatures#Zmaj

QmQ8rSfVCgotJ4T1GdmUmqVTuhipSjM6gSSk6yZ7.name: “Morpheus and Iris”
QmQ8rSfVCgotJ4T1GdmUmqVTuhipSjM6gSSk6yZ7.description:
Inspired in Morpheus and Iris,  painted in 1811 by Pierre-Narcisse Guérin.

This painting most probably relates to the Roman poet Ovid’s version of the tale of Alcyone and Ceyx.

Ceyx dies during a storm at sea, and so the goddess Juno decides that his wife, Alcyone, must be informed of his passing with all haste. Iris, the messenger goddess, is dispatched by Juno to Somnus, the personification of sleep, with instructions that Alcyone should be told that very night in a dream.

Somnus sends forth his son, Morpheus, god of sleep and dreams, who changes his appearance to match that of Ceyx, and enters the dream world of Alcyone.

Dripping with seawater, Morpheus, as Ceyx, tells Alcyone of his passing, and commands that funeral rites are undertaken. In her dream, Alcyone attempts to grab hold of her husband, but as she goes to touch Morpheus, so she awakens; but Morpheus has done his job, for Alcyone now knows that she is a widow.

For all Matrix fans this is how the character Morpheus’ name was chosen, in reference to the god of dreams, as the Matrix world was merely a form of dream.

QmQ9WnumCdnQnLFPXS2QWKAZyM7uNbstvZYgY74s.name: / ONE MORE PETAL /
QmQ9WnumCdnQnLFPXS2QWKAZyM7uNbstvZYgY74s.description:
Inspired in “He Loves Me, He Loves Me Not” painted by Robert Fowler (1853-1926).

‘He/she loves me, he/she loves me not’ is a game of French origin initially called ‘effeuiller la marguerite’ (‘strip the daisy’).

In the original French version of the game, the petals do not simply indicate whether the object of the player's affection loves them, but to what extent: un peu or "a little", beaucoup or "a lot", passionnément or "passionately", à la folie or "to madness", or pas du tout or "not at all."

However the poor girl in this painting looks like her daisy needed one more petal!.

QmQAaHRrwMbJXsrvT7c3THqFPpZeK1FFVRGQuHkb.name: The Old Tower
QmQAaHRrwMbJXsrvT7c3THqFPpZeK1FFVRGQuHkb.description:
"Once there were people here. More people than you'd ever believe. More people than Earth has seen since the day or.. Or even until now. They lived in this huge tower. Kind of like the massive multi purpose high rises they have in China these days. But bigger as there was not exactly an end in sight. I mean if you looked at it it was a structure. Defined with boundaries and all that. However when you tried to find the end of, the last floor for example, it was an effort in vain. In The Old Tower, the end as well as the beginning were all elusive, at best an ouroboros." 
--excerpt from Interviews with Walter, A Mindread by J.J.F. Nokihufo

...

Final images rendered from my photography with AI asisstance.

QmQAg6Pe6FwZLsAQMTykGQYLY2iqaZ6jUVF8UawF.name: A Disappeared Movement   一场消失的运动
QmQAg6Pe6FwZLsAQMTykGQYLY2iqaZ6jUVF8UawF.description:
"A Disappeared Movement" is a performance art project in which the artist acts as a guide and leads the participants to disappear from Xingfu Street. It was launched in 2020, in which the artist spent 6 months investigating the surveillance in the Xingfu Street district in Beijing. He delved into the blind spots of each surveillance camera, creating a set of maps that enable participants to avoid surveillance, and releasing it to the public for free. Later, a fire of wide spread social controversy was ignited due to the reports from multiple world media, such as BBC, SCMP HongKong, France Télévisions, The Globe and Mail, The Times, Dutch Telegraph, Tokyo Shimbun, etc. Subsequently, the Chinese government intervened, investigating all participants of the art project and giving them admonition. Since then, reports and exhibitions of "A Disappeared Movement" have been banned in China.  
Now "A Disappeared Movement" will forever exist on the Blockchain as a piece of Programmable Art.

《一场消失的运动》是艺术家邓玉峰在 2020 年花 6 个月的时间调查北京的幸福大街街区的所有摄像头,并研究每个摄像头的死角,创作一套能躲避摄像头监视的路线图,免费给大众使用。艺术家以“导游”的方式带领参与者一起消失在幸福大街的行为艺术项目。后因 BBC、香港南华早报、法国电视台、加拿大环球邮报、 英国泰晤士报、荷兰电讯报、日本东京新闻等几十家的世界媒体的报道引发了广泛的社会争议。 随后，中国警方介入，对艺术项目的所有参与者进行调查并给予警告。 此后，“消失的运动”的报道和展览在中国被禁止。
现在《一场消失的运动》以可编程艺术的形式永远存在于区块链上。

QmQCajAh9KDdoAN7jxNVBrYxzSqSSnHRbqY8Eujp.name: “Untitled #3”, from “Slits in Depth” series (2020/ 2022)
QmQCajAh9KDdoAN7jxNVBrYxzSqSSnHRbqY8Eujp.description:
“Untitled #3” is part of the series of 3D stereographic photo collages “Slits in Depth”, by Pedro Victor Brandão, that since 2020 is being minted on async.art as dynamic compositions that alternate interior and exterior spaces in impossible perspectives, leveraged by the programmable features of the platform.

Created in the third pandemic year, this work was commissioned by Pivô for the exhibition "Guided tour", curated by the curatorial platform aarea (founded by Livia Benedetti and Marcela Vieira). "Guided tour'' is the edition #4 of Pivô Satélite program. In addition to Pedro Victor Brandão, artists Gabriel Junqueira, Júlia Rocha and Gabriel Massan also participate in the project. The artists were invited to create correspondences between Pivô's digital space and its exhibition space in the Copan Building, located in São Paulo.

The composition “Untitled #3” is made up of a frontal element together with two other images: an Adiantum twig photographed in front of a mirror; and two backgrounds: a cloudy sky and an interior environment of one of Pivô's galleries. During the 24 hours of the day, one background is gradually replaced by another. When viewed with red and cyan anaglyph glasses (red lens on the left eye), elements pop off the screen.

During the exhibition period of the work on Pivô's website (March 23rd to April 24th, 2022), visitors can sign a document with their non-custodial wallet to enter the giveaway of the work.

Pivô Satélite can be accessed at https://www.pivo.org.br/en/satellite/
________________________________________________

“Sem Título #3” faz parte da série de fotocolagens estereográficas 3D “Cortes em Profundidade", de Pedro Victor Brandão, que desde 2020 tem sido emitida no async.art como composições dinâmicas que alternam espaços interiores e exteriores em perspectivas impossíveis a partir das funcionalidades programáveis da plataforma. 

Criado já no terceiro ano pandêmico, este trabalho foi comissionado pelo Pivô para a exposição "Visita guiada", curada pela plataforma curatorial aarea (fundada por Livia Benedetti e Marcela Vieira). "Visita guiada" é a edição #4 do programa Pivô Satélite. Além de Pedro Victor Brandão, participam também do projeto xs artistas Gabriel Junqueira, Júlia Rocha e Gabriel Massan. Xs artistas foram convidadxs a criar correspondências entre o espaço digital do Pivô e seu espaço expositivo no Edifício Copan, localizado em São Paulo. 

A composição de “Sem Título #3” é feita de um elemento frontal junto a duas outras imagens: um galho de avenca fotografado em frente a um espelho; e dois fundos: um céu nebuloso e um ambiente interno de uma das galerias do Pivô. Durante as 24 horas do dia, um fundo é gradualmente substituído por outro. Quando vistos com um óculos anáglifo vermelho e ciano (lente vermelha no olho esquerdo), os elementos saltam da tela. 

Durante o período de exibição do trabalho no website do Pivô (23 de março a 24 de abril de 2022), visitantes podem assinar um documento com sua carteira não-custodial para concorrer ao sorteio do trabalho.

Pivô Satélite pode ser acessado em https://www.pivo.org.br/satelite/

Pedro Victor Brandão
MAR 2022

QmQEEGTcbdsEqidQ3FoQzxiB7oGVSf6kKNiYtV9s.name: Wave
QmQEEGTcbdsEqidQ3FoQzxiB7oGVSf6kKNiYtV9s.description:
If we lose a loved one, are they gone forever? 

A human being is a pattern of information moving through spacetime as a wave. The matter that makes you is ever changing as you absorb and expel molecules throughout each day. Every 7-10 years almost all the cells in your body will have been replaced. You are not a physical thing. You are a pattern. 

Your pattern is not contained by your physical form. Your actions in this world will connect and intertwine your pattern with- and into the minds of others. 

When you die, some details of your pattern will be lost - but all those whose minds you’ve touched, will still hold you within them.

A memory is a physical pattern of strengthened connections between neurons in a brain. For as long as your memory is carried, your pattern will still exist in this world. Still affecting people, their actions, their dreams and their future.  

Your thoughts, values and aspirations can still propagate long after your physical form has ceased to exist. Immortality is possible, but it is up to you to set it in motion.

QmQETjvwQybCo1fvGUWjoJ2uTQE7GmaNP7ijK8m5.name: Kids Takeover Putin: Nova Apartchik #2
QmQETjvwQybCo1fvGUWjoJ2uTQE7GmaNP7ijK8m5.description:
Based on Putin photography, Kids Takeover Putin is text-to-image experimentation on war, peace and leadership. It is re-creating the leadership in the eyes of a kid takeover for peace.

Stop the War. We hoped, I hoped this was already the past in Europe. We should not go back.

There is a lot of interesting material that range from childish and peaceful to satirical and dark. I will post them and perhaps I will post most of them hoping this ends as soon as possible.

This is one of the 12 2-piece Nova Apartchiks on Async Art. There is also 1 24 piece set and some 4-piece somewhat more abstract pieces on Async Art. For multi editions and some other 1/1s, please visit my collection on KnownOrigin.

by Mad Monk, 1/1 on Async Art, 2022

QmQEawx3Pwkh46P7H8c8ndfdi34zY1KxQ7EYqs5M.name: MARTYRIUM
QmQEawx3Pwkh46P7H8c8ndfdi34zY1KxQ7EYqs5M.description:
"Martyrium" is a 24 hour journey of personal purgatorial visions. 
Thinking about the Aristotelian Metaphysics and Ethics. 
The rediscovery of these works in the middle ages by the scholastic philosophers shaped the assumptions and beliefs of what lies beyond.

"Martyrium" updates four times a day.
"The Fall" brings "The Punishment".
"The Punishment" leads to "Repentance".
And finally "Deliverance", a direct reference to "The Creation of Adam" by Michelangelo di Lodovico Buonarroti Simoni.

QmQLJoDdDpLkCYagRhqA1ms98Ne9WcYotnAGyhR8.name: GM_GA_GE_GN
QmQLJoDdDpLkCYagRhqA1ms98Ne9WcYotnAGyhR8.description:
Good Morning, Good Afternoon, Good Evening, Good Night! 

Right now on Twitter, as you're reading this, someone is tweeting their followers one of these salutations.  In the 24/7, internationally connected NFT world, these simple greetings connect us all. 

This piece has 4 states, each representing one greeting. The female figure represents anticipation, confidence, and solitude. 

Her pose, similar to Degas "Little Dancer" sculpture, is, perhaps, an exercise in patients while she awaits for what's next.

Dimension: 3840 pixel x 3840 pixel
Type of Work: GANs Algorithm trained photograph
Date of Dataset: 2010-2017
Edition: Unique

The photographs in the series of Regeneration produced by using Generative Adversarial Networks. I took over three thousand photos spanned nearly a decade for a specific project and selected over a thousand photos from there as the Dataset for AI training. The photographs have been gestated by AI that integrated all the subtle emotions of the original pieces, which are the most exciting parts of this series.

QmQUKC9c1q5mzZpvFpgWEXw4UxDXqLrEu2VzYxwD.name: EXPANSION #TRSX1
QmQUKC9c1q5mzZpvFpgWEXw4UxDXqLrEu2VzYxwD.description:
For the series EXPANSION, an artificial intelligence script was asked to expand an image of a high-rise building, only using the information available to it in the image itself. 
In the 24-hour transition, the expansion increases each hour, becoming more and more chaotic and overwhelmingly uninhabitable.
Loss of identity, but at the same time discovering an aesthetic appeal to this deconstructed reality are central to this.

QmQUyaMTvT53FCy262pC8QZG2xjkKpu7bGiuaaPy.description:
Art from nodes and edges of 32k rows of data from 2020 US presidential election. County / Presidential nominees / Party.

Artist Portfolio: https://www.flatarc.io/potus

​The idea of making artworks with data is my quest to engage people in stories not just by looking at a picture but also delve into historical stories (big datasets). Adding more narrative/artistic elements to it. With this, it’s possible to take complex data from almost anything that's around us and use that to create a storytelling art experience.

QmQY4vZJ1chjZ97ro8GQFkMbr7AmJCcDdtuEZLHX.name: Page One
QmQY4vZJ1chjZ97ro8GQFkMbr7AmJCcDdtuEZLHX.description:
Page One is a collaborative writing device composed of 75 layers and a combined 1636 states.  The goal is to collectively work together to publish pages which will subsequently be made into another artwork. Page One has various positions to choose from including WRITERS, EDITORS, TITLE and VETO. Two other positions PAGE and STATUS are controlled by the creator. 

For a more comprehensive guide, or to see the current progress written by Page One, please visit: https://www.bottlesartwork.com/pageone

QmQamfcqPuj661Hp2XLnRChzm1NmNg9eez5RC7d8.name: In my end is my beginning
QmQamfcqPuj661Hp2XLnRChzm1NmNg9eez5RC7d8.description:
Memento Mori
"Remember that you must die."

A piece exploring life, death and rebirth. This artwork is composed of 24 images that change every hour, as life transitions into death. The work is then reborn with each new day and the cycle begins again.

Inspired by the final words of Mary Queen of Scots "In my End is my Beginning", and featuring her skull-shaped 'Memento Mori' watch.

Digital painting created in Photoshop.

QmQd8tn46uYBfGEU52k4VLYngpentB7Yr68zwpZb.name: 24h Samedi / Merge Down
QmQd8tn46uYBfGEU52k4VLYngpentB7Yr68zwpZb.description:
BRIEF: “Hot, Hot, Hot!” is a collection of static and animated digital art reflecting on love, longing, and existential loneliness. A self-exploration of the feminine form; an introspective odyssey upon the digital seas only touching briefly the sensual shores of the real world. Named after each of the 7 days of the week in French &  English words/phrases; this piece represents 1 day consisting of: 1 primary static image + 5 alternate glitch states (used to create a separate animation). 

BACKGROUND: 

For millennia the feminine form has been appropriated, commodified, objectified, curated, policed, and brutalized by men and for the male gaze. 

Today, unconditional self-acceptance of feminine bodies remains an act of radical self-love and still carries risk of violence in a deeply misogynist culture. The luxury of safe self-expression is elusive; only further complicated by age, color, creed, sex, gender, ability, sexuality, and class. Whether it be in real or digital spaces, feminine bodies are treated with a spectrum of toxic hostile reactions from self-appointed patriarchal enforcers who take it upon themselves to steal joy, love, life, and happiness from any female (sex or gendered) persons that exercise their self-sovereignty in public or private; real or digital spaces. Despite the culture of terror, the feminine aspect of humanity is asserting herself and sisters are embodying in their power.

INQUIRY: 

When the last grain of dust settles on the digital frontier what will the real world look and feel like? Will NFB’s (non-fungible-beings) and their fleshy forms be treasured or despised? Will the real world lay in rubble? Does a world still reeling from the pandemic return to desperately pressing flesh against flesh; or will glass, silicone, and electricity be the sole comforts accessible to those inside of a deepening dystopian nightmare? 

What does love, intimacy, and vulnerability look and feel like in the future? How does it feel in the present? Will the essential need of skin to skin contact between human beings drive our species to create teleportation devices out of sheer desperation? As HD gives way to 4K, 6K, 8K, Augmented Reality, and Virtual Reality, how far can we, and will we, push ourselves across the world; across the universe — at the speed of light — in search of love?

QmQdPufmpuDhQpVhivhgUbdj8LpuidjH7YjQydKc.name: Stellar Goddesses
QmQdPufmpuDhQpVhivhgUbdj8LpuidjH7YjQydKc.description:
Have you ever gazed up at the sky and wondered what magical mysteries lie above? Who is in control when the yellow sun that shines bright or when the blue moon appears at night, glowing, surrounded by stars? What if I told you that there are goddesses up above blessing us with their magical, stellar aura everyday? Do you believe in stellar goddesses? 

With this piece, it will alternate between Stellar Goddess and Cosmic Consciousness depending on our actual time of day in the real world.

ABOUT THE ARTIST:

My name is Shaylin Wallace or Shay the Surrealist and this is my second tokenized NFT artwork! I specializes in creating surreal, yet minimal compositions by manipulating stock images using Adobe Photoshop. In 2014, I started editing images on apps such as PicsArt and Union App and overtime, I found my passion which is manipulating images in surrealistic ways. In 2017, I saved up enough money to purchase my very first laptop and soon after got an Adobe subscription and downloaded Photoshop! Since then, I have designed hundreds of unique photo-manipulations and many amazing series as well. Welcome to my Imagination.
Warning: Your Mind May Be Blown Away!

Check out more of my artwork: https://www.smwvisuals.com/photo-manipulations 

Thank you in advance if you collect this piece!
Shaylin Wallace | https://www.smwvisuals.com/
