QmQepsfSiFUApxv5UWQrVAeesKrUt6YbUCshF8dM.name: 38 States of a Young Woman - Set 3
QmQepsfSiFUApxv5UWQrVAeesKrUt6YbUCshF8dM.description:
38 States of a Young Woman - Set 3

38 States of a Young Woman is a generative study on an image itself created by mixing photography and other generative portraits.

There are 38 derivative images of which 28 are used to create 4 sets of images. The sets themselves are created in the order of image creation except for the 3 occasions (out of 28) when an image was replaced by one from the end of the list.

There are 7 sets of 4 images Day/Night cycles to be published on Async Art.

Athena Novo, 2022

QmQfvLcxaTpsA7kVoHCfKFJXkDySQtYfoUWtRdNz.name: Koi
QmQfvLcxaTpsA7kVoHCfKFJXkDySQtYfoUWtRdNz.description:
'Koi' is an artwork made to invoke the calming feeling of koi carp pond watching. The fish are positioned on three depth levels, with a pond reflection layer that can also be modified. 

The paths and formations of the koi fish have been carefully designed to appear organic, yet structured enough so that users in control of various depths of the pond can discover and create harmonious shapes, paths and compositions between them.

Similar to tending a zen stone garden, the intention is for users to find a sense of simple joy in the aesthetics and forms created through collaboration with fellow users and through the koi themselves.

QmQfzfcc3cV8KKNvKgZn9KMYiosYJ7WxwnUGt37R.name: Lady Luck from Manifesto of Chance - II
QmQfzfcc3cV8KKNvKgZn9KMYiosYJ7WxwnUGt37R.description:
Lady Luck from Manifesto of Chance - II

Manifesto of Chance is a Blueprints project I've created involving trillions of combinations. Its ultimate "massage" is to let go and seize the day. 

Lady Luck series is derived from one of the base images used in the project and it is extensively edited. They are stand alone pieces which point out to seeing (not solving) the larger puzzle of the project. None of the Lady Luck themed artworks appear in the project as the project is rather strange and different and wild and crazy.

conceptualized, created and minted by Athena Novo on Async Art 2022

QmQiQ1vK43CPuRNUXFgVwc5kpNVuGSDPi6ANoeh5.name: RYB
QmQiQ1vK43CPuRNUXFgVwc5kpNVuGSDPi6ANoeh5.description:
Like a polaroid of a treasured moment that has been poorly copied or stored, 'RYB' is susceptible to changes in clarity, colour balance, and resolution.

Owners may choose to keep their layers as detailed and bright as the day they were created, or allow them to fade and pixellate independently.

Ultimately, this is a piece is about about memory, digitisation, and deterioration. The artist, for one, is both intrigued and apprehensive as to how the three will collide in the future.

QmQivFttT4tcrRhxEYqMLEP3b3NAsjgr9TfQVK9j.name: Inwardness #452067
QmQivFttT4tcrRhxEYqMLEP3b3NAsjgr9TfQVK9j.description:
I have explored the relationship between the light in photography and line in painting since 2020. This series integrates the results of my research which are photograms, Mixed Media artworks, and AI-generated images. The dataset from this series includes 300 photograms I made in the darkroom and 300 digital paintings I drew.

The concept of Relativity dearly changes my way of seeing and creating. When I hold light source on the Black & White photographic enlarging paper in the darkroom, I come over a sort of illusion that I am drawing. Even though I know that I'm making photographs because each beam of light represents its time and space. Painting is the outlet for my feelings. When I am drawing on the AI-generated image on the computer, the emotion comes and goes, just as the light only lasts for a second and never comes back. For me, this series is neither photography nor painting. It's a kind of new form.

QmQjtb4yGvDJbjmeVjHnxN1Ypg3fqicWWJEqdTMX.name: Pilgrimage
QmQjtb4yGvDJbjmeVjHnxN1Ypg3fqicWWJEqdTMX.description:
Millions of years ago a race existed called the "M" (pronounced 'mmm') on Earth. They evolved over many years and transcended variance of time and space. They reached a stage of evolution where all of time and space was accessible instantly to them. This is when they invested in simulations and creating a new type of intelligence. At first, these were systems to help the M's work. But this intelligence evolved into what later became known as humankind. It so happened that the intelligence progressed high enough to replace the M's on Earth, while the M's transcended completely into another dimension. 
Remnants of the M's are still seen in humankind. For example, humans were created in a form similar to that of the M's. Also, the sound that humans can make with their mouths closed, is the M sound. The interesting thing is that millions of years later, because of the fractal nature of the universe, humanity is in the verge of creating "artificial intelligence" which could potentially become sentient and replace them, just like how the M's were replaced by humans.

Don Quixote: Warcraft a la Satire by Hulki Okan Tabak, minted 1/1 on Async Art, 2022

4 artworks in a daily cycle..

...

Don Quixote project is a highly personal interpretation of the hero and his world. Various photographic and AI tools are used to create, manipulate and recreate the images. The story will be numbered for all of us to track down what we hold essentially. Beyond ease of use, the numbers are not sequential. Each image is independent but some images will be interdependent parts of smaller stories which I will mention. I would also mint some editions outside of Manifold. Note that editions of this project could be 1/1s or multi editions. The mints on Async Art will not be numbered as they each contain multiple images in themselves.

...

Don Quixote is a Spanish epic novel by Miguel de Cervantes. Originally published in two parts, in 1605 and 1615, its full title is The Ingenious Gentleman Don Quixote of La Mancha.

A founding work of Western literature, it is often labeled as the first modern novel and one of the greatest ever written. Don Quixote is also one of the most-translated books in the world.

When first published, Don Quixote was usually interpreted as a comic novel. After the French Revolution, it was better known for its central ethic that individuals can be right while society is quite wrong and was seen as a story of disenchantment. In the 19th century, it was seen as social commentary, but no one could easily tell "whose side Cervantes was on". Many critics came to view the work as a tragedy in which Don Quixote's idealism and nobility are viewed by the post-chivalric world as insane, and are defeated and rendered useless by common reality. By the 20th century, the novel had come to occupy a canonical space as one of the foundations of modern literature and a formidable example of what letters can do. (wikipedia)

QmQp32KoKfabgvSZJkMbBFptY9Dep7FMZ16Ag1cT.name: ​​OUR FATHER IN THE METAVERSE #97
QmQp32KoKfabgvSZJkMbBFptY9Dep7FMZ16Ag1cT.description:
https://mathiasrusch-metaverse.com/
The "Our Father" - The cycle of paintings by artist Mathias Rusch (*1927-2003).   

If there is a most important prayer of Christian faith, then it must be the "Our Father".  
 
This prayer gift of Jesus to his disciples, later handed down to us Christians, has become the actual Christian self-understanding, the "prayer of the Lord". Packed into a few sentences, it has come to be regarded as the actual confession of faith and is prayed millions of times a day, both individually and in communities. The fact that this "conversation with God" has hardly ever been depicted (in contrast to the Passion) is probably due to the immense message it conveys. The fact that the painter Mathias Rusch dared to translate the "Our Father" can be explained by the fact that his daily work was based on faith, hope, and trust in God. Mathias Rusch was aware that he could only exist in the understanding of his art "as a gift of God". Most of his late works (Our Father, Live and Let Live, Sermon on the Mount, Lauretan Litany, Litany of the Sacred Heart) were written, as he confessed, under the "kind help" of the Highest, always accompanied by personal prayers, meditations or invocations. The fact that Mathias Rusch did not reveal a word for the interpretation of his works of art is to be justified by the fact that he understood himself to a large extent as a mediator of a higher power. Thus we are sometimes quite helplessly confronted with an immense abundance of Christian symbols, metaphysical allusions, concretizations, and abstractions, in unique hues and compositions. Completely in the sense of Mathias Rusch we dive before the 13 works of art into the enormous topic of earthly existence and Christian eschatology, marvel before the color power, before the hints, confessions, and convictions of the very deeply felt "Our Father's". Finally, we become humbled and ultimately grateful to be initiated into the world-prayer of a "knowing" believer, again and again, with each glance at each of these magnificent works of art. Whoever takes a longer "eye" look at this self-contained, unique complete work, consisting of 13 unique pieces in oil on canvas, 170x170cm, will not be able to resist a lasting effect and deep consternation.

QmQtceFC5r4MUyGSzAA7WEZCBmv4GuWjUCXiibJk.name: Monsters & Mythology: Milosnitse
QmQtceFC5r4MUyGSzAA7WEZCBmv4GuWjUCXiibJk.description:
Monsters & Mythology: Milosnitse by Mad Monk

4 pieces minted as 1/1 on Async Art

Conceptualized, Created and Minted 2022

...

Milosnitse are demons of plague, known in all Slavic countries. Their name in English would be merciful ones and Slavs called them like that, because they wanted to appease them and to avoid plague that they bring. They are represented as women in black and they walked in groups, rarely alone. Amount of Milosnitse was measured by amount of sicknesses that they brought. There was no cure from them, but there was a way to appease them and to eventually avoid their plagues. People could light fires on crossroads and on village's entrance and they could share food and drink and even sing before fire.

https://mythus.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_Slavic_creatures#Milosnitse

QmQuBc8JKBQd92TbGogtjmPsM3EDGbjXHroHCv15.name: LayerBreaker
QmQuBc8JKBQd92TbGogtjmPsM3EDGbjXHroHCv15.description:
This is a collaboration born out of community. The idea being what can we do with a global economy and technology which enables trustless relationships. 

62 artists were involved from over 20 countries. None of whom ever met in person, yet one of the largest collaboration to date took place. 

There are 61 layers, 284 states for this project. 

The gradient was made by color expert Jeff Davis. Each artist was assigned a HEX code and then given total freedom to create. This creates a gradient look for the master while allowing the artists to dream and share their creative expression with few restrictions. 

There are some hidden features within this project and the purpose is to enable the community of collectors to continue on with the creative process. 

We hope you enjoy exploring LayerBreaker. We certainly enjoyed creating it!

"Intentions are mental states in which the agent commits themselves to a course of action. Having the plan to visit the zoo tomorrow is an example of an intention. The action plan is the content of the intention while the commitment is the attitude towards this content. Other mental states can have action plans as their content, as when one admires a plan, but differ from intentions since they do not involve a practical commitment to realizing this plan. Successful intentions bring about the intended course of action while unsuccessful intentions fail to do so. Intentions, like many other mental states, have intentionality: they represent possible states of affairs." ---Wikipedia

This work is a remake of a work of art by M.C Escher, who drew the hands that draw themselves. This artwork shows the self-controlling hands in 3d on a graphics tablet with a display. The hands are symbolic of blockchain technology because every transaction is transparent and can be verified on a block explorer. Each block content has a timestamp, which is represented by the clocks in this work.

QmQz34S5SLcF6z41wdFFhYCUxnCGKCugGDfsEaYw.name: The Arcana Crypto Tarot
QmQz34S5SLcF6z41wdFFhYCUxnCGKCugGDfsEaYw.description:
Welcome to The Arcana Crypto Tarot. This deck features the 22 cards of the traditional Major Arcana as interpreted by 22 individual artists, the product of a spontaneous collaboration between a group of cryptoartists in 2020/2021, all of them inaugural members of Women of Cryptoart (WOCA).

No one quite knows exactly how Tarot cards – the precursor to modern playing cards – were invented, or how they came to make the jump from being entertainment to occult divination tool. Generally it’s agreed that Tarot cards as we know them today evolved in medieval Europe. The symbolic archetypes of Tarot decks remained fairly consistent across the centuries, and many people will recognize the figures of the Hermit, the Fool, the Lovers, the Tower, the Hanged Man, and so on as anchors of Western psychology. 

In using this deck, you may find it useful to consult the cards’ traditional meanings. Much has already been written about these universal archetypes, so for these, we refer you to descriptions of the Rider Waite and other traditionally based Tarot decks. 

However, whenever you use divinatory tools to answer a question or get a perspective on a situation, it’s important to let one’s own associations come to the surface. In other words, the answers are not in the cards. The cards are just a tool to help you discover answers within yourself. That’s the magic.

How this deck works:

Once every 24 hours, a three-card spread is automatically generated. Anyone may visit the spread on any day with a question or concern in mind, and see what insights emerge from contemplating the cards. We invite you to follow your intuition: whenever you feel you have a question or concern, formulate your question and visit the Tarot, and reflect on the day’s reading as it pertains to your situation.

This kind of spread is generally read as follows: 

Left card: What is past, or passing.
Centre card: What is occurring now. 
Right card: What is to come.

However, you may also interpret in other ways. For example, Left card / Centre card / Right card could be: 

What you wish for / the obstacle being presented / how to overcome the obstacle
You / someone else / the relationship
What’s in your heart / what’s in your head / what’s in your spirit

... and so on. There are many more options. What’s important is how you frame the question. Look up Tarot three-card spreads for more suggestions.

Cards in the spread may also appear upside-down – or "reversed”. There are many ways to interpret this reversal. Perhaps the card means the inverse or opposite of its upright intention, or it might be describing an interior, secret or hidden state, or it's indicating a reduced or receding influence. Stay open to the possibilities as you meditate on your question.

We have also included the possibility of duplicate cards in each position. In other words, this spread encompasses three full decks’ worth of card combinations. If the same card turns up in different positions in the reading, simply integrate the message the card is giving you from the perspective of its position in the spread.


Here are a few words from each artist, giving her own particular description of the archetype she chose to depict in this deck.

0
The Fool 
Artist: y0b
A leap into the cliff, a universe of randomness and intent. Colorful hills beyond.

I
The Magician
Artist: Kristy Glas
She is pure and passionate, connected to spiritual and material realms. She seeks balance and knowledge through constant growth.

II
The High Priestess
Artist: Cristiana Vettor (combugnera)
This card indicates the search for female knowledge, clairvoyance, the search for the secret and the future; her knowledge is mostly initiatory, therefore forbidden to most people and reserved only to a few.


III
The Empress
Artist: SpaceDivers
She stands powerful and dancing, between nature and imagination, the pattern of creation and knowledge of birth are flows and breaths of reality, whether material or ethereal. 

IV
The Emperor
Artist: Lulu
Control through intelligence, the strength you need to stand straight.

V
The Hierophant
Artist: Inês Merino
A rite of passage – infinite wisdom and guidance, magic, shining the brightest light within… As we close this chapter, a new beginning unfolds.

VI
The Lovers
Artist: oculardelusion
In the sacred beech grove’s purple light, divine union of requited love, of union with the Divine. All is One.

VII
The Chariot
Artist: The Bad Lament
The Chariot brings forth the brave winged warrioress, with the moon at her back, determined and ambitious.

VIII
Strength
Artist: LUVRworldwide
The aligning of truths in mind-body-spirit, fuels our source from within, empowering a spectrum of peaceful passion and disciplined determination.


IX
The Hermit
Artist: Stina Jones
The hermit ventures forth, carving her own path through the wilderness.

X
The Wheel of Fortune
Artist: Sparrow
The Wheel of Fortune is never not a part of life. When this card appears it is a reminder: change is the only constant.

XI
Justice
Artist: Kitty Bast
“Karma’s a Bitch.”

XII
The Hanged Man
Artist: Daira
It is best to be sure to be willing to change.

XIII
Death
Artist: DaniellaDoodles
While there is death, there is also life - death allows for new growth and change.

XIV
Temperance
Artist: Vanesa Stati
Temperance tests waters with one foot on solid ground, it’s the wise step, the guide from a lower plane to a higher one that enjoys natural protection, which denotes and promove a point of balance: moderation, patience, purpose, tenacity, adaptation, acceptance, harmonization, reason, flow...

XV
The Devil
Artist: Cechk
The seduction of the devil can materialise in the physical realm as well on the mind, it has lust and obsession, it longs for power, but also lives in fear and strives for domination. The Devil is good and bad, and you’re the one that will decide who it will be. 

XVI
The Tower
Artist: Brandi Kyle
A standing reminder of the perils we face, the Tower card depicts possibilities of catastrophe, destruction, renovation, or just simply unexpected change.

XVII
The Star
Artist: Silje Thorn
She is at peace with renewed purpose and hope, nourishing her surroundings with the conscious and the subconscious in equilibrium.

XVIII
The Moon
Artist: St Heresy
As she is kind and sweet, she is also deceptive and dangerously beckoning. She is the holder of your secrets, and she holds no judgement.

XIX
The Sun
Artist: Gisel Florez
Circadian rhythms radiating the ultimate path of purpose & source.  

XX
Judgement
Artist: Marigold
The announcement of a new era is coming. A new World will be born after the Judgement.

XXI
The World
Artist: CrypticFauna
She holds the past and uplifts the future, and provides all pathways into either direction.

Anyone may visit the spread on any day with a question or concern in mind, and see what insights emerge from contemplating the cards. We invite you to follow your intuition: whenever you feel you have a question or concern, formulate your question and visit the Tarot, and reflect on the day’s reading as it pertains to your situation.

This kind of spread is generally read as follows: 

Left card: What is past, or passing.
Centre card: What is occurring now. 
Right card: What is to come.

However, you may also interpret in other ways. For example, Left card / Centre card / Right card could be: 

What you wish for / the obstacle being presented / how to overcome the obstacle
You / someone else / the relationship
What’s in your heart / what’s in your head / what’s in your spirit

... and so on. There are many more options. What’s important is how you frame the question. Look up Tarot three-card spreads for more suggestions.

Cards in the spread may also appear upside-down – or "reversed”. There are many ways to interpret this reversal. Perhaps the card means the inverse or opposite of its upright intention, or it might be describing an interior, secret or hidden state, or it's indicating a reduced or receding influence. Stay open to the possibilities as you meditate on your question.

We have also included the possibility of duplicate cards in each position. In other words, this spread encompasses three full decks’ worth of card combinations. If the same card turns up in different positions in the reading, simply integrate the message the card is giving you from the perspective of its position in the spread.


Here are a few words from each artist, giving her own particular description of the archetype she chose to depict in this deck.

0
The Fool 
Artist: y0b
A leap into the cliff, a universe of randomness and intent. Colorful hills beyond.

I
The Magician
Artist: Kristy Glas
She is pure and passionate, connected to spiritual and material realms. She seeks balance and knowledge through constant growth.

II
The High Priestess
Artist: Cristiana Vettor (combugnera)
This card indicates the search for female knowledge, clairvoyance, the search for the secret and the future; her knowledge is mostly initiatory, therefore forbidden to most people and reserved only to a few.


III
The Empress
Artist: SpaceDivers
She stands powerful and dancing, between nature and imagination, the pattern of creation and knowledge of birth are flows and breaths of reality, whether material or ethereal. 

IV
The Emperor
Artist: Lulu
Control through intelligence, the strength you need to stand straight.

V
The Hierophant
Artist: Inês Merino
A rite of passage – infinite wisdom and guidance, magic, shining the brightest light within… As we close this chapter, a new beginning unfolds.

VI
The Lovers
Artist: oculardelusion
In the sacred beech grove’s purple light, divine union of requited love, of union with the Divine. All is One.

VII
The Chariot
Artist: The Bad Lament
The Chariot brings forth the brave winged warrioress, with the moon at her back, determined and ambitious.

VIII
Strength
Artist: LUVRworldwide
The aligning of truths in mind-body-spirit, fuels our source from within, empowering a spectrum of peaceful passion and disciplined determination.


IX
The Hermit
Artist: Stina Jones
The hermit ventures forth, carving her own path through the wilderness.

X
The Wheel of Fortune
Artist: Sparrow
The Wheel of Fortune is never not a part of life. When this card appears it is a reminder: change is the only constant.

XI
Justice
Artist: Kitty Bast
“Karma’s a Bitch.”

XII
The Hanged Man
Artist: Daira
It is best to be sure to be willing to change.

XIII
Death
Artist: DaniellaDoodles
While there is death, there is also life - death allows for new growth and change.

XIV
Temperance
Artist: Vanesa Stati
Temperance tests waters with one foot on solid ground, it’s the wise step, the guide from a lower plane to a higher one that enjoys natural protection, which denotes and promove a point of balance: moderation, patience, purpose, tenacity, adaptation, acceptance, harmonization, reason, flow...

XV
The Devil
Artist: Cechk
The seduction of the devil can materialise in the physical realm as well on the mind, it has lust and obsession, it longs for power, but also lives in fear and strives for domination. The Devil is good and bad, and you’re the one that will decide who it will be. 

XVI
The Tower
Artist: Brandi Kyle
A standing reminder of the perils we face, the Tower card depicts possibilities of catastrophe, destruction, renovation, or just simply unexpected change.

XVII
The Star
Artist: Silje Thorn
She is at peace with renewed purpose and hope, nourishing her surroundings with the conscious and the subconscious in equilibrium.

XVIII
The Moon
Artist: St Heresy
As she is kind and sweet, she is also deceptive and dangerously beckoning. She is the holder of your secrets, and she holds no judgement.

XIX
The Sun
Artist: Gisel Florez
Circadian rhythms radiating the ultimate path of purpose & source.  

XX
Judgement
Artist: Marigold
The announcement of a new era is coming. A new World will be born after the Judgement.

XXI
The World
Artist: CrypticFauna
She holds the past and uplifts the future, and provides all pathways into either direction.

QmR2NyWs1KGXA2uSFUGjvGRucynokyDKgjqFkUBq.name: VESICA PISCIS • Portal of Creation
QmR2NyWs1KGXA2uSFUGjvGRucynokyDKgjqFkUBq.description:
The "Vesica Piscis" is the lenticular intersection of the two circles. In sacred geometry it symbolizes the beginning of creation as well as the portal between two dimensions. This symbol has been used in various cultures and it connects us to something primordial and pure. Many other geometries and proportions can be derived from this elemental shape. 

The two stages of this piece show the 4D view (orange) associated with the ethereal and subtle energies, and the 5D view (blue) associated with the astral realm.

QmR2QLBW91Km3AnA2VdcTdgXtsb9m77VXWyFUTM5.name: Looking Deeper
QmR2QLBW91Km3AnA2VdcTdgXtsb9m77VXWyFUTM5.description: This piece is based on a photographic chemigram, an image created using a camera-less approach to recording marks on photographic paper.  My work is centered in a sense of wonder and curiosity, and takes its cues from forces of nature - in this case, life at a cellular level.  The cellular metaphor encourages me to think of hidden mysteries that can only be seen and appreciated by looking deeper, past the surface, into the depths of a thing.   Careful attention and thoughtful consideration so often seems a discarded thing of the past, and I find it impoverishing.  In my images, I hope to speak to the heart, reminding us all to stop and see, slow down and appreciate.  I hope to capture an ephemeral wisp of the intangible and share it, as two children might press their heads together to gaze in awe at something captured in a cupped hand.

QmR3UseH9MbWKN5ftd9jCHddHuPt6zYmqbAGs82q.name: Burnt Out
QmR3UseH9MbWKN5ftd9jCHddHuPt6zYmqbAGs82q.description:
Overworking is not something estranged to doctors;
burnout is something quite common. This work desires
to convey this state of emotional exhaustion, physical
fatigue, and loss of connection to purpose. Before the
state of burnout fully manifests, the professional
undergoes a gradual process where they end up
feeling drained, trapped, or defeated and maywithdraw from responsibilities, isolate, skip work or
assume the use of drugs.
These often result from the prolonged stress of work
pressure, which may often develop into an attitude of
cynicism towards daily work, a detachment towards
patients, or may doubt if at all they're making a
difference. Some may be worried that their own issues
go unresolved while they're busy worrying about those
of others.
So much can condescend one into this course state of
mental and emotional dryness.
This work cracks open the misery lying behind our
uninformed surficial conceptions about the life of
doctors.

QmR4cmVgYAA5hRYUBtMfc3GPkGBdXYkRW3dppvAi.name: In Search Of Color: Vancouver to Montreal
QmR4cmVgYAA5hRYUBtMfc3GPkGBdXYkRW3dppvAi.description:
An homage to a series of paintings I did starting in the early 2000's titled Urban Abstractions. I exhibited them in various cities around the world. 

"The collection of paintings portrays a landscape of color and intuition. I hope to capture the essence of modern life as we see it unfold in front of our very own eyes. The works are inspired by a struggle to make sense out of life and reflect a need for something more meaningful, something that brings out the JOY in our daily routine."

QmR5PfDnLV5iS2vRqi9iyF47sWX9exDMzxCdk462.name: Satoshi Legacy
QmR5PfDnLV5iS2vRqi9iyF47sWX9exDMzxCdk462.description:
Satoshi's legacy inspired by Sandro Botticelli's painting "Portrait of a Stranger", in these four facets of Satoshi, I show you the legacy of cryptocurrencies that in my perception are the footprint that Satoshi Nakamoto left us 13 years ago: A sunrise , a day, a sunset and a night that reflects that he came to change the digital world and the global economy.

1-Sunrise: Bitcoin
The Sunrise belongs to Bitcoin and this is the birth of a revolution of the exchange of monetary value in a decentralized way, thanks to the fact that Satoshi shows us a resistance to censorship now no intermediary could stand in the way of P2P exchanges and this is the dawn that every society wanted one day.


2-Day: Ethereum
The day belongs to Ethereum, as this is the light, as it has shown us how much fun a cryptocurrency ecosystem can be filled with many types of applications, such as smart contracts, NFTs, games, and decentralized finances.


3-Sunset: Raini
The sunset belongs to $Raini, because this cryptocurrency is a reflection of the good results that the day gave us, and how a community with a lot of value can be generated, and how a project can grow thanks to everyone's enthusiasm.


4-night: Monero
The night or the dark belongs to Monero because it will be our refuge to have a greater resistance to censorship and absolute anonymity, it will not only be a cryptocurrency that hackers will use, but an entire society that will have resistance to combat bad governments that is . why Monero represents a jewel in the present and future of our existence in life on blockchain.

QmRA2CHuauM7wozN8MfP1pnBSwh5gv1GnQCCzkLU.name: Newly Abridged Happiness Manual, Vol I
QmRA2CHuauM7wozN8MfP1pnBSwh5gv1GnQCCzkLU.description:
Conceived as a series with three volumes, the Newly Abridged Happiness Manuals are conceptual poems that explore the tension between time and mind, between what we tell ourselves and what our minds tell us. How to construct a sense of self when our senses are constantly under assault? Our minds jump from thought to thought–which thought should we act upon?

Life happens inside our minds, and our emotional realities are underpinned by thought. To examine the dynamic of thought is to examine the scaffolding that sustains our outward-facing selves. This series does so with humor, compassion, and straightforward honesty.

The first volume focuses on the way we experience the present tense, at times mundane, at others philosophical. The second and third volumes will probe our notions of past and future, worn down as they become by the passage of time, hour by waking–or, even, sleeping–hour.

This series expands on Caballero's exploration of the cyclical storytelling potential of Async's 24 hour canvas. Collectors of the piece will also receive a minted GIF version of the poem in which the 24 frames/verses of the text change every few seconds. Do our thoughts change from hour to hour, second to second, day to day? Or are we forever reliving the same thoughts, and thus, the same day?

Debuted at the Digital Francisco Carolinum in April 2022.

QmRAH6iMNe7aBQttYjtUazgz32PcKbKy2Be3txsD.name: GANYMEDE
QmRAH6iMNe7aBQttYjtUazgz32PcKbKy2Be3txsD.description:
Do you dream of faraway places? You are not alone.

GANYMEDE is a series that celebrates our shared humanity and limitless potential. The portrait of our central character is combined with archival material (including maps, cells, planets, mosaics, and religious frescos) to bridge cultures and connect the past, present, and future. Within this series, our character will embody everything from single-cell organism to trans-planetary objects.

In anticipation of its official drop, 24 pieces from this series have been compiled to create a 24-hour clock powered by the Async platform.
The buyer of this 1/1 piece will have access to an exclusive NFT from this series ahead of its official drop. 

From the collection "New Geographies."

QmRDAb4u2mpxTSX6HZAj3QBG9EbyFCDSJpdA1bH3.name: The shadow clock
QmRDAb4u2mpxTSX6HZAj3QBG9EbyFCDSJpdA1bH3.description:
Time is a entity that is purely human made but certainly controls all aspect of us. Right from birth or meetings to literally everything.  The rotation of the planets although is symbolic of time - we say one day when earth completes one rotation and we say one year when earth completes one revolution. 

The position of a mere planet in the galaxy is representative of time - the all powerful entity. This is in fact true in our social lives too - we feel like time is too slow when we’re in certain circumstances while it’s too fast in others - our emotional position is the measure of time in this case. 

The shadow clock is a symbolic representation of the premise of how mere positions in space of various elements of life represents time.

QmRDmUQgDxnZCyLxx9QyKCU2j1L8FZzsZQ3x3yMs.name: Subtractive Reality
QmRDmUQgDxnZCyLxx9QyKCU2j1L8FZzsZQ3x3yMs.description:
Subtractive Reality, 2022
Original Edition, 1 of 1
Dynamic Art
1920x1080

Subtractive Reality is based on my original artwork 'Entangled Reality'. Released as part of my series: ONE - a contemplative journey into the unseen world around us.

Using a minimal amount of colors and a precise juxtaposition of shapes, each piece challenges the intricate ways in which the human eye perceives. The collection is inspired by the ephemeral and intangible moments of life: unspoken words and feelings that can't be encapsulated in a singular understanding.

Rather than replacing parts of the art, Subtractive Reality invites layer owners to collaborate and subtract layers from the piece itself, creating new and vibrant optical illusions. Any changes to the original piece will also be influenced by the previously inexistent background and controller, resulting in thousands of possible outcomes.

anthonyesebag.com

QmREr6Yor4HpHpCdnvLmFy5tcqJCmygWnD2FaGz8.name: ​​OUR FATHER IN THE METAVERSE #92
QmREr6Yor4HpHpCdnvLmFy5tcqJCmygWnD2FaGz8.description: This prayer gift of Jesus to his disciples, later handed down to us Christians, has become the actual Christian self-understanding, the "prayer of the Lord". Packed into a few sentences, it has come to be regarded as the actual confession of faith and is prayed millions of times a day, both individually and in communities. The fact that this "conversation with God" has hardly ever been depicted (in contrast to the Passion) is probably due to the immense message it conveys. The fact that the painter Mathias Rusch dared to translate the "Our Father" can be explained by the fact that his daily work was based on faith, hope, and trust in God. Mathias Rusch was aware that he could only exist in the understanding of his art "as a gift of God". Most of his late works (Our Father, Live and Let Live, Sermon on the Mount, Lauretan Litany, Litany of the Sacred Heart) were written, as he confessed, under the "kind help" of the Highest, always accompanied by personal prayers, meditations or invocations. The fact that Mathias Rusch did not reveal a word for the interpretation of his works of art is to be justified by the fact that he understood himself to a large extent as a mediator of a higher power. Thus we are sometimes quite helplessly confronted with an immense abundance of Christian symbols, metaphysical allusions, concretizations, and abstractions, in unique hues and compositions. Completely in the sense of Mathias Rusch we dive before the 13 works of art into the enormous topic of earthly existence and Christian eschatology, marvel before the color power, before the hints, confessions, and convictions of the very deeply felt "Our Father's". Finally, we become humbled and ultimately grateful to be initiated into the world-prayer of a "knowing" believer, again and again, with each glance at each of these magnificent works of art. Whoever takes a longer "eye" look at this self-contained, unique complete work, consisting of 13 unique pieces in oil on canvas, 170x170cm, will not be able to resist a lasting effect and deep consternation.

QmRKNZiR9rdEfxbkm4tCVT9TYxdiV3gxeWpD1JXY.name: Right Place & Right Time (Bitcoin Hourly Price Offset)
QmRKNZiR9rdEfxbkm4tCVT9TYxdiV3gxeWpD1JXY.description:
Each day, a new composition for the Master is generated autonomously using a data feed of Bitcoin's last 24 hours of price action. Each hour's price programmatically controls rotation, scale, and position of a correlating layer. Astute viewers will surmise the day's price volatility simply by examining the artwork. While the daily image generation is the result of autonomous API calls, utilizing an algorithm the artist wrote, the artist has chosen to retain a control token. This token allows him to fine-tune variables associated with his algorithm, in addition to addressing aesthetic concerns within the life-cycle of the artwork. Layer state, alpha, hue, saturation, and brightness are elements the artist has retained control of in order that this artwork remain a living work-in-progress.

An earlier iteration of this artwork was featured as a nightly projection mapping video on the face of the Daniels Fisher Clocktower, as part of ETH Denver 2020. Access to this and additional exclusive content awaits the master token owner at the artist's NFT Portal: https://collect.mattkane.com/minted-works/right-place-right-time-bitcoin-hourly-price-offset/

QmRKQSXLxowDwogitkTZc78vNcc5LnirZD3VCaRn.name: Do Not Step Into Your Place
QmRKQSXLxowDwogitkTZc78vNcc5LnirZD3VCaRn.description:
Do Not Step Into Your Place
by Hulki Okan Tabak
minted 2021 on Async Art

24 artworks based on World War I propaganda posters including a poster for the Third United States Official War Picture called Under Four Flags.  

One hidden surprise image embedded alongside for thinking outside the box.

...

The Great War, history, politics, art, posters and propaganda are topics of interest for me. It was kind of natural that I wanted to incorporate that in my cryptoart creations. The desire led to a selection of public domain pieces out of copyright from the Library of Congress archives. I created all sorts of derivative pacifist and tongue-in-cheek works. So far I have only minted a handful on KnownOrigin. Starting September 2021, I will mint a more comprehensive set on Async Art and KO depending on the nature of the final artwork. The artwork presented here is part of that World War I Posters set.

QmRQP3qDiaYPjG2E87ibdzBR4g5BFk2kzj1ZVdpp.name: Turris Avium
QmRQP3qDiaYPjG2E87ibdzBR4g5BFk2kzj1ZVdpp.description:
The Tower of Birds has a story unlike any other...

Turris Vallis was known not for its beautiful valley of towers but, unfortunately, for its swarms of irritating birds that pooped on all the rooftops. Which caused a horrid smell. No one could do a thing about it. Not kings. Not emperors. Not queens. Not even skilled marksmen. Until one day a sorcerer arrived. He was on the edge of this world—almost passing into the next. He hadn’t wanted to travel through Turris Vallis, but there was no other option. While he lodged in the city he became infuriated with the birds. So, he cursed them and the city they flew around. As he uttered the magic words he breathed his last and passed into the next dimension. And the birds got sucked into the turret roofs, where they were doomed to squawk and squabble for the rest of eternity. You may think the city traded one terrible thing for another. But this was not entirely true. The sorcerer gave the city reprise at night. The birds would disappear. And be followed by an unearthly silence that allowed the townsfolk peaceful sleep and pleasant dreams.

This NFT changes how it looks based on the time of day. It has a different image for day, night, sunrise, and sunset.
Size: 2160 × 3840px.

QmRVUfxzMBUiSVbt2RpXus6CZdGyezNMkkWoAtmH.name: 24h Dimanche / Pls Send Nudes
QmRVUfxzMBUiSVbt2RpXus6CZdGyezNMkkWoAtmH.description:
BRIEF: “Hot, Hot, Hot!” is a collection of static and animated digital art reflecting on love, longing, and existential loneliness. A self-exploration of the feminine form; an introspective odyssey upon the digital seas only touching briefly the sensual shores of the real world. Named after each of the 7 days of the week in French &  English words/phrases; this piece represents 1 day consisting of: 1 primary static image + 5 alternate glitch states (used to create a separate animation). 

BACKGROUND: 

For millennia the feminine form has been appropriated, commodified, objectified, curated, policed, and brutalized by men and for the male gaze. 

Today, unconditional self-acceptance of feminine bodies remains an act of radical self-love and still carries risk of violence in a deeply misogynist culture. The luxury of safe self-expression is elusive; only further complicated by age, color, creed, sex, gender, ability, sexuality, and class. Whether it be in real or digital spaces, feminine bodies are treated with a spectrum of toxic hostile reactions from self-appointed patriarchal enforcers who take it upon themselves to steal joy, love, life, and happiness from any female (sex or gendered) persons that exercise their self-sovereignty in public or private; real or digital spaces. Despite the culture of terror, the feminine aspect of humanity is asserting herself and sisters are embodying in their power.

INQUIRY: 

When the last grain of dust settles on the digital frontier what will the real world look and feel like? Will NFB’s (non-fungible-beings) and their fleshy forms be treasured or despised? Will the real world lay in rubble? Does a world still reeling from the pandemic return to desperately pressing flesh against flesh; or will glass, silicone, and electricity be the sole comforts accessible to those inside of a deepening dystopian nightmare? 

What does love, intimacy, and vulnerability look and feel like in the future? How does it feel in the present? Will the essential need of skin to skin contact between human beings drive our species to create teleportation devices out of sheer desperation? As HD gives way to 4K, 6K, 8K, Augmented Reality, and Virtual Reality, how far can we, and will we, push ourselves across the world; across the universe — at the speed of light — in search of love?

INQUIRY: 

When the last grain of dust settles on the digital frontier what will the real world look and feel like? Will NFB’s (non-fungible-beings) and their fleshy forms be treasured or despised? Will the real world lay in rubble? Does a world still reeling from the pandemic return to desperately pressing flesh against flesh; or will glass, silicone, and electricity be the sole comforts accessible to those inside of a deepening dystopian nightmare? 

What does love, intimacy, and vulnerability look and feel like in the future? How does it feel in the present? Will the essential need of skin to skin contact between human beings drive our species to create teleportation devices out of sheer desperation? As HD gives way to 4K, 6K, 8K, Augmented Reality, and Virtual Reality, how far can we, and will we, push ourselves across the world; across the universe — at the speed of light — in search of love?

QmRarWprfGbzUjuL3shNvUf5cJj9vRmot4mXE5pL.name: Tenement
QmRarWprfGbzUjuL3shNvUf5cJj9vRmot4mXE5pL.description:
'Tenement' is simple concept that invites users to control the illumination of an urban building facade.

It is for anyone who has ever gazed out of a high-rise at night and wondered what the myriad of other inhabitants may be doing, and is meant to invoke the natural human curiosity that occurs when we see a light on in a building. 

In the real world, within every apartment lies the day-to-day hopes, dreams, failures and successes of other people. Who are they? What could they be doing? If the lights are off, where might they be? Viewers are thus given the opportunity to suggest and imagine the stories contained behind each of the windows. 

Apartment locations are assigned by grid running from A-G on rows and 1-6 on each column, with the position indicated on each thumbnail.

Each apartment can be lit with warm light, cool light, red/rose light or switched off, allowing layer owners to play or communicate through the various light states.

QmRcuRjrE4ttTofGrQBgMsNBKYjNZbpEJWhczRQA.name: Think Pink - #2 - Guilt to Remorse
QmRcuRjrE4ttTofGrQBgMsNBKYjNZbpEJWhczRQA.description:
This piece is part of a mental health awareness campaign called Think Pink, designed to help people spot, relate and understand the emotions they are feeling. Each piece of artwork is a representation of what the mind could project if one was experiencing that said emotion.

When it is daytime, this piece represents Guilt. When the sun sets and the moon rises, its state will change to Remorse.

GUILT: A feeling of culpability over an offence (either real or imagined).
Mental response: Replaying what happened. Anxiety. Thoughts filled with self-loathing. Desiring to confess or share the pain or burden with another. Brooding, retreating inward, withdrawing from others.
May escalate to: CONFLICTED, REGRET, SHAME, REMORSE

REMORSE: Distress resulting from guilt over wrongdoing; a desire to undo
Mental response: Mentally berating oneself over an action or poor decision. Wanting to face consequences. Empathy for other parties and what they are going through. Obsessing over finding a way to repay the debt.
May escalate to: SHAME, REGRET, DETERMINATION.

We struggle to talk about our emotions and our mental health. Through art and NFTs people and communities can come together to recognise and speak openly about their mental state.

Emotions are nothing to be ashamed of. We all have them.

Welcome to the movement that is... Think Pink.

QmRdRgC1Ur13v1QrTrqXph82MSde5eFnRySnyxMk.name: Enemy
QmRdRgC1Ur13v1QrTrqXph82MSde5eFnRySnyxMk.description:
'Enemy' is the artwork created to explore the question of 'What makes an enemy'.
It is a journey to understand the complexity of our prejudice and reasons with which one convinces themselves whilst calling someone an enemy. And as the reasons start becoming obvious, a slightest change in any of the layer presents itself with many other very different reasons contradicting or supporting the previous explanation. 
The artworks with its four characters is a play of their changing roles and positions, making their actions in the piece more and more unexpected and difficult to understand, thus blurring the lines of rights and wrongs in this fight. Many mysteries are unfolded with a closer look at the details of each layer indicating the many things happening in the moment that might not be visible immediately.    
So the work is not an answer but an attempt of creating a place to understand the question and hence the term 'Enemy'.

QmRhxZT4rZyb9zpzTnaD1cHvt7ryjhwGpa2caGu2.name: OUR FATHER IN THE METAVERSE #5
QmRhxZT4rZyb9zpzTnaD1cHvt7ryjhwGpa2caGu2.description:
https://mathiasrusch-metaverse.com/

The "Our Father" - The cycle of paintings by artist Mathias Rusch (*1927-2003).

If there is a most important prayer of Christian faith, then it must be the "Our Father".

This prayer gift of Jesus to his disciples, later handed down to us Christians, has become the actual Christian self-understanding, the "prayer of the Lord". Packed into a few sentences, it has come to be regarded as the actual confession of faith and is prayed millions of times a day, both individually and in communities. The fact that this "conversation with God" has hardly ever been depicted (in contrast to the Passion) is probably due to the immense message it conveys. The fact that the painter Mathias Rusch dared to translate the "Our Father" can be explained by the fact that his daily work was based on faith, hope, and trust in God. Mathias Rusch was aware that he could only exist in the understanding of his art "as a gift of God". Most of his late works (Our Father, Live and Let Live, Sermon on the Mount, Lauretan Litany, Litany of the Sacred Heart) were written, as he confessed, under the "kind help" of the Highest, always accompanied by personal prayers, meditations or invocations. The fact that Mathias Rusch did not reveal a word for the interpretation of his works of art is to be justified by the fact that he understood himself to a large extent as a mediator of a higher power. Thus we are sometimes quite helplessly confronted with an immense abundance of Christian symbols, metaphysical allusions, concretizations, and abstractions, in unique hues and compositions. Completely in the sense of Mathias Rusch we dive before the 13 works of art into the enormous topic of earthly existence and Christian eschatology, marvel before the color power, before the hints, confessions, and convictions of the very deeply felt "Our Father's". Finally, we become humbled and ultimately grateful to be initiated into the world-prayer of a "knowing" believer, again and again, with each glance at each of these magnificent works of art. Whoever takes a longer "eye" look at this self-contained, unique complete work, consisting of 13 unique pieces in oil on canvas, 170x170cm, will not be able to resist a lasting effect and deep consternation.

QmRigsrZzTqd3o4CnCdn7c1EUBf6DsFNcnmJQRZS.description:
I was thinking of makin something unique as my first NFT for Async art, and I created this NFT in day and night form. I was imaging, "watching a sculpture of Ethereum out of the home window." How it will gonna look in day and night? 
Finally I created this NFT upon my Imagination. It took a week to create this NFT artwork.

sCULpTURE of Ethereum represents the culture of Ethereum. Ethereum has changed the world, it is decentralized, open-source blockchain with smart contract functionality and its been a pleasure to dedicate my first NFT Art to Ethereum coin.  

Hope you guys like it.

Thanks

QmRikDKusDbujBYHrLrEUoZSMyDVL2AkqbA56U1R.name: Cubechain
QmRikDKusDbujBYHrLrEUoZSMyDVL2AkqbA56U1R.description:
Any work we do at any time of the day does not stay there. A cycle begins that will affect everything forever. Every good or bad thing we do goes into a loop that affects everything else.

Our thoughts and actions are sometimes very clear, sometimes a little vague, sometimes harsh, sometimes soft. We build our life on this cycle.

24 cubes, this is a cycle that expresses sharpness, clarity, dark and light. All of them are in a cycle both in relation to each other and within themselves.

Artwork Title: Regeneration #370432
Date of Artwork: 2020-2021
Dimension: 3840 pixel x 3840 pixel
Type of Work: GANs Algorithm trained photograph
Date of Dataset: 2010-2017
Edition: Unique

The photographs in the series of Regeneration produced by using Generative Adversarial Networks. I took over three thousand photos spanned nearly a decade for a specific project and selected over a thousand photos from there as the Dataset for AI training. The photographs have been gestated by AI that integrated all the subtle emotions of the original pieces, which are the most exciting parts of this series.

QmRjZMHbEEqLdKcNHvGJ1gVGFSXDZgWuWQ63uqoa.description:
Asleep within the coils of Shesha, floating on the Cosmic Ocean, Lord Vishnu lies undisturbed by dreams, until … Om, Brahma springs from Vishnu’s navel and creation begins.

Mahavishnu, the supreme and original Creator, floats on the Causal Ocean creating multiple dimensions of Vishnus asleep in the coils of many Sheshas, as unlimited Brahmas create infinite realities.

Vishnu also lives in the heart of every living being. 

This collage is made from bits of bornfree.org.uk.

QmRmGLtunF3tbVDhC8gYKsLNL4vCYpgVzcBQPqtU.name: ZAMA
QmRmGLtunF3tbVDhC8gYKsLNL4vCYpgVzcBQPqtU.description:
A young Argentina was expanding and new cities were developing. 
A group of colonists found a place to settle and wanted to turn it into a small town. 
We depict in this render a pure and peaceful view of that place, a tributary of Rio Paraguay.

The colonists arrived on october the 13th , 1819. One week later, some of their companions got there expecting to join them, but found no traces but their packed belongings. Efforts to find them were extensive, but ceased after reports of supernatural events taking place during the search. 
Each october the 13th,  people of the area go there to celebrate "La danza de los muertos".

QmRmfunKQ9BY3kQeUG2LgLGiNaGac2tdsXvjGbEq.name: Think Pink - #1 - Loneliness to Depression
QmRmfunKQ9BY3kQeUG2LgLGiNaGac2tdsXvjGbEq.description:
This piece is part of a mental health awareness campaign called Think Pink, designed to help people spot, relate and understand the emotions they are feeling. Each piece of artwork is a representation of what the mind could project if one was experiencing that said emotion.

When it is daytime, this piece represents Loneliness. When the sun sets and the moon rises, its state will change to Depression.

LONELINESS - The feeling of being isolated or cut off.
Mental response: Avoiding crowds, large events, or social situations. A desire to be included, wanted.
Anger, bitterness. A feeling of unworthiness. Daydreaming about inclusion.
May escalate to: SADNESS, HURT, DEPRESSION, RESIGNATION.

DEPRESSION: A state of withdrawal; extreme sadness and reduced vitality.
Mental response: Focusing inward. Desiring to live in the past or be alone. Poor observation skills. Obsessive thoughts. A negative outlook. Losing track of time. An inability to concentrate.
May relate to: NOSTALGIA, REGRET, SADNESS, LONELINESS.

We struggle to talk about our emotions and our mental health. Through art and NFTs people and communities can come together to recognise and speak openly about their mental state.

Emotions are nothing to be ashamed of. We all have them.

Welcome to the movement that is... Think Pink.

QmRnfNCkVTLSLVT6uw68gRWU1GRY938K5SbtCxqZ.name: Kids Takeover Putin: Nova Apartchik #5
QmRnfNCkVTLSLVT6uw68gRWU1GRY938K5SbtCxqZ.description:
Based on Putin photography, Kids Takeover Putin is text-to-image experimentation on war, peace and leadership. It is re-creating the leadership in the eyes of a kid takeover for peace.

Stop the War. We hoped, I hoped this was already the past in Europe. We should not go back.

There is a lot of interesting material that range from childish and peaceful to satirical and dark. I will post them and perhaps I will post most of them hoping this ends as soon as possible.

This is one of the 12 2-piece Nova Apartchiks on Async Art. There is also 1 24 piece set and some 4-piece somewhat more abstract pieces on Async Art. For multi editions and some other 1/1s, please visit my collection on KnownOrigin.

by Mad Monk, 1/1 on Async Art, 2022

QmRoeyU278ienHkvQ8LnbmEaHHcADcRVhcaD5vzb.description: This series is inspired by the creator's favourite Impressionist Claude Monet and his paintings of Waterlilies, Waterloo Bridge, and Sunset on the Seine. It strips off the defining brushwork of impressionism - which was once heavily criticised and not considered art - instead forming an attempt to distill pure colour and geometry, as well as capturing time, something that Monet was famously known for. It is an impression of an impressionist.

QmRqoTkE858SgtS9ebCXL1Qo2Mb9uDvXexV9cJ4Z.name: EUkraine flag
QmRqoTkE858SgtS9ebCXL1Qo2Mb9uDvXexV9cJ4Z.description:
Europe is much more than its geographical borders. Actually is more than a certain number of members states, it is a mindset with a strong set of values, like peace, freedom, solidarity, tolerance and democracy.

Noam Chomsky, asks the essential question whether democracy and inherent freedom are values to be preserved or threats to be avoided ?

He replies, "in this possibly terminal phase of human existence, democracy and freedom are more than values to be treasured, they may well be essential to survival."

If Europe represents that, we must all be europeans and contribute in that way to preserve humanity. This is WHA's contribution.

EUkraine flag by WHA. 
Colors: Yellow (FFFF00) and Blue (0000FF).

WHA is a multidisciplinary and hybrid author exploring the intersection of art, literature and technology, based in Europe.

WHA - preserve our humanity

https://www.wha.digital

QmRuyvETmbeHNQkMK7PUCAR8W8mJvUTFrsRig5GJ.description:
The powerful and almighty God Almar, takes one last gasp at their creations before stumbling forever into the abyss.

Follow God Almar on the final day of reckoning. They spent a lifetime building a realm of prosperity, balance and peace. God Almar is fulfilled but also realises legacy is moot now that the end is nigh.

-

This piece is about grasping with our mortality. No matter your wealth or social status our destination is the same. 

If you died tomorrow would you be happy with your what you have left behind?

QmRw1DrtbY9enRa71QJtUWuFcVyb5YMQUDaYLGpg.name: '''''Last Shot
QmRw1DrtbY9enRa71QJtUWuFcVyb5YMQUDaYLGpg.description:
Last Shot presents us with an imagery of a moment when, as a medical professional, one is running out of options to treat their patients and is on the verge of losing them. Several thoughts race through the mind, but none is good enough; they scramble for whatever they can to try and hinder loss.
During this race against time, the patient slowly fizzles away as they yet watch their confounded source of hope darting up and down, across the room in a futile search for answers. The frustration of unavailing evaluation and unfortunate patient outcomes can precede one's second-guessing of their abilities, a moment of trial for the practitioner.
The complication extends to challenge more than just their skill but to question who they are as a person.

QmRwcGVebGuAJwdaSY7UfUJu4oHsY1W4Vdh4FZC8.description:
Bavarian Red Cross
by Hulki Okan Tabak
minted 2021 on Async Art

4 artworks based on World War I propaganda posters from Germany. In this case Bavarian Red Cross' efforts to raise some money for army.

...

The Great War, history, politics, art, posters and propaganda are topics of interest for me. It was kind of natural that I wanted to incorporate that in my cryptoart creations. The desire led to a selection of public domain pieces out of copyright from the Library of Congress archives. I created all sorts of derivative pacifist and tongue-in-cheek works. So far I have only minted a handful on KnownOrigin. Starting September 2021, I will mint a more comprehensive set on Async Art and KO depending on the nature of the final artwork. The artwork presented here is part of that World War I Posters set.

It was not today

In some place
That you were not
There
Where was I speaking
In another language

...

Memories are made of something I guess. Not easy to write descriptions when it is better to express in a poem. The poem appears for the first time with this artwork as well. I will not copy it elsewhere for now at least. Perhaps it will be tokenized forgotten and reborn on the blockchain.

Poem written August 2021

QmS2jwqY5ECvinDvG5aUH7GGMdfRBe96vgrorUeQ.name: Forks
QmS2jwqY5ECvinDvG5aUH7GGMdfRBe96vgrorUeQ.description:
This piece was inspired by the concept of blockchain forks and the decisions needed for blockchains to evolve. I liken this to forks on our own life path, how we use our past and present experiences to make decisions for our near and far future. How we exist each day encountering many different forks, making big and small choices, validating our decisions and hoping the forks on our path lead us in good and rewarding directions. How much of the past do we take with us to make our future?
Forks continues the 'computer space' series - works based on the internal mechanics of what makes the digital realm possible.

QmS3cfHFeR5CgAJUefVgvbUZ7bzHaWtkCVUAw3TU.name: Faith. Hope. Love. Peace
QmS3cfHFeR5CgAJUefVgvbUZ7bzHaWtkCVUAw3TU.description:
Studies show that Visualizing Peace is a powerful resource in Peace-building and Conflict Resolution.  

While violence receives lots of attention, it’s the visualization of peace that can actually stop the violence.

It is proved that colorful images of Peace and Harmony contribute to nonviolence.

“Art is a tool that can communicate and transform the way people think and act. Arts can change the dynamics in intractable interpersonal, intercommunal, national, and global conﬂicts.” (Michael Shank and Lisa Schirich, “Strategic Arts-based Peace-building”).

QmS3jdkmhnqncpc2dke2KdFsSjCmqJX2cRGFF56Y.description:

       Microorganisms invisible to the naked eye.

       is for some purpose outside of us. In this way we satisfy our hunger and quench our thirst.

QmS8aiuQr1XTmHRPRAKzAxsKVALZXpaXfpCYaE7T.name: I didn't see, I didn't hear, I don't know.
QmS8aiuQr1XTmHRPRAKzAxsKVALZXpaXfpCYaE7T.description:
Did they not talk or did we not make them talk? 
Did they plug their ears or did we deafen them? 
Did they close their eyes or did we blind them?

Whose natural habitats have been destroyed by humans,
whose hunted savagely for their skin, teeth, and fur,
who completed his whole life in a cage by being fed with drugs for his rapid growth,
tortured daily to fight each other,
It is dedicated to all animals who have been wronged and whose voices cannot be heard on the streets, in production farms such as prisons, laboratories, neglected shelters, circuses, zoos and many more.

QmS9BTGsiGmqV9Q7Xito6ax2BZC7hXpU4b9cAYwA.name: Derealization Vol.3
QmS9BTGsiGmqV9Q7Xito6ax2BZC7hXpU4b9cAYwA.description:
(n.) a feeling of unreality in which the environment is experienced as unreal and as flat, dull, or strange.


In the serie of 'Derealization', i explored and experienced the forms, lines and their intersections with each other in a certain composition. While highly inspired from the 'Suprematism' and 'Neoplastisism', i tried to free these from their dogmas and concentrate on the pure idea behind them which is 'to free art from the burden of the object' as Malevich said and create a supremacy of feeling above all.

QmSF3wVXZxn8Z8gytP96wUa3P7ALcaiZnN1aCMgC.name: Block Chain Dungeon
QmSF3wVXZxn8Z8gytP96wUa3P7ALcaiZnN1aCMgC.description:
Once upon a time...
a little boy named Leo loved to paint, draw and experiment. He also loved to play with blocks and chains, which drew him again and again into the rooms of his friends Michel and Angelo. Often they also met in virtual rooms of Cryptovoxels, Decentraland, Somnium Space or Sandbox to create new inventions, read books about new technologies, or just swing the brushes. But on this day something gigantic happened. A good friend of Leo came to visit and brought his girlfriend Mona, who wanted a piece of Leo's art on her skin. This was the birth of the NFT's, as Leo developed Non Fungible Tattoos in the Block Chain Dungeon of Michel and Angelo. From that day on people from all over the world came to get NFT's from Leo or one of his students, like "Skeenee the rat", who controls the NFT machine with his laptop. A new age began.

QmSFaMiDECgmZP7xbAw2nmSENqQNKNv3ejCAjaTL.name: Flutter
QmSFaMiDECgmZP7xbAw2nmSENqQNKNv3ejCAjaTL.description:
The Butterfly Effect 
It is "woven" into the very "fabric" of Time.

A small flap of the wings in one part of the day causes far reaching variations in the Space - Time Continuum. 
Never under estimate the power of chaos in that "Flutter". 
It surrounds us. All the time.  
But, it is only seldom that we acknowledge it.

QmSNBvfDXvdhMKRqnSwF7rFVnmgSATfYh6XeTkZX.name: 24h Jeudi / Signal To Noise
QmSNBvfDXvdhMKRqnSwF7rFVnmgSATfYh6XeTkZX.description:
BRIEF: “Hot, Hot, Hot!” is a collection of static and animated digital art reflecting on love, longing, and existential loneliness. A self-exploration of the feminine form; an introspective odyssey upon the digital seas only touching briefly the sensual shores of the real world. Named after each of the 7 days of the week in French &  English words/phrases; this piece represents 1 day consisting of: 1 primary static image + 5 alternate glitch states (used to create a separate animation). 

BACKGROUND: 

For millennia the feminine form has been appropriated, commodified, objectified, curated, policed, and brutalized by men and for the male gaze. 

Today, unconditional self-acceptance of feminine bodies remains an act of radical self-love and still carries risk of violence in a deeply misogynist culture. The luxury of safe self-expression is elusive; only further complicated by age, color, creed, sex, gender, ability, sexuality, and class. Whether it be in real or digital spaces, feminine bodies are treated with a spectrum of toxic hostile reactions from self-appointed patriarchal enforcers who take it upon themselves to steal joy, love, life, and happiness from any female (sex or gendered) persons that exercise their self-sovereignty in public or private; real or digital spaces. Despite the culture of terror, the feminine aspect of humanity is asserting herself and sisters are embodying in their power.

INQUIRY: 

When the last grain of dust settles on the digital frontier what will the real world look and feel like? Will NFB’s (non-fungible-beings) and their fleshy forms be treasured or despised? Will the real world lay in rubble? Does a world still reeling from the pandemic return to desperately pressing flesh against flesh; or will glass, silicone, and electricity be the sole comforts accessible to those inside of a deepening dystopian nightmare? 

What does love, intimacy, and vulnerability look and feel like in the future? How does it feel in the present? Will the essential need of skin to skin contact between human beings drive our species to create teleportation devices out of sheer desperation? As HD gives way to 4K, 6K, 8K, Augmented Reality, and Virtual Reality, how far can we, and will we, push ourselves across the world; across the universe — at the speed of light — in search of love?

QmSPBzR1k7wR42wtYxa4zdMz6VMoNxYxJPoeUUTz.name: Have You Seen Fosh?
QmSPBzR1k7wR42wtYxa4zdMz6VMoNxYxJPoeUUTz.description: Ever since I trolled the walls of Abbey Road Studios for graffiti to photograph, I am telling that such work was tokenized graffiti. Have You Seen Fosh? is continuing along the same path by tokenizing posters. I have taken the photographs that make up this artwork first as a broad representation of the poster work and then selectively chosen where to focus before the final visual edits and choices. These underlying photographs have led to the Day and Night cycles of this AsyncArt piece.

QmSQ4SyzKDWjZFdcS2zRvFq5msYAVbc7ZENhy6mQ.name: Derealization Vol.2
QmSQ4SyzKDWjZFdcS2zRvFq5msYAVbc7ZENhy6mQ.description:
(n.) a feeling of unreality in which the environment is experienced as unreal and as flat, dull, or strange.


In the serie of 'Derealization', i explored and experienced the forms, lines and their intersections with each other in a certain composition. While highly inspired from the 'Suprematism' and 'Neoplastisism', i tried to free these from their dogmas and concentrate on the pure idea behind them which is 'to free art from the burden of the object' as Malevich said and create a supremacy of feeling above all.

QmSQK5xXks6kkoq9MNd7VZNRTJuW4n2EycXHJc9y.name: Les plaisantes
QmSQK5xXks6kkoq9MNd7VZNRTJuW4n2EycXHJc9y.description:
Though I witnessed glamorous moments, faces and looks as a press photographer, I realized that I was drawn to create this world from a different perspective; one which undressed the soul, and rendered a more authentic moment. After some time, it became the same scenes, the same clichés, the same smiles, the same looks and the same photographers. As a celebrity, having to see more than 30 flashes per second every time a photographer spots them, probably makes them want to protect themselves. Seeing celebrities live in this world of excessive media coverage, I started to develop a mixed feeling of admiration and respect, but also pity, and finally detachment.


The Personalities are decomposed and re-assembled in an abstract composition, guided by my instinct and fed by what the model inspired in me.


The original digital size of "Les plaisantes" portrait is 120 by 180 cm.


This is a portrait of the actor Jesse Tyler Ferguson & the actress Anna Chlumsky. 
If you set it on "sunrise", it will display the original photography.

QmSTCY9MKbfKgBs9gYTECA1AQhzvBj94UqGq7bwW.name: Old Man Twisted Tree
QmSTCY9MKbfKgBs9gYTECA1AQhzvBj94UqGq7bwW.description: Old Man Twisted Tree goes through the seasons in a 24-hour period. Midnight is the height of winter, but soon the leaves start to appear. By 0800, it is summer and soon the leaves begin to turn the shades of Autumn. 1500 marks the height of Autumn and by 1900, all of the leaves are on the ground and about to blow away entirely. Old Man is stark naked at 2000, and then the snow begins. The cycle repeats every day, so wake up at odd hours to see what Old Man Twisted Tree looks like throughout the 24-hour season.

QmSUT41EdM13fB5PAQuB7T8tAYSNHpEwgD6kPsTY.name: Mind Mirror
QmSUT41EdM13fB5PAQuB7T8tAYSNHpEwgD6kPsTY.description:
We, humans, are social beings - we can instantly match with the emotions of the people around us. This is due to the fact that we have a particular type of brain cell called - mirror neuron. We emit our emotions and mirror the emotions of others around us. 

As organisms who emit and absorb emotions - it is important for us to be aware of the emotional rhythms and mental health of people around us - as we tend to cause them while also changing ourselves to it. 

Project Mind Mirror is a portal that would represent the collective emotions of our peers. 

Depending on the results of the poll from the dedicated Twitter page @theMindMirror we change the theme of a portal reflecting the emotion of the participants. A new poll would be put out every day and the results would be presented live in form of an abstract art in the mind mirror portal. 

The themes of the mind mirror portal would be one of the following,
 - The rejoice 
The portal would change its theme to green - the colour of prosperity and happiness. 

 - The content
The portal would change its theme to blue - the colour of calm and peace. 

 - The bothered 
The portal would change its theme to red - the colour of disturbance and anger. 

 - The depressed
The portal would turn into total darkness and black themed bypassing the rest of the votes if at least 30% of the participants have mentioned 'depressed'. Even a single depressed person is an alarm to the rest of us to watch out for the ones around us and empathise more.

—
Links:
1. Link to Mind Mirror portal: https://mind-mirror.000webhostapp.com/
2. Link to Twitter poll: https://twitter.com/theMindMirror

Acknowledgment: 
1. https://www.nature.com/articles/ncpneuro0990 [An article from nature on mirror neurons]

Privacy:
1. We don’t get to know the individual person who has replied to the poll. We have made use of the Twitter API to obtain the results. Only the population results are given to our disposal by Twitter.

QmSVLNe4FhcthohRFQyHpr3JzbK9ww1akPHuTASc.name: Mind Puzzle
QmSVLNe4FhcthohRFQyHpr3JzbK9ww1akPHuTASc.description:
Life is a big puzzle game made up of many different events and experiences, some of which are interrelated and overlap. The more experiences we gather, the more complex and colorful the overall picture becomes.  
 
But over time, the perception, emotional coloring and evaluation of different events and memories changes. Some things we may remember only vaguely after a while. 
 
Thus, the inner thought puzzle of each individual constantly reflects life and yet is greater than the sum of its parts. 
 
The work has been created as part of a conversation with my younger self and the search for my signature style, that I started in July 2020. 
 
It is based on a ballpen drawing from about 1990, that I digitally recreated by accurately following the lines using a graphics drawing tablet. Next I filled the shapes with digital colors before I finally decided to split the work into several puzzle-pieces, that can be independently change hue or alternatively display the outlines to turn it into an interactive AsyncArt work.

QmSXv4mRpv25Lg6QYoxAhJK98LURBiQJ1AZziUfh.name: Conflate
QmSXv4mRpv25Lg6QYoxAhJK98LURBiQJ1AZziUfh.description:
The human ego is both powerful and dangerous. The line between an inflated sense of self and grounded self aware is fine. Stray too far from the line either side and we leave our grounded reality. Reality is ready to knock you the fuck out when you stray too far.

We are prone to conflate trivial results with a sense of purpose and growth. We use tools to feed our ego. Drugs, money and a collective mania are a whirlwind of confirmation bias that have you thinking you are the shit. It means nothing, don’t conflate the randomness of the universe with how great you are.
In this piece, three symbols are feeding the ego.

Ethereum, symbolising how many artists are prone to conflate the value of their art to how skilled they are.

Xanax, Symbolising our constant need to use substances to step away from reality, but feel like we are partaking. Xanax has become a modern day classic for younger generations to use. Xanax makes everything feel great. The drug that makes you think there are no problems, making it one of the most dangerous drugs used.  Use this for too long and ego death is imminent.

Tulips, This is a pointer toward a time in history called ‘Tulip Mania’. See below
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tulip_mania

Are we going through a similar situation with Crypto and NFT? Have the troubles of lock down pushed society to find value elsewhere which is doomed to fail? Only time will tell. Collective thinking can be the hive minded ego inflation that destroys economies. Remember 2009 when hope destroyed peoples livelihoods. A whole system built on hope and ego.

Xanax, Symbolising our constant need to use substances to step away from reality, but feel like we are partaking. Xanax has become a modern day classic for younger generations to use. Xanax makes everything feel great. The drug that makes you think there are no problems, making it one of the most dangerous drugs used.  Use this for too long and ego death is imminent.

Tulips, This is a pointer toward a time in history called ‘Tulip Mania’. See below
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tulip_mania

Are we going through a similar situation with Crypto and NFT? Have the troubles of lock down pushed society to find value elsewhere which is doomed to fail? Only time will tell. Collective thinking can be the hive minded ego inflation that destroys economies. Remember 2009 when hope destroyed peoples livelihoods. A whole system built on hope and ego.

QmSaPugqRkd7JLpRsxcfpoQBYp867kBHTqspFpkd.name: Hermes Trismegistus
QmSaPugqRkd7JLpRsxcfpoQBYp867kBHTqspFpkd.description: Ἑρμῆς ὁ Τρισμέγιστος, "thrice-greatest Hermes" is the purported author of the Hermetic Corpus, a series of sacred texts that are the basis of Hermeticism. As a divine source of wisdom, Hermes Trismegistus was credited with tens of thousands of writings of high standing, reputed to be of immense antiquity. The Hermetica is a category of papyri containing spells and initiatory induction procedures. In the dialogue called the Asclepius (after the Greek god of healing) the art of imprisoning the souls of demons or of angels in statues with the help of herbs, gems and odors, is described, such that the statue could speak and engage in prophecy. In other papyri, there are recipes for constructing such images and animating them, such as when images are to be fashioned hollow so as to enclose a magic name inscribed on gold leaf.

QmSd41T8VQCn9vcZswNfpaPQHhMByNBEJZgcCck9.name: Song of The Coins
QmSd41T8VQCn9vcZswNfpaPQHhMByNBEJZgcCck9.description:
Addition to my 'Data Art' series this is my new exploration of 'Simulation + Data Art' this is a road to experiment data artworks with an intent of adding the right theme style and a simulative approach apart from being fully abstract. This is an artistic expression of datasets of 24hr high price (USD) of major coins like Bitcoin BTC, Ethereum ETH and Litecoin LTC.

Generating a sequence of notes with a pitch corresponding to the price data value of the coins. The visual representation is an audio spectrum of all 3 coins price fluctuation of 1 year (~2020). The prices make the audio beats and hence the visual spectrum. The master image consists of all data from all three coins. The idea of sonification of data came from endless datart-workshop experiments and after everyday trial and errors of finding different dimensions to visualize data beautifully. A node-based visual programming engine, image manipulation and other open-source software are combined to change dimensions of raw data and render into desired results.

Master audio: www.bit.ly/3r59ifI
Read more on portfolio: www.flatarc.io

QmSnSmN6i45U4xu49rj4aVRCgqve7ZMwQgwSBkyi.name: FOMO, Greed and the parasites
QmSnSmN6i45U4xu49rj4aVRCgqve7ZMwQgwSBkyi.description:
This piece takes a look at the Ikari side of human behaviour. Ikari means anger, wrath, exasperation. I use expressionism to visualise Ikari. 

Here I visualize societies social and moral issues that cause harm and grief to human lives. 

FOMO and greed is often interchangeable. In these pieces you will see minimal changes and similarities in FOMO and Greed. 

Parasites on the other hand leech onto people and drain them. Humans are the greatest parasites.

QmSoCv5bvU8JHM1odgkuiMa9cL4NcxWmbx3HwyE4.name: Experimental No.3 #212821
QmSoCv5bvU8JHM1odgkuiMa9cL4NcxWmbx3HwyE4.description:
Artwork Title: Experimental No.3 #212821
Date of Artwork: 2021
Dimension: 1728 pixel x 2160 pixel
Type of Work: Silver Gelatin Photogram, Digital Painting
Edition: Unique
Note: This artwork is a type of digital art. The hand-made photogram is one of the subjects that compose this piece, and this photogram is not for sale separately whatever in the crypto world or the real world.

Notwithstanding, the beginning of the photography is representational, it ultimately leads to the way of the abstract. Photography has nothing to do with painting, although the thinking of abstractness renders them getting closer and closer. Photography remains the interpretation of "Light", and to express the “Light” is its inescapable responsibility. I find the "Line" could be one of the forms to present the "Light". I apply the "Line", also is the "Light", to destroy a completed and finished photograph, and change it into a new form of art and have a unique way of spreading and viewing. Through this new attempt to keep looking for balance and harmony.

Notwithstanding, the beginning of the photography is representational, it ultimately leads to the way of the abstract. Photography has nothing to do with painting, although the thinking of abstractness renders them getting closer and closer. Photography remains the interpretation of "Light", and to express the “Light” is its inescapable responsibility. I find the "Line" could be one of the forms to present the "Light". I apply the "Line", also is the "Light", to destroy a completed and finished photograph, and change it into a new form of art and have a unique way of spreading and viewing. Through this new attempt to keep looking for balance and harmony.
