QmSoxTiP6GeAs6QsCYZhNDa6Jfp9YLqpieJXTxEU.name: Cybèle
QmSoxTiP6GeAs6QsCYZhNDa6Jfp9YLqpieJXTxEU.description:
As a press photographer, I attended many red carpet events. Though I witnessed glamorous moments, faces and looks, I realized that I was drawn to create this world from a different perspective; one which undressed the soul, and rendered a more authentic moment. After some time, it became the same scenes, the same clichés, the same smiles, the same looks and the same photographers. As a celebrity, having to see more than 30 flashes per second every time a photographer spots them, probably makes them want to protect themselves. Seeing celebrities live in this world of excessive media coverage, I started to develop a mixed feeling of admiration and respect, but also pity, and finally detachment. 

The Personalities are decomposed and re-assembled in an abstract composition, guided by my instinct and fed by what the model inspired in me.

The original digital size of "Cybèle" portrait is 120 by 180 cm. 

This is a portrait of the artist Solange Knowles.

QmSqRyuoTwNcwJ2KHW8kssK785dnendpAw1qWvnN.name: Big Trouble in Māo Māo City
QmSqRyuoTwNcwJ2KHW8kssK785dnendpAw1qWvnN.description: The origins of Māo Māo City are lost to pre-history, before rough tongues could speak, before our claws would carve these marble idols, when humans were our masters. This much we know. Some say once cats were worshipped as gods, but I say, any god gets his balls cut off, ain't no kind of god at all. Out of that era we hear only the howling songs yowled in the early years of cat cognition. And the Pixel Records dug from the endless chains and remants of the Virtual Multitude, still running to this day on DeCentral Station, a dangerous Multiverse of endless reflection plasma-gapped from the Global Grid. These days there's tension in the Double Māo. Kitty God's Army units openly patrolling the streets, Short-cats on the scene looking for answers, Marlene can barely feed her kittens, Ol' Mangey's on the moloko again. I even heard a rumor the Amigos are expanding their territory. It's like you need 10 lives just to survive in this town. We all feel it. This city is filled with fear and that fear has a name. Kung Paw. Once the Elite Guards, by claw and fang they cut through all opposition to their Emperor's terrible will, until the night his Majesty's kitcubine slipped on the raised dias, and their agile Captain Aditi caught her mid-fall. Though he kept her paw from touching the ground and preserved her honor, his own paws had broken the deepest taboo and by the Emperor's own decree - the punishment was death. In a moment of weakness or love, the Emperor commuted the sentence to exile. Enraged their leader was denied an honorable death, the Kung Paw slaughtered the Emperor in dark memorial and fled into exile to search for their Master, making way for the popular uprising that swept the city, and this uneasy peace that's descended. It was rumored that the Kung Paw found their leader in a great cavern underground in the wastes of the West, performing arcane rituals to seek forbidden power. These days I don't know what to believe... Pray the Eyes of the Kitty God are upon us now, my kitties. Look to the East and Shao Mountain. Surely righteous cats still walk this domain.

QmSr1dxsVNwMdo8t7ZXumhyar5gHp1xvjiy2Hcz1.name: The Whistler
QmSr1dxsVNwMdo8t7ZXumhyar5gHp1xvjiy2Hcz1.description:
The Master's Study

The conception of oil painting began as a statement of wealth.  Landscapes with castles overlooking their lands filled with the owner's livestock.  Tables filled with exotic foods and expensive crystal to display possessions.  Mythological scenes were stories of high society, the privileged knowledge only to the wealthy.  Pretentious portraits of royalty; it isn't their faces that glow in these compositions, but their dresses and jewelry.  

The painting of The Whistling Boy by Frank Duveneck (1848-1919) is a painting representing a blue collar worker.  The work at the time in history helps represents part of a departure of paintings representing an individual’s monetary value.  Painting began to be about the average joe, instead of the rich and wealthy.  The painting wasn't about depicting treasures, bounty's won, still lives filled with riches.  But now the painting was about being human, and the daily toils of life from the average worker.  In this context, this was a very remarkable painting of its' time.  And what for, would an artist make a painting like this?  To get paid?  Whom would ever purchase a work of this manner?....

 The artist takes the notion even further, capturing a moment where the boy is whistling. A satirical element in many respects: Has this poor boy immortalized himself through oil painting, and is he whistling to spite all of the rich nobility that came before him in this tradition of portraiture? Not to mention the haphazard way the clothing is painted, truly a disgrace to the fine art of painting.

The whistle, not only a final cat call from a disrespectful boy, but also full of such poetry. The artist captures that one moment in time, breathing life into this pile of colored mud we call paint. It’s quite a beautiful moment, and it inspired me with that same type of dynamic humor. I built upon this scene, which adds even more layers to this game that always lead us to second-guess ourselves. My work reveals these hidden elements with a twist of ironic absurdness. (Note, a recent cleaning of Duveneck’s painting revealed a cigarette in the boy’s hand. Doesn’t this change the entire meaning of this work from how it has been presented?)

As we shift from dawn/day/dusk/night we notice a hideous green monster appearing.  In remembering the Dr. Hide and Mr. Jeckyl's, Doctor Banner and his evil Hulk side.  In the new found NFT artworld, is painting remembering it's ugly pasts? Is the beast rearing its' head?  Or is it the artist with the hulking power of the beast now?  For value rests clearly inside....

Original oil on canvas created from the Master Study's series of work, 2014-2015
In creating this piece, I feel the formal attributes of the dynamic shifts on the blockchain can showcase the double-sided nature of this work, the history that it contained, and how the work has transformed even further with a digital movement and the implement meanings that continue to flow and evolve from the work.  Truly a timeless, and now (block)less artwork.

QmStQcuqu3T4fFY6CBLctPwrNpcgjTDq2rLEmVUj.name: Dark Moods
QmStQcuqu3T4fFY6CBLctPwrNpcgjTDq2rLEmVUj.description:
"...The world was divided into two countries.
Every photograph taken in the first was of people.
Every photograph taken in the second showed none."
--excerpt from the poem Genesis by Mary Ruefle

Beauty is a perception. Absolutes do not hold.

That perception is not ready to be perceived. The act of perceiving is an effort and its outcome as well as its inception is probabilistic. 

Between the probabilities and the perceptions, beauty or read it as reality is elusive.

Dark Moods is my imagination playing tricks to itself. Based on public domain photography from Pixabay, each image is composed of multiple images forming a state of its own. As I've perceived each image as a totality, I did not break down to layers. Instead I've provided the four images with different levels of alterations as a continuum in itself.

Dark Moods minted June 2021 on Async Art by Hulki Okan Tabak

QmSv5G1S3i3LGL7as5GPBwMEZWfTyq7XwcgwQ7q9.name: '''Karmic Wait ...
QmSv5G1S3i3LGL7as5GPBwMEZWfTyq7XwcgwQ7q9.description:
Any worthwhile lifework in the universe fulfills an existing need, serves a purpose, and generates personal satisfaction. The commitment satiates and rewards outside the promise of money. Our world has seen a growing belief in Karmic energy, a belief that the universe rewards with either a tangible blessing or a strong sense of fulfillment when you do good. The same phenomenon strongly identifies with the lives of some medical workers who heartily embrace the heaven-vested duty assigned to them by the universe.
Post any successful yet complex surgery, a sense of fulfillment floods the surgical team, and for once, life feels intimate, and its possibilities are sensed with greater intensity. This band darted into plains of positivity where consistent hope is cultivated and courage to expect the good is adopted.

Our world has seen a growing belief in Karmic energy, a belief that the universe rewards with either a tangible blessing or a strong sense of fulfillment when you do good. The same phenomenon strongly identifies with the lives of some medical workers who heartily embrace the heaven-vested duty assigned to them by the universe.
Post any successful yet complex surgery, a sense of fulfillment floods the surgical team, and for once, life feels intimate, and its possibilities are sensed with greater intensity. This band darted into plains of positivity where consistent hope is cultivated and courage to expect the good is adopted.

QmSv7uKgbTYcSAzjCjVurcS1bcvbsZGcZCQDTCRp.name: Big Bounce
QmSv7uKgbTYcSAzjCjVurcS1bcvbsZGcZCQDTCRp.description:
According to the Big Bounce scenario, the universe did not begin with the Big Bang. Rather, a universe existed that contracted into an unprecedentedly hot, dense state (which we think of as the Big Bang) and then expanded again. These drawings - Day and Night - reflect that scenario, the Big Bounce, in which everything contracts again.

These are unique hand-drawn artworks. The artworks Day and Night - #2 and #3 - were created on sturdy black drawing sheets measuring seventy by fifty centimeters. Due to the unique drawing technique, each art production was time intensive.

QmSvTLPCFn8zVUADDWztiyKaXJ8jpjzuKyN3nTcY.name: OUR FATHER IN THE METAVERSE #4
QmSvTLPCFn8zVUADDWztiyKaXJ8jpjzuKyN3nTcY.description:
https://mathiasrusch-metaverse.com/


The "Our Father" - The cycle of paintings by artist Mathias Rusch (*1927-2003).


If there is a most important prayer of Christian faith, then it must be the "Our Father".


This prayer gift of Jesus to his disciples, later handed down to us Christians, has become the actual Christian self-understanding, the "prayer of the Lord". Packed into a few sentences, it has come to be regarded as the actual confession of faith and is prayed millions of times a day, both individually and in communities. The fact that this "conversation with God" has hardly ever been depicted (in contrast to the Passion) is probably due to the immense message it conveys. The fact that the painter Mathias Rusch dared to translate the "Our Father" can be explained by the fact that his daily work was based on faith, hope, and trust in God. Mathias Rusch was aware that he could only exist in the understanding of his art "as a gift of God". Most of his late works (Our Father, Live and Let Live, Sermon on the Mount, Lauretan Litany, Litany of the Sacred Heart) were written, as he confessed, under the "kind help" of the Highest, always accompanied by personal prayers, meditations or invocations. The fact that Mathias Rusch did not reveal a word for the interpretation of his works of art is to be justified by the fact that he understood himself to a large extent as a mediator of a higher power. Thus we are sometimes quite helplessly confronted with an immense abundance of Christian symbols, metaphysical allusions, concretizations, and abstractions, in unique hues and compositions. Completely in the sense of Mathias Rusch we dive before the 13 works of art into the enormous topic of earthly existence and Christian eschatology, marvel before the color power, before the hints, confessions, and convictions of the very deeply felt "Our Father's". Finally, we become humbled and ultimately grateful to be initiated into the world-prayer of a "knowing" believer, again and again, with each glance at each of these magnificent works of art. Whoever takes a longer "eye" look at this self-contained, unique complete work, consisting of 13 unique pieces in oil on canvas, 170x170cm, will not be able to resist a lasting effect and deep consternation.

QmSwAe3zu1VXvwYL49yH5VoJHqdNusKd1XqBFyKP.name: Before Sunrise
QmSwAe3zu1VXvwYL49yH5VoJHqdNusKd1XqBFyKP.description: For the most part, we are abstract, determined by motives that arise from thoughts, not by immediate impressions.  Much of the reason for our pain and happiness is not the actual "now" but abstract thinking. When we have intense mental pain, we even create some physical pain, just to divert our attention from mental pain to physical pain. Mental pain is far greater than physical pain, it hurts the body more easily and more seriously than physical pain. "It's not the things themselves that trouble people, it's people's beliefs or perceptions about them."

QmSwhPTqdZCdRzhw8dyJpLE1kdzPcDtP1g3dUY8n.name: dLOVE.
QmSwhPTqdZCdRzhw8dyJpLE1kdzPcDtP1g3dUY8n.description:
​dCREATION. is the first artistic attempt to represent and idealize the origin of humanity following the new evolutionary theories. Fine Art history meets the Sci-fi worldwide trend in a unique atmosphere of emotions and colors, leaving a window for every kind of personal interpretation. A fantastic series of four different Art Pieces to describe the unknown feeling between the Creator and his born, all connected by a third element, the “God Particle” or the Higgs-Boson, which plays an essential role in this metaphysical relationship. The three parts of the whole, the sacred Trinity, all those essences find a place to exist in this abstract world, a reality full of mysteries and secrets, which will reveal a new vision of human evolution myth. A dualism of specific colors characterizes each piece to describe all feelings involved in this ancient and primordial love, where is essential to find your own truth to explain the whole.

Illustration n.2: dLOVE.

QmSwyKWmB3vNK8tqRBMBtoHNHx1ue7bSLByb71FE.description:
This artwork can display 16,777,216 colors using only 3 layers.

It works by implementing the RGB Color Model, in which the red, green, and blue primary colors of light are added together in various ways. Each layer has multiple states from 0-255, which can be changed to produce any color within the 16,777,216 available colors.

QmT2dqfERZAywC1xKsi3CCs9KWMVhp8DWdf4eomJ.name: Surreal Storyteller: Fragments of the Story
QmT2dqfERZAywC1xKsi3CCs9KWMVhp8DWdf4eomJ.description:
"In the United terminal in Chicago at five on a Friday afternoon
The sky is breaking with rain and wind and all the flights
Are delayed forever. We will never get to where we are going
And there’s no way back to where we’ve been.
The sun and the moon have disappeared to an island far from  anywhere.

Everybody has a heartache — "
---from Everybody Has a Heartache: A Blues by Joy Harjo

...

Surreal Storyteller is stranded in his own stories. He can not get to where he is going as that place is constructed via the story he tells. Lacking the necessary audience, Surreal Storyteller is stuck in a semi-permanent existence of de-construction and re-construction amidst his stories.

...

Surreal Storyteller: Fragments of the Story by Hulki Okan Tabak

I enjoy creating fluid projects that arise from an idea and run for long stretches where I contribute new works. As I've grown to like the combination I use Async Art and KnownOrigin as the primary minting venues for the project.

Special thanks to one of my most admired storytellers Joy as I referenced her poem. I feel a part of her tribe that spans beyond native American land. Much love and admiration..

1/1 minted on Async Art, 2022

QmT55AGu1hStmLdnp7otZ4RqKv6yMWAVHF6zea4S.name: The encoffiner of data 数据入殓师
QmT55AGu1hStmLdnp7otZ4RqKv6yMWAVHF6zea4S.description:
The encoffiner of data
This work explores the issue of digital heritage that has arrived. I imagined a career as a data encoffiner, using her perspective to examine the data that people have left in the world. Digital heritage carries the memories of the dead, the sorrows and joys... For the clues, we follow the path of the data grave to explore the secrets of a person’s memory.
数据入殓师
此作品探讨已经到来的数字遗产问题. 我想象了一个数据入殓师的职业, 用她的视角审视人们留存于世的数据. 数字遗产承载了亡者生前的回忆, 喜怒哀乐… 顺着数据留下的线索, 我们沿着数据坟墓的小径, 探索一个人记忆的深处的秘密。

http://gaowenqian.com/

QmT76LQy3qn5nagW6ZjDzCZci8cGrcRokFmh8yqS.name: Mind Sketch II
QmT76LQy3qn5nagW6ZjDzCZci8cGrcRokFmh8yqS.description:
"...So, like a sentinel, he could not sleep. The night was full of wrong,
Earthquakes and executions. Soon he would be dead,
And still all over Europe stood the horrible nurses
Itching to boil their children. Only his verses
Perhaps could stop them: He must go on working: Overhead
The uncomplaining stars composed their lucid song."
--from the poem Voltaire at Ferney by W.H. Auden

Mind Sketch II is the second of the mind sketches. Cerebral looking emotionally involved pieces of personal expression bullshit confusion love lost thoughts and experimentation. Purposefully quoting Auden whom I admire, specifically focusing on Voltaire for some reason or another.

Mind Sketch II consists of two pieces to be displayed half and half during the day and the night.

Minted on Async Art on June 2021 by Hulki Okan Tabak

QmT81gXEKKmheXiY3TSY3473fdQcYpT61uzGeL65.name: Artist Art
QmT81gXEKKmheXiY3TSY3473fdQcYpT61uzGeL65.description:
We make art because there is something inside the creative person that needs to get out. The poet, musician, actor, and visual artist all have a desire to express what they feel and to create something of great value. It's a type of therapy or a form of meditation. Many do art for the pure joy of it.
When society has clarity on issues, opportunities for change in thought exist, as well as an appreciation of the message behind the art.
Art can cause people to reexamine their thinking on the subject that’s put before them.

QmT9KMoL8cdBjHSfSPK9zZmPGscjhAZrkbu2TrdA.name: Collective Instinct
QmT9KMoL8cdBjHSfSPK9zZmPGscjhAZrkbu2TrdA.description:
This piece echoes the utter essentialness of collective instinct and teamwork for doctors and their teams in the healthcare setting. The trust built and the cohesion cemented reduces the chances of medical errors and develops a greater appreciation of each other's work. This phenomenal approach enables these professionals to better meet patient needs as a collective, and through shared responsibility, their tasks are smoothed and procedures timely executed. Observations and decisions made together guarantee them enhanced efficiency and effectiveness.
Exemplified is a classic case of workplace teamwork, something they execute so well that demands a heightened sense of social and relationship awareness.

QmTADBCtc2X2NsALnddXHkBWWgvdHpwmbLnsfQC9.name: In The Future Everyone Will Want To Be Anonymous For 15 Minutes
QmTADBCtc2X2NsALnddXHkBWWgvdHpwmbLnsfQC9.description:
The piece is a pop art reinterpretation of Magritte's painting, Woman's Face covered by a Rose.

The focus of the artwork is a female whose facial features are concealed by the flower.
The aesthetic and messages in the piece explore a complex social construct, the nature of the metaverse and the concept of anonymity versus the need to be recognized.

Follow your (he)art but take your head with you.

We are the metaverse.

QmTAdw885caCswbbW48kgwW7SDDLK6Wr3CF4GPrg.name: Dover: The Unseen Discovered
QmTAdw885caCswbbW48kgwW7SDDLK6Wr3CF4GPrg.description:
Dover: The Unseen Discovered by Mad Monk

Part of a three artwork series on Async Art

Minted as a 4-piece artwork on Async Art, 2022

...

The piece is a human AI collaboration based on manipulated text input inspired by Mary Ruefle's poem Seven Postcards from Dover.

"The teacher said inner truth
and the chalk said like a fresco inside the earth
that no one has ever seen
and one day decides to be discovered
and begins to breathe—
do you know what that means?"
--- excerpt from Mary Ruefle's poem Seven Postcards from Dover

QmTC1jemTsSEytHD8C2XzahVXAYzqVQtfU79JMvm.name: My Lifetime
QmTC1jemTsSEytHD8C2XzahVXAYzqVQtfU79JMvm.description:
Pathways to the feeling of being complete; turns, backsides, loops, and nonsense end up at the same spot. 
Your ways determine some emotions, others by your environment. 
The fact we reach for answers gives the feeling of being lost, only to end up filling up our own lives to be as they are supposed to be.

Surf was the backdoor to the emptiness I had found in my youth. Having problems for finding myself in the middle of the chaos everyone called life. A labyrinth of emotions and challenges that made me what I am today. I wouldn't get rid of anything. It's part of my life. It's part of me. I wouldn't be the person I am today if I hadn't had those experiences, and I'm grateful for that.

QmTDA2qiQ3P8AyTyv5dCyejw2q3iGnPw779nHtro.name: Origin
QmTDA2qiQ3P8AyTyv5dCyejw2q3iGnPw779nHtro.description:
The journey of man has finally taken us to the heavens where one day we might possibly find the source that we are made out of or, better yet; see our own reflection, kindly and graciously, looking back at us. 

This is a series of photographs created in a time where space travel is becoming more accessible to the average person and where mankind is looking outward more than any time before. 

As an artist with a photographic vision, I believe strongly to portray the human spirit as a center point rather than a pawn within our universe. 

May this brief yet timeless collection bring you continued success on your journey through space, time, and immortality. 


Creatively Yours, 
Giano Currie 


(As the first artwork of hopefully many more on this platform I am offering a printed version to its future owner)

QmTEGXsPEddKLipvmEgSQR7RLRXGxPfRuf7c9Qnq.name: The Eye
QmTEGXsPEddKLipvmEgSQR7RLRXGxPfRuf7c9Qnq.description:
Humans destroy the environment and don't see themselves in the process. The world changes and we don't realize that the environment is what unites us.

The artwork “The Eye” intends to criticize the changes made by humans to the environment and how it does not recognize himself as the offender. The moment he looks in the mirror, he never sees exactly what he is.

Each layer has a meaning in its colors and shapes. Their combinations tell a story through historical events on Earth.

QmTEmiYTwZzXAujx7sVA23K5V2mdNmUuHKhNsFgz.name: The Different Pages of My Room
QmTEmiYTwZzXAujx7sVA23K5V2mdNmUuHKhNsFgz.description:
Sometimes two's a crowd
Sometimes you need more space
Sometimes you might need love in a different kind of way
I want to be your best friend every day
I want to be the one you love
I want to be your confidant
I wanna be the one you trust and care for
I want to be the one that fills your mind with something new
I want to be the one you hold on tight
I want to be the one that you'd run to at night
I want to be the one you never let go of
I want to be the one who understands what you need
I want to be the one who brings out the best in you

But I also wanna be the one who loves you.
For now, I just enjoy the intimacy.


This piece began as a photograph of my room. Then I added photographs of Adire which are symbolic and crucial to representing my culture in my artworks. Next, I paint the flowers and the human figures in my usual workflow, thereby creating a balance between the painted foreground and the photographed background.

QmTFcH9zUBWJ86x1Jop55Q8vM5gQm2ipkPydN5na.name: The Way Of The Bullrun
QmTFcH9zUBWJ86x1Jop55Q8vM5gQm2ipkPydN5na.description:
Portrait of the greatest icon of martial arts cinema of all times and one of the biggest pop culture icons of the 20th century.

The artwork also explores bullrun and bull market concepts and strong faith that is present in the crypto community.

It is made in pop art/street style and additionally delves into comic book cover style and includes the number of the crypto artwork minted by the artist.

“If you always put limits on everything you do, physical or anything else, it will spread into your work and into your life. There are no limits. There are only plateaus, and you must not stay there, you must go beyond them.”

“If you always put limits on everything you do, physical or anything else, it will spread into your work and into your life. There are no limits. There are only plateaus, and you must not stay there, you must go beyond them.”

QmTGdbqgGDNoV7kkSRA5JhLcfmHjPACCuchxU3mo.name: 3l3m3nt4l
QmTGdbqgGDNoV7kkSRA5JhLcfmHjPACCuchxU3mo.description:
This series of elemental mandala collages were created during a time filled with emotional turmoil. 

Inspired by a Buddhist meditation practice called Metta Bhavana (Loving Kindness); I embarked on the creation of these four collages, with the objective of transmuting through creative practice, this unskillful yet natural emotional state of mind, into love, kindness and forgiveness - for the self and the other.

In researching Buddhist iconography and associated symbolic meaning, homage was payed to the source of this Metta practice, by incorporating the five Buddhas with their associated correlational properties:

Akshobhya = Blue = Water = Dawn
Ratnasambhava = Yellow = Earth = Noon
Amitabha = Red = Fire = Sunset
Amoghasiddhi = Green = Air = Midnight.

The 5th Buddha is incorporated around the circumference of the four collages:
Vairochana = White = Space = Timeless

These images were original digitally created a 4000x4000px, then reduced to 2160x2160px to upload to ASYNC.

Correlation source: 'The Mandala of the Five Buddhas' - by Vessantara (c)1999 [Windhorse Publications]

QmTGt6xg1jxfhjm7174iqyDUHT2TCGgqWLGucGQG.name: Regalia
QmTGt6xg1jxfhjm7174iqyDUHT2TCGgqWLGucGQG.description:
Regalia is a generative, participatory and interactive artwork meant to let the audience be a part of the creation of the art itself. Using GANs and photo manipulation, I created the Insignias at the centre. The area around the Insignia is a playground where anyone can draw and complete the artwork. Regardless of skill levels, anyone can make amazing creations because of the use of symmetry. 

The interactive artwork is at : https://nurecas.github.io/regalia/ . By clicking/tapping and drawing around the insignia different symmetrical patterns can be created. The final artwork can be downloaded by pressing enter/return key. Also, this page is linked to the layers of Regalia, i.e. based on the states of the different layers, the colour palette of the artwork, the central insignia, the planes of symmetry and the brush size changes. Thus, the owner of each layer controls the look and feel of the artwork and its creation process. 

I believe that a true artist starts by creating/curating his tools of creation. In the same spirit, many of my works hitherto have been on creating tools, digital or otherwise, and then using those tools to create art. Regalia is also created with the same concept in mind.

QmTGwujRdu864q1vupk5CodteTFux5RkNHXCTsmg.name: Tears, of Sadness & Joy
QmTGwujRdu864q1vupk5CodteTFux5RkNHXCTsmg.description:
This is for the people who feel like they never belong, the outsiders.
The outcasts, the exiled, the divergent thinkers. 
The ones who join groups, but never feel part of the community.

Your existence matters! 

Night State represents sadness and loneliness.
A dark veil causing blindness from the primal truth: 
Nature gave us the gift of existing. It doesn't matter who you are, your mere existence is a cause for celebration. It doesn't matter what others think about it, nature believes you have a role in this, like everybody else.

Day State represents joy and love.
The dark veil is off. The individual, while still lonely, experiences feelings of acceptance. The void created by the craved love is filled with peace. 
They discover that love has many sources, it can be given, but it can also be generated within.

QmTJU2cm2DfiXRfAK1yr2TvfCqiJyPEdeCE3JjUC.name: Experimental No.3 #7840
QmTJU2cm2DfiXRfAK1yr2TvfCqiJyPEdeCE3JjUC.description:
Artwork Title: Experimental No.3 #7840
Date of Artwork: 2021
Dimension: 1688 pixel x 2160 pixel
Type of Work: Silver Gelatin Photogram, Digital Painting
Edition: Unique
Note: This artwork is a type of digital art. The hand-made photogram is one of the subjects that compose this piece, and this photogram is not for sale separately whatever in the crypto world or the real world.

Notwithstanding, the beginning of the photography is representational, it ultimately leads to the way of the abstract. Photography has nothing to do with painting, although the thinking of abstractness renders them getting closer and closer. Photography remains the interpretation of "Light", and to express the “Light” is its inescapable responsibility. I find the "Line" could be one of the forms to present the "Light". I apply the "Line", also is the "Light", to destroy a completed and finished photograph, and change it into a new form of art and have a unique way of spreading and viewing. Through this new attempt to keep looking for balance and harmony.

From communicating their basic emotions, to discussing the economic implications of rising Ethereum gas prices, Pixel Tribe Kitties will keep each other entertained for hours. 

As their communications evolve and become more sophisticated, the inhabitants will come to realize that certain combinations of emotes will unlock secrets within their world. Try it out for yourself, if you're lucky enough to adopt a Kitty.

QmTTfgFMDu45V3SFdM3K9KmV7JAMQD8CtLKEzJ8n.name: History’s Monsters
QmTTfgFMDu45V3SFdM3K9KmV7JAMQD8CtLKEzJ8n.description:
At the Acropolis Museum in Athens lie the fragments of dozens of carcasses, cast in stone and marble. Heads without bodies, hands without arms, horses without their riders. These ghostly splinters are a stark reminder of the legacy of colonial history; their missing parts scattered around the museums of the world, from London to The Louvre. 

‘History’s Monsters’ is an attempt to glue history back together, collecting broken fragments of ancient Greek sculptures, statues and grotesques from across the world and reconstructing them in a horrifying game of Exquisite Corpse. The Frankensteins that are created in turn recall the many gods and hybrids that populate ancient Greek mythology, from Medusa to the Minotaur, and from Cerberus to the Cyclops. These are history’s monsters. 

The piece consists of twelve monsters. Each monster changes colour and texture depending on whether it’s night or day in Athens, Greece (where the Acropolis Museum stands), to create twenty-four unique images, metamorphosing every hour - a macabre clock. The first visual creation of London-based band HMLTD, and following their Async Music genesis piece 'LEAVING', 'History's Monsters' will play an integral role in their upcoming second album campaign.

QmTW6cw6EiM5F2McdDhJF4K5oBLLeN1AurNt4QGR.description:
Diana, is inspired by "Diana and Her maidens", an 1898 painting by Edward Robert Hughes.

In Ovid's version of the Metamorphosis poem, a hidden lake appears in the wooded valley of Gargaphie. There, Diana, the goddess of the woods, bathed and rested after a hunt. 
Actaeon, a young hunter, accidentally witnessed the bath of the goddess. In retaliation, Diana splashed him with pool water, cursed him, and transformed into a deer.

QmTYLoefie88wr9RdYn8QFrxm2s53LvPBTUG6bRN.name: Dark Tourism - Chernobyl (24 Photo Editions in 1 NFT)
QmTYLoefie88wr9RdYn8QFrxm2s53LvPBTUG6bRN.description:
Dark tourism is a concept where you visit the worlds most darkest places ever historically associated with death, tragedy and suffering.
In 2017, I've visited Chernobyl. Took the tour to visit Kiev, Pripyat, and Chernobyl Nuclear Reactor Site.

The ghost city of Pripyat was amazing. When the government back then declared an evacuation, people didn't have any time to take their belongings with them.
All they packed was their clothes in small bags.

Pripyat was one of the richest cities in the whole world back then as the wages of the workers of Nuclear site was enough for them to become wealthy.
But money didn't solve anything when, in 26th of April, 1986, the reactor exploded.

The abandoned Pripyat elementary school was also evacuated when the children were actually in classes.
And the tour guide says that none of the items in there were ever touched or re-placed.

This 24 photos are all taken by @koklucinar and generated by eNFThusiast.
It's a portrait design. Hope you enjoy it with your Meurals or Apple TV's.

All original 24 photos, without the background frame details, will be provided upon request by the owner of this NFT.

Important Note: This is a programmable NFT. It contains 24 photos and it updates automatically every hour.
Come back in about an hour later to see the next photo or view all photos with the Async Art's explorer.

QmTaurEyzDi6BTLD3rrpj77qLen86oUF5cwwWeQi.name: The Zen Garden
QmTaurEyzDi6BTLD3rrpj77qLen86oUF5cwwWeQi.description:
I am attempting to Show the Beautiful  Simplicity of a ZEN Day!
The Basic Forms and Shapes, Enticed from the Natural Settings and formless light.
This should encourage a feeling of one with the images and the peacefulness and clarity of mind and spirit.

I find solace and humility in the pursuit of my own internal struggle.
Where my discoveries of my personality flaws, my ever changing and evolving "Self" and the internal struggles with the "I" allow me to keep moving forward.

I hope this piece brings comfort and contentment to whomever views it and i hope they gain some comfort from knowing these artworks have been therapeutic for me to create.  Please enjoy them for the purpose they where created, ZEN peacefulness, love and Joy.

QmTbzPUVv2AfEArLpr4cxjxoP2Ci6raRm7p4SDZu.name: La jalouse
QmTbzPUVv2AfEArLpr4cxjxoP2Ci6raRm7p4SDZu.description:
As a press photographer, I attended many red carpet events. Though I witnessed glamorous moments, faces and looks, I realized that I was drawn to create this world from a different perspective; one which undressed the soul, and rendered a more authentic moment. After some time, it became the same scenes, the same clichés, the same smiles, the same looks and the same photographers. As a celebrity, having to see more than 30 flashes per second every time a photographer spots them, probably makes them want to protect themselves. Seeing celebrities live in this world of excessive media coverage, I started to develop a mixed feeling of admiration and respect, but also pity, and finally detachment. 

The Personalities are decomposed and re-assembled in an abstract composition, guided by my instinct and fed by what the model inspired in me.

The original digital size of "La jalouse" portrait is 120 by 180 cm. 

This is a portrait of the actress Ashley Judd.

QmTc9DuGmxDmeJH8vZNTScZ5ussMaktj9TEEmUgW.name: PHONONS
QmTc9DuGmxDmeJH8vZNTScZ5ussMaktj9TEEmUgW.description:
Phonons is an Async Music piece composed of 7 individual stems, each one of them capable of 5 interchangeable variants.
A Phonon can be described as a unit of vibrational energy that arises from oscillating atoms within a crystal.
The vision behind this piece is to to represent the cycle of life, evolution, discovery, mutation and conflict through sound.
Each stem in each of its variants plays an equally important role in achieving this transformation by blending, fusing and at times clashing with its counter-particles.
This track is designed to loop endlessly: its end reconnects with the beginning in a perpetual cycle.

PULSE is the beginning of the voyage
BREATH is the first contact with reality 
MASS is where particles expands, experience and grow
TRANSMUTE represents the ability to change, morph and reinvent
ANTI-MATTER is absence of tone, a negative space where noise and disruption take center stage

options.label: Take a picture where we wave to a future without us.
Inside the Pantheon you feel touched by a conscious light.
To brave it, you will need more than just courage; you will need to believe.
‘To do this, we have to ask our rulers: Can you leave the water in the rivers, the trees in the forest? Can you leave the bauxite in the mountain?’ ~ Arundhati Roy

Currently, before we do anything or touch anything, we are asking ourselves, “Is it safe?”. It is the hardest question to answer considering the setting of Le Grand Tour; in a world drenched in the pangs of a pandemic and the climate change threat.
‘El lugar menos seguro romos nosotros a recan’ ~ Quote from Massel’s drawing in this Dada Conversation: https://dada.art/pa/132360

QmTiLJtDPz1NsmREku1VAR717MzamavZJBnm5EpD.name: Ride or Die
QmTiLJtDPz1NsmREku1VAR717MzamavZJBnm5EpD.description:
“Ride or Die” is PLS&TY’s newest single release in collaboration with Barbados-born soul singer, Bobby Saint. 

Tommy Leas, a Florida native - better known as PLS&TY - is burgeoning into the electronic dance music scene with his unique sound: languid bass, captivating vocals and enough upbeat melodies to make anybody feel good. After a collection of chart topping singles including "Good Vibes" (#1 on iTunes US Electronic Charts), "Down For Me", "Rebel Love (#1 on iTunes US Electronic Charts), and "Motives" (#1 on iTunes US Electronic Charts / Top 25 Billboard Electronic Charts), PLS&TY would see his productions Remixed by Grammy nominated Morgan Page, Rusko, Cazzette, Bondax, YehMe2 (Josh from Flosstradamus latest venture), and more. 

His music has amassed over 100 million listens across streaming platforms, and has been placed in nationally airing television commercials, including a Hershey's Chocolate campaign which has been viewed over 1 BILLION times. Prior to “Ride or Die”, PLS&TY kept busy with a 2019 touring season that included A-List electronic festivals Shaky Beats, Breakaway, Electric Forest, EDC Vegas, & more, along with the release of his “Very Special” EP, which included pop records with artists like Sean Kingston, Wifisfuneral, & Alex Aiono (of Netflix’s “Finding Ohana”).

“Ride or Die” is a summertime, feel-good single that encompasses love & romance. Saint’s vocals lead listeners to imagine time spent in tropical paradise with their partner. Now in programmable format on Async Music, users can select alternate variations of the stems that comprise the master track. In this way, the master track dynamically shifts and promotes adventure, like the upbeat tune itself that is “Ride or Die”.

QmTiMs8WL8sjd1MSNxewtiqsmemqiV9rvFcHbuUZ.name: From The Plain People
QmTiMs8WL8sjd1MSNxewtiqsmemqiV9rvFcHbuUZ.description:
From The Plain People
by Hulki Okan Tabak
minted 2021 on Async Art

4 artworks based on World War I propaganda posters from the US depicting the war time aid to Belgium. The core propaganda was to show the aid as humanitarian and from the plain people of the US to the ordinary Belgians. 

...

The Great War, history, politics, art, posters and propaganda are topics of interest for me. It was kind of natural that I wanted to incorporate that in my cryptoart creations. The desire led to a selection of public domain pieces out of copyright from the Library of Congress archives. I created all sorts of derivative pacifist and tongue-in-cheek works. So far I have only minted a handful on KnownOrigin. Starting September 2021, I will mint a more comprehensive set on Async Art and KO depending on the nature of the final artwork. The artwork presented here is part of that World War I Posters set.

38 States of a Young Woman is a generative study on an image itself created by mixing photography and other generative portraits.

There are 38 derivative images of which 28 are used to create 4 sets of images. The sets themselves are created in the order of image creation except for the 3 occasions (out of 28) when an image was replaced by one from the end of the list.

There are 7 sets of 4 images Day/Night cycles to be published on Async Art.

Athena Novo, 2022

QmTnWnYcp64u6q9ZDnNLYANebQQR1abgVSLV5Kc6.name: / ANDROMEDA /
QmTnWnYcp64u6q9ZDnNLYANebQQR1abgVSLV5Kc6.description:
Andromeda chained to a rock as a sacrifice to sate a sea monster, before being saved from death by Perseus, her future husband.
Inspired in Edward Poynter, son of the architect Ambrose Poynter. Edward met Frederick Leighton in Rome, who made a great impression on the 17-year-old.

Boasting of being as beautiful as the Nereids, Andromeda's mother, Cassiopeia, provoked the fury of Poseidon, who decided to flood the Earth and send the sea monster Ceto to destroy men and cattle. Cepheus, Andromeda's father, knew from the oracle of Amun what the only solution was: to marry his daughter to the monster. To do this, he left her only dressed in jewels and chained to a rock.
Perseus, who after killing Medusa had received winged sandals as a gift from the Naiads, saw her chained and fell in love with her. After asking for the girl's hand in exchange for killing the monster, Perseus, with the head of Medusa - who turned whoever looked at her to stone - killed Keto and turned him into a coral.
It is a theme represented in art by artists like Giorgio Vasari and Rembrandt.

QmTpBPCcUHVF46CfSgAiSAv5kYTZkZYwuBxzYhJS.name: Sonder
QmTpBPCcUHVF46CfSgAiSAv5kYTZkZYwuBxzYhJS.description:
“Sonder. You are the main character—the protagonist—the star at the center of your own unfolding story. You're surrounded by your supporting cast: friends and family hanging in your immediate orbit.

Scattered a little further out, a network of acquaintances who drift in and out of contact over the years.

But there in the background, faint and out of focus, are the extras. The random passersby. Each living a life as vivid and complex as your own.

They carry on invisibly around you, bearing the accumulated weight of their own ambitions, friends, routines, mistakes, worries, triumphs and inherited craziness.

When your life moves on to the next scene, theirs flickers in place, wrapped in a cloud of backstory and inside jokes and characters strung together with countless other stories you'll never be able to see. That you'll never know exists.

In which you might appear only once. As an extra sipping coffee in the background. As a blur of traffic passing on the highway. As a lighted window at dusk.”

― The Dictionary of Obscure Sorrows - John Koenig

QmTpfnRWzrXTdsdQeCT3FMRMwNtYcg4cKh1HKkHV.name: Paradigm Resolute
QmTpfnRWzrXTdsdQeCT3FMRMwNtYcg4cKh1HKkHV.description:
Resolve the Paradigm, resolve reality. 

This piece displays the complexity and beauty hidden behind the layers of perception in our seemingly simple reality, and the power of simple changes to create formidable shifts. How you use this power to shape this piece is in your hands.

The base pattern is a generated Fourier Transform of the Cardano blockchain logo using software created for my research thesis on Fourier phase holography for use in quantum optical and atomic physics. Here the artistry of nature is revealed behind the veil of science.

QmTpoFc2rne3bo3EgN4CBKvumcADKCiyr1iHGRtW.name: Getting In There
QmTpoFc2rne3bo3EgN4CBKvumcADKCiyr1iHGRtW.description:
Getting In There
by Hulki Okan Tabak
minted 2021 on Async Art

4 artworks based on World War I propaganda posters from Germany.   

...

The Great War, history, politics, art, posters and propaganda are topics of interest for me. It was kind of natural that I wanted to incorporate that in my cryptoart creations. The desire led to a selection of public domain pieces out of copyright from the Library of Congress archives. I created all sorts of derivative pacifist and tongue-in-cheek works. So far I have only minted a handful on KnownOrigin. Starting September 2021, I will mint a more comprehensive set on Async Art and KO depending on the nature of the final artwork. The artwork presented here is part of that World War I Posters set.

QmTr3VRRk2dNpGhP4TgTuPFNkWC2QJGVMnnynUwz.name: Making Memories
QmTr3VRRk2dNpGhP4TgTuPFNkWC2QJGVMnnynUwz.description:
"...I could leave these shores,
I could sail home, I could
take something with me,
I could leave something in
return, and at that word
it came back, alive."
---from Vapor Wake by Mary Ruefle

This is a 2 x 2 x 2 series. 2 states, 2 photographs, 2 artworks. Making Memories and Taking Memories are  out of town fun on the road. Photographs are from 1997. 

As I've read or heard somewhere not that long ago, possibly by Slavoj Zizek or my mind plays with me -- he was saying that memories are meaningful only if photographed. It would not mean much to have memories if there was no way store them. 

He of whoever it was meant to say that memory making, memory taking and memory recalling are interlinked. Logically, emotionally, socially and economically.

QmTvq577DLxFzPWPeMnsWEPG4DFcTQyDPFaKne8b.name: Path to Nirvana
QmTvq577DLxFzPWPeMnsWEPG4DFcTQyDPFaKne8b.description:
This is a puzzle that is the human's "sense of self".

Each of us has 3 parts of "self".  The Ego, Super Ego, and Id.
Ego is mostly the one representing us.  It's what we show to the world.  But it alone is not the true "self".  How can we be complete when we are only in touch with 1/3 of ourself?

Nirvana frees us from the effects of karma and the cycles of death and birth.  In order to get there, we must explore deep into our inner truth. 

When you accept, forgive, and love all 3 parts of you, you can be at peace with each and learn to let go.  The moment you truly becomes **"SELFLESS"**, Nirvana is here!

In this thought provoking artwork, watch how the 3 versions of "self" work with each other, or NOT, on this journey to Nirvana!  Who will show up today?  Tomorrow night?  Will the Ego let others come out to play?  Will the Super Ego finally let its hair down and free the Id?  Will they ever reach Nirvana?  It's all up to the Layer Owners...

The puzzle is simple, the meaning, complex. 

**OWNERS BEWARE, this is a piece of art as well as a piece of puzzle, each Layer acts as a gateway to the ones underneath.  When you own one of the Layers, you will decide how the identity on that Layer behaves.  It's meant to bring awareness to us, reflecting on our actions.  The reveals of the inner selves and Nirvana may be very quick, or take a very very long time.  It's all meant to mimic the real struggles we have with our "inner selves".**

metadata.name: Still I Rise and Fall Again and Climb Up and Fall Again to Rise Again
metadata.description:
Still I Rise and Fall Again and Climb Up and Fall Again to Rise Again by Hulki Okan Tabak

in the hope and perhaps vain belief that we hold a slight chance to make the future better
in anticipation of people organizations countries that rise beyond the confines of today
to go beyond for an ideal that encompassed not the loftiest of all goals but the mere essentials of humanity

with respect to Maya Angelou and her great poetry

QmU2eRyB3MgVW6k3tWRK68JKUXaSH976iMPDnASf.name: Kids Takeover Putin: Abstract #2
QmU2eRyB3MgVW6k3tWRK68JKUXaSH976iMPDnASf.description:
Based on Putin photography, Kids Takeover Putin is text-to-image experimentation on war, peace and leadership. It is re-creating the leadership in the eyes of a kid takeover for peace.

Stop the War. We hoped, I hoped this was already the past in Europe. We should not go back.

There is a lot of interesting material that range from childish and peaceful to satirical and dark. I will post them and perhaps I will post most of them hoping this ends as soon as possible.

This is one of the 2 4-piece somewhat abstract pieces on Async Art. There is also 1 24 piece set and 12 2-piece Nova Apartchiks on Async Art. For multi editions and some other 1/1s, please visit my collection on KnownOrigin.

by Mad Monk, 1/1 on Async Art, 2022

QmU6mxoiMA8DbxdJqdTVKbG9Nf4JTbX6vFvhY5vv.name: Lady Luck from Manifesto of Chance - III
QmU6mxoiMA8DbxdJqdTVKbG9Nf4JTbX6vFvhY5vv.description:
Lady Luck from Manifesto of Chance - III

Manifesto of Chance is a Blueprints project I've created involving trillions of combinations. Its ultimate "massage" is to let go and seize the day. 

Lady Luck series is derived from one of the base images used in the project and it is extensively edited. They are stand alone pieces which point out to seeing (not solving) the larger puzzle of the project. None of the Lady Luck themed artworks appear in the project as the project is rather strange and different and wild and crazy.

conceptualized, created and minted by Athena Novo on Async Art 2022

QmU7ePDWLCwCx89p9mv8QzhWYT4waauPwkshbL7k.name: HIKIKOMORI
QmU7ePDWLCwCx89p9mv8QzhWYT4waauPwkshbL7k.description:
A Hikikomori is the Japanese word for a Shut-In, a person who does not leave his house at all, sometimes for decades. This is a growing problem, with about 2 Million people only in Japan being isolated in their homes away from society, and increasing all over the planet. This piece tries to bring awareness and convey the asphyxiating feeling of not being able to leave your room, it talks about depression and difficult times, it is a mirror of your comfort zone. It´s also a celebration of the good old times and childhood memories and a realization that things get better.

This artwork consists of two layers, Day and Night, that help reinforce the feeling of being a Hikikomori. I started making this piece during this year´s lockdown, in the span of 5 months and hundreds of hours I designed, 3d modelled and textured each one of the hundreds of elements in the scene which have been meticulously curated to fit the same 90s aesthetic.

QmU8BqodzFVn91A3vNNz8sV8i772ojFfZ8V2Xeh5.name: The Shining metastory by 65.000+ avatars
QmU8BqodzFVn91A3vNNz8sV8i772ojFfZ8V2Xeh5.description:
The day: Jack Torrance, played by Jack Nicholson in the Stanley Kubrick film The Shining (1980), is telling you "All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy." He writes this thousand of times.
By night, the Grady tweens insist: "… Come and play with us. Come and play with us, Danny. Forever...and ever...and ever."
These 32.832 avatars are waiting for you tonight. 
Ready to play?

----
The series “metastories”
I am a Western actor playing roles in Chinese movies; these are 65.000+ Chinese actors playing roles in Western movies. 
In the Pekin Opera (China, 18th century) the color of the mask denotes character: a red face is courage and bravery; a white face is a treacherous and evil man, or a green face reveals surly obstinacy and lack of self-control… These NFTs are made with those masks: we know the character, but we don´t know the actor behind the mask, they are avatars. 
For me is like a “microverse” of thousands of avatars playing “microstories” inside the big story (stories about the story, “metastories”). Personally, I like that this series connects East and West, unites Opera, Film and Digital art, and links the 18th to the 21st century.
(In the second to last column is my signature in “metamorse” :) -morse with avatars, 1 mask=dot, 2 masks=dash).

QmU8GnEm8khYB8MUfiZTAo2KPwkEijrD58ufNCTu.name: Dive
QmU8GnEm8khYB8MUfiZTAo2KPwkEijrD58ufNCTu.description:
How often do we pay attention to things located in the center?
The one that takes up the most space. Large dimensions. Louder voice.
We are jumping on the top, while missing the details and what is really important.

After all, often only a small part (person, event, creation) can give a name to the whole phenomenon, era or canvas. 

Who has the main role in this picture?

This work is done in an original combination of fine art, digital art, collage.
Consists of 4 parts.


ABOUT THE ARTIST:

For a long time I was associated with art, artists, galleries, exhibitions. And all this time he was behind the scenes. Worked with Art Gallery (by R. Abramovich) / Sotheby’s Institute of Art. And at some point, overwhelmed with inspiration, decided to become an artist.

In my work I combine different styles, approaches and techniques.
Statics and movement. Color and monochrome. Fine Art and Generative Art. In combination, all this gives the effect of hypnosis, fundamentality and unique esthetics.

QmU8UEitMVdsee5zV1TD5DWMg3x3UhuRyEWoGbVi.name: Voxorium
QmU8UEitMVdsee5zV1TD5DWMg3x3UhuRyEWoGbVi.description:
Voxorium is a 3D, generative, sound-reactive and hence interactive sculpture - A peaceful art that flutters with sound.
The final interactive artwork can be experienced at: https://nurecas.github.io/voxorium 
or at: 
https://ipfs.io/ipfs/QmZJqEUoiMGhmdKWN8EZKjP2NNhXa77foTQSghSFBzTgt5

Voxorium is not only a sound-reactive work, but can also record a conversation, a music clip or an audio moment in the form of a 3D sculpture and an .ogg file. As soon as you load Voxorium, recording begins. Pressing the enter button will download the image, the audio recording and the sound sculpture model (GLTF) corresponding to the conversation. This image/sculpture will be unique and hence can be preserved as a memory/representation of that conversation/music etc. ( Maximum recording time is 1 minute, after which the file will be auto-downloaded. ) Thus, the artwork goes beyond just interaction, but also into creation - in the form of a memorabilia of a conversation/music.

The pandemic of 2020 had forced us to be inside our homes. When 2021 started I had renewed hopes, but things remained the same. I started to experience a lot of silence around me. And to my own consternation, the silence grew such that any sound around me made an indescribable impact on me. Perhaps it’s easier to say I became more sensitive to sound. With Voxorium I wanted to create generative variants, but I wanted to go beyond assigning a random number and generating with code. I wanted to give it a human touch. My heightened sensitivity drove me into listening to those subtle sounds around me which I usually comfortably ignore. I realised each of these sounds had a memory, a thought or a feeling attached to it. I decided to “visualise” these sounds. I recorded these sounds (33 in total) and played it through different unique variants of Voxorium and used the generated images as layers for this art. I also added, the memory, thought or feeling associated with the sounds in the description of each layer. Thus the artwork is also a collection of myself in parts and is such that “the whole becomes the part becomes the whole becomes the part”

A note on privacy - 
1. Voxorium is completely front-end based and does not store any sound data/recording. All recording happens in the browser only. The experience best works on Desktop. 
2. I decided to keep all recordings and 3d models corresponding to the layers to myself, but have shared the image and the story related to it in the layers.

QmU8ZHNtr1PGPiqfQY5fphS24zuTh9x99oVr2ViJ.name: Surreal Storyteller: Fuzzy Beyond Fuzz
QmU8ZHNtr1PGPiqfQY5fphS24zuTh9x99oVr2ViJ.description:
"In the United terminal in Chicago at five on a Friday afternoon
The sky is breaking with rain and wind and all the flights
Are delayed forever. We will never get to where we are going
And there’s no way back to where we’ve been.
The sun and the moon have disappeared to an island far from  anywhere.

Everybody has a heartache — "
---from Everybody Has a Heartache: A Blues by Joy Harjo

...

Surreal Storyteller is stranded in his own stories. He can not get to where he is going as that place is constructed via the story he tells. Lacking the necessary audience, Surreal Storyteller is stuck in a semi-permanent existence of de-construction and re-construction amidst his stories.

...

Surreal Storyteller: Fuzzy Beyond Fuzz by Hulki Okan Tabak

I enjoy creating fluid projects that arise from an idea and run for long stretches where I contribute new works. As I've grown to like the combination I use Async Art and KnownOrigin as the primary minting venues for the project.

Special thanks to one of my most admired storytellers Joy as I referenced her poem. I feel a part of her tribe that spans beyond native American land. Much love and admiration..

1/1 minted on Async Art, 2022

QmUApJapVS6ZWUe5Urydeb3Yj53VCpGCEArduKta.name: Déesse en dérive
QmUApJapVS6ZWUe5Urydeb3Yj53VCpGCEArduKta.description:
As a press photographer, I attended many red carpet events. Though I witnessed glamorous moments, faces and looks, I realized that I was drawn to create this world from a different perspective; one which undressed the soul, and rendered a more authentic moment. After some time, it became the same scenes, the same clichés, the same smiles, the same looks and the same photographers. As a celebrity, having to see more than 30 flashes per second every time a photographer spots them, probably makes them want to protect themselves. Seeing celebrities live in this world of excessive media coverage, I started to develop a mixed feeling of admiration and respect, but also pity, and finally detachment. 

The Personalities are decomposed and re-assembled in an abstract composition, guided by my instinct and fed by what the model inspired in me.

The original digital size of "Déesse en dérive" portrait is 120 by 180 cm. 

This is a portrait of the cosmetic doctor Tabasum Mir.

QmUBeiRKjW82YNkaHh4dC8gAwGR9fNSNHUezK4Ng.name: Peccadillo
QmUBeiRKjW82YNkaHh4dC8gAwGR9fNSNHUezK4Ng.description:
This artwork changes four times a day. 
This project is based on my daily observations and how I interpret them using surrealism.

Day:
"A man drinks and drinks and eats and eats... In the end we see ourselves out paced by women. Our heart is given to them and so is our brain and so on... To be honest its all in their hand."
A surrealistic place representing man's quick daily food consumption, and drinking and others and others, in like a day.
Night:
"Is that thing watching me? .... Bodies decay. A form of rust takes our bodies and honestly its inevitable. Our hearts disappear slowly, disintegrating. But look the fat man, I thought he was big boned. He is just like the others."
A surrealistic place where rusting represents a decaying body. and we are being watched by the big brother, which always could be at night.
Sunrise:
"Heaven was kinda a ... disappointing place."
A surrealistic place describing, well, heaven. 
Sunset:
" I win a chess game but I lost the real game... the life one."
In this I don't know exactly. I imagined this while I was playing chess, and while feeling really bad for the horse. Anyway decided to compose it in a surrealistic place representing the revenge of the horse.

QmUCDdHEfsKniwdTt9JgaMCNK84ydpuQY8xach6E.name: Dots - A Minimal Love Story
QmUCDdHEfsKniwdTt9JgaMCNK84ydpuQY8xach6E.description:
We usually think of love as an intense emotion confined to a specific time and space, but the truth is love goes beyond that.

In the beginning there was nothing ; then 2 dots manifested.

No awareness of the other. Centuries passed, yet they never met. 

Each dot created more dots, generations of dots.

Their realities never collided, until one specific day.

One moment in time that took several millennia to happen.

QmUCWRjUsuY5byGmk74H4Bcv2xJGEBgRwu26woSa.name: the Remixable Reclining Nude
QmUCWRjUsuY5byGmk74H4Bcv2xJGEBgRwu26woSa.description:
A programmable lying woman.
The traits of her mutable body are selectable from 6 art history masterpieces covering a span of 4 centuries: 

Giorgione - Venere dormiente (1507-1510)
Tiziano - Venere di Urbino (1538)
Francisco Goya - Maja desnuda (1797–1800)
Gustave Courbet - Femme nue couchée (1862)
Amedeo Modigliani - Nudo sdraiato (1917-1918)
Isaac Israëls - Reclining reading nude (1915-1922)

4 remixable layers with 6 states each for a journey to discover 1296 shades of sensuality, beauty and mystery, knowing that in every part of them there is the brushstroke of a master and the energy of his spirit and his time.

QmUCbiAVrqDcpmwa77WZRfWW4F9ERvk2RhWq8jf8.name: Powers That Be
QmUCbiAVrqDcpmwa77WZRfWW4F9ERvk2RhWq8jf8.description:
Powers That Be
by Hulki Okan Tabak
minted 2021 on Async Art

4 artworks based on World War I propaganda posters from Germany. Powers That Be is based on the same source material as its companion piece Der Letzte Hier on Async Art and Helft! Powers Beyond Us minted nearly a year ago on KnownOrigin. Powers That Be combines elements used in all three in a different manner for a Day/Night cycle programmable artwork experience with Async Art.

...

The Great War, history, politics, art, posters and propaganda are topics of interest for me. It was kind of natural that I wanted to incorporate that in my cryptoart creations. The desire led to a selection of public domain pieces out of copyright from the Library of Congress archives. I created all sorts of derivative pacifist and tongue-in-cheek works. So far I have only minted a handful on KnownOrigin. Starting September 2021, I will mint a more comprehensive set on Async Art and KO depending on the nature of the final artwork. The artwork presented here is part of that World War I Posters set.

QmUD7TgmfyLBXk1qG1t7St4LDBKtVD8am8iq1b5n.description: This is a conceptual artwork, which intends to question the nature of art and its relation to economic values. Is good art determined by the price it reaches in the market or by the content itself? Is this work a good work of art at all? Who determines the aesthetic value: the institutions of the art world, or the disinterested appreciator? Would you appreciate this QR-Code? See where it takes you. Creator: The Philosopher, 2021, Digital Art.

QmUDNWFUNXmz3A8BQywkN1qe5xqz5Gr3aoBuxxs5.name: B9 Early Works IV
QmUDNWFUNXmz3A8BQywkN1qe5xqz5Gr3aoBuxxs5.description:
Bulbasaur 9 series on Async Art is a collaboration between Hulki Okan Tabak and Bulbasaur 9 as a father - son team. Unless extra information is given, all drawings are by B9 and editing is by HoT. 

Bulbasaur 9 is an emerging artist, YouTuber and storyteller. You can find more about him on his YouTube channel at https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCRjLXhHKyBpI813vFvMiMVQ.

This series is a result of library search by the duo. Some of the works were previously minted and burned afterwards. Some of them are minted for the first time. The series runs through 7 sets of 4 artworks, 1 HoT influenced special collaboration and 1 set titled Falling into the Tree. 

Due to the programmable nature of Async Art's canvas which enables multiple artworks to coalesce into one, this platform was chosen for minting.  

Early Works IV consists of:
Cap Capture
Running Off
The Dentist
Whoa Ha

QmUGHs3CRSoyWDzPJ8V7evbNz7phfwWhz2EW1jQa.name: Inwardness #129001
QmUGHs3CRSoyWDzPJ8V7evbNz7phfwWhz2EW1jQa.description:
The concept of Relativity dearly changes my way of thinking, seeing, and creating, and keeps looking for balance and harmony in the final artwork. I have explored the relationship between the Light in photography and the Line in painting since 2020. Photography retains the interpretation of the Light, and the Line could be one of the forms to present the Light. I created photograms with the shape of the light in the darkroom, then trained them to generate brand-new integrated images. After that, I painted and destroyed the image with lines, colors, and recomposed the image.

The material in this series includes Photograms (Cameraless photographic processes), Digital Paintings, and AI-generated images (Gans Algorithm). The dataset of AI-generated images contains 300 photograms and 300 digital paintings.

Depth of Infinity makes these beautifully changing over nuances of lights during a full cycle. Absolutely stunning in person... 
Time is relative and flexible, and the dividing line between past, present, and future is an illusion. Reality is ultimately timeless. These quantum flowers are the reflection of that magical delight of pure energy with no time nor space boundaries. 

"There is no branch of mathematics, however abstract, which may not some day be applied to phenomena of the real world." ― Nikolai Lobachevsky

Opium was a factor that would lead to violence in cold blood. This is the similarity with religion.
This work; reflects the religious societies that blindfold themselves. Don't believe in anything so much that it completely kills your logic and put an end to some tragic events that have happened over millions of years. The power is in your mind.

QmURGLQjXPU4SJdnTVtbS9t8fjkrMr3QMCthZZiN.name: Composable Me (Part I: Spring)
QmURGLQjXPU4SJdnTVtbS9t8fjkrMr3QMCthZZiN.description:
Hello, world—I just minted myself as an interface.

The avatar you see is me, about to embark on a six month creative journey that you co-lead. This is my genesis NFT.

Equip my feet, my hands, and my torso with six unlocked wearables to determine my creative tools, environment, and approach. I will check in with the Master Layer daily, and document the process and results on my socials.

Three dynamic layers each include three state-changes:

1. Hands = Tools:

- paint palette & brush - "painting"
- violin & bow - "music"
- empty hands

2. Chest = Environment:

- coder tee - "digital"
- burner tee - "analog"
- blank tee

3. Feet = Approach:

- hiking boots - "explorations"
- tightrope - "exercises"
- bare feet

How the states of these three layers interact, shapes the output. If wearables remain unchanged, then I'll dive deeper in that direction. If wearables switch often, I'll make that part of the process.

In this way, layer owners can be as hands-on or hands-off as they want. I will keep going regardless. I believe that wonderful things emerge from where chance and intention meet... Also major #fails, which are a part of this too!

# Locked Inventory

Every two months, a new NFT unlocks six new wearables, and the previous get retired. The performance moves containers in this way, and I will look to the new Master Layer for creative prompts.

At the end of six months, there will be a surprise gift sent out to the original owners of all three NFTs, as a thank you for being my first supporters and co-creators in this space.

# About Me

I've spent the better part of a decade making visual art, and now find myself circling back to my first loves: music and tech. You can get a sense of my work and career at www.wi-ch.com

This project is a blockchain-first interactive performance piece. I hope it inspires others to engage with their own creativity in strange & wonderful new ways. I am sincerely grateful to all my supporters, collaborators, and mentors, past, future, present, and in parallel timelines^^

Showing up every day to create, in relationship to this space and the greater world, is my commitment to approaching life as art—with purpose, playfulness, and a generous misting of magic.

You can find me on IG @weseeclearly, where all my other socials are linked.

QmUSLNi9SRtoKQ45qVLLnSfXEn3cc5iKM9a6PoQp.name: Dandelion
QmUSLNi9SRtoKQ45qVLLnSfXEn3cc5iKM9a6PoQp.description:
2021, digital manipulated photography, light drawing, abstract symbolism.
Light drawing is a technique in which a camera is used as a canvas and a light source is used as a brush. Some may find it abnormal to move the canvas over a fixed brush, but I like it. The result may be something unexpected. This is drawing blindly; it is difficult to depict something recognizable other than line and color. From time to time, I finish the images in a photo editor. Dandelion is a work from the Narcissus series. The series is united by the presence of an abstract image of a flower in each piece. The theme of the series is Self-concept.

QmUSQ1hUjbCEwTCZaCcgD5B2BYhF2T3yJ2gXBctx.name: The TV Of Tomorrow
QmUSQ1hUjbCEwTCZaCcgD5B2BYhF2T3yJ2gXBctx.description:
In a series of animated short films from 1949, Tex Avery imagines a world that exists one hundred years in the future. Showcasing his predictions for the advancement of humanity, The TV Of Tomorrow's charmingly surreal visuals appear in stark contrast to an inadvertently out-of-date sense of humour, that by today’s standards, feels culturally obsolete.

Featuring two collages created from a single source of imagery (Zeit Online - August 21, 2021), this autonomous nft alternates its humorous predictions on the hour. Fated to become The TV Of Tomorrow, this artwork is intended to be viewed from the year 2050 onwards.

QmUSfjgQBvZDJ9tLuRCjckEptMuR5tsXX42GT4Ne.name: Digital Device June 2020
QmUSfjgQBvZDJ9tLuRCjckEptMuR5tsXX42GT4Ne.description:
Sometimes, things happen by chance or coincidence. During the lockdown of the Covid-19 pandemic, I’ve experimented with textures, colors, and optical effects - and an AI software. The aim of this optical study was to see what sensations it could provoke and explore the state of “controlled confusion” it could create, while keeping it simple.
One of the first results of my optical experimentation is this Digital Device. Starting from single lines of various thicknesses, I played with repetition and chromatic clashes, soon realizing these very simple elements could open infinite possibilities and generate countless patterns: the experiment could not be interrupted.
While thinking back at Bruno Munari and the Italian season of Arte Programmata (programmed art) of the 1960s, I looked at the programmable future of it, finding in Async the perfect solution for keeping my artistic exploration and this historical movement alive. Only this time it is the collectors who can play the creator’s part, having the chance to write a new page in the history of programmable art.
To learn more about the creative process and the relevance of this Digital Device in relation to the tradition of Arte Programmata you can check out the brief manual at http://www.mattiac.it/mattiac_dd1_async.pdf

QmUTGSYoSJKXLzFT7HEtHcmey4sNjB4tiByDFtjM.name: Nihtegale. Stranger and Friend.
QmUTGSYoSJKXLzFT7HEtHcmey4sNjB4tiByDFtjM.description:
You are what it is to be a song, and here I am to be a stranger, that identifies with you. They do not see although they do. some green perhaps, and your sweet air. They are looking at you now, and they are looking at me.

This is the portrait of a bird and the imagined stranger that tells of it at different times of the day. The imagination as a storytelling self makes this a portrait of the bird, the stranger, and also of me.
This work is based on my readings related to avian aurality and lore in England from the 7th to the 10th century, with particular interest in Riddle 8 of the Exeter Book, which is seemingly the only surviving instance of the nightingale in Old English text.

QmUTr8RrPj94kdSgRL7cLtVTCZ2MffZKGnv4kv6b.name: Inwardness #332165
QmUTr8RrPj94kdSgRL7cLtVTCZ2MffZKGnv4kv6b.description:
I have explored the relationship between the light in photography and line in painting since 2020. This series integrates the results of my research which are photograms, Mixed Media artworks, and AI-generated images. The dataset from this series includes 300 photograms I made in the darkroom and 300 digital paintings I drew.

The concept of Relativity dearly changes my way of seeing and creating. When I hold light source on the Black & White photographic enlarging paper in the darkroom, I come over a sort of illusion that I am drawing. Even though I know that I'm making photographs because each beam of light represents its time and space. Painting is the outlet for my feelings. When I am drawing on the AI-generated image on the computer, the emotion comes and goes, just as the light only lasts for a second and never comes back. For me, this series is neither photography nor painting. It's a kind of new form.

QmUWS23UtkATyzFaonP678EHRJj8rMb4yExyMYFY.name: One More Turn III
QmUWS23UtkATyzFaonP678EHRJj8rMb4yExyMYFY.description: In 'One More Turn III', the artist invites you to write the interactive history of a fabled polygonal isle. More than 50 hexagonal tiles are available to be 'claimed', and can be done so with the owners preference of blue, red or yellow.   Be warned - no single tile you own is completely protected from external influence. Claimed territory exerts faint influence over adjacent tiles until they reach full opacity.   You may endeavour to grow a single chosen colour hex code across the continent as if it were an expanding empire, with each new tile bolstering the values of the last.  You might also choose to blend your layers together to better represent peaceful coexistence and the  cross-pollination of ideas, or collaborate with other owners to promote unity across the region.  Or, you could focus on the artwork itself - mixing primary colours together regardless of geography or history to achieve a greater aesthetic purpose.  Finally, layers have the additional option of being left intentionally blank. You may wish to preserve the painting underneath, or simply leave the land as you discovered it.

QmUYb2C4iRDVX31q8izYwKxLydf3RAyYf7Xgtxzy.name: Ocean Eve
QmUYb2C4iRDVX31q8izYwKxLydf3RAyYf7Xgtxzy.description:
Ocean Eve

The ocean lifts.
The ocean punishes.
The ocean forgives.
The ocean heals.
The ocean connects.

Eve is the life force.

The ocean is a metaphor for the metaverse and Eve represents all of us. A collective and individual consciousness.

Ocean Eve ebbs and flows with the water, exploring and constructing an infinite immutable path. When balance and stillness is needed the leaf is there.

We are all interconnected by the same ocean.

The four works of art in this token allude to entering, exploring, admiring, and exiting the ocean. 

-

My genesis series is inspired by the entering of the metaverse. The merger of nature and technology is a topic that has inspired my art for over 20 years and will be the driving force in my genesis series. Any token holder is along for a lifelong journey of expansion and community that in itself will be a work of art.

This is a 1 of 1 autonomous token and the first appearance of Ocean Eve. There is a related video animation that is an edition of 10 called “Metaverse Eve.”

Any holder of an Async token will be rewarded with exclusive tokens in the future.
 
Bio: Over the last 20 years Ari Lankin has extensively developed painted languages exploring abstraction, conceptual process, and realism. His current paintings are intentionally open to interpretation and rich in visceral sensation. They encourage experienced based conversations on the universe and mankind. They hover between mystical and scientific. The physicality of paint, intuition, memory, and exploration are crucial aspects of his practice. His last solo show in New York City in 2020 completely sold out, he has two murals on public display at World Trade Center 3, and he has had major signature product collaborations with TROJAN™ Condoms and Adidas.

QmUZByGpLqtV98s6eyRfPKWXRe5dtt7Qof6L2GNA.name: Future Vision（未来视野）
QmUZByGpLqtV98s6eyRfPKWXRe5dtt7Qof6L2GNA.description:
This is it. 

Today we’re going out there onto the streets. We’re going to tie up traffic for a bit in hopes of bringing awareness to everyone of just how far the gov’t has gone against the common folk. Anyway, you’ve heard the rant before.

There are about a dozen of us. We’ll make some noise, hopefully get some news coverage and make as many people aware that they can and should fight back! Look for us on the news. I’ll be thinking of you the whole time.

There’s a pretty high chance State Security will probably arrest us and hold us for awhile so I put some dumplings in the fridge. Just boil them in water for about 5 mins.

I love you,
E.

(就是今日了。 

今天我们将走入街道。我们将要阻拦交通，抱着希望能让众人看清政府到底在对峙老百姓这条路上走了多远。总之，你以前肯定听过这样的抱怨。

我们人数有十几个。我们会大肆喧哗，希望会得到媒体的关注，让更多的人明白他们应该反击！看新闻的时候注意有我们的消息。我心里会一直想着你。

国家安全机构很可能会逮捕我们，可能会拘留我们一段时间。冰箱里有冻的饺子，开水里煮5分钟就行了。

我爱你。
E。)

QmUbibQtN38UCKxNUbtGXoRqiMzxwryfHjWcf9R6.description:
At first glance (and there's usually not a second) Bill appears to be rather unremarkable; which is very often true. He's an average middle-class citizen, with a mediocre job, living an average middle-class life. Or so he would have you believe... 
 
When the sun settles and darkness envelops Sky City, Bill takes to the streets as the celebrated hero, Mr. Fabulous; sworn to protect his beloved city from the evils of intolerance, discrimination, and inequality.

When the sun settles and darkness envelops Sky City, Bill takes to the streets as the celebrated hero, Mr. Fabulous; sworn to protect his beloved city from the evils of intolerance, discrimination, and inequality.

QmUdSiCuxzqgCSwrZypfPc1gbTY8x67ySUGtiCVM.description:
What began as a personal journey to one’s own self has translated into these Multilayered images arise in which the fragility and instability of our seemingly certain reality is questioned. 
Exploring to develop forms that do not follow logical criteria, but are based only on subjective or accidental associations and formal parallels, which incite the viewer to make new personal associations.
A face that resonate with oneself to question my own persona.

QmUfJSm3P3fe4wXHT4iDLyUSWdAyf6DkvpWKgrn8.name: Is That  a Whale?
QmUfJSm3P3fe4wXHT4iDLyUSWdAyf6DkvpWKgrn8.description:
Staring at an alien landscape, you wonder if the actual alien is the place or you yourself. Looking outward because you can't look the other way, you spot a figure familiar from books of some other childhood. There in the distance to your right, or whatever direction this strange place permits, swims a big figure of folk and lore alike. You can't contain the excitement. You can ignore the people supposedly serious stern sharp shipshape indeed around you. You can not ignore yourself. You shout. You shout inadvertently. IS THAT A WHALE?

Minted 2021 on Async Art by Hulki Okan Tabak

Based on photographs of things and places. Edited to abstraction through age and tear. Refigured reconfigured reimagined as a story of whales and alienation.

QmUkmVd2qSK6764NKDyJo9exnwd7tyVpZGWanq1T.name: "In Between" - New York City Collection - Yellow
QmUkmVd2qSK6764NKDyJo9exnwd7tyVpZGWanq1T.description:
My photographs reflect how a split second and a slight tilt of the camera changes the entire story, which will never be written again. Positioning myself between the visible and unseen moves me.

When you live in a city, storefronts are a big part of life, and on top of that, I love everything about fashion. The storefronts display many sides of what it could be. I let my eyes travel inside the juxtaposed layers of possibilities, and my curiosity takes over to find something familiar yet surprising. Once I find that I hide between the reflected and the real life. Life is daring yet fragile, wild yet vulnerable, puzzled yet simple, content yet melancholic, and always in between. 

These photographs are part of my "In Between" series, taken in New York City the last winter. There are two images of the same scene taken from a different angles changing every hour.

QmUmEfWgFCtt5dAFjN3bm7UoNXcCjvnoP1GifYeR.name: Thorbit
QmUmEfWgFCtt5dAFjN3bm7UoNXcCjvnoP1GifYeR.description:
'Thorbit' is a combination of the words 'thought' and 'orbit'.

It is a visual generator of creative prompts, operated by three color-coded rings. 

Each ring can be rotated in 15 degree increments. 

By combining different rotations, new ideas and conceptual approaches are created in the glowing text on the right. 

Additionally, any of the results that appear around the orbit can also be used as viable solutions.

With a minimum of 12,167 possible combinations, Thorbit is designed both as a display piece and as a tool that can be used during times of creative blocks, artistic difficulties, or to provide inspiration.
