QmUnh6kzyXbGYerhxPPjGS1tmUEggKFaDSbREkos.name: BITCOIN.
QmUnh6kzyXbGYerhxPPjGS1tmUEggKFaDSbREkos.description:
The Ultimate Store of Value. 

The next time someone says "Bitcoin uses too much energy", proceed to ask them very simple questions. 

Question 1: How much energy does it use? Beatboxing will begin. 
Question 2: Too much energy in comparison to what? Further beatboxing. 
Question 3: Have you read the Bitcoin white paper? Inevitable facepalm. 

This piece showcases the evolution of my understanding of the nature of money. 

Andreas Antonopoulos was instrumental in that understanding. Ironically, Peter Schiff may have kickstarted this journey with his video, "I am the 1%. Let's Talk". 

With my recent discovery of Michael Saylor, the excitement has been revived. 

Here's to the future.

Wake up early or late
Drink coffee
Take care of the house
Talk with the plants
Play with cats
Stretch 
Hug someone
Take a sunbath
Do crochet or embroider
Read newspaper, magazine, book...
Play an instrument
To cook
To play
Keep your head in the clouds, the moon or another planet
Light an incense, energize
Listen to music
Photograph a place
To think in a big love
Look at the moon and stars
To dance
Drink a wine with snacks
Have a night of love
See that simple things can transform us or transform our days
To thank for having completed, lived and won another day.

24h seems like a short time.
Sometimes we have to stop and have little moments to ourselves.
Anyway, we don't know when our day will be incomplete.

QmUr3umQLvX1xuDgiqnqNnRtpjr624xWYAxUwx5A.name: Old Bitcoin Art
QmUr3umQLvX1xuDgiqnqNnRtpjr624xWYAxUwx5A.description:
Old Bitcoin Art

Artist portfolio: flatarc.io/crypto-art

Addition to my quest for visualizing complexity of computational thinking and using data as my paint. With the service of AI (artificial intelligence) such as generative adversarial network (GAN) and many other to create amalgamations to analyze form by an artistic thinking with the help of machine intelligence. Not a single source from any original art is used to create these paintings. Used NASA's public collection of Hubble telescope cosmos images. The model itself ended up giving it vibes of unique historic art movement styles. Just to get philosophical, As we have not yet figured out what conscious itself is, then how can we define what art should be.
​
Also a unique opportunity when you need to think about parametric form with unusual physics which cannot exist in reality, this is where machine intelligence services you with power of exploring unusual and other-worldly forms and experiences. Refer my other 'Data Art' project pages for more about inspirations. This current piece of work was a tribute to the fascinating, daring Bitcoin-crypto-community and people who love decentralization. Unbelievable paradigm shift that will change everything that we know as norms.

QmUrMXhKrSiVgukfBFVrroGJj7SsJNfcpmGLiau4.name: The Wake (Complete)
QmUrMXhKrSiVgukfBFVrroGJj7SsJNfcpmGLiau4.description:
NFT + PHYSICAL + AUDIO + VIDEO!! 

NFT:
Template: Sunrise/Day/Sunset/Night
Dimensions: 2680x3280

PHYSICAL
Medium: Acrylic Ink on Ampersand Gessobord 
Depth: 1/8" 
Width: 16" (41cm) 
Length: 20" (51cm) 
The physical is the Day state. 
 
AUDIO
Album Name: The  Wake 
Original Release Date: Friday August 13th 2021
Format: WAV
Songs: 10
Total Length: 23:07

VIDEO
Details: Music video for The Wake complete with lyrics for songs that have vocals! Mixture of live footage, animations, drawings, and all sorts of eccentricities. 
Format: MOV
File Size: 9.06 GB
Dimensions: 3840x2160
Length: 23:07

-
Upon purchase I'll send the physical in the mail!
Contact me upon purchase and we'll get it setup!
The songs & video I will send via email/cloud storage!
-

Little about the piece:
I started working on the album cover after I created a couple songs that would eventually turn into the first tracks of The Wake. It was a lot of fun putting together the songs then listening to the latest mix while working on the drawing. I'd take mental notes of what I wanted to change so when I would hit a wall with the drawing I'd switch to music. Going in I knew that I wanted to have a casket, some trees, water, use only a couple of colors, and for the first time draw something larger than a piece of paper! The album I made before The Wake is called Death and I wanted this to be a sendoff of sorts so that train of thought led me to create a type of portal where the casket was heading. The vines kind of just happened and the water I wanted to have this unnatural swirliness to them. The part that took the longest was all the lines in the trees but it was sort of peaceful drawing all of them! 

On average I tend to release an album every 2 years and I thought this was a perfect halfway point before I start working on my next music project to release somewhat of an *ABSOLUTE EDITION* of The Wake. I can't think of a better way to enjoy the album.

QmUsPLdpfqaA3RbzGxwWAU3wzeKxrunwSfnXFSJQ.name: Proof of Concept
QmUsPLdpfqaA3RbzGxwWAU3wzeKxrunwSfnXFSJQ.description:
Proof of Concept contains a small square that can move to 19,522 locations using only two layers.

Dynamic non-fungible tokens of our time are still very much in their infancy. We are plagued with high transaction fees, smothered in centralization and limited in our technology. Our blockchain is off-chain. Those who can code thrive, while those who cannot are banished, alongside the ideas they will never be able to create. There are glimmers of hope though. A few individuals and entities have began sharing tools amongst the less knowledgeable, providing years of experience within what feels like days. This is life changing for a lot of us.

Proof of Concept has dimensions of 1920x1080 pixels. The grid space is 1880x1040 pixels, with each individual grid representing 10x10 pixels in width and height. This leaves 188x104 grids that the square can move to, which equates to 19,522 individual locations. 

The three layers available in this artwork are: X-Axis, Y-Axis and Color. The X-Axis controls the x position of the square, while the Y-Axis controls the y position of the square. The Color controls the color of the square. There are two colors to choose from: gold and black. Gold is slightly special as it behaves like a gradient, changing brightness depending on the x position of the square.

It's worth noting that with an additional 2708 states (1732+976) added to the X-Axis and Y-Axis layers of this artwork, all 2,073,600 locations could have been available for the square to move to (assuming each individual grid had a dimension of one pixel). This was purposely not included. A few of these locations would move the square off the artwork, minor x and y changes would be unnoticeable and individual grid spaces would be impossible to distinguish from one another. It's also worth noting that with an additional two layers, and 768 states, all 16,777,216 colors of the RGB Color Model could have been available to choose from for the square. This was purposely not included as well.

Proof of Concept was created to answer one simple question: "Given the knowledge and tools available to me at this current time, can I move a square around an artwork without limitation on how many locations it can move to?". 

The concept has been proven. It is possible.

QmUt65395oGvu4DcArDXTecDD99cfXyvJGHbGd6k.name: What time is it? S H : I  T
QmUt65395oGvu4DcArDXTecDD99cfXyvJGHbGd6k.description:
Anxiety, parents, hurry, career, pressure, friends, speed, work-work-work, dream of days 48 hours long, diet, stress, time, adrenaline...
An ironic version of the human being today and his fantastic relationSHIP (or "relationSHIT") with time.

As it usually happens in life with our state of mind, also here every hour is closely linked to the other ones through the use of color: every layer takes one color sample from the previous layer and then adds a new color, creating a never-ending cycle and a wide range of hues.

QmUwMGcyAEaTSpB9xg5hhU9hHF2t36op2VRij9wW.name: The Dark City
QmUwMGcyAEaTSpB9xg5hhU9hHF2t36op2VRij9wW.description:
What if all the constraints of a physical world disappear, and we are left with a
database of attributes - information that determines the properties of environments. Can we envision spatial conditions that are governed by digital physics?

Nowadays, with the technology of artificial lighting, we remove the unique conditions that darkness offered to us – the ability to hide, the oblivion.

In the Dark City, there is a totally different sensual experience. Noises are suddenly amplified, the smell becomes stronger and we totally rediscover the sense of touch.

QmUwWbMSCxtV6EW3F7t2AQ9NQYYVrXp1SGYnziny.name: Experimental No.3 #212820
QmUwWbMSCxtV6EW3F7t2AQ9NQYYVrXp1SGYnziny.description:
Artwork Title: Experimental No.3 #212820
Date of Artwork: 2021
Dimension: 1728 pixel x 2160 pixel
Type of Work: Silver Gelatin Photogram, Digital Painting
Edition: Unique
Note: This artwork is a type of digital art. The hand-made photogram is one of the subjects that compose this piece, and this photogram is not for sale separately whatever in the crypto world or the real world.


Notwithstanding, the beginning of the photography is representational, it ultimately leads to the way of the abstract. Photography has nothing to do with painting, although the thinking of abstractness renders them getting closer and closer. Photography remains the interpretation of "Light", and to express the “Light” is its inescapable responsibility. I find the "Line" could be one of the forms to present the "Light". I apply the "Line", also is the "Light", to destroy a completed and finished photograph, and change it into a new form of art and have a unique way of spreading and viewing. Through this new attempt to keep looking for balance and harmony.

QmUwr792P2zuybTDQ4t2rbBxj1cXdbrSYd4UTtUY.name: Hi, my name is...
QmUwr792P2zuybTDQ4t2rbBxj1cXdbrSYd4UTtUY.description:
Aku is a young black kid created by Micah Johnson as a response to his nephew's question, "Can astronauts be black?". Empowered by his magical space helmet, Aku is on a mission to prove that he can be anything. Released as an NFT in February, Aku quickly inspired people across the world and became the first NFT to be optioned to become a feature film. After seeing the overwhelming responses to the inspiring message about what Aku meant to them, Micah realized the importance of collaborating directly with the community to shape the characters and stories within the Aku movie.

"Hi, my name is..." is the unveiling of the newest character in the Aku story. Created with the help of the Aku community, this collaboration concludes by giving the final control to the owner of the work. This programmable NFT enables the collector to ultimately decide if and/or when to remove the character's helmet to reveal their identity. Furthermore, because of it's programmability, this work changes every hour to reflect the rising and setting of the sun, symbolizing the determination it takes to achieve our dreams. The final element of the work is to work directly with the Aku team to name the newest member of Aku World.

QmUxjwLA9KhkURaAXf5zj98fBdNPCMMqTWC2ZAWz.name: Garden of One
QmUxjwLA9KhkURaAXf5zj98fBdNPCMMqTWC2ZAWz.description:
"Garden of One" from creator and photographer Jeremy Cowart is an abstract, passing-of-time, Lightograph NFT powered by Async Art. 

Multiple pictures of the single rose were photographed, while Cowart intentionally moved light through the space. 24 images were selected, then collaged together, in order to create a dawn to dusk sort of feel. Async Art's signature time-synchronized approach emphasizes this evolution of light through the course of a day, based upon the creator's timezone. 

If the collector so desires, a physical print of one selected stage of the "Garden of One" can be provided. 

A "Lightograph" is the patent-pending photography innovation invented by Cowart that evolves light through a still image. No 3D software is used in the process. Learn more at Lightograph.com and JeremyCowart.com.

QmUzEGRX6oipBkH4pH7bAxhBYz2ezkPHPpD3MGGB.name: A LONG JOURNEY: Dream Keepers NFT + Signed Physical Book
QmUzEGRX6oipBkH4pH7bAxhBYz2ezkPHPpD3MGGB.description:
This piece features artwork from my children’s book, THE DREAM KEEPERS, but with some teeny-tiny changes.  Can you spot the differences?  There are 4 states, each with 10 unique differences to find. 

Plus, only for the collector of the primary sale, I will mail you a signed copy of the actual children’s book.  After the auction is settled, just DM my Twitter account to provide shipping information.  You can also request a hand-written message if this is a gift to the little Dreamer in your life. 

THE DREAM KEEPERS was published by POW Kids Books in August of 2021, and I am the author and illustrator.  It’s a story about perseverance and positivity. Dreams can come true when you team up with these two helpers - Hard Work and Happy Thoughts!

Compare each state with the original artwork in the book.  Some of the differences will be easy to spot by your 5 year-old.  Some will be trickier!  Totally stuck?  Need a clue?  Just DM me on Twitter.  Happy Reading!

Plus, only for the collector of the primary sale, I will mail you a signed copy of the actual children’s book.  After the auction is settled, just DM my Twitter account to provide shipping information.  You can also request a hand-written message if this is a gift to the little Dreamer in your life. 

THE DREAM KEEPERS was published by POW Kids Books in August of 2021, and I am the author and illustrator.  It’s a story about perseverance and positivity. Dreams can come true when you team up with these two helpers - Hard Work and Happy Thoughts!

Compare each state with the original artwork in the book.  Some of the differences will be easy to spot by your 5 year-old.  Some will be trickier!  Totally stuck?  Need a clue?  Just DM me on Twitter.  Happy Reading!

QmV6TaodCBgSrocHDi3eZ64sS15kgyCojKMmFwYF.name: metaphysics of life
QmV6TaodCBgSrocHDi3eZ64sS15kgyCojKMmFwYF.description: It's like we're all walking on an old swaying wooden bridge in the world. If we can't find anything to hold on to, we roll over. And we continue to fight with ourselves while looking for a subject, thing, person, ideology to which we can connect. Centuries have not changed its ordinary style in human psychology. One day we will realize that the only thing we can hold on to in the world is love. Until that happens, we will integrate with things. We will greet the insects. We will mix colors. And we will become alienated from those closest to us. We'll get lost in untidy dirty walls. After a while, the days become the same as the other days. Then hours are like days. Let's Think Now. Are our emotions a closet that we can open into the dark and show? Or how are we different from an insect trying to escape between things?

QmV6jcigzBuHrVEVCCrnYz544ryLnsPGRdKMazXd.name: Covid Collage Project
QmV6jcigzBuHrVEVCCrnYz544ryLnsPGRdKMazXd.description:
Our former eyes have been replaced, and the curtain pulled back on the inequities that we didn’t quite FULLY see before; rampant ableism, deep racism, vitriolic sexism and complex classism. 

News and news feeds are full of surreal death stories and devastating condolences, read and consumed through these new eyes of truth; all laid bare by Covid19. 

We look with different eyes that are metallic and shiny. Eyes that haven’t yet been formed; new eyes that no longer know how to ‘look to our future” for hope and possibilities. Eyes swimming in pools of uncertainties brought by Covid19.

Our Instagram lives and our materialistic obsessions are now unimportant and breaking apart at the seams. Nails unpainted, unkempt hair with new natural roots growing out of our scalps. spring fashion lines left the rack, are locked up in retail stores collecting dust. All were deemed unimportant by Covid19. 

We are left to self reflect, face ourselves, slow down, and toss and turn at night with vivid crackling dreams alive with messages screaming from our subconscious. A newly formed focus on symbols and images, not yet fully understood, brought to you by Covid19. 

Our connection to nature and the world around us is only now beginning to be understood. We thought we were separate, but now we know we are one. We were never masters of this universe because nature was never ours to master. Fractured plants, roaming animals, the unpolluted sky, the contaminated dirt, seeping in and out of our bodies. Sequestered in our homes, our minds begin to change, open up, and fracture with confusion; scattered with former motivations that are no longer valuable. We float in a sea of unknowns, covering our faces with psychological and real masks. Covid19 is a virus that makes reliability and safety unknown. In a sparkly shiny isolated dreamy space —  how will we prophesize our new future and manifest in an uncertain one?

QmV7KAKk74ZVChPjWnHpXrFiaR1MKW9wcHaAUYdv.name: Retro Fortuna
QmV7KAKk74ZVChPjWnHpXrFiaR1MKW9wcHaAUYdv.description:
The artworks are multi-layered spatiotemporal mappings of Istanbul which are filtered through conflicting emotions about now, the past and the future. Unique identities, personal backgrounds, everyday habits and future expectations of absolute strangers get entangled in our dense urban settings and create a state of flux which changes us in profound ways.

As time passes and the future unfolds, our memories and identities transform. Each twenty four hour cycle adds to you and subtracts from you.

Daylight and darkness and all that lie in between cast their colours upon you. You're a canvas, painted over and over.

A never ending work in progress, a state of becoming which never ends.

Until the very end.

QmV8Z9JsiMcrN5MJ87imhk5ThRspb9MgBsGZo9Qa.description:
"We are not the first." Carbon Study is a generative art exploration in trying to mimic textures of graphite on white paper.

Each layer is composed of countless particles under different style of movement leaving behind a trace of their existence reminiscent of how civilization leave the traces of their existence.

Each layer speaks about a story of their civilization and how they co-existed.

When these civilizations come together, they form a complex yet the aesthetic world of their own.

There is a scope to play with it by changing various aspects of civilizations and forming new worlds.

QmV9rVfqmMVnZyeeRxWKF37v6s7qmJ5NW3XpznqN.name: Art Vandal
QmV9rVfqmMVnZyeeRxWKF37v6s7qmJ5NW3XpznqN.description:
When i was in Paris, i was drawn to these designated poster spaces in metros. One poster stuck on top of each other, some torn off, crumbling, thick; layers and layers of musicians, cinema, sports, commercials and some vandalised by public too, by scribbling. 

These interventions led to abstract imagery formed within those framed borders. I then methodically travelled across all the metro rail routes, stopping at all stations. Carefully observing how each poster space had evolved over time and deterioration, documenting photographically these abstracts that were formed with time, erosion and human intervention. I titled the project "Art Vandal" as i believed these actions and interventions shape up the final form that i was able to observe then. 

I was not sure of how to exhibit these images with the same effect that one could have while viewing those frames in metro station. Hence it lay dormant for years with me. When i was introduced to Async Art and programmable art I was curious to explore this project in terms of interactivity. Hence I pulled different elements from around 75 images as individual layers. With each layer the viewer/buyer has the choice to change between different elements, thus giving rise to unique set of abstracts with different backgrounds depending on the choices made.

This way of showcasing the project, I believe hold justice to the whole idea itself, not letting go off the various interactions that go in to creating a unique piece every time; just like those poster frames.

QmVALgHwgZEqauDfSdjgcZfk17tmcZW7tDFvLT9K.name: The Remixable Queen of Art
QmVALgHwgZEqauDfSdjgcZfk17tmcZW7tDFvLT9K.description:
She is always changing, she is one but 7776 times different, surrounded by a frame with various possible shades of color, but you can always recognize in her the traits of Leonardo's "Mona Lisa", Raffaello's "Dama col Liocorno", Botticelli's "La Nascita di Venere", Gustav Klimt's "Giuditta I", Vermeer's "Girl with a Pearl Earring" and Alfons Mucha's "The Rose". 

The woman as a subject in the history of art: what can happen by putting the women of great masters of painting in a blender? How does her face appear, the whole of her gaze, her pose, and the set of colors and shapes which emotions arouses, what can it convey to a viewer in the 21st century?

Remixing the 5 main layers (the eyes, the mouths, hair, the bodies and the backgrounds of the masterpieces paintings) the owners are the real protagonists in the 'creative act', as the Master is an artwork that is always changeable, in different and renewable ways, to give shape to 'The Remixable Queen of Art' in a way that only a new medium like programmable art can  achieve.

QmVAa2JayNsdwTMnJSoNY3JeUN4S4CbCLScEwNuW.description: This art reflects one of the pandemic consequences, which is a poor mental health. Sometimes life turns into a prison and we don't know how to wait for the blow of fate. While in the day we can hide our feelings, in the night the horror takes control of ourselves. The horror can be painful. But one thing allow us to survive the night. The certain that after the night it cames the day keeps the flame inside our hearts alive. With the day it cames the small hapiness of seeing the sunrise. With the sunrise in our minds we progress and become stronger.

QmVB4EErNEAQeaQCbhXKYyV63VecpiY6HVNZvv7e.name: Playing the Card Players
QmVB4EErNEAQeaQCbhXKYyV63VecpiY6HVNZvv7e.description:
This is Playing the Card Players from The Most Expensive Artworks Project collaboration by Athena Novo and Mad Monk.

It is a remix of Paul Cezanne's The Card Players. It is No 3 in the project in parallel with its place on the list. Accordingly it has been last sold April 2011 in a private sale for USD 250 million. The seller was George Embiricos and the buyer was the State of Qatar. 

...

The Most Expensive Artworks Project started with an idea and a web page on Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_most_expensive_paintings.

Athena Novo and Mad Monk collaborated on "doing something" with the list. First idea was to make a common "burn" GIF. Step by step the original or an alternative version would be burned i.e. like a GIF. However the idea of destructing artworks did not appeal. Then glitching was cast off as the main tool for something more appealing was under consideration. It was the idea of remixing the artwork more freely - sometimes with itself and sometimes with others on the list (as a pre-condition to narrow the universe).

Consequently AN and MM started to work on from the top of the list. Several results were obtained and from them, the story modes with multiple artworks will be minted on Async Art by Athena Novo while the single items (in GIF or JPG) will be minted on KnownOrigin by Mad Monk as a part of the collaboration.

...

The Card Players is a series of oil paintings by the French Post-Impressionist artist Paul Cézanne. Painted during Cézanne's final period in the early 1890s, there are five paintings in the series. The versions vary in size, the number of players, and the setting in which the game takes place. Cézanne also completed numerous drawings and studies in preparation for The Card Players series.

The series is considered by critics to be a cornerstone of Cézanne's art during the early-to-mid 1890s period, as well as a "prelude" to his final years, when he painted some of his most acclaimed work.

Each painting depicts Provençal peasants immersed in their pipes and playing cards. The subjects, all male, are displayed as studious within their card playing, eyes cast downward, intent on the game at hand. Cézanne adapted a motif from 17th-century Dutch and French genre painting which often depicted card games with rowdy, drunken gamblers in taverns, replacing them instead with stone-faced tradesmen in a more simplified setting. Whereas previous paintings of the genre had illustrated heightened moments of drama, Cézanne's portraits have been noted for their lack of drama, narrative, and conventional characterization. Other than an unused wine bottle in the two-player versions, there is an absence of drink and money, which were prominent fixtures of the 17th-century genre. 

The models for the paintings were local farmhands, some of whom worked on the Cézanne family estate, the Jas de Bouffan. Each scene is depicted as one of quiet, still concentration; the men look down at their cards rather than at each other, with the cards being perhaps their sole means of communication outside of work. One critic described the scenes as "human still life", while another speculated that the men's intense focus on their game mirrors that of the painter's absorption in his art. (Wikipedia) https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Card_Players

QmVDARqDkYw4tHBjZsAjJb77gjjCPVEjwkcBdj2H.name: 实验1号：无，有 #7240 (Experimental No.1: Nothing, but everything #7240)
QmVDARqDkYw4tHBjZsAjJb77gjjCPVEjwkcBdj2H.description:
我创作的灵感源于生活，在日常中观察、体会、转化成我的艺术观念。研读中国古典哲学经典能让我辩证地去思考、看待各种疑问，包括在艺术上的。一个全新的文化环境对人会产生很大的影响，让我认识到个体是很难完全从自身的固有文化中逃离出来，这种根深蒂固的烙印不仅源于家庭还有社会、历史的影响。古老文明的延续、推陈出新与当今世界不可避免地面对多元文化的碰撞与交融，人类文明的发展不正是在这种似有似无的规律下演变而来的吗！我尝试着不把多文化的冲撞当作是一种冲突，而是多文明融合的过程。万物相辅相成，在冲撞中取得平衡，一切均离不开“变”。在我的作品中，抱着这样的思索与感悟去探寻摄影创作的各种可能性，实验1号作品正是这么产生的。

The inspirations of my creation derive from life. I observe, experience, and transform it into my artistic concepts in daily life. Studying classic Chinese philosophical text allows me to think and regard dialectically to all kinds of questions, including those in art. A brand-new cultural environment will significantly impact people, making me realize that it is difficult for individuals to completely detach from their own inherent culture. This ingrained imprint not only stems from families but also social and historical influences. The continuation and innovation of the ancient civilization and today's world inevitably faces the collision and integration of multiple cultures. Didn’t the development of human civilization evolve under the indistinct ways? I try not to treat the clashes from multicultural as a kind of conflict, but a multi-civilization integration process. All things complement each other and balance in the collision. "Changes" is the key. In my artworks, I'm carrying this kind of thinking and comprehending to explore the various possibilities of photography creations. The series of Experiment No.1 is precisely how it came about.

QmVEQUYYDWkccR9nTy4rCNTgRFx1fDmpWjVHQTbD.name: GANOODLE [Async Edition]
QmVEQUYYDWkccR9nTy4rCNTgRFx1fDmpWjVHQTbD.description:
GANOODLE [Async Edition] is part of a series of experimental character artworks, created by training a generative adversarial network on a data set of my own character doodles, then illustrating selected results by hand. This genesis Async Edition marks the fourth installment in the GANOODLES series and their debut to the world of programmable art. 

The GANOODLES project has always been about experimentation—learning through playing and pure curiosity, using a blend of technology and traditional drawing methods. Now, Async’s mechanism lets layer owners act as collaborators, with complete creative control to mix and match shapes and features, allowing others to experiment and play along with me! 

The Async GANOODLE incorporates five possible state changes in its body, eyes, frame and canvas layers, allowing the owners of each layer the ability to switch between those different variations. Make it as coordinated—or as chaotic—as you’d like!

QmVES5vvhShjqmQyFSnW7b6Cdt1G3EzZPPjJfJFS.name: "FAMILY MATTER"
QmVES5vvhShjqmQyFSnW7b6Cdt1G3EzZPPjJfJFS.description:
Medium: Kodak film negatives (1930’s-1950’s) / cc0 art / Procreate 

“FAMILY MATTER” is a re-creation of memories preserved by my ancestors, done by breathing new life into old negatives. This collection explores their lives and experiences the way I envision them. Memories and stories, as powerful as they can be, lack the visual guidance one needs to transport themself through space and time. “Family Matter” is a new visual layer that future generations can use to experience my family's history through my eyes, at this particular point in time.

cc0 art: Memes by 6529, XCOPY, SMOWL, ZORA (zorbs + state of mind), Pepe, rektguy, nouns, mfers, loot, tjo (BLuE)

QmVHoc1yyKW9vKoykgwjE64ctUoUy8wn81eJz5wv.name: Onward
QmVHoc1yyKW9vKoykgwjE64ctUoUy8wn81eJz5wv.description: I created "Onward" to honor the people that have contributed, and continue to contribute to the greater goal of an open society. A Cypherpunk's Manifesto was written by Eric Hughes on March 9,1993. It was a declaration and commitment to create technologies that protect our rights of privacy. Eric, David Chaum, Adam Back, Hal Finney, Nick Szabo, and Wei Dai are just a handful of leaders that changed our way of life with their dedication to writing code. Their contributions were the foundations of Satoshi Nakamoto's Bitcoin.   The manifestos last word is onward, which you see the subject in the artwork gazing up towards. She has committed to joining this movement. She wears the bitcoin gas mask as protection from our current world of fiat. At the bottom of the piece you see the date of the manifesto anchoring the artwork. Its a reminder that this journey has been travelled by many before us, and will continue to be travelled by many after us. "Let us proceed together apace. Onward."

QmVMo2uQb2BhgUeYSzg8SJTGmwn3XvKhjXMNGzdj.name: the Remixable King of Art
QmVMo2uQb2BhgUeYSzg8SJTGmwn3XvKhjXMNGzdj.description:
A programmable male portrait.

The ever-changing remix of the traits obtained from the sectioning of six portraits of famous painters from the history of art, covering a span of 4 centuries:

Andrea del Castagno (1421–1457) - Portrait of a Gentleman
Antonello da Messina (1430-1479) - Portrait of a Young Gentleman
Raffaello Sanzio  (1483–1520)- Portrait of Pietro Bembo
Ottavio  Leoni (1578–1630) - Portrait of Caravaggio
Rembrandt (1606-1669) - Self portrait
Vincent van Gogh (1853–1890) - Self portrait

5 remixable layers with 6 states each for a journey to discover expressions, unexpected looks, colors and shapes of his 7776 possible combinations, knowing that in every part of them there is the brushstroke of a master and the energy of his spirit and his time.

QmVXD3bpbHWQyGhREEkXZcC79uNXZgYri32VTCJk.description:
Eastern philosophy, especially Hinduism is a myriad cauldron of schools and thoughts and I get confused and confounded - mostly because it requires years of reading and understanding.

Purusha - represented in the male form represents "Pure Consciousness" 
Prakriti - represented in the female form represents "The Primary Substance" 

When you bring them together, a representation of pure consciousness within the original form is what we are in essence. The passive force (Purusha) and the active force (Prakriti) are intertwined, inseparable and represent the non-duality of the supreme being - both father and mother, both aloof and active, both fearsome and gentle, both destructive and constructive - thereby speaking to the unification of all that is opposite and contrasting to represent a whole. 

Ardhanarishvara reconciles and harmonizes the two conflicting ways of life: the spiritual way of the ascetic as represented by Shiva, and the materialistic way of the householder as symbolized by Parvati. 

It also represents the presence of both in each being. Every human within them contains Shiva and Parvati in varying degrees. There exists a spectrum between the binaries of males and females, and that spectrum is where we find balance in life.

Collaboration : Indrani Mitra imagined Parvati and Vishesh Chopra crafted Shiva

QmVZS4dSzuetNT5gCmRSv6TBokSE9MBup5EmJubA.name: Sedative | Blue Prints | 24
QmVZS4dSzuetNT5gCmRSv6TBokSE9MBup5EmJubA.description:
W a t e r | L i g h t | S o u n d | revealing sacred geometry - Cymatics - The study of vibration

By resonating frequencies inside a small dish full of water, we see the geometric shapes created by chaos eventfully finding balance. Images taken from frequencies 24hz being resonating inside a speaker within a small 1inch pan -  with light shining above in a ring shape. This allows us to see 3d geometry in the reflection of the water on the surface. By filming the process at 1/30 shutter speed 50fps, we allow more light to travel when capturing the visuals. In this piece there are 24 images taken from [ 24 second clip] of sound being resonated. Each frame represents O N E  H O U R  of time in the day as if it were seconds, although this is generous as we are fortunate enough to extend just one moment of perfect synchrony in Cymatics. 

Process on Cymatics | https://hic.af/o/715440

These are the blue prints for Sedative 1/1 [HEN] resonated at 24hz | 24secs | 24frames
10|04|2022

QmVawhrQLyqXfbpzrFLHgo23yRRhSFNtzRizgMqV.name: F.U.S.E. Syntax [Two]
QmVawhrQLyqXfbpzrFLHgo23yRRhSFNtzRizgMqV.description:
A new audio-visual experiment under the F.U.S.E. moniker between brothers Richie & Matthew Hawtin continuing their collaboration which started in the 1991 with the seminal electronic music album "Dimension Intrusion" on +8/WARP records.

Syntax [Two] explores the relationship between its innate components and how the re-arrangement of their layer and states create subtle but profound new iterations.

Each audio & visual layers have been designed to interplay with one another resulting in thousands of unique possiblitlies.

Syntax [Two] is part of the new F.U.S.E. Syntax release that will be available on all music streaming platforms on June 4th.

The release will also include a special version, "Syntax [Two] @username Async NFT mix" which will be determined by from the current Master Track state one week after the sale of the Master and all layers. This will give each layer owner the unique opportunity to contribute to the remix of Syntax [Two] by having their layer decisions affect the final audio & visual outcome of this special officially released version.

In addition, the current Master owners Async username will be credited in the remixes title.

QmVbhtdjWStMXBtJCzPM4JWkkWDkVNcUksa6HF2n.name: Inwardness #700791
QmVbhtdjWStMXBtJCzPM4JWkkWDkVNcUksa6HF2n.description:
The concept of Relativity dearly changes my way of thinking, seeing, and creating, and keeps looking for balance and harmony in the final artwork. I have explored the relationship between the light in photography and the line in painting since 2020. Photography retains the interpretation of the light, and the line could be one of the forms to present the light. I created photograms with the shape of the light in the darkroom, then trained them to generate brand-new integrated images. After that, I painted and destroyed the image with lines, colors, and recomposed the image. The materials in this series includes Photograms (Cameraless photographic processes), Digital Paintings, and AI-generated images (Gans Algorithm). The dataset of AI-generated images contains 300 photograms and 300 digital paintings.

QmVdSBJ4QPzxNAqvC8xgVKneCBetK3GqiKdHs6QU.name: Huexixua
QmVdSBJ4QPzxNAqvC8xgVKneCBetK3GqiKdHs6QU.description:
Huexixua means ‘’head’’ in Chontaquiro, which is an Arawak language.
This 24-hour dynamic artwork is a tribute to indigenous people from South America, their tradition of creating ‘’colossal heads’’ sculptures and Native American Indian colourful totem poles. The word ‘’totem’’ meant ‘’to be related to someone’’ - totem poles represent both the written history and Native American family lineage.

QmVdT8aGuZaKtGDamJXrGtQwkbQEi6Hmjmt9iqJB.name: Cuddle
QmVdT8aGuZaKtGDamJXrGtQwkbQEi6Hmjmt9iqJB.description:
Humankind seeks affection. I have wondered many a time whether it is to love or to be loved that matters. There is a profound rabbit hole on that topic but Cuddle is more basic, more innocent, gullible even, modestly carnal, mostly emotional.

Cuddle's front layer is an abstraction from a segment of a project. That piece has been re-created in my imaginary depiction of two people hugging, holding, cuddling each other in the most basic confines of line-art abstraction.

Behind the Cuddle runs a gamut of photographs for different times of the day as Async Art's engine throttles through the incessant 24 hour interval of our lives. Sunrise hits with a garden shot of flowers in the morning from 2020. Day invigorated with an image from 25 years ago of a sun casting shadows through shutters. Sunset is a stylization of a female figure from a 1990 photograph that went through an extensive 2021 Photoshop session. Night uses a public domain photo in a subtle abstract yet attractive manner.

All through the cuddle remains the constant. Our need to express and to be heard and to be cared and to care. For most of the healthy ones at least..

Idea and execution and minting and the rest by HoT, sometime during the summer of 2021 on Aysnc Art as a Day/Night template project.

QmVeFrKoNnnyCDJR4R8TW1tngBLRLYaHxWHqE8By.name: Habitación SUR
QmVeFrKoNnnyCDJR4R8TW1tngBLRLYaHxWHqE8By.description:
Habitación SUR es la última creación del colectivo CryptoArg donde el conjunto argentino pone en evidencia su heterogénea escencia.
La habitación se presenta como un espacio virtual donde las distintas obras se combinan entre sí generando distintos puntos de vista de la misma galería. Las obras pueden ocurrir o no ocurrir, pero solo en su conjunto ellas tienen sentido. De esta manera, Habitación Sur se configura como un punto de encuentro donde 26 artistas confluyen en una misma dirección: el Sur.


"Habitación Sur" is the latest creation of the CryptoArg collective where the Argentinean group shows its heterogeneous essence.
The room is presented as a virtual space where the different works combine with each other generating different points of view of the same gallery. The works may or may not appear due to their multiple combinations of layers, but it is only as a whole that they make sense.  In this way, this room is configured as a meeting point where 26 artists converge towards the same direction: South.

QmVefMdGL4RxWWvweGLtJL8D1qap1ByCmGcR6R5P.name: Florality
QmVefMdGL4RxWWvweGLtJL8D1qap1ByCmGcR6R5P.description:
Florality is an artwork depicting how the vibrance of our cultivation looks when the sun/moonrays falls on it at different times both during the day and night. Far away from the hustle-bustle of our city life which is full of machines, here we see the beauty of the nature in various shades. With advancement in technology, we look at out mobile phones or our watches to know the time, but a farmer who has sown seeds and seen the soil enriched with cultivation, knows the time of the day just by looking at the sun/moon rays falling on it. He does not need any watch or a mobile phone to know if its noon or evening. The same flower can look differently and in a different colour throughout the day, just like humans who can be vibrant  irrespective of time - be it a warmer day, a sunny noon, a breezy evening or a chilled night.

Florality is a unique 1/1 artwork based on 24-Hour time cycle comprising 24 images that change one image per hour (Pacific Time). The art created using javaprocessing & simulated based on day & night time cycles using neural machine learning algorithms.

Technical specifications ->
Dimensions - 3000 x 3000
Total Images - 24
Average size per image - 11.08 MB
Total file size of 24 images - 266 MB
Edition - Unique (1/1)

3. If Only The Blame Game Was Over (24 artworks)
4. If Only You Could Understand (24 artworks)

The 4-parts are minted on Async Art.

In addition, there will be couple of dark GIFs to be minted on KnownOrigin in collaboration with Mad Monk.

...

This is a story of modern times urban misunderstanding and loneliness.

A part of ourselves in there..

...

Public domain photography has been used in this series. The images were extensively edited and choreographed to be in tandem with the narrative.

QmVhrA24d7rkcwnL2wF5bX1TQi62uDyHcs356gQ1.name: The Killers
QmVhrA24d7rkcwnL2wF5bX1TQi62uDyHcs356gQ1.description:
"The Killers" is a political cover piece of the rock band formed in Las Vegas in 2001 by Brandon Flowers (lead vocals, keyboards, bass) and Dave Keuning (lead guitar, backing vocals).
The Killers are considered one of the biggest rock bands of the 21st century, and the most successful act to ever emerge from Nevada.

The piece features characters from the past and present who have stained the history with blood. 
The monsters of the past make up this piece as a reminder that when those in charge, who are supposed to protect us, became responsible for our deaths, something has gone wrong!

Due to the programmable nature of Async Art's canvas which enables multiple artworks to coalesce into one, this platform was chosen for minting.

60
Jumpin Time
Luigi as a Hero
Pokemon TV

QmVox2udF2up9dSoFvQRJPLkJ1bYDtonbiLejWr3.name: The Dissipation
QmVox2udF2up9dSoFvQRJPLkJ1bYDtonbiLejWr3.description:
When you are dissipated you can't hold yourself solid. You're there, like water. Like muddy water. You can't swim and you can't see. You have to imagine a lifeboat and try to get on it, as your life depends on it.

When the boat never comes you have to sort through the spiral. 
You look into the eye.
And you sit tight, waiting for your judgment. 

This is a work about trauma. Is a work about a journey that never ends. 
Each layer depicts a state of mind, a chance for a voice to be heard.

For all the girls who don't have a name. 

"As a seashell.
They had to call and call
And pick the worms off me like sticky pearls.

Dying
Is an art, like everything else. "
excerpt from Lady Lazarus, by Sylvia Plath

QmVtseYbA3YwwL5ttmwCxzXAvpH1psidgkryDnfh.name: Experimental No.3 #6960
QmVtseYbA3YwwL5ttmwCxzXAvpH1psidgkryDnfh.description:
Artwork Title: Experimental No.3 #6960
Date of Artwork: 2021
Dimension: 2160 pixel x 1695 pixel
Type of Work: Silver Gelatin Photogram, Digital Painting
Edition: Unique
Note: This artwork is a type of digital art. The hand-made photogram is one of the subjects that compose this piece, and this photogram is not for sale separately whatever in the crypto world or the real world.

Notwithstanding, the beginning of the photography is representational, it ultimately leads to the way of the abstract. Photography has nothing to do with painting, although the thinking of abstractness renders them getting closer and closer. Photography remains the interpretation of "Light", and to express the “Light” is its inescapable responsibility. I find the "Line" could be one of the forms to present the "Light". I apply the "Line", also is the "Light", to destroy a completed and finished photograph, and change it into a new form of art and have a unique way of spreading and viewing. Through this new attempt to keep looking for balance and harmony.

QmVz9w1LxC5Dg5UoDk9vt5MyPJiHRCU6hkppHgLJ.name: It's Here
QmVz9w1LxC5Dg5UoDk9vt5MyPJiHRCU6hkppHgLJ.description:
It's Here is a physical traditional oil painting on canvas, 30x40'' (76x100 cm) made between February and July 2020 in Boston, Massachusetts USA, and adapted for Async on February 2021.
This piece shows Chico the Bear lying on the grass. The original oil painting is the night state of this programmable art piece, and it shows a crane from an UFO catcher machine.
For this piece I wanted to show a more story driven image, leaving the interpretation  to the viewer, since you don't know if the crane is going to rescue or kidnap the bear, either way I wanted to show an intriguing and somehow anxiety inducing picture.
Many people have seen the original piece in my studio and I've received a wide variety of reactions, from anxiety to joy.
The buyer of this programmable art piece will get a professional giclee reproduction of the original oil painting, printed with pigment inks, lightfast and archival, signed and numbered. Comes with certificate of authenticity.

QmW1AnjRZ2Jk4vK7NtfEi1L5rG7ikPDPbhursHRL.name: Penitentiary of the Forbidden Harvest
QmW1AnjRZ2Jk4vK7NtfEi1L5rG7ikPDPbhursHRL.description:
This artwork composes of two separate artworks, which update twice a day to reflect day/night cycles.  This is an abstraction of the mind. My neighbor was cleaning her windows yesterday. She looked sad and tired. But the window's had to be cleaned. I imagined this. 

Day:
We all are stuck inside a glass box. We need to break it and not be afraid of it. 3D artwork composed of a women stuck inside a glass box struggling.

Night:
She broke out. Now she enjoys life but searching for something she cannot find. Maybe she needs to go inside the box again? 3D artwork composed of a SEARCH.

QmW1Ke5TEaq1U57qH26mq72x3BrTfcxXUdc63rX1.name: Kids Takeover Putin: Nova Apartchik #11
QmW1Ke5TEaq1U57qH26mq72x3BrTfcxXUdc63rX1.description:
Based on Putin photography, Kids Takeover Putin is text-to-image experimentation on war, peace and leadership. It is re-creating the leadership in the eyes of a kid takeover for peace.

Stop the War. We hoped, I hoped this was already the past in Europe. We should not go back.

There is a lot of interesting material that range from childish and peaceful to satirical and dark. I will post them and perhaps I will post most of them hoping this ends as soon as possible.

This is one of the 12 2-piece Nova Apartchiks on Async Art. There is also 1 24 piece set and some 4-piece somewhat more abstract pieces on Async Art. For multi editions and some other 1/1s, please visit my collection on KnownOrigin.

by Mad Monk, 1/1 on Async Art, 2022

QmW1kmV1eedVSRYYksur7WHJN7pYcZgNyQKwGbiJ.description:
Inferno Cantos XXIV 

This is a metaphorical exploration of the nature of sin. Through taking this journey though Hell in every hour,  you may seek to understand the nature of sin and its consequences, and contemplate on the inner workings of divine justice and mercy.

Inspired by The Hell Canto 24, a section of Dante Alighieri's epic poem, "The Divine Comedy." Specifically, in Canto 24, Dante and Virgil encounter the souls of those who were guilty of "Simple Fraud," which involves deceiving someone through a false promises.

No False Promises Here!

QmW25uxzqVJ7ZLje3eLdStuR893VG55cseakznF1.name: Camping Spirit
QmW25uxzqVJ7ZLje3eLdStuR893VG55cseakznF1.description:
Camping Spirit is a collaborative artwork made by Mikko Lyytinen & PXLPET The artwork changes automatically between two images based on a day and night cycle.

A group of pxlpets have gone for an outdoors trip and set up their camp on a beautiful forest clearing near the mountains. It is a pleasant, peaceful day. You can hear the sounds of wildlife roaming around in the bushes and the whisper of a light breeze gently rattling the leaves.There is no rush anywhere, it is as if the time stood still in this enchanted landscape. 

As the sun begins to set and all the colors slowly fade away into the darkness, a sense of mystery fills the air and everyone's imagination starts to run wild. What kind of strange creatures could be hiding out there in the shadows of the forest? All the old tales of fairies, trolls and dragons even, suddenly seem to become real. Everyone is too excited to sleep and the night passes in waves of chatter, interrupted by sudden quiet when someone hears a sound and everyone is trying to figure out what kind of mythical creature it was that made it. 

In the morning everyone is surprisingly full of energy and ready for another day of leisure in their idyllic campsite.

QmW2h2TANtsWDApZdNsX6LSCZAifKAJipK5CM3J4.description:
Who Are You? is a pop art homage to the famous Magritte's painting The Man In A Bowler Hat.

It further explores the unbreakable connection between what is hidden and what is visible within the context of modern lifestyle and crypto art culture.

Each layer gives the freedom to the collector to choose which narrative will be displayed and thus make decisions that shape the artistic creation.

Every next level of your life will demand a different you. Level up.

QmW4r6GjNpo4UyKHzpmkmHRrQ6qZ5v2hbTeKincm.name: / TRAPEZE ARTIST/
QmW4r6GjNpo4UyKHzpmkmHRrQ6qZ5v2hbTeKincm.description:
When I was a child I dreamed of being a trapeze artist, climbed to the heights of my trapeze I grew like a giant. 
In my dreams I reached the always desired triple somersault. 
I told myself, next time in the Barcelona circus I will do it without a net. Paradoxically, I felt safer without a network, freer. 
The excited public thanked me and thousands of times I emerged triumphant from my challenge.

My dreams were filled with trapezes, awards, books, press clippings, and memorabilia from the circuses I had traveled to.

QmW87etmdPMrBS6JqABcedE4N6myErejcASKeRLp.name: Ratio
QmW87etmdPMrBS6JqABcedE4N6myErejcASKeRLp.description:
“Every unique thing in nature is related to the whole, and partakes of the perfection of the whole. Each particle is a microcosm, and faithfully renders the likeness of the world.

In geometric harmony of the cosmos there are ways that resemble, there are universal patterns, from blood vessels, to winter trees or to a river delta, from nautilus shell to spiral galaxy, from neurons in the brain to the cosmic web.

A whole universe of connections is in your mind – a universe within a universe – and one capable of reaching out to the other that gave rise to it. Billions of neurons touching billions of stars – surely spiritual.”

Alejandro Mos Riera

QmW8H4Vn1NXFWjEMvi54GzBzLp4NcJsPMdks9L3o.name: Kids Takeover Putin: Nova Apartchik #7
QmW8H4Vn1NXFWjEMvi54GzBzLp4NcJsPMdks9L3o.description:
Based on Putin photography, Kids Takeover Putin is text-to-image experimentation on war, peace and leadership. It is re-creating the leadership in the eyes of a kid takeover for peace.

Stop the War. We hoped, I hoped this was already the past in Europe. We should not go back.

There is a lot of interesting material that range from childish and peaceful to satirical and dark. I will post them and perhaps I will post most of them hoping this ends as soon as possible.

This is one of the 12 2-piece Nova Apartchiks on Async Art. There is also 1 24 piece set and some 4-piece somewhat more abstract pieces on Async Art. For multi editions and some other 1/1s, please visit my collection on KnownOrigin.

by Mad Monk, 1/1 on Async Art, 2022

QmW9GKQhSHBqE39qWfxWfT5nnHsdi1Dj1Yy7BDhs.name: Lady Luck from Manifesto of Chance - I
QmW9GKQhSHBqE39qWfxWfT5nnHsdi1Dj1Yy7BDhs.description:
Lady Luck from Manifesto of Chance - I

Manifesto of Chance is a Blueprints project I've created involving trillions of combinations. Its ultimate "massage" is to let go and seize the day. 

Lady Luck series is derived from one of the base images used in the project and it is extensively edited. They are stand alone pieces which point out to seeing (not solving) the larger puzzle of the project. None of the Lady Luck themed artworks appear in the project as the project is rather strange and different and wild and crazy.

conceptualized, created and minted by Athena Novo on Async Art 2022

QmWDXViHfcqCeMsbSxzq2e4S9fngXLHt5pmZtbAH.name: A Circadian Rhythm
QmWDXViHfcqCeMsbSxzq2e4S9fngXLHt5pmZtbAH.description:
Time moves differently when you go for a walk. It is simultaneously fast and slow, both seamless and stuttering.

No matter how time decides to move around you, it will always cycle - even if that takes all day.


In this piece, 24 digital paintings make up a dynamic, looping animation that changes frame every hour. Copies of each painting at their original 3200x6400 resolution are available to the owner on request.

The owner constructs, modifies & tattoos their very own Doll Lady... Is she falling down a rabbit hole, lost in a sea of cats or gazing into the unknown void? Do you like Pink Ladies or Lilac Ladies? Or do you pick the Wild Card? There's always a wild side to an innocent doll face. Is she obsessed with crypto ponies or crypto kitties? Or does she have an insatiable desire for Mr. Honey Badger. Come inside and have a nice cup of NFTea with the bunnies. Is your lady chained to the blockhain? Does your lady shed Bitcoin tears or ETH tears? Does your doll face don a Rotten Heart? Do you HODL to the Moon to meet the ETH Kitty? Do you have an obsession for cyborgs or Puddin'? Would you like a slice of Death by Pink? Is The Cat's Eye green or golden? Little trolls with mini daggers not included. The cheshire cat might trade you his ears for your goggles. Modifications of the Host. How long is forever? Sometimes, just one second.

QmWDmiWZTs8PfQn5UZNHtUfpXjYXzBCP8k2ihQxv.name: The Wanderer
QmWDmiWZTs8PfQn5UZNHtUfpXjYXzBCP8k2ihQxv.description:
I journey thru my quest,
the snow envelops me,
day, night, dusk, dawn, I walk,
it's difficult yet I pursue,
for what awaits me is a purpose.

Created in 2017, and revisited it this year. I made this while aimlessly finding what I want to do. Until this day, I still don't know what my purpose is. I dedicate this to all of us who are wandering and discovering our quests. The journey might be difficult, but we are all wanderers and we should not stop wandering.

QmWEnaLw1zucf522hgFAd43V6teFbA7ZCNgxcsnt.name: Dictatorship
QmWEnaLw1zucf522hgFAd43V6teFbA7ZCNgxcsnt.description:
Welcome to my Dictatorship, an authoritarian form of asynchronous art, characterized by a singlular artistic vision controlling every layer with no toleration for any pluralism of any kind.

The owner of the Master will have a window overlooking the main street of Utopium, Capital of MY Dictatorship.

I will have many ways to surprise you, amuse you and also scare you. Be certain I'll use and abuse this power.

The Ministry of scripted periodical and random events will make sure this street never looks the same, even when the Dictator is on vacation.

Remember, though, that a window works both ways and that you're giving up some of your privacy (and all of your control) by opening the curtains to view the scene before you.

Trust and Fear.

QmWEv4XTydF6zt9FmYQr7hPAru63vAzLZXJVBQt8.name: Don Quixote: Jousting for Delusional Glory
QmWEv4XTydF6zt9FmYQr7hPAru63vAzLZXJVBQt8.description:
Don Quixote: Jousting for Delusional Glory by Hulki Okan Tabak, minted 1/1 on Async Art, 2022

4 artworks in a daily cycle..

...

Don Quixote project is a highly personal interpretation of the hero and his world. Various photographic and AI tools are used to create, manipulate and recreate the images. The story will be numbered for all of us to track down what we hold essentially. Beyond ease of use, the numbers are not sequential. Each image is independent but some images will be interdependent parts of smaller stories which I will mention. I would also mint some editions outside of Manifold. Note that editions of this project could be 1/1s or multi editions. The mints on Async Art will not be numbered as they each contain multiple images in themselves.

...

Don Quixote is a Spanish epic novel by Miguel de Cervantes. Originally published in two parts, in 1605 and 1615, its full title is The Ingenious Gentleman Don Quixote of La Mancha.

A founding work of Western literature, it is often labeled as the first modern novel and one of the greatest ever written. Don Quixote is also one of the most-translated books in the world.

When first published, Don Quixote was usually interpreted as a comic novel. After the French Revolution, it was better known for its central ethic that individuals can be right while society is quite wrong and was seen as a story of disenchantment. In the 19th century, it was seen as social commentary, but no one could easily tell "whose side Cervantes was on". Many critics came to view the work as a tragedy in which Don Quixote's idealism and nobility are viewed by the post-chivalric world as insane, and are defeated and rendered useless by common reality. By the 20th century, the novel had come to occupy a canonical space as one of the foundations of modern literature and a formidable example of what letters can do. (wikipedia)

QmWFVBTccGP4smWZS26yVuUVc7RrBQEt9jemogVo.name: The Changing Aroma of the Amazon Jungle
QmWFVBTccGP4smWZS26yVuUVc7RrBQEt9jemogVo.description: Amazon jungle had the smell of the rainforest. The wet soil's smell, the strong smell of tropical flowers, an explosion of fresh fragrances from an immense variety of plants combined, the pungent smell of decaying animals, wood and leaves rotting on the jungle floor. The lungs of the planet, one of the main living repository of the world's biodiversity, the home of the Indigenous Peoples, are under attack. Climate change and brutal deforestation in Amazonia are changing their aroma. With the settlers, the extreme climate and wild fires, the sky darkens and arrives the black rain with the smell of smoke and burning. Even the Brazil’s National Museum that kept one of the best collections of indigenous literature and artefacts in the world was eaten by the flames. “This is the greatest loss of indigenous writing in Latin America. Our memory has been erased.”

QmWJvcEDoUjuEH4bPYwz2SYYGGgLSfrCsC6nn3cb.name: B9 Early Works II
QmWJvcEDoUjuEH4bPYwz2SYYGGgLSfrCsC6nn3cb.description:
Bulbasaur 9 series on Async Art is a collaboration between Hulki Okan Tabak and Bulbasaur 9 as a father - son team. Unless extra information is given, all drawings are by B9 and editing is by HoT. 

Bulbasaur 9 is an emerging artist, YouTuber and storyteller. You can find more about him on his YouTube channel at https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCRjLXhHKyBpI813vFvMiMVQ.

This series is a result of library search by the duo. Some of the works were previously minted and burned afterwards. Some of them are minted for the first time. The series runs through 7 sets of 4 artworks, 1 HoT influenced special collaboration and 1 set titled Falling into the Tree. 

Due to the programmable nature of Async Art's canvas which enables multiple artworks to coalesce into one, this platform was chosen for minting.  

Early Works II consists of:
Blondie 6-10
Mushroom Party
Power to Transform
Zz

QmWKaR1uUEhLM4d1i3XuY8CW21MVjpGUjTrE1uGU.name: Visions of the Past
QmWKaR1uUEhLM4d1i3XuY8CW21MVjpGUjTrE1uGU.description:
She knew she couldn't ever truly experience the beauty of Mao Mao City, the stories were very clear that the city had fallen during the last great war, when the Kung Paw were finally defeated, albeit at great cost.  She couldn't stop thinking what that old tabby had said though... he seemed so certain of his beliefs. Could it be that she was truly the grandaughter of the exile? The legends never mentioned anything more of Captain Aditi after his exile, and the rumor that he had been found by the most loyal soldiers of the Kung Paw; deep in the belly of Shao Mountain, dabbling with dark powers not meant for kitty kind. But then, there were conflicting theories about how kitties learned to change their form by light of day to one resembling that of the hoomans of ancient times. Not even the great royal mages could say with any certainty why kitties gained this ability, nor did they know for sure why it was only possible in daylight; most kitties simply accepted the common belief that it was a gift offered them by the Kitty God, whose gaze strays to the west when night falls. The uncertianty was too much to bear. She had overheard the royal mages speaking of a spell they'd discovered that may let them witness events of the past, If she WAS a descendant of Aditi, and assuming the rumors of his involvement with dark magics were true, then maybe, just maybe, she could harness the ancient captains power, now possibly flowing through her veins, and could succeed where the royal mages had failed. 

Protect her Kitty God, she is young and has too important a destiny...

QmWPKgkpzB6hAM2pcpm8btQL9z616zYynGYKS731.name: Nu Day in Her Own Way
QmWPKgkpzB6hAM2pcpm8btQL9z616zYynGYKS731.description:
This is Nu Day in Her Own Way from The Most Expensive Artworks Project collaboration by Athena Novo and Mad Monk.

It is a remix of Modigliani's Nu Couche with a dose of some more Modigliani . It is No 10 (skipping a lot in between at will) in the project in parallel with its place on the list. Accordingly it has been last sold November 2015 in Christie's New York for USD 170 million. The seller was Laura Mattioli Rossi and the buyer was Liu Yiqian. 

...

The Most Expensive Artworks Project started with an idea and a web page on Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_most_expensive_paintings.

Athena Novo and Mad Monk collaborated on "doing something" with the list. First idea was to make a common "burn" GIF. Step by step the original or an alternative version would be burned i.e. like a GIF. However the idea of destructing artworks did not appeal. Then glitching was cast off as the main tool for something more appealing was under consideration. It was the idea of remixing the artwork more freely - sometimes with itself and sometimes with others on the list (as a pre-condition to narrow the universe).

Consequently AN and MM started to work on from the top of the list. Several results were obtained and from them, the story modes with multiple artworks will be minted on Async Art by Athena Novo while the single items (in GIF or JPG) will be minted on KnownOrigin by Mad Monk as a part of the collaboration.

...

Nu couché (also known in English as Red Nude or Reclining Nude is a 1917 oil on canvas painting by the Italian artist Amedeo Modigliani. It is one of his most widely reproduced and exhibited paintings. (Wikipedia)

This piece was inspired by "The Great Wagon" by Rumi as well as the song "Julia (or, 'Holy to the LORD' on the Bells of Horses)" by mewithoutYou. Thanks to the assets provided by AsyncArt, this piece is made up of four editable layers with three of them consisting of 8 different states of color combinations that will influence the overall image. If these layers happen to have different owners, then they have the option to sync up colors to create a homogeneous piece or diverge paths to create a different blend of colors to their liking. The choice is theirs (and potentially yours!)

Thank you for viewing.

QmWPgn4BGkHBeAWkJfS3XCVocJBDDChHrynkS6R7.name: Parasite Family Portrait #1
QmWPgn4BGkHBeAWkJfS3XCVocJBDDChHrynkS6R7.description:
Parasite Family is a series of work made from an archive of film negatives I discovered in an out-of-business film lab. When I was a child, individuals would come to this community film lab to get a photograph taken for business purposes. In digital era, however, these film labs were shut down. In a way, these negatives are like a memory of my society.

In this project, I experimented with the film negatives through various techniques – collage, color-grading, re-printing, and re-mixing.  For the piece minted at Async, I created a 'living' family portrait which changes from daytime to nighttime.

QmWPxMQ7uLc1CVLwqewp2J3dByAUb7ZpcPYVB16r.name: Aesthetic Antagonists
QmWPxMQ7uLc1CVLwqewp2J3dByAUb7ZpcPYVB16r.description:
Lord Gravity tends to spend most mornings,
staring at the windows of his own place at Lake Black Albatross. 
From there He is often able to see strange figures from the distance, 
that populate the lake and its surroundings.
These figures are part of the nihilistic group called "Aesthetic Antagonists", 
a propaganda machine that generates
deception, hype and disinformation.
The hero, Master of the Space Age,
is constantly monitoring this group, 
as they parade across his window over the lake, 
in search for a rebellious reaction from Lord Gravity 
- repeatedly unsuccessfully.

QmWS2HdF7pJrQ9ejZBktSNuJ4yJeoqEiWwaRhKC9.name: Myaru Garhwal
QmWS2HdF7pJrQ9ejZBktSNuJ4yJeoqEiWwaRhKC9.description:
Garhwali Language is spoken in Uttarakhand,  it is nonetheless designated as "vulnerable" in UNESCO's Atlas of the World's Languages in Danger, which indicates that the language requires consistent conservation efforts.
 
People who live in Garhwal Himalayas have long since learned humility, patience and a quiet resignation. Deep in the crouching mist lie their villages.

I have spent a lifetime in the mountains. And if I had to do it all over again, I would still choose to spend my life here. Most Garhwali cultivators are poor, some are very poor. And yet these are cheerful people, sturdy and with wonderful powers of endurance.

This 4 series of artwork readily focus on theme of Garhwal processed in Generative art and digitally distorted manner with a vision from my eyes. Eyes that still have a vision to do something for its culture, its soil. Eyes that won't rest until Myaru Garhwal (My Garhwal) becomes a key point for attraction of entire world in terms of tourism and economy towards its culture.

QmWUS64JcoMrtyK4FjFS7fjqxiQhpsEAzJSRGVwU.name: The Samurai of the Warring States
QmWUS64JcoMrtyK4FjFS7fjqxiQhpsEAzJSRGVwU.description:
The Samurai of the Warring State I 

The Sengoku period (戦国時代, Sengoku Jidai, "Warring States period") is a period in Japanese history of near-constant civil war, social upheaval, and political intrigue from 1467 to 1615. An anonymous poem captured the mood of the times. "A bird with one body but two beaks, pecking itself to death." However, it was also a time of significant cultural and economic growth. This was when legendary samurai like Saito Dosan, Takeda Shingen, Uesugi Kenshin, Tokugawa Ieyasu and Oda Nobunaga emerged as major players, consolidating the territories of their respective domains while encouraging the practice of arts like classical painting, architecture and the tea ceremony.

This is the first in a series of artworks that explore the Samurai of the Sengoku Period. A place of beauty and serenity and despair, torment and violence. Each layer has between 30 to 37 states that allow you to change the feel of the work. Change the background, the clouds, the birds, the insects, the fog, the skull, the helmet or the mask. There are over 416,965,528 non-repetitive combinations available in this work.  Change how you see each legendary samurai.

QmWXuNGSnzpi9DEFkfKg8KqJfLzqBWPg5TiFuyx6.name: 15 minutes
QmWXuNGSnzpi9DEFkfKg8KqJfLzqBWPg5TiFuyx6.description:
antwoman makes a tribute to one of the most esteemed and important artists of the 20th century - Andy Warhol.
His art was playful and fun. He was not afraid to experiment and did not address what the critics said. Why do only one painting if you can do several, each in different colors?! this piece celebrates this approach because I think in art it is important to try and play. That's how you get to the really interesting things. 
He was fascinated by advertising and celebrities & by the idea of people as brands or consumer products. What's happening now really reflects his vision. We are all consumer products in some way and we all have our 15 minutes of fame.

QmWbPuptpgBXgbzqa7uEXGkJgVbUZQJPDZBLE5xi.name: ​​OUR FATHER IN THE METAVERSE #44
QmWbPuptpgBXgbzqa7uEXGkJgVbUZQJPDZBLE5xi.description:
https://mathiasrusch-metaverse.com/

The "Our Father" - The cycle of paintings by artist Mathias Rusch (*1927-2003).   

If there is a most important prayer of Christian faith, then it must be the "Our Father".  
 
This prayer gift of Jesus to his disciples, later handed down to us Christians, has become the actual Christian self-understanding, the "prayer of the Lord". Packed into a few sentences, it has come to be regarded as the actual confession of faith and is prayed millions of times a day, both individually and in communities. The fact that this "conversation with God" has hardly ever been depicted (in contrast to the Passion) is probably due to the immense message it conveys. The fact that the painter Mathias Rusch dared to translate the "Our Father" can be explained by the fact that his daily work was based on faith, hope, and trust in God. Mathias Rusch was aware that he could only exist in the understanding of his art "as a gift of God". Most of his late works (Our Father, Live and Let Live, Sermon on the Mount, Lauretan Litany, Litany of the Sacred Heart) were written, as he confessed, under the "kind help" of the Highest, always accompanied by personal prayers, meditations or invocations. The fact that Mathias Rusch did not reveal a word for the interpretation of his works of art is to be justified by the fact that he understood himself to a large extent as a mediator of a higher power. Thus we are sometimes quite helplessly confronted with an immense abundance of Christian symbols, metaphysical allusions, concretizations, and abstractions, in unique hues and compositions. Completely in the sense of Mathias Rusch we dive before the 13 works of art into the enormous topic of earthly existence and Christian eschatology, marvel before the color power, before the hints, confessions, and convictions of the very deeply felt "Our Father's". Finally, we become humbled and ultimately grateful to be initiated into the world-prayer of a "knowing" believer, again and again, with each glance at each of these magnificent works of art. Whoever takes a longer "eye" look at this self-contained, unique complete work, consisting of 13 unique pieces in oil on canvas, 170x170cm, will not be able to resist a lasting effect and deep consternation.

Packed into a few sentences, it has come to be regarded as the actual confession of faith and is prayed millions of times a day, both individually and in communities. The fact that this "conversation with God" has hardly ever been depicted (in contrast to the Passion) is probably due to the immense message it conveys. The fact that the painter Mathias Rusch dared to translate the "Our Father" can be explained by the fact that his daily work was based on faith, hope, and trust in God. Mathias Rusch was aware that he could only exist in the understanding of his art "as a gift of God". Most of his late works (Our Father, Live and Let Live, Sermon on the Mount, Lauretan Litany, Litany of the Sacred Heart) were written, as he confessed, under the "kind help" of the Highest, always accompanied by personal prayers, meditations or invocations. The fact that Mathias Rusch did not reveal a word for the interpretation of his works of art is to be justified by the fact that he understood himself to a large extent as a mediator of a higher power. Thus we are sometimes quite helplessly confronted with an immense abundance of Christian symbols, metaphysical allusions, concretizations, and abstractions, in unique hues and compositions. Completely in the sense of Mathias Rusch we dive before the 13 works of art into the enormous topic of earthly existence and Christian eschatology, marvel before the color power, before the hints, confessions, and convictions of the very deeply felt "Our Father's". Finally, we become humbled and ultimately grateful to be initiated into the world-prayer of a "knowing" believer, again and again, with each glance at each of these magnificent works of art. Whoever takes a longer "eye" look at this self-contained, unique complete work, consisting of 13 unique pieces in oil on canvas, 170x170cm, will not be able to resist a lasting effect and deep consternation.

Since the killing of George Floyd, major protests have rocked the US and some parts of the world, boosting conversations around race, racism and racial inequalities. Black, Indigenous, People of Color have raised their voices to highlight the systemic racism that has not only kept them down but has also led to countless and avoidable killings by law enforcement.

"My Body, My Crime" is a documentation of this social phenomenon.

QmWfqSR7KYuvJqgp22dyQvuFLtmcHGpKERUANULL.name: Choose the Man You Will Become
QmWfqSR7KYuvJqgp22dyQvuFLtmcHGpKERUANULL.description:
I've been going to barbershops since I was a kid. Posters like this often lined the walls, were even positioned right outside to invite customers in.

Recently, I found that these posters were not just a display of hairstyles: They started to mean more to me. To me, they were choices that we could make as men in the society.

Seen by some as the most common place for the exhibition of toxic masculinity, barbershops could as well be urging us to be better men by presenting us with these varieties of choices.

So, man, choose the man you will become.

QmWgFU42ddt78wPxP1SWEHrkhiy1ZLwCnNiQU1tA.description: Timeless is a look into how cultural memory can be stored in digital objects. This piece consists of a single layer that represents different aspects of the intertwinement between culture and technology. The “time” layer evolves autonomously throughout a Gregorian year, gradually returning the central piece to its archaeological origin, deeper into the ground. Every 1st of the month, the sculpture will be buried a bit more until a whole year cycle, where it will emerge and begin the process once again. An endless temporal loop.

QmWgPv6CjhAbhJXGEeZurhwRfJ8K96yaRtj2c1AP.name: Neural Alchemy
QmWgPv6CjhAbhJXGEeZurhwRfJ8K96yaRtj2c1AP.description:
We live in times where New Aesthetic and New Media are the rule of our visual code. My creative process appropriates the characteristic visual features of the main movements present in digital art in recent years—such as Glitch Art, 3D models, DataViz, Code Art, Vaporwave and Cyberpunk, in order to mix them with each other and reintegrate them with traditional media such as drawing and painting. As a painter by training, I conduct myself through an erratic process that seems more like a search for a personal aesthetic within the density of images and information characteristic of our era.
Compose obsessively is the key to associating these elements in an image; distribute visual weights, observe the piece at a different distance, move away and get closer. Neural Alchemy is the result of cautious curation of elements and careful observation and decision-making to solve a piece that is not meant to be static. As an artist, producing an image for the format in which Async Art works is one of the most exhilaratingly creative challenges I have ever faced.
The piece is made up of four layers based on the core elements: Mood, Material Color, Ethereal Color and Body Matter. Each one plays with references of the styles mentioned above. Hope you find hidden messages and feel inspired by this creation, you might enjoy this piece as much as I do.

QmWhChprGuPJW4PAT4KbpivP62h6tTQdfkyV9ZQL.name: The House On The Hill...
QmWhChprGuPJW4PAT4KbpivP62h6tTQdfkyV9ZQL.description:
I had a memory return the other day about some old movie or TV series i used to watch when i was younger (probably too young) where there was the classic "House on the Hill" horror theme.

I got quite a strong memory recall of it and, as i often do got a physiological response also (hair standing on back of neck and goosebumps!) which was really creepy!

So i thought I would put a good clean fun sense of hilarity and humor on that situation and this is what you see here!

I love trying to make people smile and be happy so hopefully this piece will do that for you :)

MacHatter

PS - I think the Movie/TV Series may have been Salems Lot!

QmWkSnu8vJvLfVnhRNt5ASDsm3JY24HsTM6amdtS.name: Paradox Pathways
QmWkSnu8vJvLfVnhRNt5ASDsm3JY24HsTM6amdtS.description:
In the 1980s, string theory was proposed to be the sought-for unified theory that unifies all forces and matter. The strings are unable to be detected with current scientific methods. It's theorized that there are mini dimensions that are undetectable to us, and the strings are just as small so that they can vibrate through these dimensions connecting all forces and matter. 

In this artwork, an individual discovers how to see and interact with these strings. He is able to navigate the strings as if they are a path on the ground. While traversing the paths through dimensions, he saw and experienced such otherwordly sensations and emotions. Experiences that are so alien to one's sense of reality that they can not be explained justly. 

Tears run down his face as he is overcome by such never-before-seen beauty and by the realization that he is lost with no way back to his home dimension. What first felt like a dream quickly became a nightmare. He is constantly traversing the dimensional paths, running into the other versions of himself. However, his other selves aren't the same as him - they feel as though they are imposters, dangerous ones at that. His other selves feel the same way toward him.

Is he doomed to wander the paths in fear for eternity? Will he eventually find a way out? The answer is unknown.

QmWmXm858AU6JxTkorbt9vf7F6v2k8TLTn3uC3zA.description: "The Great Desire" is a homage to the entire Blockchain scene with all its symbols and memes, with Bitcoin and Satoshi as avant-garde elements in the foreground; as well as the founder of the Ethereum Blockchain Vitalik Buterin. In memory of the great mania of the ICO bubble of 2017 and with a look into the future to future highs yet to come, "The Great Desire" illustrates a mass phenomenon in which "the hope for freedom and independence" and "the desire to become rich and financially independent" are holding each other the balance and are in the focus. There is much more to say about this piece and all information will be available in the article which is connected to it.

QmWr6TFSp1XxXP6wQWR9QpHGomm389X4VndJrQZK.name: Lex Be Don
QmWr6TFSp1XxXP6wQWR9QpHGomm389X4VndJrQZK.description:
I have often wondered how parts make up a whole. I have written about it. I have actually written a mini poem about it and published it on Medium. I've minted another such into a different sort of NFT here on Async Art. This piece is another divide and don't conquer one. Loosely based on my grafitti photographs from Abbey Road Studios' walls, I focus taking bits out of the original photo and re-creating the linked pieces for this work. I sincerely wonder that if I live and it's years later that the art market boom of NFT would have happened to the extent that experimental works on Async Art have also been sweeped. I really would hope to see the day and  f*** talk about it for fun over coffee.

I call it a photograph.

I call it text.

I call it glitch.

I call it pseduo painting.

I even call it photo painting.

I may call it pseduo photo painting of selective text.

Lex Be Don by Hulki Okan Tabak
Minted on Async Art as 2021 ages further
