QmWrXz12g1NUgSQfR5y5479Grfgmy5D5WHN9M99C.name: Pumpkin Life Cycle
QmWrXz12g1NUgSQfR5y5479Grfgmy5D5WHN9M99C.description:
EXPERIENCE THE LIFE CYCLE OF A PUMPKIN! 

Every 24 hours go from a bag of pumpkins seeds to the garbage bin! 

Hour breakdown:
00:00 Bag Of Pumpkin Seeds | Night
01:00 Freshly Planted | Day
02:00 Raining | Night
03:00 Tiny Sprout | Day
04:00 Larger Sprout | Night
05:00 Largest Sprout | Day
06:00 Almost Ready | Night
07:00 For Sale | Day
08:00 Sold | Night
09:00 In Transit | Day
10:00 Kitchen Counter - Clean | Night
11:00 Kitchen Counter - Gutted | Day
12:00 Cut And Ready | Night
13:00 Outside Steps - No Leaves | Day
14:00 Outside Steps - Little Leaves | Night
15:00 Outside Steps - Plenty of Leaves | Day
16:00 Halloween | Night
17:00 Wrappers On Floor | Day
18:00 Slightly Deflated | Night
19:00 More Decay | Day
20:00 Night Chunks | Night
21:00 Lots Of Decay | Day
22:00 Rotting With Flies | Night
23:00 Garbage | Day

Every image was penciled on paper then I used acrylic ink to pen the the lines I liked. Once I was happy with the inks I took high resolution photos of the them then colored and edited on my phone! Overall I'm quite happy with the result and even more happy with the possibility to do this on chain! I hope you enjoy this piece and the fall as much I do!

QmWtPchnoxgEPAcPSbxhvXDYqrn1Nt4u2B2he8tE.name: Lord Gravity
QmWtPchnoxgEPAcPSbxhvXDYqrn1Nt4u2B2he8tE.description:
Lord Gravity is a Master of the Space Age, a contemporary superhero who floats in space. 

He is a ruler of gravity and is often seen being dropped by his spaceship into a planet. He can move objects as well as gravity itself when he uses his abilities. He has very little physical strength, so he is always looking for new ways to help out humans and other planets' inhabitants. 

He is immune to any form of gravitational force and is known for being able to absorb any shape or object that he encounters and then redirects all that energy into a force field that surrounds him while he floats around Space. 

His left arm helps his movements and he often needs to change his appearance, in 24 hour cycles, every hour, to blend in with the colours of the multiple planetary regions that he visits every day.

@cyrusjameskhan

QmWvEWWcnQevKS2Zwi2r5HpJmqZP15iJZze7TSdf.name: Turris Caelestia
QmWvEWWcnQevKS2Zwi2r5HpJmqZP15iJZze7TSdf.description:
Birdlings from far away made the pilgrimage to Turris Caelestia on a yearly basis. “Celestial Tower” was its name in the common tongue. They wanted to see the stars and suns and moons pass through the double arch that made up the tower city. It was a sight to see. But they wanted something more: new feather colours. While the celestial bodies moved, the tower absorbed the emanating cosmic energy. And as the birdlings flew nearby they would absorb that energy from the tower. In so doing, their feather colours would change in colour. Sometimes to white. Sometimes to green. Sometimes to sparkling gold.

This NFT changes how it looks based on the time of day. It has a different image for day, night, sunrise, and sunset.
Size: 2160 × 3840px.

QmWwMNHHezeGFyoXAEUN6qmZKFH6Y3yoc6vPAd6Y.name: The Emotional "State" of Ai...
QmWwMNHHezeGFyoXAEUN6qmZKFH6Y3yoc6vPAd6Y.description:
This 24 Image Blueprint Is actually a representation of the "21 Facial Expression" research done by Professor Aleix M. Martinez at Ohio State University back in 2014.

I have a particular interested in this as I have difficulty recognizing basic facial expressions (and emotions) due to ADHD and CPTSD so I found that creating these artworks, and especially using Ai to do so, is extremely interesting and I love the results.

Not being able to regulate my own emotions sometimes means I can go through a lot of these emotions in a single day and being able to express myself through these artworks helps me get closer to understanding these emotions and myself.

Its a life long journey and one I am happy to be taking (although it gets a bit rough sometimes, especially for my loved ones) and slowly figuring out (after 50 years on the planet) what makes me tick in the way I tick specifically.  

Doing the work to learn about emotions and how to understand/regulate and enjoy them is allowing me to perhaps understand other people a bit better and also allows me to get closer to those I Love and Cherish and Ai has allowed me to achieve this with the greatest amount of pleasure.  This is singularly the most important benefit to me from working on myself.

I almost have a synchronicity with the Ai as you can see in the images, some of them are quite clearly what they are supposed to be, others not so much, maybe just but not quite, that's pretty much me in a nutshell.

Anyway I hope you enjoy the artworks, live a beautiful, soulful life, be compassionate and kind but most importantly love yourself for who you are, you are unique and worth Loving.

Machatter

Doing the work to learn about emotions and how to understand/regulate and enjoy them is allowing me to perhaps understand other people a bit better and also allows me to get closer to those I Love and Cherish and Ai has allowed me to achieve this with the greatest amount of pleasure.  This is singularly the most important benefit to me from working on myself.

I almost have a synchronicity with the Ai as you can see in the images, some of them are quite clearly what they are supposed to be, others not so much, maybe just but not quite, that's pretty much me in a nutshell.

Anyway I hope you enjoy the artworks, live a beautiful, soulful life, be compassionate and kind but most importantly love yourself for who you are, you are unique and worth Loving.

Machatter

QmWxhoPCYorys3G2F6L2LLFDRxkt2E4edGH6f6jS.name: Burning
QmWxhoPCYorys3G2F6L2LLFDRxkt2E4edGH6f6jS.description:
Burning = The Urge To Create. There's always something brewing inside. Always an idea, an image or a plan to work on. Always a face to spend time with. To see the beauty and take the power to transform it into something else. I'm looking for unity in the World of a Scatterbrain. I flow through colors and find Peace inside my work. The progress, doing the work, the feeling when I step outside time. It's all captured in my work. Dense and Intense. Looking for details that light up and want to be discovered. Like diamonds in a mine.

The layers of this piece all have 2 states. The layer owners can choose which one will be visible. When Smoking, Holding, Staring and Flaying are together switched to State #2 they block the background image and become a New Piece. The layer owners have to work together if they want to see this piece. 


I want every layer owner to have the feeling they own something special that can also be shown just by itself. We all contribute to a larger system, but have our own thoughts and feelings too. I mean, we're all part of a family but we're also individuals. Like the transformers. 



Extra info:
I've burned the Base Drawing of this work in order to extracted value offline and added it to the online world. 

I set the drawing on fire in my garden and recorded the process. I've tokenized it and published it in an edition of 10 on Rarible and will give them away to a lucky few.

QmX1eA2PxGyVXNEGpCgM1AFsnUxMgRcxNjdwu1uk.name: ''Collective Instinct ""
QmX1eA2PxGyVXNEGpCgM1AFsnUxMgRcxNjdwu1uk.description:
This piece echoes the utter essentialness of collective instinct and teamwork for doctors and their teams in the healthcare setting. The trust built and the cohesion cemented reduces the chances of medical errors and develops a greater appreciation of each other's work. This phenomenal approach enables these professionals to better meet patient needs as a collective, and through shared responsibility, their tasks are smoothed and procedures timely executed. Observations and decisions made together guarantee them enhanced efficiency and effectiveness.
Exemplified is a classic case of workplace teamwork, something they execute so well that demands a heightened sense of social and relationship awareness.

QmX1r1pxEaTMsaL9SFP4NHCTu6LARyVhGVAzj52N.name: Imagination Swamp. Tribute to Attitude Apoteket
QmX1r1pxEaTMsaL9SFP4NHCTu6LARyVhGVAzj52N.description:
Imagination is a swamp of ideas that often decomposes and rarely floats free. In this swamp things move more quickly beneath the surface. The things we do not see, the things we do not tell, lie beneath a variegated layer of green and damp. 

A constant effort to do more of one and less of the other as life slips between our fingers like water under a tap, but just as the water disappears, a current fills the swamp with new organic material matter. 

This piece is a tribute to two of the most creative people I have ever met, Attitude Apoteket, a digital design studio based in Aarhus. Look for them in the metaverse.

QmX2HT2gUrwmXw5tGqGqYNfkoD32sxumNDr4mxdi.name: Mariupol
QmX2HT2gUrwmXw5tGqGqYNfkoD32sxumNDr4mxdi.description:
1937. As Spain War was at its apogee, Franco with his Nazi allies bombed civilians for the first time in the city of Guernica.

85 years later. As we could not imagine the comeback of a war at our borders; we see soldiers engaging in a war by bombing Mariupol, Kyiv and other cities, and millions of civilians are on the run, scattered over Europe away from their home they might never see again. 

Because of the Emergency of the Situation, 38 artists decided to create a massive collaboration within 3 weeks. 

'Mariupol' will be displayed during the Non-Fungible Conference on a giant screen wall. This will take place in Lisbon, Portugal in April 4-5 2022 and is created under the supervision of The Guild.

There is an emergency in Ukraine now, but more generally, the XXI Century seems to redefine the war as a new normal. Nobody can accept this in Ukraine or any other country, we need to do something, we need to act here and now!

All the funds and royalties will go to “Voices of  Children” to bring psychological support to child victims of war.


Artists Involved: 

Rutger van der Tas, 0xMJ, Shinji Akhirah, Jetski, Ytje Veenstra, ROBNESS, Skeenee, Mightymoose, jivinci, crashblossom, oficinastk, orabel, Jæn, emmavauloup, Shortcut, 8thproject, Louis16art, fabianospeziari, XERAK, abysms, carlasafe, Nino Arteiro, Magusz, dasNeves, BOOYASAN, Airco Caravan, GertJanAkerboom, LUVRworldwide, Marcotic, Niels Broszat, Tom Abbink, ejthek, Pule the dr, Sparrow, Miss al simpson, Angie Taylor, Agoria, Teto.



Supervision: The Guild: Rutger van der Tas, 0xMJ

Curators: John Karp, Benoit Couty and The Guild

Initiated by John Karp

First Exhibition : Non-Fungible Conference, Lisbon, Portugal

QmX2g3uzoeuLvMmz86U8BBq3XswcMn4f6bidweQk.name: dBIRTH.
QmX2g3uzoeuLvMmz86U8BBq3XswcMn4f6bidweQk.description:
​dCREATION. is the first artistic attempt to represent and idealize the origin of humanity following the new evolutionary theories. Fine Art history meets the Sci-fi worldwide trend in a unique atmosphere of emotions and colors, leaving a window for every kind of personal interpretation. A fantastic series of four different Art Pieces to describe the unknown feeling between the Creator and his born, all connected by a third element, the “God Particle” or the Higgs-Boson, which plays an essential role in this metaphysical relationship. The three parts of the whole, the sacred Trinity, all those essences find a place to exist in this abstract world, a reality full of mysteries and secrets, which will reveal a new vision of human evolution myth. A dualism of specific colors characterizes each piece to describe all feelings involved in this ancient and primordial love, where is essential to find your own truth to explain the whole.

Illustration n.0: dBIRTH.

All of your collected assumptions have hardened into reality. You will toss and turn some more, tempering your body to house a new set of fleeting thoughts tomorrow.

QmX3ccioLkxm8WkwYeaYVRBWCuuwfGYQ4ahSSW2E.name: Programmable "Hodl'em"
QmX3ccioLkxm8WkwYeaYVRBWCuuwfGYQ4ahSSW2E.description:
Texas hold 'em (hold 'em or holdem) is one of the most popular variants of the card game of poker. Two cards, known as hole cards, are dealt face down to each player, and then five community cards are dealt face up. Each player seeks the best five card poker hand from any combination of the seven cards; the five community cards and their two hole cards.

This piece brings a maximum interactivity concept between the layers owners. Interact with other layers owners to compete in the most epic and endless programmable poker game in blockchain.

Why not look at life through rose colored lenses?

QmX5ZTypHcXqPbn8wXWWgBVWUvv8NpHuUYkNgHC8.description: Bolides are passing by the night sky. The intensity of their action increases hour after hour. Initially they barely break the dark of the night, but then they split into smaller pieces and the build-up of their kinetic energy brightens up the dull and dark colours of an apparently calm and peaceful night. This generative piece uses the same base algorithm to create 24 different layers that change once every hour.

2 Artworks in 1 Daily Cycle

New York Polaroids by Athena Novo, Summer of 2022, An Alternative New York during the NFT Summit, Minted 1/1 on Async Art

While everyone was enjoying the NFT Summit, a different group of visitors were in New York. Some call them demons, monsters and zombies while I would prefer more neutral terms but nonetheless here are some of the photographs I've taken of them which I release with full disclosure and their cooperation. The prospective collectors should acknowledge the existence of "undead" and some even more exotic characters might cause some alarm among the general population. Therefore viewer caution is warranted even though most of these peoples I met during the NFT Summit seemed to be of absolutely good character (not sure about some demonic entities that did not respond) and interested in art and its manifestation with the technologies branded aptly as NFT and what not.

QmX7Nz7GNe7U6327MzsNq7cQ6EcVsXsRsxZJAgap.name: The Remixable Kiss
QmX7Nz7GNe7U6327MzsNq7cQ6EcVsXsRsxZJAgap.description:
A programmable NFT where 12 lovers are cut out of six paintings, masterpieces of art history covering a time span of six centuries:

Giotto - Incontro alla Porta d'Oro (1303-1305)
François Gérard - Psyché et l'Amour (1798)
Francesco Hayez - il Bacio (1859)
Dante Gabriel Rossetti - Paolo and Francesca da Rimini (1867)
Jean-Léon Gérôme - Pygmalion et Galatée (1890)
Gustav Klimt - Der Kuss (1907-1908)

3 layers with 6 states each for a journey to discover the most surprising and daring kisses, where men and women are mixed for a conceptual and technical realization that is my artistic contribution to the exaltation of contemporary possibilities of programmable nfts, with a respectful eye to the historical heritage of classical art and with the privilege of knowing that in every part of this artwork there's the brushstroke of a master and the energy of his spirit and his time.

QmX7xHVdnuzmrpqfaM1pnDTKnfVbUPQdERU7Joe5.name: Wheel of Time
QmX7xHVdnuzmrpqfaM1pnDTKnfVbUPQdERU7Joe5.description: The Wheel of Time is turning, as it has always been. We have good times and bad times. It's a cycle. All things and circumstances around us keep changing with time. That's what is portrayed in this Art, with different backgrounds and textures. The wheel of time has the design of a geometric Mandala. The shape of the wheel changes Algorithmically every hour, along with its background. Shadows of the Daytime versions, 6 am to 6 pm, have their shadows change as per the location of the Sun. Enjoy! Cherish your time! There is something that doesn't change. What is that?

QmX8Yw1MHhBEfzqsDxJUxKZRK5ikVeP8m7aUoTLr.name: The Smoking Woman
QmX8Yw1MHhBEfzqsDxJUxKZRK5ikVeP8m7aUoTLr.description:
She watches you intently as the smoke from her cigarette gently dances on the air. You're trying hard to discern her gaze in the dim light. Is it mild curiosity, mere annoyance, disgust, or is it desire?

I work both digitally and traditionally, striving to make the two indistinguishable in order to show critics the value of digital art in the world of fine art. I pick my subjects based on the emotion(s) it evokes in me and then I try to convey that same feeling in the work I create.

Dimension: 3840 pixel x 3840 pixel
Type of Work: GANs Algorithm trained photograph

The photographs in the series of Regeneration produced by using Generative Adversarial Networks. I took over three thousand photos spanned nearly a decade for a specific project and selected over a thousand photos from there as the Dataset for AI training. The photographs have been gestated by AI that integrated all the subtle emotions of the original pieces, which are the most exciting parts of this series.

QmXA4NEbTH5sJ1J7DbadceavyUWr4BsBwW8gbdhU.description:

Location: 1.3521° N, 103.8198° E

North is towards the top of the screen, thus the sun is perceived as rising from the right and setting on the left. The hour can be derived from the rotation of the crane (e.g. at 12 o'clock the boom points upwards), to those in GMT +8 at least. :)

QmXAVvUBUiCCHdqrCiJh3emKNZfdH575mgqozzhf.name: Julia
QmXAVvUBUiCCHdqrCiJh3emKNZfdH575mgqozzhf.description: In this piece, I applied the ideas and stylistics of such art movements in painting as pointillism, suprematism and color field painting to art photography. While developing the color field light painting, I added to it the geometric micro-shapes. As a result, I got a technique, which I called a suprematist color field (I will publish artwork in this technique later). Continuing to experiment, I combined the suprematist color field with the classic nude. As a result, I got another technique - suprematist pointillism. This artwork is done in this technique.

QmXBFXd4yM68dyLRfoi1o9amkxM8At3bbtAEVWzg.name: 24 Hours of Skulls
QmXBFXd4yM68dyLRfoi1o9amkxM8At3bbtAEVWzg.description:
---This NFT represents the sale of 24 physical ink paintings of animal skulls and skeletons created by Skeenee. These paintings were first featured on Makersplace (https://makersplace.com/skeenee/). Skeenee will personally deliver this physical collection to the winner of this auction on first sale---

Spend a day in the company of Skeenee’s Skull and Skeleton creations in your own space in the metaverse. Venture inside CryptoVoxels to your very own parcel where “24 hours of Skulls” awaits.  With each hour spent there, an exciting new artwork is displayed, revealing 24 unique creations. Understand the creation process behind each piece as it is brought to life through video.
Finally come back to reality as you take ownership of each of the 24 physical artworks, delivered in person by Skeenee. (Buyers in the International Space Station may need to wait to take delivery).

Buy this and you’ll receive:
* The NFT, "24 hours of Skulls"
* 24 ink paintings created by Skeenee with fountain pen and ink on Arches paper
* A central CryptoVoxels Parcel featuring the NFT, the paintings and process videos. (https://www.cryptovoxels.com/parcels/281)
* A mural of the artwork

Each artwork comes from the Skull & Skeleton ink painting series which was started by Skeenee in 2018 to study anatomy & contrast and was inspired by renaissance drawings; a demonstration of a time where art and science were seen as one. The paintings are drawn with fountain pens on Arches paper, painted & shaded with Sumi ink and watercolors.

Remember, the clock is ticking…

QmXD5kgQU2zD93vevXvkjQo64HY6haUqfCUtiQEW.name: 24 Hours in The City That Never Sleeps
QmXD5kgQU2zD93vevXvkjQo64HY6haUqfCUtiQEW.description:
NYC is a place filled with sensory delights any time of the day. In this work there are four different autonomous state changes representing different times of the day: shining sunrise, bright afternoon, magic hour sunset, and late night escapades. 

We live in a world that is constantly shifting every second. Let's take a minute to celebrate the humanity that bonds all of us. 24 Hours in The City That Never Sleeps is a piece about all the people that bring the big city to life. Each Frank has it's own unique story, self-expression, and energy. Each day we cross paths, form new connections, and try to leave our positive mark on the world. Frank is an extension of everyone. Helping others helps everyone. Let's be Frank.

Frank Ape is a mystical creature who lives amongst the humans but without human restrictions.  What started as a form of self-expression on the streets of NYC for artist Brandon Sines quickly turned into a movement for the people.

 Frank has special powers that he continues to discover as he is tested by the many challenges of life. Frank champions positivity and equality, and cares about all living things. He believes in using imagination and play to inspire other people and animals through thoughtful actions.

QmXEEQ8vRytyw9xaQWWpbRtLLX866NmVyNFW788y.name: AI x Klimt x Adele x Dreams
QmXEEQ8vRytyw9xaQWWpbRtLLX866NmVyNFW788y.description:
AI x Klimt x Adele x Dreams
by Hulki Okan Tabak
minted on Async Art

24 pieces 24 hours 

...

This work is based on Gustav Klimt's first portrait of Adele Bloch-Bauer (1907). The piece has been sold by Christie's in a private for USD 135 million in 2006. The piece is in public domain. 

I have walked through various stages of re-imagination on the original piece. I have first applied a general conversion which was subsequently mixed with various genes from randomly selected digital works. I selectively defined starting points and increments that I followed for the next 23 images in journeying with Adele through genders and worlds. The process was awesome, fun and immersive. The end result is strange, post-modern and anything but plain beautiful. It speaks to my mind partly as a visual provocation but even more so as a vessel to convey how close sit different states and sides of life.

...

Portrait of Adele Bloch-Bauer I (also called The Lady in Gold or The Woman in Gold) is a painting by Gustav Klimt, completed between 1903 and 1907. The portrait was commissioned by the sitter's husband, Ferdinand Bloch-Bauer, a Jewish banker and sugar producer. The painting was stolen by the Nazis in 1941 and displayed at the Österreichische Galerie Belvedere. The portrait is the final and most fully representative work of Klimt's golden phase. It was the first of two depictions of Adele by Klimt—the second was completed in 1912; these were two of several works by the artist that the family owned. (Wikipedia)

Community is the fabric that unites us all. Celebrate each other and be a positive member of your neighborhood. Say hello, offer to lend a helping hand, talk to the animals, and keep an eye out for aliens. As the collector of this work of art you can customize the piece by controlling the amount of Franks, animals, and six different times of the day. How you compose the different states of each layer helps tell a story of a moment in time in the neighborhood.

QmXKoFNq6JKhpZWacDMVVBgafcbYEQAcqq9KRXXt.description:
24 collaborative drawings in a single artwork that changes by the hour.

Anger as a Weapon of Choice is a collaboration between Bulbasaur 9 and Hulki Okan Tabak.

The primary drawing comes from a personal project by B9 and HoT has expanded on the subject matter with different degrees and methods of reimagination.

There are three 24 piece collaborations as a part of this project which will be all minted on Async Art. Meanwhile collaboration also created GIFs based on individual stills and they will be minted on other cryptoart platforms.

QmXLMDMBQ4oXzs8DS6HX28Hj7Q3bCnkMTLjpYJMk.name: Portrait of Satoshi Nakamoto #22: The God of Thunder
QmXLMDMBQ4oXzs8DS6HX28Hj7Q3bCnkMTLjpYJMk.description:
The juxtaposition of a historical mythological tale realizes the puppeteers of the 21st century.

Part of the on-going Master Study project @bigcomicart
Also coinciding with a possible of portrait of Satoshi Nakamoto:

"Under Kim Jong-un, North Korea has continued to develop nuclear weapons, testing bombs in February 2013, January and September 2016, and September 2017.[133] As of 2018, North Korea had tested nearly 90 missiles, three times more than in the time of his father and grandfather.[102] In 2012, on the 100th anniversary of Kim Il-sung's birth, he said, "the days are gone forever when our enemies could blackmail us with nuclear bombs"" -- Wikipedia, 'The Education of Kim Jung Un'

"Jupiter is usually thought to have originated as a sky god. His identifying implement is the thunderbolt and his primary sacred animal is the eagle,[13] which held precedence over other birds in the taking of auspices[14] and became one of the most common symbols of the Roman army (see Aquila). The two emblems were often combined to represent the god in the form of an eagle holding in its claws a thunderbolt, frequently seen on Greek and Roman coins.[15] As the sky-god, he was a divine witness to oaths, the sacred trust on which justice and good government depend." -- Wikipedia

QmXLYXrNYri449hQadTJXaecGEvsiRHY5KAgDx7R.name: Pawns & Hiding figures
QmXLYXrNYri449hQadTJXaecGEvsiRHY5KAgDx7R.description:
Sometimes you feel like there is an invisible force.
The hidden figure that directs the chess game.
With the hands of puppet chess players decides the outcome of the battle.
Revolutions.
Pandemic. 
Economic crisis. 
Wars. 

It seems like someone's having fun playing games where you're just a pawn.

They hide behind colorful newspaper headlines.
Behind significant events and incidents.
They're watching you from stock charts and freshly printed banknotes.
What's this? 
Paranoia? 
Conspiracy theory? 
Or…?

Digital painting 
3000 x 3000 px

When you find it
Is it because of the search

What you find
Is it what you sought for?

December 2012 — June 2020

QmXRjntfFrnbiXeCLyZsJrDkC3i2BaUsTxMtr1id.name: Loop
QmXRjntfFrnbiXeCLyZsJrDkC3i2BaUsTxMtr1id.description: In this piece, I tried to raise awareness to the global warming by showing the three major indicators of it by using these circular charts which represent the CO2 emissions (top), sea level rise (middle) and temperature (bottom) changes through years. Each slice can be thought as timeframes and the occupancy of the slices represent the units of them. Each day/night these charts start from the past when everything is sweetness and light and end with the current level of the global warming, which create a loop of awareness reminding us each day that we can't change the past and motivates us to take action for a better future.

QmXVPju8VYNqcsysNxPGHwoXvZU7zY71vMweQ5LY.name: Soliloquy
QmXVPju8VYNqcsysNxPGHwoXvZU7zY71vMweQ5LY.description:
As I continue to wonder what the future holds for me, I find myself speaking more to myself. Planning, strategizing, and hoping. Mixed with anxiety and worry. I wonder who else has such thoughts. Who else is wondering if they will ever make it in this life?
I paint my most recent feelings in this piece, hoping others will be able to relate and maybe draw strength from the realization that they are not alone.
'Soliloquy' is the story of a black man who is deep in thoughts about his life.

This piece began as a photograph of my street. Then photographs of Adire which is symbolic and crucial to representing my culture in my artworks. metadata.name: Soliloquy
metadata.description:
As I continue to wonder what the future holds for me, I find myself speaking more to myself. Planning, strategizing, and hoping. Mixed with anxiety and worry. I wonder who else has such thoughts. Who else is wondering if they will ever make it in this life?
I paint my most recent feelings in this piece, hoping others will be able to relate and maybe draw strength from the realization that they are not alone.

QmXVqz8qjY2jkHWUuBExdrRD2bECPE6UpYepBB9R.name: Sun Kachina Hours
QmXVqz8qjY2jkHWUuBExdrRD2bECPE6UpYepBB9R.description: Kachina spirits live in Native American Hopi villages. Many years ago I was priviledged to witness the Niman (Going Home) ceremony, which concludes the Kachina season with an outdoor Kachina Dance at sunrise.  It was a magical experience. A few years later, I was able to trade a painting for a traditional Kachina doll made by a noted Hopi artisan.  It was a Clown Kachina.  Another important Kachina is the Sun Kachina, a highly abstracted version of which is reimagined in this work.  The images change on the hour throughout the 24 hour night/day cycle.

QmXWm2dkc95C3AnKadp6hGsLWfGGtSnzG17hWzFz.name: Magic Place
QmXWm2dkc95C3AnKadp6hGsLWfGGtSnzG17hWzFz.description:
Ever feel like you're in the center of the universe but at the same time somewhere in the far reaches of it?

Close your eyes and take a deep breath. Let the calm fill you and float in a sea of bliss. That is your Magic Place. A place that always exists inside of you.

This piece is a reminder at any time of the day, no matter where you are or how busy you may be, that you can take a break. Take as long as you need and remember the beauty of life and everything around you are all right there when you decide to open your eyes again.

I continually find myself observing how metropolises incorporate nature into their city planning and how people find unique spaces and make them their own. Finding or creating your own secret magical space is an artform everyone can practice.

Frank Ape is a mystical creature who lives amongst the humans but without human restrictions. What started as a form of self-expression on the streets of NYC for artist Brandon Sines quickly turned into a movement for the people. Frank has special powers that he continues to discover as he is tested by the many challenges of life. Frank champions positivity and equality, and cares about all living things. He believes in using imagination and play to inspire other people and animals through thoughtful actions.

Exposure to pestilent infestants without sufficient personal protective equipment occasioned a vital challenge for medical workers in the early months of the Coronavirus. Several dedicated staff lost their lives in service after contracting and succumbing to the deadly microbes while in line of duty committed to saving as many as they possibly could.
The art piece revels in their selfless altruism and unfeigned compassion during a time of crisis in contemporary history.

QmXaUbnhWecovZDvPiRbx88gCsaasK2AYcGoXVtR.name: Beyond
QmXaUbnhWecovZDvPiRbx88gCsaasK2AYcGoXVtR.description: We are used to looking at things only from straight angle, overlooking details that are hidden from us at first glance. This type of vision shapes our understanding of things, and drives us into the framework of the stereotypes we have created. What if we look at the world wider? What if we get used to presenting the bigger picture instead of focusing only on the details that are visible at first glance? This kind of vision would allow us to look at things more broadly, penetrating their essence and not just the outer shell. We came up with strict rules that formed the basis of life, and now, being guided by these rules, we ourselves limit our freedom of action, freedom of outlook and breadth of thought. But at the same moment, these rules and frameworks exist only in our head, and it is in our power to get rid of them. I was always inspired by the icons of Andrei Rublev, who painted his icons depicting the world in reverse perspective, as well as Pablo Picasso, who painted pictures without trying to adhere to generally accepted rules, but trying to show the very essence instead of the usual shell. The surreal spirit of such works prompted us to learn the principles of action of various optic lenses, the features of light refraction and the capabilities of various software in order to be able to push the boundaries of our usual vision, but already in the world of digital art. It took me 3 months of experiments to make this experience become possible, and this picture is the result of these experiments. It changes its appearance depending on the time of day. At night, we see the forms and strict lines we are accustomed to, in the morning and in the evening it begins to transform and freezes in an intermediate stage, in which you can see how proportions and sizes change. During the day, we have the opportunity to look beyond the usual and see what is hidden from our eyes. Forms and lines no longer lend themselves to familiar representations, but create a whole new image that allows us to look differently at the forms that have become familiar. If we treat our life in this way, we will be able to look at things with a fresh look of a child who does not yet have established conservative concepts, which means there is unlimited freedom of research and imagination. Thanks to such views of the world, we can finally look deeper, we can look beyond.

QmXbsWawjtAf8hJ5CD9YfToao91tpq9tGo5ee2sH.name: 24h Spiral Dance
QmXbsWawjtAf8hJ5CD9YfToao91tpq9tGo5ee2sH.description:
BRIEF: This minimalist digitally hand-drawn stipple exploration of spiral formation grows an hour at a time; reaching its fullest coiled shape at midnight. 

BACKGROUND:

Since the human story began, upon every continent & island inhabited by human beings there were people carving spirals into wood, metal, stone, and bone. From galaxies to our DNA, spirals are repeated endlessly throughout our Universe at macro & micro scales. These deceptively simple motions reveal the principle of parsimony — energy conservation — at play in the Cosmos. Derived from Latin parsimonia meaning "sparingness, frugality, thrift," from pars-, the past-participle stem of parcere "to spare, save, refrain from, use moderately" and -monia, suffix signifying action, state, or condition. (Etymonline) 

INQUIRY:

Art did not begin as an institutional construct; and it will not end with the (at times, seemingly inevitable) decline of modern technological human civilizations on Earth through waste & war. Can we learn something from the silent movements of our world? Does our technological cosmology accurately place us within an infinite garden? Can we put aside finite games of centralization & domination to humbly rebalance? Will we mirror our infinite nature and collectively embody simplicity before our time runs out? No matter our fate, the vast & dazzling patterns in which we reside and find our being will remain long after the last pixel blinks out of existence.

QmXfMQqRsNGjHExAQEgCHsT2PmEQdFRLFXUn3unx.name: To be, is to feel
QmXfMQqRsNGjHExAQEgCHsT2PmEQdFRLFXUn3unx.description:
During the lockdown, I stumbled upon the use of AI and the generation of visuals using GANs. I began getting intrigued by questions like how does a machine think up visuals? What goes through its “mind/consciousness” while doing so? Does it possess a mind or a consciousness like humans do? If these machines could think, could they feel too?

This last question stuck in my head and became something I constantly found myself returning to. I began thinking more; could I create an NFT piece that could emote and feel? 

I researched how emotions work in humans to see if I could replicate the same as an interactive Async piece. Human emotions are due to a few chemical components; to break it down, it is predominantly controlled by neurotransmitters. The most common ones are Adrenaline, Dopamine, Serotonin and the rest being Noradrenaline, GABA, Acetylcholine, Glutamine. Each neurotransmitter controls different emotions in a human being. 

This piece tries to emulate the functioning of the human brain. The emotional mess/bliss that every human lands up with is due to different compositions and combinations of these chemical concoctions. Buyers could purchase each of these “neurotransmitters” as individual layers, therefore giving them a chance to interact with the piece and decide how it "feels”, what it feels. 

With each layer owned by different human identities, they interact and their own emotions at that point of time could reflect in the changes they make to the piece. This gives rise to unique and infinite possibilities, just like the human mind.  

After all, what is existence if one cannot feel?

QmXigfpZQgKhrxfPyXpd9MyoR5ty2YnxqB3xPQ1p.name: Dybbuk Box Diablo
QmXigfpZQgKhrxfPyXpd9MyoR5ty2YnxqB3xPQ1p.description:
**Disturbing Bad Vibes Vile Nasty**

The box has mysterious origins. Rumor has it that it was found in the back of a hearse with other enchanted objects.

The original box was purchased online for a music video by Dasychira called "Eternal Family", which tells the story of four YouTubers who wish to seal their fate and be together forever: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wnMKAquagdI

One day after the video shoot, the box was hidden in a secret location by one of the directors due to another crew's concern of its "dark energy".

Upon coming back to retrieve it sometime later, the director discovered the box had vanished. It has remained missing since.

Now, Dybbuk Box Diablo exists exclusively in digital (and spiritual) form as this NFT.

QmXj7HLW57ma8UxZbPbNqf7hFaugwsFccVhJy2Pt.name: Weihnachtssammlung
QmXj7HLW57ma8UxZbPbNqf7hFaugwsFccVhJy2Pt.description:
Weihnachtssammlung
aka Christmas Collection
by Hulki Okan Tabak
minted 2021 on Async Art

4 artworks based on World War I propaganda posters from Germany. In this case Bavarian Red Cross' efforts to raise some money for army.

...

The Great War, history, politics, art, posters and propaganda are topics of interest for me. It was kind of natural that I wanted to incorporate that in my cryptoart creations. The desire led to a selection of public domain pieces out of copyright from the Library of Congress archives. I created all sorts of derivative pacifist and tongue-in-cheek works. So far I have only minted a handful on KnownOrigin. Starting September 2021, I will mint a more comprehensive set on Async Art and KO depending on the nature of the final artwork. The artwork presented here is part of that World War I Posters set.

QmXjgzjni6UiBKbeyv32xtmagTSiuaLs71xEV3kv.name: Farfalle Two
QmXjgzjni6UiBKbeyv32xtmagTSiuaLs71xEV3kv.description:
'Farfalle Two', named after the Italian word for 'butterflies', is an interactive, co-operated tri-chromatic inkblot.

It is comprised of three, individually selectable layers of prints in cyan, magenta and yellow, which overlap to form a vibrant composite image.

Each layer contains twelve inkblot designs. By selecting two identical designs, tertiary colors can also be created.

Its three layers can be combined and interpreted in a large number of ways that always produce unpredictable results for viewers to contemplate on what they see before them. 

When experiencing the piece, viewers are encouraged to consider one simple question :

"What do you see now?"

QmXmXVxZM1sBSSQiXVWJNHZiv935QDZ99UZHUbb5.name: Exquisite Being
QmXmXVxZM1sBSSQiXVWJNHZiv935QDZ99UZHUbb5.description:
Exquisite Being is an artwork inspired by the drawing exercise “exquisite corpse.” In this piece, the body parts of the figure, and its background, can be changed to build new combinations. The three options for each body part and background represent distinct ideological forces that influence the development of society: they were inspired by the archetypes of The Industrialist, The Artist, and The Scientist.  Each archetype views the world and the development of their species through a different lens and set of values. 

These archetypes were referenced in an essay written by a nineteenth-century French economic, political, and socialist thinker, Henri de Saint-Simon, in 1825. Henri de Saint-Simon coined one of the first uses of the French phrase “Avant Garde” to describe the role of artists in driving social change through their work. “We artists will serve you as an avant-garde, the power of the arts is most immediate: when we want to spread new ideas we inscribe them on marble or canvas.” In addition to artists, Henri de Saint-Simon saw scientists and industrialists (i.e., the businessman, the capitalist) as the three forerunners and shapers of society. 

This artwork is a collaborative piece between the artist and the different owners. Together, the owners of each part of the creature contribute to one character that represents a whole group of beings in the early stages of development on a new planet. As they evolve, they will need to make many choices of what to build their new society around. Therefore, the owners will not only determine the creature’s look but their evolutionary trajectory, the future of their society, and by extension, the health of their planet. The effects of these choices will be explored in future artworks.

“Exquisite Being” is a mixed media piece that combines physical hand-crafted characters with digital environments. Pipe cleaners, felt, yarn, clothes pins, and wooden beads were used to build each creature and their body parts. They were photographed in the physical world in front of a green screen and inserted into virtual environments. These environments, including the structures, props, and lighting, were rendered in real-time out of a game engine.

QmXmdkro9iQtfKuoV8Va2v559XiobQH5wVPDjtH6.name: Asteroid Blue
QmXmdkro9iQtfKuoV8Va2v559XiobQH5wVPDjtH6.description:
Asteroid Blue


Consists of two 1 of 1 unique panoramic views of a digitally hand carved metamorphic architectural space, that represent day and night cycles.


Gentle lines hide among intense meshes, flowing freely they create a fabric of space or maybe a landscape of a distant asteroid from an outer space? In this art work we invite your imagination to travel outside of human perception or maybe even outside of this world. We invite you on a journey that explores the idea of architectural space. Follow the day and night cycles to become a space explorer and make new discoveries.


Coming from years of architectural research in depth, each digital painting is a carefully crafted abstract architectural landscape, that explores spatial qualities of landscape, surface and texture.
Each art work comes from a process that involves hand sculpting in different mediums, starting from physical sculpting and into a 3D digital hand sculpting.
The art work comes from the project Interface, that took more than 7500 hours to develop the project and methodology plus more than 250 hrs to finish one digitally hand sculpted landscape.

1 of 1
2021
MABLAB

QmXo9tbxuL7hhGNjvaPsKYt9FSqzjK1ByLo2U7iE.name: Street of Lost Dreams
QmXo9tbxuL7hhGNjvaPsKYt9FSqzjK1ByLo2U7iE.description:
Street of Lost Dreams
by Hulki Okan Tabak
4 piece programmable artwork on Async Art
1/1 minted September 2021

...

Part of a series of Marylebone, London based artworks. All of these works consist of photographs taken by me in January 2020. It is the time of Lunar New Year, Wuhan lockdowns, and the very first signs of the virus in Europe.

Marylebone was originally an Ancient Parish formed to serve the manors (landholdings) of Lileston (in the west - which gives its name to modern Lisson Grove) and Tyburn in the east. The parish is likely to have been in place since at least the twelfth century and will have used the boundaries of the pre-existing manors. The boundaries of the parish were consistent from the late twelfth century to the creation of the Metropolitan Borough which succeeded it. (Wikipedia)

QmXqiByH4zPiyhuAA5k9iEWYaW6f9jVGHqCt5iRx.name: DraCColumbus
QmXqiByH4zPiyhuAA5k9iEWYaW6f9jVGHqCt5iRx.description:
BRIEF: A meme about monsters, culture as propaganda, 500+ years of appropriation of the wealth of nations through genocide, slavery, and colonialism. 

BACKGROUND: 

On a small island, called Guanahani by the Indigenous Taíno People (in present day Bahamas), Christopher Columbus accidentally made landfall on the 12th of October 1492.

Conceived & realized as a single animation during October 2020, DraCColumbus is inspired by the gothic horror novel “Dracula” by Bram Stoker and the disturbingly persistent hero worship of Christopher Columbus in the form of U.S. monuments, urban & institutional nomenclature. Using four different lights I explore the archetypal vampire as it relates to cultural propaganda of European colonialism broadly and the fetishization of its legacy of entrenched power structures; including but not limited to the control of water, land, natural resources, human beings, language, monopoly on violence, infrastructure, and currency. 

INQUIRY:

In 1492 Columbus sailed the ocean blue,
The Niña, the Pinta, and the Santa Maria too.
Carried by the wind across the open sea,
Bringing death, destruction, and disease.
500+ years of genocide — it’s true.
I see a vampire’s legacy.
What about you?

QmXrL6ffaruzZ6VAQwHo6S7aQGGczJMWr3EXQNMb.description:
Rebeca handed you the pot filled with soup, she placed it next to you. As you had foreseen, you had no appetite.

Rebecca stared at you, an unyielding gaze.

Then, you lifted the lid. You lifted it slowly, as slow as Rebecca had placed it. You felt a strange dread as you uncovered the pot, but understood it was your nerves playing tricks on you. You fantasized of being far away, maybe in the lobby rather than the top floor, alone with her.

Rebecca stared at you, an unyielding gaze.

And when the lid was finally removed, and you looked inside, and then you looked at Rebecca, and Rebecca was staring at you with unyielding gaze, and she turned her eyes towards the inside of the pot, and she smiled, and you started moaning, and everything decided to dance in front of your eyes, everything started to blend together, and only the image of the lid remained, rising slowly, the liquid inside, and... and...

You had not expected that. You were too smart to expect that. You had the intelligence to spare, even to the point that the overflow was unable to keep on living inside your brain, and it decided to seek a way out. Now you count numbers and more numbers sitting in the bunk. No one can get a word out of you, but you used to look through the window, as if you expected to see luminous signs, and then you step forward with your right foot, you twist your hip the same way that someone who is preparing to swing a golf club would, and you bury your empty hand inside the void of your cell.

Fragment of ‘Puzzle’ by Julio Cortazar 1938.

Addiction reflected in creativity. I've been smoking for thirty years. At first I tried to quit, then I stopped. Ironically, I smoke less.
I made the first portrait (day) in 2013. It is a digital imitation of ink on paper, also called light drawing.
The second portrait (night) was made using the light painting technique in 2019.

QmXusgNP3iEg5oM6N6EkoCYvt7REAALqz6jrKzbB.name: 38 States of a Young Woman - Set 7
QmXusgNP3iEg5oM6N6EkoCYvt7REAALqz6jrKzbB.description:
38 States of a Young Woman - Set 7

38 States of a Young Woman is a generative study on an image itself created by mixing photography and other generative portraits.

There are 38 derivative images of which 28 are used to create 4 sets of images. The sets themselves are created in the order of image creation except for the 3 occasions (out of 28) when an image was replaced by one from the end of the list.

There are 7 sets of 4 images Day/Night cycles to be published on Async Art.

Athena Novo, 2022

QmXut1gWU8EaUVRXHkoq6nJaiFoKVGortwMhLBHp.name: Don Quixote: The Windmills are Real, We are Fiction
QmXut1gWU8EaUVRXHkoq6nJaiFoKVGortwMhLBHp.description:
Don Quixote: The Windmills are Real, We are Fiction by Hulki Okan Tabak, minted 1/1 on Async Art, 2022

2 artworks in a daily cycle..

...

Don Quixote project is a highly personal interpretation of the hero and his world. Various photographic and AI tools are used to create, manipulate and recreate the images. The story will be numbered for all of us to track down what we hold essentially. Beyond ease of use, the numbers are not sequential. Each image is independent but some images will be interdependent parts of smaller stories which I will mention. I would also mint some editions outside of Manifold. Note that editions of this project could be 1/1s or multi editions. The mints on Async Art will not be numbered as they each contain multiple images in themselves.

...

Don Quixote is a Spanish epic novel by Miguel de Cervantes. Originally published in two parts, in 1605 and 1615, its full title is The Ingenious Gentleman Don Quixote of La Mancha.

A founding work of Western literature, it is often labeled as the first modern novel and one of the greatest ever written. Don Quixote is also one of the most-translated books in the world.

When first published, Don Quixote was usually interpreted as a comic novel. After the French Revolution, it was better known for its central ethic that individuals can be right while society is quite wrong and was seen as a story of disenchantment. In the 19th century, it was seen as social commentary, but no one could easily tell "whose side Cervantes was on". Many critics came to view the work as a tragedy in which Don Quixote's idealism and nobility are viewed by the post-chivalric world as insane, and are defeated and rendered useless by common reality. By the 20th century, the novel had come to occupy a canonical space as one of the foundations of modern literature and a formidable example of what letters can do. (wikipedia)

QmXvT8hSRE2PHRmNqG3cz4CgGMfW34otamP8V9dJ.name: Nothing New
QmXvT8hSRE2PHRmNqG3cz4CgGMfW34otamP8V9dJ.description:
This creation changes every hour in a 24-hour cycle. It depicts the building and burying of a structure. The creature rebuilds the dome every day, and each day it is reclaimed by the sands. The work portrays the inherent meaninglessness of our toil, which eventually passes with time. It poses the question: knowing this, why do we continue to build what we build?

The creature was crafted from pipe cleaners, felt, yarn, clothes pins, and a large bead. It was photographed in the physical world in front of a green screen and inserted into a virtual environment. This environment, including the house, props, and lighting, were rendered in real-time out of a game engine. The process combines physical and digital worlds as a reflection of our own way of existing in both spaces.

“What has been will be again, what has been done will be done again. There is nothing new under the sun.”

QmXwjWZHgruUChBmsqP5k7aL3AbsawbqZ1UCQX3R.name: Lets do it a Dada - the portable museum
QmXwjWZHgruUChBmsqP5k7aL3AbsawbqZ1UCQX3R.description:
'(...) my son
let us always shuffle through the colour of the world
which looks bluer than the subway and astronomy
we are too thin
we have no mouth
our legs are stiff and knock together
our faces are formless like the stars (...)' - Tristan Tzara, 'Great Lament Of My Obscurity Three'

The portable museum is a collaborative piece between Brandi Kyle (@PlaceofMany) and Oficinas TK. 

With a friendly nod to Dada (and a heartfelt 'thank you' to Duchamp), this work presents elements from both artists' arranged inside a display case, on a hinted institutional environment, inviting the viewers to question what makes a work of art, while smiling at ideas like context, presentation, content or perception.

QmXzNx91RyfoUHVUf1EE3MYjVcxsDoj4rgcA63yn.name: Day Cat, Night Cat
QmXzNx91RyfoUHVUf1EE3MYjVcxsDoj4rgcA63yn.description:
"Day Cat, Night Cat" is my contribution for the Kitty Bungalow Charity event. With this piece I wanted to tell about the complex different personalities that cats can have.

The Day Cat is my parents cat called Peukku. It means thumb in Finnish and she got that name because she has one extra toe on all paws. She's lives in the countryside and has been outdoors cat for all of his life. Shes very cautious as outdoors cats need to be and runs away from most people, but shes known me from a small kitty and I can still nowadays approach her and give her some pats but she usually wants to keep a distance and is definitely not a cat to hold! Sometimes when its quiet and safe, she might go on my parents lap when they watch tv. In summertime she loves to just sleep somewhere in the meadows or in the barn. Her nails are sharp as needles and shes pretty good at catching prey.. although she has gained quite a lot of weight recently.

The night cat is my cat called Kelmi (hard to translate, something like criminal/mischievous in Finnish). He is few years old Bengal cat. Bengals are domesticated from the wild Asian leopard cats and behave like one! Like all Bengals, he is very energetic and playful and needs quite a lot of entertainment to keep him satisfied. His favorite game is to play fetch and has already learned to come literally poke me with his paws to start playing with him when my girlfriend takes our dog out for a walk (that's the time to play or otherwise the doggo steals the toy). He has also no problem keeping up wresting with our dog that's 4 times of his weight. metadata.name: Day Cat, Night Cat
metadata.description:
"Day Cat, Night Cat" is my contribution for the Kitty Bungalow Charity event. With this piece I wanted to tell about the complex different personalities that cats can have.

The Day Cat is my parents cat called Peukku. It means thumb in Finnish and she got that name because she has one extra toe on all paws. She's lives in the countryside and has been outdoors cat for all of his life. Shes very cautious as outdoors cats need to be and runs away from most people, but shes known me from a small kitty and I can still nowadays approach her and give her some pats but she usually wants to keep a distance and is definitely not a cat to hold! Sometimes when its quiet and safe, she might go on my parents lap when they watch tv. In summertime she loves to just sleep somewhere in the meadows or in the barn. Her nails are sharp as needles and shes pretty good at catching prey.. although she has gained quite a lot of weight recently.

The night cat is my cat called Kelmi (hard to translate, something like criminal/mischievous in Finnish). He is few years old Bengal cat. Bengals are domesticated from the wild Asian leopard cats and behave like one! Like all Bengals, he is very energetic and playful and needs quite a lot of entertainment to keep him satisfied. QmXzyh8Zbqy4x1ZUU6e33BeFyd8h6X3bZejF2DJ3.name: Path of the Monolith
QmXzyh8Zbqy4x1ZUU6e33BeFyd8h6X3bZejF2DJ3.description:
This was a magical crossroad, the air shifted as various places converged into this one space. With each turn there was a new opening, a separate path leading to a magical monolith. 

So many possibilities...

The hero felt lost, unsure where to go, knowing that each monolith provided different blessings and strengths. She took her time, examining all of the choices thoroughly- She could always use more knowledge, protection and fortune, but maybe she craved for a meaningful connection and some additional courage. This was a difficult choice, but there was no wrong choice, which gave her comfort.

In the end she let her instinct choose, what felt right for her. As she approached the Monolith, she felt the magic radiating from it washed over her. 

The backgrounds represent our past, where we come from. The cloaks symbolize the present moment, they're the insulation from the outside world. The protection and comfort, giving us the strength to keep going. Whereas, Monoliths represent the future, they can be considered more like magical charms to aid us in our pursuits. Each monolith has it's own meaning and purpose.

The symbols in the art can be transcribed into English words revealing the deeper meanings in the artwork and combinations. The symbols' key is located on the cloaks preview layer.

This painting is a part of the Adventure series, a journey about discovery, persistence and perseverance. This project is quite personal but I keep the meanings vague enough for others to find their own interpretations and connection to the art.

QmY3QM18vR2yWp5e6jBU6mFuA368NKJCTdJ6dz4K.name: Lake Garda... WabiSabi in Italy.
QmY3QM18vR2yWp5e6jBU6mFuA368NKJCTdJ6dz4K.description:
• TEST THE ARTWORK: before you decide to purchase, you can test and play around with the Master by triggering changes to the States of the Layers (3 Layers + 16 States = 150 possible combinations) by going to this link:
https://www.tonycorocher.com/nft-digitalart/AsyncArt/lakeGarda

• DESCRIPTION:
This artwork is kind of a consequence of the time I spent in Japan during the previous years and of my learning about their culture and the WabiSabi aesthetic principles so dear to the Japanese way of life. 
Once I got back to Italy I decided to apply these concepts to the beauty of my country and selected Lake Garda as one of the possible options. I spent about 2 weeks going around the lake, waking up very early in the morning to try to catch the right light, the right atmosphere, the fog and the nature waking up to the new day and took about 1000 photographs.
Then, to create this NFT digital artwork I spent another 3 weeks putting together, combining and "fusing" these images into a series of possible combinations which not only had to look natural, but, most importantly, had to always reflect what I was looking at and the atmosphere of one of the most beautiful locations in Italy. 

I had a lot of fun creating this artwork, but the intricacy, clarity and smoothness of the combinations was no joke. Perspective, depth of field, main subjects, secondary subjects and backgrounds all had to be thought and imagined during the shooting, much before getting to the editing (which was no joke either). I sincerely hope this can be seen in the final artwork.

This NFT digital artwork is composed of 1 Master, 3 Layers and 16 states which can be triggered from the Layers to change the Master in 150 possible combinations. It is n.5 in the "WabiSabi" NFT Collection.

www.tonycorocher.com

QmY4kgorYKX98v1S42tUYxJT1PqHtBG6NrWuFtfX.name: Blockchain Rakuchu Rakugai-zu
QmY4kgorYKX98v1S42tUYxJT1PqHtBG6NrWuFtfX.description:
This piece was created in the likeness of the streets of Kyoto on a folding screen that’s the abstraction of the blockchain, created in the early days of blockchain technology.

Blockchain’s true nature is a new system that is decentralized. It’s created from a combination including irreversible hash functions, miners, nodes, and chains for a trustworthy system.

The creator believed that the power of the system “is like a bunch of new, invisible hands of gods that were born from the common consciousness based on the trust between humans.”  The gods that keep the blockchain system intact isn’t a single god, but the many blockchain tokens, making it similar to the millions of spirits in Shinto. The basis of blockchain was created by people, but ideally, blockchain itself cannot be directly controlled by humans. (Though it might be possible if the system is imperfect.) The girl who is depicted on a large scale in this art is not a god, but rather a being like a future shrine maiden that can be used by god.

Humanity can’t access the system directly, but they can connect to the system through the shrine maiden. Because of the maiden, the system is governed throughout the city, but there are also places outside that are not under the system. In order to make it obvious that this space is stateless, the buildings in the art are from all around the world. The shrine maiden’s appearance suggests that she is Japanese, just like the founder of blockchain, but her hair is pink, a color not found in nature, as well to imply statelessness. The general idea (god) of the ideal blockchain is firm, but its history is still quite short, so the shrine maiden is still a young, immature teenager doing this as a part-time job. She may make mistakes when the processes can’t be dealt with on the chain. Miners use cranes to maintain the basic structure of the system. They’re not working because of the orders to do that; instead they are private general contractors doing it for profit. The various cryptocurrencies and tokens are concealed in the system’s space like clouds, but that’s just all they are, and they represent the essence of the system itself. Exchanges in shops are transactions. At the time, on the web, the systems were different for the regular web and the blockchain web even though it was the same web. The blockchain web had practical use for cryptocurrency through the reliable demand, but after that the system was put in use in a wide variety of fields like entertainment and art, so the soul of the system was created within the virtual space of the web just like the Milky Way runs through the galaxy.

QmY4zDEpyYM6HMXL3rX5B27nx1TZB1yBVBKETxRw.name: 24h CATastrophe Averted
QmY4zDEpyYM6HMXL3rX5B27nx1TZB1yBVBKETxRw.description:
BRIEF: Abstract techno magical surrealist self-portrait with artist’s still-quite-feral kitty for Kitty Bungalow & Async Art.

BACKGROUND: In a world governed by straight lines and rigid thought, a gentle curve can be disruptive. A soft bit of fur & flesh can make an awful mess out of a clean but heartless machine. 

INQUIRY: Proverbial wayward women (& kitties), hexes, vexes, and societal complexes: visually explore the symbolism, stigma, myth, and magic of feline &  feminine forms as repressed elements within a rigid societal infrastructure through abstract techno magical surrealism. Further probe the unconscious with 24 unique variations of color & detail; ranging from subtle to drastic differences. (programmed to change every hour throughout a 24 hour period). 

The juxtaposition of organic & digital shapes creates contrast and highlights the intrinsically awesome power of conscious endogenous life forms in the Universe — opening up room for broader meditation on the extant tension & interplay between the permanence of chaos & the impermanence of order — and how grounding our bodies IRL through physical connection & affection can anchor us, support us, and offer love when we are at our most vulnerable; fostering curiosity, play, resilience, and space for hearts to open, shift, and heal. 

When viewed through different lenses, filters, or contexts, things, people, places, images, symbols, and ideas, can take on new meaning, depth, and texture. 24h CATastrophe AveRTed is a call to reflect, observe, witness, to be present with the unknown, with growth, change, and evolution under the sun. May this piece serve as reminder to pause & look deeper, to be slow to judgment; and above all, to be kind; to one another and, of course, to be kind to kitties — especially the wayward ones. <3

QmY6uZQZfxuTvFcjD6DE6ZzvNwhbrookMRp9asWA.name: LEAVING
QmY6uZQZfxuTvFcjD6DE6ZzvNwhbrookMRp9asWA.description:
‘Leaving' is a dynamic musical artwork about the different states of a unique relationship between three people; a love triangle told from the perspective of all those involved. The three characters interweave and blur into each other, with the different primary emotional states as represented by the instrumental intermingling with unpredictable results - eventually, past present, and future; the betrayed, the betrayer and the object of the betrayal; loss, guilt and hope; all meld into one. In total, there are 6400 different songs included in the artwork - not trivially different, but radically so. Each unique composition is a snapshot of a different angle of the love triangle both in time and in perspective - the irreducible, overwhelming state of confusion that permeates all human relationships, captured musically. The accompanying cover art work, beautifully rendered by our collaborator Mike Raymond, is the visual representation of ‘Leaving'. Each possible composition, acting as each distinct moment in the relationship, has a corresponding and distinct visual representation: three lovers, 6400 different dances, spinning and looping around in eternity. 

We view the 20 tracks included as the primary colours of our composition. But relationships are not simple; therefore, the master track will dynamically reflect the intricate complexity of love and loss. The collectors can choose the timbre, intensity and sonic identity of the different instrumental layers, as well as the narrative and character behind the vocal layer, and mix the fundamentals into a unique whole, capturing the different shades and shapes love and loss can take. We believe ‘Leaving' represents a new frontier in what art and music is, and should do; both an experiment in storytelling, in sonic variations, in the value of art and in the relationship between audience, collector and artist. The stem owners can change who sings the vocal part, what the lyrics are, what the main melody is, what instrument plays the bass line, what kind of drumming style underpins the performance. All the variations seamlessly work together to form 6400 unique compositions, each of which is musically rich enough to be a standalone song - spanning everything from pianno ballads to electronic mayhem. Each layer-owner has the power to alter the whole master, without knowing what the other layer owners will do. Essentially, 'Leaving' is a collective artistic composition with randomness and agency factored in - collectors might collaboratively arrive at a state or a genre, consciously or unconsciously, by responding (or ignoring) each others’ choices. Each different state has been separately written, performed and recorded in a decentralised fashion by HMLTD and our collaborators, Tallulah Eden and Seth Evans.

Each unique composition is a snapshot of a different angle of the love triangle both in time and in perspective - the irreducible, overwhelming state of confusion that permeates all human relationships, captured musically. The accompanying cover art work, beautifully rendered by our collaborator Mike Raymond, is the visual representation of ‘Leaving'. Each possible composition, acting as each distinct moment in the relationship, has a corresponding and distinct visual representation: three lovers, 6400 different dances, spinning and looping around in eternity. 

We view the 20 tracks included as the primary colours of our composition. But relationships are not simple; therefore, the master track will dynamically reflect the intricate complexity of love and loss. The collectors can choose the timbre, intensity and sonic identity of the different instrumental layers, as well as the narrative and character behind the vocal layer, and mix the fundamentals into a unique whole, capturing the different shades and shapes love and loss can take. We believe ‘Leaving' represents a new frontier in what art and music is, and should do; both an experiment in storytelling, in sonic variations, in the value of art and in the relationship between audience, collector and artist. The stem owners can change who sings the vocal part, what the lyrics are, what the main melody is, what instrument plays the bass line, what kind of drumming style underpins the performance. All the variations seamlessly work together to form 6400 unique compositions, each of which is musically rich enough to be a standalone song - spanning everything from pianno ballads to electronic mayhem. Each layer-owner has the power to alter the whole master, without knowing what the other layer owners will do. Essentially, 'Leaving' is a collective artistic composition with randomness and agency factored in - collectors might collaboratively arrive at a state or a genre, consciously or unconsciously, by responding (or ignoring) each others’ choices. Each different state has been separately written, performed and recorded in a decentralised fashion by HMLTD and our collaborators, Tallulah Eden and Seth Evans.

QmY86mLArhjFn5hGDPvBsA9HFhLVohtQSkU2XGzw.name: Swimming Through the Weephole
QmY86mLArhjFn5hGDPvBsA9HFhLVohtQSkU2XGzw.description: Exploring the ideas of bodily autonomy, nature and fantasy through mixed media. This NFT has been created from an original sculpture. The box was primed in my favourite earthy pink, I layered found objects and drawing using resin on the inside. The title refers to the figures swimming. A weep hole, weep or weep-brick is used in masonry to allow moisture to escape from walls, they function like the eyes of a walls, keeping the inside of the home safe from rot and mould. The weep hole is an essential, generally unnoticeable part of brick houses. I imagined the world inside that space of essential-invisible being. The button headed swimmers are a playful take on humanoid figures.

QmY9dfJHH8Q5S2uLbKVspY4rFNCvUdxmnnSQG7q1.name: Betty's Notebook
QmY9dfJHH8Q5S2uLbKVspY4rFNCvUdxmnnSQG7q1.description:
UNCOVER THE MYSTERY 
Betty's Notebook is a controversial piece of evidence in the Amelia Earhart mystery. Recorded by 15-year old Betty Klenck in 1937, the document continues the mystery of what really happened to Amelia Earhart as she was taken off her flight path. The musical adaptation by Nicholas Reeves puts audiences in Betty’s shoes: as if listeners turn a tuning knob on a short wave radio trying to hear Amelia Earhart’s distress calls that are frequently obstructed by various radio interferences.  The dynamic nature of Betty’s Notebook allows audiences to uncover chilling distress signals and key clues by toggling variants within different stems. The ever evolving music creates a holistic picture of the eternal mystery of Amelia Earhart.

  PHYSICAL RADIO
 If the Master Track NFT meets its reserve price, the owner will receive a physical life-size short wave radio with built-in speakers and screen. The radio will update in real-time to the latest audio-visual Variants. This physical radio piece is fit for private collections, museums, and galleries.   

TIME CAPSULE
 Immortalize the mystery by owning a Limited Edition Record NFT of your favorite Betty’s Notebook version. By literally taking a snapshot of the latest iteration, you get to hold onto a unique part of the mystery. 

Learn more about Betty’s Notebook and its Stems by clicking on them or at verdigrismusic.org

QmYDmPuReE9uaFAGFFN3MmWsbb8hMmiThXQwDiXo.name: ​​OUR FATHER IN THE METAVERSE #17
QmYDmPuReE9uaFAGFFN3MmWsbb8hMmiThXQwDiXo.description:
https://mathiasrusch-metaverse.com/

The "Our Father" - The cycle of paintings by artist Mathias Rusch (*1927-2003).   

If there is a most important prayer of Christian faith, then it must be the "Our Father".  
 
This prayer gift of Jesus to his disciples, later handed down to us Christians, has become the actual Christian self-understanding, the "prayer of the Lord". Packed into a few sentences, it has come to be regarded as the actual confession of faith and is prayed millions of times a day, both individually and in communities. The fact that this "conversation with God" has hardly ever been depicted (in contrast to the Passion) is probably due to the immense message it conveys. The fact that the painter Mathias Rusch dared to translate the "Our Father" can be explained by the fact that his daily work was based on faith, hope, and trust in God. Mathias Rusch was aware that he could only exist in the understanding of his art "as a gift of God". Most of his late works (Our Father, Live and Let Live, Sermon on the Mount, Lauretan Litany, Litany of the Sacred Heart) were written, as he confessed, under the "kind help" of the Highest, always accompanied by personal prayers, meditations or invocations. The fact that Mathias Rusch did not reveal a word for the interpretation of his works of art is to be justified by the fact that he understood himself to a large extent as a mediator of a higher power. Thus we are sometimes quite helplessly confronted with an immense abundance of Christian symbols, metaphysical allusions, concretizations, and abstractions, in unique hues and compositions. Completely in the sense of Mathias Rusch we dive before the 13 works of art into the enormous topic of earthly existence and Christian eschatology, marvel before the color power, before the hints, confessions, and convictions of the very deeply felt "Our Father's". Finally, we become humbled and ultimately grateful to be initiated into the world-prayer of a "knowing" believer, again and again, with each glance at each of these magnificent works of art. Whoever takes a longer "eye" look at this self-contained, unique complete work, consisting of 13 unique pieces in oil on canvas, 170x170cm, will not be able to resist a lasting effect and deep consternation.

QmYEDbvctb2uQc38m5AVNGoC7TZXv8EEbS9Z68VG.name: THE SOUL OF JAPAN: Profound Tranquility or Modern Loneliness? (WabiSabi n.4)
QmYEDbvctb2uQc38m5AVNGoC7TZXv8EEbS9Z68VG.description:
• VERY IMPORTANT:  
THIS PIECE IS SOLD AS A SINGLE ARTWORK! This means that THE LAYERS ARE NOT FOR SALE but will be delivered FREE OF CHARGE TO THE PERSON WHO COLLECTS THE MASTER. I decided to do this because the artwork was created to be in the hands of one collector and I would like him/her to have the ability to trigger changes to his/her liking.

• TEST THE ARTWORK: before you decide to purchase, you can test and play around with the Master by triggering changes to the states of the Layers (3 Layers + 18 States = 216 possible combinations) by going to this link:
https://www.tonycorocher.com/nft-digitalart/AsyncArt/testwabisabi04

• EXTRA!!! A PHYSICAL PRINT: the owner of this artwork will also be eligible to receive a Museum Quality Fine Art Giclèe Print (70x40 cm) done using carbon pigmented inks on Hahnemühle Archival Paper of the highest quality. This will be a 1of1 Fine Art Print and a collectors item (with holograms, signature, date, stamps and paper certificates) in line with my 10 years selling museum quality prints. The special feature here is that the collector will be able to select the 3 States he/she likes more (one for each layer) and I will get that selection printed and sent to him/her. 
You can find more info about my Fine Art Prints process here: https://www.tonycorocher.com/fine-art-prints/

• DESCRIPTION: 
I loved Japan and its culture since I can remember… its aesthetic principles of beauty, its sense of peace, the respect for others, its harmony and safety. 

In this artwork I want to present and describe (through a series of 18 interchangeable street photographs I took around Japan in 2 years) a feeling of detachment and kind of “self inflicted” loneliness which may seem very strange to a non Japanese or someone traveling to this beautiful country for the first time. This feeling can be encountered all over the country but is felt more strongly in the big cities, especially in the streets of Tokyo. 

A feeling that deeply entangles and mixes with a secular way of life, with a thought process and a value system based on respect, duty and obligation… all directed to achieve harmony and tranquility.
To most Japanese these are not just ideas to believe in, but almost “unmovable objects” that still linger in the further recesses of their “modern” minds.
These ideas may have changed their forms in the last century but they have also retained their influence and are frequently the main reason of misunderstanding with non Japanese people.

This NFT digital artwork is composed of 1 Master, 3 Layers and 18 states which can be triggered from the Layers to change the Master in 216 possible combinations. It is n.4 in the "WabiSabi" NFT Collection.

These ideas may have changed their forms in the last century but they have also retained their influence and are frequently the main reason of misunderstanding with non Japanese people.

This NFT digital artwork is composed of 1 Master, 3 Layers and 18 states which can be triggered from the Layers to change the Master in 216 possible combinations. It is n.4 in the "WabiSabi" NFT Collection.

QmYEcfEML1QMukWtXUQQMerGCy2LjG86vdj5mvRX.name: The Lion Faced One - Mother of All
QmYEcfEML1QMukWtXUQQMerGCy2LjG86vdj5mvRX.description:
I took a dive in a world of space exploration, rebuilding humans as AI's, people uploading their minds into so called proxies and human beings bio engineering themselves to live in marine environments. I saw this world come alive while reading the Poseidon's Children book trilogy by Alastair Reynolds, while mixing in my own interests: old scifi movies and my childhood obsession with stories about space exploration. 
The matriarch, Eunice Akinya, is a space pioneer. She's named The Lion Faced One because she painted the image of a lion on her space helmet when she was younger. This character resonated with me on a personal level. She reminded me of my grandmother, who passed away in 2020. Being 98, she experienced WWII. When our country was occupied by the nazis, she smuggled weapons and and supplies past German checkpoints,. She was pretty fearless and practical to a fault, just like Eunice Akinya.
The source material reflects my own ideas. It challenged me to imagine how I would envision a future world, while anchoring it firmly to classical concepts in art, like landscapes and portraits.

QmYF1uwAfQRvGFpbqr1FhuqeJcZVPWy2dpu72gLB.name: La croque-mitaine
QmYF1uwAfQRvGFpbqr1FhuqeJcZVPWy2dpu72gLB.description:
Though I witnessed glamorous moments, faces and looks as a press photographer, I realized that I was drawn to create this world from a different perspective; one which undressed the soul, and rendered a more authentic moment. After some time, it became the same scenes, the same clichés, the same smiles, the same looks and the same photographers. As a celebrity, having to see more than 30 flashes per second every time a photographer spots them, probably makes them want to protect themselves. Seeing celebrities live in this world of excessive media coverage, I started to develop a mixed feeling of admiration and respect, but also pity, and finally detachment.


The Personalities are decomposed and re-assembled in an abstract composition, guided by my instinct and fed by what the model inspired in me.


The original digital size of the portrait is 80 by 160 cm.


This is a portrait of the American model, Alexandra Richards.
If you set it on "sunrise", it will display the original photography.

If he could not have his victims at the time of their natural reckoning, he would have them another way. He had one last card to play, their spirit could not be replicated. Sands of time continued to fall; with each grain, a small part of their soul faded. A battle was being fought in their minds, the prize: continued life. They turned to meditation in an effort to strengthen their spirit. Known as MindfulDeath, this meditative state allowed them to fully project their consciousness and explore the great beyond at will.
