QmYQ3zZETnr3v23fYkpWiiT96fVeNXHvniiChTBQ.name: Frank's Papaya
QmYQ3zZETnr3v23fYkpWiiT96fVeNXHvniiChTBQ.description:
This work is a very personal piece and at the same time quintessentially New York. Let me share with you the story behind "Frank's Papaya." I've decided to write this description more stream of conscious, almost like a journal entry, or a casual conversation. Sit back and take a ride in my mind.

Some of the earliest memories in my entire life are of going to Gray's Papaya on 72nd and Broadway in New York City.  I would go with my Mom and my Dad separately and don't think I was ever there with them at the same time. They were no longer together but they knew how much I enjoyed getting dogs.

The place is a visual overload with all the colors, especially the hanging paper fruits. I loved those as a kid and still do.  One thing I like is that it's pretty much remained the same for as long as I can remember it.  That entire block actually.  There's a mattress store that's been there forever and some other longtime spots. A part of New York that has managed to stay frozen in time.

The hot dogs are awesome and I learned about putting mustard and sauerkraut on "dogs" from my Dad there.  No ketchup!  But try telling my wife that lol. The papaya juice was also incredible but I am scared to think now how much sugar was in those - probably contributed to my pre-diabetic diagnosis. 

I liked that they had tons of Obama signs up when he was running for president and aren't afraid to promote whatever cause they are behind. 
Feels like a piece of old New York that I hope always stays where it is. Real New York flavor and expression.

Also, Frank serving up franks is something I've thought about for a while and what better place to pay homage to.

I learned when you order to just say the number of hotdogs you want.. for example, "Can I get two with sauerkraut?"  You put the mustard on yourself, everyone has their preference for just the right amount :)

A little bit about the layers -

The ceiling - I wanted to keep it fun and festive. Hanging Fruit, hanging sneakers, and disco balls. 
 
The TV - I thought it would be fun to offer a bunch of options on the TV, a celebration of both old and new, a sort of time machine if you will:  classic late night NYC public access shows on Channel 35 like Robin Byrd, sports, sitcoms, as well as current Crypto news and some classic Frank Ape pieces I've made over the years. 

The Customers - A little bit of choose your own adventure celebrating both young and old. 

The Employees - Always there with a smile and grace to serve up dogs in a second at any time of the day or night.

Thanks for joining me on this adventure!

Frank Ape is a mystical creature who lives amongst the humans but without human restrictions.  What started as a form of self-expression on the streets of NYC for artist Brandon Sines quickly turned into a movement for the people. Frank has special powers that he continues to discover as he is tested by the many challenges of life. Frank champions positivity and equality, and cares about all living things. He believes in using imagination and play to inspire other people and animals through thoughtful actions.

metadata.name: Frank's Papaya
metadata.description:
This work is a very personal piece and at the same time quintessentially New York. Let me share with you the story behind "Frank's Papaya." I've decided to write this description more stream of conscious, almost like a journal entry, or a casual conversation. Sit back and take a ride in my mind.

Some of the earliest memories in my entire life are of going to Gray's Papaya on 72nd and Broadway in New York City.  I would go with my Mom and my Dad separately and don't think I was ever there with them at the same time. They were no longer together but they knew how much I enjoyed getting dogs.

The place is a visual overload with all the colors, especially the hanging paper fruits. I loved those as a kid and still do.  One thing I like is that it's pretty much remained the same for as long as I can remember it.  That entire block actually.  There's a mattress store that's been there forever and some other longtime spots. A part of New York that has managed to stay frozen in time.

The hot dogs are awesome and I learned about putting mustard and sauerkraut on "dogs" from my Dad there.  No ketchup!  But try telling my wife that lol. The papaya juice was also incredible but I am scared to think now how much sugar was in those - probably contributed to my pre-diabetic diagnosis. 

I liked that they had tons of Obama signs up when he was running for president and aren't afraid to promote whatever cause they are behind. 
Feels like a piece of old New York that I hope always stays where it is. Real New York flavor and expression.

Also, Frank serving up franks is something I've thought about for a while and what better place to pay homage to.

I learned when you order to just say the number of hotdogs you want.. for example, "Can I get two with sauerkraut?"  You put the mustard on yourself, everyone has their preference for just the right amount :)

A little bit about the layers -

The ceiling - I wanted to keep it fun and festive. Hanging Fruit, hanging sneakers, and disco balls. 
 
The TV - I thought it would be fun to offer a bunch of options on the TV, a celebration of both old and new, a sort of time machine if you will:  classic late night NYC public access shows on Channel 35 like Robin Byrd, sports, sitcoms, as well as current Crypto news and some classic Frank Ape pieces I've made over the years. 

The Customers - A little bit of choose your own adventure celebrating both young and old. 

The Employees - Always there with a smile and grace to serve up dogs in a second at any time of the day or night.

Thanks for joining me on this adventure!

Frank Ape is a mystical creature who lives amongst the humans but without human restrictions.  What started as a form of self-expression on the streets of NYC for artist Brandon Sines quickly turned into a movement for the people. Frank has special powers that he continues to discover as he is tested by the many challenges of life. Frank champions positivity and equality, and cares about all living things. He believes in using imagination and play to inspire other people and animals through thoughtful actions.

You live at the rhythm of the nature, breath and embrace some wild garden.

Night Version: Neon, Glowing Dreamscape - inviting the soul to new sleep walking discoveries

QmYQALGZZAWnK1GruAKacVKuNWMJNEFJ1sEZ69JU.name: Parysiano
QmYQALGZZAWnK1GruAKacVKuNWMJNEFJ1sEZ69JU.description:
Culture in a vice versa city has been changing the mood of people not in it. Like a culture you're not a part of and you feel it, quote everyday.
Some people would love to wake up with their perception of Paris soo vibrant and yet so it's their dream to live there. Some people just day dream about vacay in there, their perception is what they chose to see, maybe just visit have great croissant with coffee buy some balenciaga and go home. The true dreamers are the sunset ones , they care about the city deeply, thinking they and the city can co-live together creating harmony for creativity and love. The night in Paris is for homies of Paris from start to the finish, the true leaders of their city, who just stick with it till the end. It takes all their energy but they have some life changing steps to only what they know where.

Parisiano consist thus of 4 pieces based on the day time. 
Morning
Day
Sunset
Night

Each belong to part of the story.
freshlyfe story

QmYSBQD3bBgw9ey6G7CeWNB1WaXc2PxQ8zxgnncw.name: RGB Geometry
QmYSBQD3bBgw9ey6G7CeWNB1WaXc2PxQ8zxgnncw.description:
Explore the basic building blocks of The Project using geometry and colour in this programmable NFT consisting of 3 layers.

By superimposing three beams of red, green and blue light each of a given intensity, one has the ability to generate an array of different colours. We are exposed to this mixing of light throughout our lives, take a moment and appreciate these colours in their purest form. Red (255, 0, 0). Green (0, 255, 0). Blue (0, 0, 255).

But what is light and colour without shape and form? This NFT showcases 6 different geometric primitives. If you look hard enough these primitives are all around us at both a macro and micro level. Bound by points and lines and then assembled into a mesh of polygons, choose your primitive.

QmYSGfvhfvJDRFs1thjoDRrhifz2HmC92FmDykP4.name: Screens
QmYSGfvhfvJDRFs1thjoDRrhifz2HmC92FmDykP4.description:
Examining the concept of day and night through the AsyncArt feature.
For thousands of years, humans have adapted their lives and activities to day and night.
During the day they performed all the necessary processes for their survival and at night they slept and rested.
In modern societies, however, with the use of electricity and technology, where the night is less dark now and you always have something to do, the concept of night and day, in many cases, has been adjusted to a new form.
As an artist working in digital media, the day has ceased to be the only 24-hour period where I can work.
In fact most artworks, including this one, have been created in the still of the night.
On the globalized planet, where there is always day and night at the same time, a new society is being created that,
gives the impression that it never sleeps and always something is happening.
The artwork "Screens" is examining this concept, also, 
from the perspective of the affect that this change has to our personalities and bodies.
Digital 3d / 2021

QmYTc1ipLaSaQFbHbryZpdBezgtMehr7CkUsh7js.name: Celestial Palace
QmYTc1ipLaSaQFbHbryZpdBezgtMehr7CkUsh7js.description:
From Earth, Saturn appears yellow in color. Its golden hue is a gift given by the sun's reflection on its surrounding clouds. 

But you are enjoying this majestic view from your balcony floating above the clouds in a special part of the world exclusive to a select number of people with the privilege of owning such a spectacular view. Soft friendly pink and lilac clouds from The Hot Pink Planet Gliese 504B in the Virgo Constellation move throughout your balcony floor. Nearly everything is more beautiful through rose colored gases.

This work of art is programmed to automatically update to reflect the current time of day.

QmYUufTtHoeExt45zUgvWu1VCgXpmLAUYXewfLHv.name: The Timepiece of Thades
QmYUufTtHoeExt45zUgvWu1VCgXpmLAUYXewfLHv.description:
In 2152 the first new world mission arrived on a planet located within it's sun's habitable zone that had become known to all as 'Thades'. Virtually the same distance from its own sun as our Earth is to its sun, the landing team hoped to discover a new society. Instead, what they found were the archaeological remains of a long dead technologically advanced civilization.

However, one of the alien artefacts discovered and still in working order within many of the crumbling structures on the planet, was a cycling projection of 24 images that have come to be known collectively as, 'The Timepiece of Thades'.

Much conjecture has been made over the true meaning of the symbols, but most most experts agree that each image was an individual visual representation of an hour on the planet, with the possibility of a further division of each of these hours by 5, as represented by the 5 glyphs that visually interact with one another. It has been also suggested that the Thadeans further divided their day into six 4 hour periods – as represented by the 6 changing backgrounds.

The Timepiece of Thades remains as the only working piece of technology ever to be found on the planet...

Artist's notes: 

The project started with the creation of 5 separate glyphs as clearly seen in the 12pm piece, I then rearranged and combined 5 glyph layers with each other, with a view to creating new forms and dynamic angles/juxtapositions that draw the viewer into each piece's composition.

The aim was to create a set of works that looked and felt as if they were alien artefact art that had simplistic roots based in a primitive time, yet that had also developed along with a technologically advanced society. The concept was that the pieces were used as a form of visual communication, in this case symbolizing the time of day on an alien civilization.

Features:

*Aspect Ratio of the artwork is created at 16:9, suitable for full-screen display on Apple TVs/Widescreen monitors/Smart TVs & Smart phones
*Lossless PNG format utilized means no matter displayed large or small, the quality will be flawless
*Timezone set to PST
*Autonomously changes 24 times in a day, on the hour, every hour (forever)
*Background also changes every 4 hours, a total of 6 times in 24 hours
*Each hour's image is a 1 of 1 abstract piece of artwork within its own right
*The first time I've used the landscape orientation for an NFT work
*My particular CMYK Hexadecimal values used throughout
*My first AsyncArt solo piece

QmYVVkZXNFz7QVMT4JpCLZQqpcEaqh4vLwrm9oXw.name: 24 Hours of Skulls | Skeenee's Physical Collection
QmYVVkZXNFz7QVMT4JpCLZQqpcEaqh4vLwrm9oXw.description:
24 original physical ink paintings of animal skulls and skeletons created by Skeenee will be sent for free to the buyer of this NFT on first sale. 

These paintings were first featured on Makersplace (https://makersplace.com/skeenee/)

The original buyer will also reveive a central Voxels Parcel featuring the NFT, the paintings and process videos. (https://www.cryptovoxels.com/parcels/281)

Each artwork from 24 hours of Skulls comes from the Skull & Skeleton ink painting series which was started by Skeenee in 2018 to study anatomy & contrast and was inspired by Renaissance drawings; a demonstration of a time where art and science were seen as one. The paintings are drawn with fountain pens on Arches paper, painted & shaded with Sumi ink and watercolors.

QmYY1QBCCu9MfPjrG4Aaczqb4v6TZSQArCcXmMYA.name: The Baptism
QmYY1QBCCu9MfPjrG4Aaczqb4v6TZSQArCcXmMYA.description:
This is my first exclusive digital piece for Async Art. Made in January 2021.

This piece celebrates the baptism of my signature red bear, that until now, didn't have a name. Now his official name is Chico.

I created Chico in 2017 and since then I've been asked about his name by almost everybody that has seen him. Sadly I never came up with a name that I thought could suit him well. In January 2021 the artist Brian Murphy, sculptor based in Boston MA, suggested the name Chico for the bear and I thought it suited him perfectly: it means "small" in Spanish, it gives him a cool Latin-American vibe and it also sounds cute to me.

I decided to make Chico's baptism public using blockchain technology so it could be official.

The piece also contains a series of symbols I've been working with lately, like stars, sparkles and dripping clouds.

The layers can be changed to show different stages of the hearts, a regular red or a special golden version of Chico and also a colorful day or red night background (that hides an easter egg).

You can see more works here: https://www.jaime.works

QmYbXALNbEUYbS2f2aVHc21uzeouATqDVZRU7pL6.name: The Fountainhead
QmYbXALNbEUYbS2f2aVHc21uzeouATqDVZRU7pL6.description: There is a fundamental loneliness, which is different from everyday loneliness, nor is it being without friends or being alone. Some people are forced to betray themselves, but think they are loved. Some people are lost all their lives, and finally drive themselves crazy with fire. There are also people who control the life and death of others, but they cannot accept the death of flesh and blood. Connected to each other, unable to escape the trajectory of life. We are pregnant with destruction and rebirth, fighting against disasters in our lives. It seems to cut the raw green fruit with a sharp knife, leaving pale juice and black sacs.

QmYcSf9YvyqcCPqtX2U1K6u31MAGRBTqxLDcqynP.name: What time is it in Antarctica ?
QmYcSf9YvyqcCPqtX2U1K6u31MAGRBTqxLDcqynP.description: Antarctica has six months of daylight and six months of darkness. The two pictures that makes this piece were taken 6 months apart in the same location in the Weddell sea. One in summer, when ice as it melts relentlessly reflects the light of a sun, and one in winter, when ice  as it builds up consistently reflects the light of the moon. This NFT thus freezes a year long cycle within a 24-hour rhythm. Every lines of longitude run through the south pole, meaning Antarctica is theoretically located in all time zones at once: How long will this cycle be allowed to carry on? What time is it in Antarctica.

2 Artworks in 1 Daily Cycle

New York Polaroids by Athena Novo, Summer of 2022, An Alternative New York during the NFT Summit, Minted 1/1 on Async Art

While everyone was enjoying the NFT Summit, a different group of visitors were in New York. Some call them demons, monsters and zombies while I would prefer more neutral terms but nonetheless here are some of the photographs I've taken of them which I release with full disclosure and their cooperation. The prospective collectors should acknowledge the existence of "undead" and some even more exotic characters might cause some alarm among the general population. Therefore viewer caution is warranted even though most of these peoples I met during the NFT Summit seemed to be of absolutely good character (not sure about some demonic entities that did not respond) and interested in art and its manifestation with the technologies branded aptly as NFT and what not.

QmYhphay6UiJTPKD3WSvzP3b4VKdVo1NMiQnbFXo.name: Reason and Passion in the Realm of Unconscious
QmYhphay6UiJTPKD3WSvzP3b4VKdVo1NMiQnbFXo.description:
"Your reason and your passion are the rudder and the sails of your seafaring soul.
If either your sails or your rudder be broken, you can but toss and drift, or else be held at a standstill in mid-seas.
For reason, ruling alone, is a force confining and passion, unattended, is a flame that burns to its own destruction.
Therefore let your soul exalt your reason to the height of passion, that it may sing;
And let it direct your passion with reason, that your passion may live through its own daily resurrection and like the phoenix rise above its own ashes."
---from On Reason and Passion (The Prophet) by Khalil Gibran

QmYjxjjsLAPVKEv4qj2urik2MgZg5TZHG45nEa7n.name: Misty Rain of Bitan
QmYjxjjsLAPVKEv4qj2urik2MgZg5TZHG45nEa7n.description:
Bitan is one of the famous tourist attractions in Asia. It is named after its tender light of the waves and the dark green water. 
At the early stage, it was a pier to bid farewell to the reluctant travelers, and the misty rain even enhanced the sadness to say goodbye to each other. 

Recently, I just said goodbye to a friend who live abroad. Although we promised we will see each other soon, we didn’t know when. 
I was so depressed that I had to transfer my emotion into the scenery and took the pen to draw this work. 
I couldn’t help but thinking of the poem of the great ancient literature master, Ouyang Xiu. “It’s natural that we have infatuations in lives, and they have nothing to do with the wind and the moon.”


2016
Shen Fung Lin

QmYmEM3iptoB3rJ5XMaa96aVLnnCM6y4SGc4gHAf.name: The Matrix metastory by 65.000+ avatars
QmYmEM3iptoB3rJ5XMaa96aVLnnCM6y4SGc4gHAf.description:
The day: 32.815 avatars playing Nemo -Keanu Reeves- show you the possibilities and transparency of a fluid reality. The Matrix (1999), by the Wachowskis.
The night: 32.832 avatars tell you during the night: there is not just a red pill and a blue pill, there are many other pills, and the most important ones: the ones you create.
Ghost avatars tell you silently while you sleep: be the owner of your unique reality.

The series “metastories”
I am a Western actor playing roles in Chinese movies; these are 65.000+ Chinese actors playing roles in Western movies. 
In the Pekin Opera (China, 18th century) the color of the mask denotes character: a red face is courage and bravery; a white face is a treacherous and evil man, or a green face reveals surly obstinacy and lack of self-control… These NFTs are made with those masks: we know the character, but we don´t know the actor behind the mask, they are avatars. 
For me is like a “microverse” of thousands of avatars playing “microstories” inside the big story (stories about the story, “metastories”). Personally, I like that this series connects East and West, unites Opera, Film and Digital art, and links the 18th to the 21st century.
(In the second to last column is my signature in “metamorse” :) -morse with avatars, 1 mask=dot, 2 masks=dash).

QmYmFiPyoLqYJvyRsMNDubPuzNCauzTk7SZxv9oi.name: the Remixable Landscape
QmYmFiPyoLqYJvyRsMNDubPuzNCauzTk7SZxv9oi.description:
A programmable landscape.
 
The ever-changing remix of the foregrounds, middlegrounds and backgrounds obtained from the sectioning of six artworks of famous painters from the history of art, covering a span of 4 centuries: 
 
Giorgione - Tramonto (1505-1508)
Pieter Bruegel the Elder - The Harvesters (1565)
Aelbert Cuyp - Travelers in Hilly Countryside (1650-1652)

QmYpbTMNu4XvCLw5iwGCqSpCW7wA5M8vpu32gEVH.name: / COPYCAT /
QmYpbTMNu4XvCLw5iwGCqSpCW7wA5M8vpu32gEVH.description:
Some great artists spend years developing a style, technique and a subject matter that is unique. They spend a lot of time and effort to mark their own style.
And one day you wake up to see that some copycat took all your ideas as a shortcut to being successful and is making quick copies of your work, pretending that this is all his/her ideas.

 Can you imagine what style Frida Kahlo, Vincent van Gogh, Gustav Klimt and Picasso would create if they copied each other?
In this little artistic canvas is happening right now! Look at them playing like childs !!

In what is one of the most powerful use cases for Bitcoin, 100% of your contributions and earnings will open all new doors for these special young men.

QmYtbsR85sEwL6bVVJCs3TwnMsoQS2nsiZp6jmRC.name: Eight Nomads
QmYtbsR85sEwL6bVVJCs3TwnMsoQS2nsiZp6jmRC.description:
You are in control of this story: Eight protagonists, each facing multiple choices. 

An epic journey into ancient worlds, magical forests and eerie landscapes.

This is a programmable NFT of 4 layers with respectively 7, 8, 7, 8 choices. 

Immerse yourself into this dark and spiritual narrative, explore the wilderness and adventure through artifacts of a lost past. Mysterious creatures and characters will fill your imagination and carry you to new planes, loose your consciousness into the ethereal and celestial worlds here portrayed. 

You will choose the fate of these travelers, heroes of an unsung future that will tell their stories through the time and sing their melodies vibrating ripples throughout the universe.

Secrets are hidden within, but it's up to you to weave the harmonies you choose, and create legends that will be forever told. 

Will you help them reach their destination, if there is one?

QmYtrKT4hVi9RBaRjAtPpr2CsegVDht9pwH7uAx8.name: Kids Takeover Putin: Nova Apartchik #9
QmYtrKT4hVi9RBaRjAtPpr2CsegVDht9pwH7uAx8.description:
Based on Putin photography, Kids Takeover Putin is text-to-image experimentation on war, peace and leadership. It is re-creating the leadership in the eyes of a kid takeover for peace.

Stop the War. We hoped, I hoped this was already the past in Europe. We should not go back.

There is a lot of interesting material that range from childish and peaceful to satirical and dark. I will post them and perhaps I will post most of them hoping this ends as soon as possible.

This is one of the 12 2-piece Nova Apartchiks on Async Art. There is also 1 24 piece set and some 4-piece somewhat more abstract pieces on Async Art. For multi editions and some other 1/1s, please visit my collection on KnownOrigin.

by Mad Monk, 1/1 on Async Art, 2022

QmYudFixKbFf471zJsAqCb95gW9UgVwXup8taLiZ.name: Reincarnation
QmYudFixKbFf471zJsAqCb95gW9UgVwXup8taLiZ.description:
Reincarnation refers to the rebirth of consciousness, character or soul in another body after the death of an organism. This is mysterious and unknowable to ordinary people, and many people believe but cannot prove it.

In the future, technology will be used to digitally transfer the human soul code to another physical body or even a cyborg to achieve immortality. The imagination has always existed in the cyberpunk world concept, and it may even realize the ultimate fantasy of human immortality in the near future.

But whether the coded soul is the original soul is also the same as the reincarnation in the traditional concept. No one can prove its truth, only one's own experience can.

QmYw1vYZN1iyPBE7P4XsybjiYQwjyc2m7W3Gs8LQ.description:
Criminal Judgment of the People's Court of Hanjiang District, Putian City, Fujian Province
 (2017) Min 0303 Xingchu No. 571

        Cai Qinglan defrauded the victim Chen Meiyuan, which caused Chen Meiyuan's daily mental suffering for many years. She and her husband have been petitioning the court without a clear result. In the criminal judgment issued by the Hanjiang District Court on April 27, 2018, recovering the illegally obtained finances of the defendant Cai Qinglan and returning it to the victim. In August of the same year, the court seized the house that Cai Qinglan illegally purchased. So far, the court has not appraised and auctioned off the property in question. The victim has petitioned many times, but no clear result.

QmYx6B6tCExsMLbeCJyxW32Aessd97EHLrtwdtRw.description:
Created from an AI edited photo, this impressionist painting is dedicated to evolutionary accomplishments in a distant and forgotten past. Rifeus aeterna are the famous sea mountains that were mentioned by ancient Greek geographers.

As for the Divine Comedy, Rifeas was located in paradise on the sixth sphere on Jupiter: the realm of those who embodied justice.

If the stars should appear one night in a thousand years, how would men believe and adore, and preserve for many generations the remembrance of the city of Bitcoin Angel which had been shown! But every night come out these envoys of beauty, and light the universe with their astonishing smile. Ralph Waldo Emerson

This portrait was inspired by this phrase.

QmZ1J6vBNPEatxityzRqcW8Nvsyjr3T66TE5hmeL.name: 24h Vendredi / Lullaby
QmZ1J6vBNPEatxityzRqcW8Nvsyjr3T66TE5hmeL.description:
BRIEF: “Hot, Hot, Hot!” is a collection of static and animated digital art reflecting on love, longing, and existential loneliness. A self-exploration of the feminine form; an introspective odyssey upon the digital seas only touching briefly the sensual shores of the real world. Named after each of the 7 days of the week in French &  English words/phrases; this piece represents 1 day consisting of: 1 primary static image + 5 alternate glitch states (used to create a separate animation). 

BACKGROUND: 

For millennia the feminine form has been appropriated, commodified, objectified, curated, policed, and brutalized by men and for the male gaze. 

Today, unconditional self-acceptance of feminine bodies remains an act of radical self-love and still carries risk of violence in a deeply misogynist culture. The luxury of safe self-expression is elusive; only further complicated by age, color, creed, sex, gender, ability, sexuality, and class. Whether it be in real or digital spaces, feminine bodies are treated with a spectrum of toxic hostile reactions from self-appointed patriarchal enforcers who take it upon themselves to steal joy, love, life, and happiness from any female (sex or gendered) persons that exercise their self-sovereignty in public or private; real or digital spaces. Despite the culture of terror, the feminine aspect of humanity is asserting herself and sisters are embodying in their power.

INQUIRY: 

When the last grain of dust settles on the digital frontier what will the real world look and feel like? Will NFB’s (non-fungible-beings) and their fleshy forms be treasured or despised? Will the real world lay in rubble? Does a world still reeling from the pandemic return to desperately pressing flesh against flesh; or will glass, silicone, and electricity be the sole comforts accessible to those inside of a deepening dystopian nightmare? 

What does love, intimacy, and vulnerability look and feel like in the future? How does it feel in the present? Will the essential need of skin to skin contact between human beings drive our species to create teleportation devices out of sheer desperation? As HD gives way to 4K, 6K, 8K, Augmented Reality, and Virtual Reality, how far can we, and will we, push ourselves across the world; across the universe — at the speed of light — in search of love?

QmZ1Sp7kqwobbXZjtBN6RZ3tgWzMSB149XBgovg1.name: #ToTheMoon @asyncart
QmZ1Sp7kqwobbXZjtBN6RZ3tgWzMSB149XBgovg1.description:
To the Moon 1920 x 1080 px, Adobe Photoshop, generative async-Layers

this piece is composed of 47 images 
collectors will also receive unlockable content: original Dimensions: 4K 3840x2160px HQ JPG

> Use the Randomize button, and you'll find all sorts of image mix by the Layer; some do work excellent, some are a bit dark or strange… it is async.art



"I'm telling you the story of the night, my gaze is directed towards the sky with a beguiling near full moon that lights up my face. A cool breeze attracts my neck, the trees rustling in the wind, everything else is silent. The sky is so close to me as never before, I look in the orbit and count the stars. The clear orbit opens behind the moon, and connects with the northern lights ... The magic of the night breaks over me ... This nocturnal magic is wonderful." 

———

generative Layer 1: 17 images 
generative Layer 2: 19 images 
Layer 3: 31 images, no tranparency

———

Moon landing July 21 1969

QmZ1qsSbpdFXa4xCcYLRYZs3Ps1RbtVsCa2AEK66.name: Money ₿adger
QmZ1qsSbpdFXa4xCcYLRYZs3Ps1RbtVsCa2AEK66.description: In this piece, there are 27 unique song combinations, with three music, drum and vocal track state changes. The honey badger will give a visual cue of what vocal track is selected by the positioning of its head, while the background is determined by the selected music state change. The drum machine lies beneath the badger as it bangs on the analog buttons to create the percussion for each track. The honey badger is an early mascot in the ₿itcoin world, and represents the unstoppable force that ₿itcoin and the entire ecosystem represents. ₿orn Unique and Kaimbr rap on the "Proof Of Work (Potomac Kings)" song, Willie Waze performs "Rug Pull" and Kane Mayfield drops in for "Cryptnology."

QmZ3pZbCqLBj17g4xFoXxshocJ3bNkfwHp4T2f3Y.name: Crypto Mundi
QmZ3pZbCqLBj17g4xFoXxshocJ3bNkfwHp4T2f3Y.description:
This is Crypto Mundi from The Most Expensive Artworks Project collaboration by Athena Novo and Mad Monk.

It is a remix of Leonardo Da Vinci's Salvator Mundi. It is No 1 in the project in parallel with its place on the list. Accordingly it has been last sold November 2017 in Christie's New York for USD 450 million. The seller was Dmitry Rybolovlev and the buyer was Badr bin Abdullah Al Saud. 

...

The Most Expensive Artworks Project started with an idea and a web page on Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_most_expensive_paintings.

Athena Novo and Mad Monk collaborated on "doing something" with the list. First idea was to make a common "burn" GIF. Step by step the original or an alternative version would be burned i.e. like a GIF. However the idea of destructing artworks did not appeal. Then glitching was cast off as the main tool for something more appealing was under consideration. It was the idea of remixing the artwork more freely - sometimes with itself and sometimes with others on the list (as a pre-condition to narrow the universe).

Consequently AN and MM started to work on from the top of the list. Several results were obtained and from them, the story modes with multiple artworks will be minted on Async Art by Athena Novo while the single items (in GIF or JPG) will be minted on KnownOrigin by Mad Monk as a part of the collaboration.

...

Salvator Mundi (Latin for ''Savior of the World'') is a painting attributed in whole or in part to the Italian High Renaissance artist Leonardo da Vinci, dated to c. 1499–1510. Long thought to be a copy of a lost original veiled with overpainting, it was rediscovered, restored, and included in Luke Syson's major Leonardo exhibition at the National Gallery, London, in 2011–12. Christie's claimed just after selling the work that most leading scholars consider it to be an original work by Leonardo, but this attribution has been disputed by other specialists, some of whom posit that he only contributed certain elements.

The painting depicts Jesus in an anachronistic blue Renaissance dress, making the sign of the cross with his right hand, while holding a transparent, non-refracting crystal orb in his left, signaling his role as Salvator Mundi and representing the 'celestial sphere' of the heavens. Approximately thirty copies and variations of the work by students and followers of Leonardo have been identified. Preparatory chalk and ink drawings of the drapery by Leonardo are held in the British Royal Collection.

The painting was sold at auction for US$450.3 million on 15 November 2017 by Christie's in New York to Prince Badr bin Abdullah, setting a new record for most expensive painting ever sold at public auction. Prince Badr allegedly made the purchase on behalf of Abu Dhabi's Department of Culture and Tourism but it has since been posited that he may have been a stand-in bidder for his close ally and Saudi Arabian crown prince Mohammed bin Salman. This follows late-2017 reports that the painting would be put on display at the Louvre Abu Dhabi and the unexplained cancellation of its scheduled September 2018 unveiling. The current location of the painting has been reported as unknown but a June 2019 report stated that it was being stored on bin Salman's yacht, pending completion of a cultural center in Al-`Ula and an October 2019 report indicated it may be in storage in Switzerland. (Wikipedia) https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Salvator_Mundi_(Leonardo)

QmZ4M55Jd3fHwmhkn9bBfLLP1ScRSSqw3UcAEqEQ.name: Regeneration #401196
QmZ4M55Jd3fHwmhkn9bBfLLP1ScRSSqw3UcAEqEQ.description:
Artwork Title: Regeneration #401196
Date of Artwork: 2020-2021
Dimension: 3840 pixel x 3840 pixel
Type of Work: GANs Algorithm trained photograph
Date of Dataset: 2010-2017
Edition: Unique

The photographs in the series of Regeneration produced by using Generative Adversarial Networks. I took over three thousand photos spanned nearly a decade for a specific project and selected over a thousand photos from there as the Dataset for AI training. The photographs have been gestated by AI that integrated all the subtle emotions of the original pieces, which are the most exciting parts of this series.

QmZ51XLRX9SJ53t78TT51X7AjkMgnhR1XsxaAPQ3.name: 24h Lundi / Wh0a
QmZ51XLRX9SJ53t78TT51X7AjkMgnhR1XsxaAPQ3.description:
BRIEF: “Hot, Hot, Hot!” is a collection of static and animated digital art reflecting on love, longing, and existential loneliness. A self-exploration of the feminine form; an introspective odyssey upon the digital seas only touching briefly the sensual shores of the real world. Named after each of the 7 days of the week in French &  English words/phrases; this piece represents 1 day consisting of: 1 primary static image + 5 alternate glitch states (used to create a separate animation). 

BACKGROUND: 

For millennia the feminine form has been appropriated, commodified, objectified, curated, policed, and brutalized by men and for the male gaze. 

Today, unconditional self-acceptance of feminine bodies remains an act of radical self-love and still carries risk of violence in a deeply misogynist culture. The luxury of safe self-expression is elusive; only further complicated by age, color, creed, sex, gender, ability, sexuality, and class. Whether it be in real or digital spaces, feminine bodies are treated with a spectrum of toxic hostile reactions from self-appointed patriarchal enforcers who take it upon themselves to steal joy, love, life, and happiness from any female (sex or gendered) persons that exercise their self-sovereignty in public or private; real or digital spaces. Despite the culture of terror, the feminine aspect of humanity is asserting herself and sisters are embodying in their power.

INQUIRY: 

When the last grain of dust settles on the digital frontier what will the real world look and feel like? Will NFB’s (non-fungible-beings) and their fleshy forms be treasured or despised? Will the real world lay in rubble? Does a world still reeling from the pandemic return to desperately pressing flesh against flesh; or will glass, silicone, and electricity be the sole comforts accessible to those inside of a deepening dystopian nightmare? 

What does love, intimacy, and vulnerability look and feel like in the future? How does it feel in the present? Will the essential need of skin to skin contact between human beings drive our species to create teleportation devices out of sheer desperation? As HD gives way to 4K, 6K, 8K, Augmented Reality, and Virtual Reality, how far can we, and will we, push ourselves across the world; across the universe — at the speed of light — in search of love?

QmZ5g599mSLjY66rqc6AyZHeTXJWAWX39nZfnRe4.name: Warehouse
QmZ5g599mSLjY66rqc6AyZHeTXJWAWX39nZfnRe4.description: A programmable 20 minutes live set of rave music by Maelstrom, where the mix isn't controlled by the performer but by those who own the individual channels of the mixer. This experiment, illustrated by Hussam Eissa, shifts the focus from the 'superstar DJ culture' to the original ethos of the rave, where the experience lies in the interactions, and where the collective takes precedence over the individual.

QmZ5uTPAPCKwWWNuSeuFkMJNEzaVgZKbTDqRmhnF.description:
Adam & Eve & Adam & Eve & Adam & Eve were the first men and women to populate the Earth, as taught by the Torah, the Bible and the Quran. Presumably living in a multicultural paradise, and enjoying a world before prejudice, their affinity for each other would have been equaled only by their love for life.

This single source collage is made from bits of images found on i-D.vice.com.

QmZ5xBW4r14ET3ngDACwfHnQLaj68E5MLpTG6QjG.name: SPHINX WITH WINGS
QmZ5xBW4r14ET3ngDACwfHnQLaj68E5MLpTG6QjG.description:
THE WORK INCLUDES LAYERS WITH A TOTAL OF 4 DIFFERENT WING EDITIONS IN IT WHICH CAN BE COMPARED TO MULTIPLE RESULTS. THE BODY PART WAS CREATED BY A GENERATIVE 3D DESIGN WITH THE ARTIST'S DEBUGGING. THE ARTIST, CHEN ZENG, TRIES TO BRING NEW GENERATIVE TECHS INTO CLASSIC FIGURES, CREATES BRAND NEW VIRTUAL EXPLORATION.
斯芬克斯最初源于古埃及的神话，是长有翅膀的怪物，通常为雄性，当时的传说中有三种斯芬克斯——人面狮身的Androsphinx、羊头狮身的Criosphinx、鹰头狮身的Hieracosphinx。亚述人和波斯人则把斯芬克斯描述为一只长有翅膀的公牛，长着人面、络腮胡子，戴有皇冠。多种形态的变化是艺术家选取司芬克斯作为图层拆解的出发点。
在希腊神话中，赫拉派斯芬克斯坐在忒拜城附近的悬崖上，拦住过往的路人，用缪斯所传授的谜语问他们，猜不中者就会被它吃掉，这个谜语是：“什么动物早晨用四条腿走路，中午用两条腿走路，晚上用三条腿走路？”俄狄浦斯猜中了正确答案，谜底是“人”。斯芬克斯的人面象征着智慧和知识。一说斯芬克斯之谜在更深层次的表现为“恐惧和诱惑”，即“现实生活”。在艺术家看来，司芬克斯同样在帮助人理解人本身。艺术家的系列雕塑作品都使用人工智能参与造型生成，本次nft作品中分开的身体元件来自于不同参数下程序给出的结果，艺术家认为，研究人工智能生成逻辑的过程同样是一个尝试理解人本身，理解创造力的过程。


The sphinx originated from ancient Egyptian mythology. It was a winged monster, usually male. There were three types of sphinx in the legend at that time - the Androsphinx with the human face and lion body, the Criosphinx with the head of the sheep, Hieracosphinx with eagle head. Assyrians and Persians describe the Sphinx as a winged bull with a human face, beard and crown. The variety of forms is the starting point for the artist to choose Sphinx as the layer dismantling.

In Greek mythology, the Sphinx sat on a cliff near the city of Thebes, stopped passers-by, and asked them with a riddle taught by the Muses, and those who could not guess right would be eaten. This riddle is: "What animal walks on four legs in the morning, two legs at noon, and three legs at night?" Oedipus guessed right. The correct answer is "human". The human face of the sphinx symbolizes wisdom and knowledge. It is said that the mystery of the Sphinx is expressed in a deeper level as "fear and temptation", that is, "real life". From the artist's point of view, the Sphinx is also helping people understand people themselves. The artist's series of sculpture works all use artificial intelligence to participate in modeling generation. The separate body elements in this nft work come from the results given by the program under different parameters. The artist believes that the process of studying artificial intelligence generation logic is also an attempt to understand people themselves. , to understand the process of creativity.

QmZ8T2pjVWEPypDfmEg9WPeH9aDeWEn13PbmKuSU.name: The Awakening
QmZ8T2pjVWEPypDfmEg9WPeH9aDeWEn13PbmKuSU.description:
The awakening of Lord Gravity
Brings power beyond measure
His strength and might
Unleashed in the dead of night

A hero for all to see
Protector of liberty
Lake Black Albatross's shining knight
Guiding us through the darkest night

But beware, foes of the light
For Lord Gravity's power is not to be trifled with
He will defeat all who dare to defy
Leaving them writhing in agony and dismay

So let us all give thanks
To the one and only Lord Gravity
For He is our saviour
In this world of chaos and uncertainty

QmZ8a6Jojuc7JuQR8v2BY9XSdFgQLvrkNMaoWAsh.name: Zombie
QmZ8a6Jojuc7JuQR8v2BY9XSdFgQLvrkNMaoWAsh.description:
Zombie highlights on all the man made activities that have made our human mankind predator on earth for other organisms. Humans have ecologically disturbed even the mightiest whales to tiny rats and crabs.

We all love after-the-bomb stories. If we didn't, why would there be so many of them? There's something attractive about all those people being gone, about wandering in a depopulated world, scrounging cans of Campbell's pork and beans, defending one's family from marauders.

When you expect the world to end at any moment, you know there is no need to hurry. The biggest lies we save for ourselves. We play a game in which we are gods, in which we make choices, and the current follows in our wake. We pretend a separation from the wild. Forgetting we too are from this wild and don't think about giving something back good to nature.

Gan A.I generated base layer hand touched digitally inside Procreate and Adobe After Effects for Post Effects.
Four paintings , Four Generative art result and yes four times the fun.

QmZ8kdZDYunh99Lm8V2EVJLE9ZpGzxvgfQEwb6AC.name: Experimental No.3 #7532
QmZ8kdZDYunh99Lm8V2EVJLE9ZpGzxvgfQEwb6AC.description:
Artwork Title: Experimental No.3 #7532
Date of Artwork: 2021
Dimension: 1675 pixel x 2160 pixel
Type of Work: Silver Gelatin Photogram, Digital Painting
Edition: Unique
Note: This artwork is a type of digital art. The hand-made photogram is one of the subjects that compose this piece, and this photogram is not for sale separately whatever in the crypto world or the real world.

Notwithstanding, the beginning of the photography is representational, it ultimately leads to the way of the abstract. Photography has nothing to do with painting, although the thinking of abstractness renders them getting closer and closer. Photography remains the interpretation of "Light", and to express the “Light” is its inescapable responsibility. I find the "Line" could be one of the forms to present the "Light". I apply the "Line", also is the "Light", to destroy a completed and finished photograph, and change it into a new form of art and have a unique way of spreading and viewing. Through this new attempt to keep looking for balance and harmony.

QmZ94Kr4gtqvC1Wan4wh1MCFaw9yGM4KX9Pi6irz.name: WANDERING
QmZ94Kr4gtqvC1Wan4wh1MCFaw9yGM4KX9Pi6irz.description: Wandering in life is a necessity in all of us. A journey in search of identity and happiness. Knowledge and experience are energizing forces. But in certain situations, we want to run away from freedom, maybe because we are tired and need someone else to talk about our dreams and fantasies. At that time we need a home and family as a place to return to. This work is based on my mixed media abstract painting on canvas. Then I recreate it on the computer. Abstract makes me enjoy and free to do what I want. You are also free to interpret it.

QmZ957vnixPDpQPW9WNXV6uuejHn2PQNSab1yv8K.name: Anxiety
QmZ957vnixPDpQPW9WNXV6uuejHn2PQNSab1yv8K.description:
The piece works on the GMT time zone. The morning anxiety is soft hazy pink. Into night the colours become saturated representing a nocturnal anxiety. The colours used are to represent the time of day but in a hypnagogic setting.

Anxiety is now snowballing in our culture especially amongst younger generations.  This art piece concentrates on the most intense moment of anxiety. The feeling of helplessness mixed with a rush needing to take action. Xanax has become a popular drug to quell feelings of anxiety. The drug has been popularised in several sub cultures.

The reflective floor is a commentary on the complete loss of self awareness during our most anxious moments. Anxiety is a loss of control, our mind looses rational determination and contemplation. 

Xanax is a drug which destroys families and lives.  Many high profile suicides have been attributed to Xanax. 

Xanax also known as Alprazolam which is a Benzodiazepine. Benzodiazepines are known to ease all feelings of uncertainty and fear, offering the human psyche a feeling of being infallible. This makes the drug highly addictive due to the sense, that nothing is ever wrong. 

I grew up watching my farther completely numbed because of his Xanax addiction. It allowed him rationalise horrendous choices. It hurt and tore apart my family.  Blackouts are common on Xanax depriving Xanax users of all accountability.

At least anxiety allows you to feel, despite it being a shit feeling. I'd rather have a lifetime of feeling then numb myself to experience nothing. Learn from your anxiety, with help and support from friends and family we can learn to control our anxiety. Drugs are just a tool they don’t fix it. They can make things much worse.

No judgement for anyone struggling with addiction or anxiety, there is always a light at the end of tunnel.

QmZ9hdx7gakSrYuvH2PQnFivKnpHFFptbeuijZXn.name: New York Polaroids: First Istvan Burns, Then Imre Burns More
QmZ9hdx7gakSrYuvH2PQnFivKnpHFFptbeuijZXn.description:
New York Polaroids: First Istvan Burns, Then Imre Burns More

2 Artworks in 1 Daily Cycle

New York Polaroids by Athena Novo, Summer of 2022, An Alternative New York during the NFT Summit, Minted 1/1 on Async Art

While everyone was enjoying the NFT Summit, a different group of visitors were in New York. Some call them demons, monsters and zombies while I would prefer more neutral terms but nonetheless here are some of the photographs I've taken of them which I release with full disclosure and their cooperation. The prospective collectors should acknowledge the existence of "undead" and some even more exotic characters might cause some alarm among the general population. Therefore viewer caution is warranted even though most of these peoples I met during the NFT Summit seemed to be of absolutely good character (not sure about some demonic entities that did not respond) and interested in art and its manifestation with the technologies branded aptly as NFT and what not.

QmZAPkYMhd1zX5BaBCf7fibn8n8oZ3mhoTotW1J1.name: Portrait of Nakamoto Satoshi #10: The Bitcoin ☢️Spaceman ☢️
QmZAPkYMhd1zX5BaBCf7fibn8n8oZ3mhoTotW1J1.description:
As part of the on-going series to find the true identity of Satoshi, the mysterious person or pseudonymous group who created the technological cryptocurrency Bitcoin which is fundamentally just beginning to change and challenge financial systems across the planet.  Many people have claimed to be this person or persons, but we have not yet found the actual source to be truth.  However, a few possible identities have just emerged in 2021, 20 years since the development of the technology:

Possible Identities:
#10-1 The Elontoshi Muskamoto
As we shoot into the future, behind us is the history we leave behind.  Could this technology be a double-edged sword?  On one hand--> from the league of extraordinary gentlemen comes the rise of a brilliant man who puts us into outer-space, has advanced electronic payment systems, revolutionized the electric car industry, launched the Falcon 9 Rocket to the international Space-Station with a billion-dollar contract with NASA.  The headlines read: "Tesla Acquires 1.5 billion in Bitcoin" -- (Source: CNBC, Feb 8th 2021)
".....I do at this point think Bitcoin is a good thing.  I'm late to the party, but I am a supporter of bitcoin.  .... However the comments on Dogecoin "are meant to be jokes.... The most ironic outcome would be that Dogecoin becomes the currency of Earth in the future... said Musk" (CNN)

Possible Identity #10-2
The Kimatoto Jung-toshi
  On the flip-side of the coin, a brutal dictator who will stop at nothing to grab power.  The headlines read: "Finding Financing in Unlikely Places" United Nations Experts sheds light on $316 million worth of Bitcoin amassed by North Korea (Nikkei Asian Review)
".....however, bitcoin is an effective tool for several reasons...... that is cut off from the modern financial system and has little access to hard currency, it is easy to understand why bitcoin is so appealing. It stands out as the perfect solution for the budding financial problems that are caused by years of disconnection from the global economy...... North Korea can effectively mine or steal bitcoin to support its economy and missile program." (Investpedia)

  The future that is laid before us we must seek-out, for it is part of the human condition to journey and explore where no man has gone before.  The blockchain is another battle-ground for humanity, and we must win this battle.  To-The-Moon 🚀🚀🚀 

Follow my adventures in space, as I tweet about them in real time(a living breathing and talking artwork): https://twitter.com/Muskamoto

QmZAfiVYMidXwPimyyAfdQXSo3KksgAF58KpyaN5.name: This Ain't No Test Drive
QmZAfiVYMidXwPimyyAfdQXSo3KksgAF58KpyaN5.description:
Let's take a ride!  Where will we go?  Who's driving?  How will we get there?  Sometimes it might seem like we are just passengers in this life. But consider for a moment, if perhaps all of these things are choices. What do you choose?
_________________________________

Explore this piece! It has three layers that change:
The Scenery
The Driver
The Vehicle

Each layer has 4 very different options. 
_________________________________

A life with choices is a good thing. Taking ownership of those choices makes it great.  Don't be a scaredy cat. Map it out and enjoy the ride!

QmZBYxcmF6G85VjN4PhrAV32sMjpmUZ3YLv3Dye2.name: Twisted Tree No. 3 - Four of Wands
QmZBYxcmF6G85VjN4PhrAV32sMjpmUZ3YLv3Dye2.description:
The Four of Wands represents appreciation for family, gratitude for the best things and experiences life has to offer. The central figure in this image is a Twisted Tree clutching eggs within the embrace of her roots, fierce and loving as she guards them. Life-giving waters run a meandering path among the dark and murky landscape - a reminder that even in the darkest hours there is hope for survival. WAGMI. 

This work is based upon one of my paintings using Ozark pigments. My inspiration for the 'eggs' came from seeing trees alongside the creeks here in northwest Arkansas (USA). Many of them have rocks trapped within the roots and the trees have grown to enclose them.

QmZCCcrTC8oZdkwxy8hwKwacNRC5GoUZMj3d4HQY.name: Zymmetra
QmZCCcrTC8oZdkwxy8hwKwacNRC5GoUZMj3d4HQY.description:
A host of things happened to me over the last few years. There were extremities of happiness and sadness. By and large as I evolved I came to question not what I did right or wrong, but what in-fact is right and wrong. What is this duality of forces. They say they are just two sides of a coin, but what is it really to understand that. 2 years back I had some clarity on this. It is not something verbally explainable. But an experience where the division of the opposites merged into unity. And thus I realised the subjective experience of division and the movement to unity. 
I tried to play with the emotional relations of the audience with this work at a subtler level - not trying to induce the obvious happy-scare emotions, but experiences at a more visceral level. Made with freely available stock materials, the artworks were composed and rendered to create imagery that asks the question : "What is right and wrong?"

QmZCcWXpnY95cxUYeDieBDcuLznkXGkp9dZ3ETg3.name: Cryptosculpture 001
QmZCcWXpnY95cxUYeDieBDcuLznkXGkp9dZ3ETg3.description:
Cryptosculptures are digitally created contemporary sculptures.
With these works I develop and deepen artistic understanding of how industrial design approach might be used for creation the unique pieces of art. This practice aims to merge design with art, thus erasing the line between them. I think in the future there will be no readable difference between these two disciplines whereas any functional object or device will look as a piece of art the same way as in art we’ll see a design elements used as a normal practice.

QmZCqQHEVtKFj9mJe8kFgwUewCafHt3yxzgmDmD9.name: in.a.room
QmZCqQHEVtKFj9mJe8kFgwUewCafHt3yxzgmDmD9.description: I have been quietly reflecting on my position in life. How I am, where I am, and who I am. These questions make you really take stock of how the various elements that float to and through your life influence it, and how your internal voice ultimately chooses what gets done with those elements. Like a stream swirling around you, there is a vibration in the air. If you could stop time you could see the ripples and turbulence pushing you in different directions. This piece was an attempt to stop time for a moment and take inventory of the various forces acting on me. The positive, the negative, the internal and the external, the real and the imagined. I tried to shape it and hold it in some tangible way. I tried to capture it for a moment in the hopes I could understand it more meaningfully. So I sat with myself and stopped time. This is me in a room.

QmZFEzeELQGpuTspRtxFCDPHBhwn4kGwqMu5yDbL.name: Humachine Imaginarium
QmZFEzeELQGpuTspRtxFCDPHBhwn4kGwqMu5yDbL.description:
Humachine Imaginarium was a collaboration between me, Ashna Sahir and the AI model GPT3. Through guided creation, we tried to find out what a text-only language model imagines - what does an AI imagine? It involved asking GPT3 to construct a scene from its imagination. The text was then used step by step by Ashna to draw the scene. A beautiful scene was created, and of particular interest were the last few lines where GPT3 reflects on the meaning of the creation, purpose of existence and its relation to the person collaborating.
This work is permanently exhibited at the esteemed AI Art Gallery of NeurIPS 2020.

QmZJ23yLWcxyZMNUpUt3V2tv3DZs2pGqNSCGJiNB.name: Madame Jazz
QmZJ23yLWcxyZMNUpUt3V2tv3DZs2pGqNSCGJiNB.description:
Though I witnessed glamorous moments, faces and looks as a press photographer, I realized that I was drawn to create this world from a different perspective; one which undressed the soul, and rendered a more authentic moment. After some time, it became the same scenes, the same clichés, the same smiles, the same looks and the same photographers. As a celebrity, having to see more than 30 flashes per second every time a photographer spots them, probably makes them want to protect themselves. Seeing celebrities live in this world of excessive media coverage, I started to develop a mixed feeling of admiration and respect, but also pity, and finally detachment.

The Personalities are decomposed and re-assembled in an abstract composition, guided by my instinct and fed by what the model inspired in me.

This is a portrait of Jazz Jennings.

QmZM9nZkkVxWYaYHd5uQBU3gAFYNr3Nf3QQtxyZP.name: Decentralized Family Time
QmZM9nZkkVxWYaYHd5uQBU3gAFYNr3Nf3QQtxyZP.description:
Welcome to my Crypto world, 

a world that is decentralized and beautiful. Storks carry your bags of crypto to a floating island where the space shuttle "Decentralize" is waiting to take you bags to the moon. Where mining means walking into an arched valley and connecting to your favorite cryptos and plugging in to it's data cable. Spending time with your family watching this all happen, even while flying your ETH kite. Imagining ideas for this series, I could see this image flash in front of my eyes and thought my daughter and I would definitely love doing this.

This is the 4th piece in my Crypto world and this piece was all drawn from scratch on my Graphics tablet. It was a family affair creating too with my wife and little girl helping with the colouring. To see the previous 3 pieces, please check my Twitter account @benza333 to work your way to them through my other galleries, or even drop me a DM about it, I'm happy to chat :) .

This is my Async Genesis

PS - Thank you to Async and The Guild for this opportunity to be a part of such an awesome platform.

QmZMQ7iEYs1rRiXakawuJgKNcYcXH127epwmULP2.description:
The power to travel through space and time
some would achieve it with acts of crime
If they knew it's as easy as being kind
we could stop the destruction of humankind
it's sad what they do to others
but instead of treating them all as sisters or brothers
they forget, that our cores were created by the same mother
becoming egoistical to not even bother
is only the entrance to the deepest pit
which leads to darkness, where no spark can be lit 
falling into the depths of despair
needing a reminder of who we once were
and if it's remembered too late
we'll have to start over
to learn again, about all the hate
so we can finally come closer
closer to an era in which harmony can be made
stopping the war for money, we just need to be brave
and since I'm here for an happy end 
we should give our best, to make them transcend.



AO

QmZN8M85XCWqBGp7irpjh6NNRPKSq7PHk4Mk2K8p.description:
Persephone is returning to planet Hades after 6000 standard years with a final mission, to defeat the Lord of the Underdark and give an end to the Long Winter. It will be a difficult adventure and first she must face the four terrible Guardians, but she is ready and well equipped. With the right weapons and knowledge of the enemies weak spots she will manage to take them out.   


Descent to Hades is a game where the players (layer owners) must cooperate and find the right combination of blade/rifle/armour/trap/guardian in order to defeat the enemy. To celebrate the defeat of each Guardian, a new artwork will be minted and airdropped to the winners. The players can find clues at the description of each layer, or can use the Explore tool to check different visual combinations before changing the states. Have fun!

QmZNW2dKNSsjU1KC8a3P6Gj3XimAvJGwuGRupp3H.description:
Today's world is filled with events that affect us all in one way or another. In the midst of these challenging times, there is something that calls to be remembered, that can help us navigate internally and externally: PRESENCE

We are multidimensional beings living in a multidimensional reality. When we reconnect to this truth, we might find what we really need right here, within and around us.

The two stages of this piece show the 4D view (orange), which is associated with the ethereal and subtle energies, and the 5D view (blue), which is associated with the astral realm.

QmZPTsnyY3SB8GPLkiU6CuGsMf3MGfnstP59dp7v.name: TEAMWORK
QmZPTsnyY3SB8GPLkiU6CuGsMf3MGfnstP59dp7v.description:
TEAMWORK

Working together in the present helps shape a brighter future.

TEAMWORK celebrates this idea visually and functionally.

Each layer owner controls three different states of their Frank, and one owner controls the color of the light. 

Each state is an integral part in the process of working together: carrying the letter, placing the letter, and helping reach the light switch.

Layer owners collaborate to create thousands of possibilities (59,049 to be exact) all representing a facet of working together. Sometimes in perfect harmony, other times in glorious chaos, but always for the greater good of the community. 

Frank Ape is a mystical creature who lives amongst the humans but without human restrictions.  What started as a form of self-expression on the streets of NYC for artist Brandon Sines quickly turned into a movement for the people. Frank has special powers that he continues to discover as he is tested by the many challenges of life. Frank champions positivity and equality, and cares about all living things. He believes in using imagination and play to inspire other people and animals through thoughtful actions.

2 Artworks in 1 Daily Cycle

New York Polaroids by Athena Novo, Summer of 2022, An Alternative New York during the NFT Summit, Minted 1/1 on Async Art

While everyone was enjoying the NFT Summit, a different group of visitors were in New York. Some call them demons, monsters and zombies while I would prefer more neutral terms but nonetheless here are some of the photographs I've taken of them which I release with full disclosure and their cooperation. The prospective collectors should acknowledge the existence of "undead" and some even more exotic characters might cause some alarm among the general population. Therefore viewer caution is warranted even though most of these peoples I met during the NFT Summit seemed to be of absolutely good character (not sure about some demonic entities that did not respond) and interested in art and its manifestation with the technologies branded aptly as NFT and what not.

QmZWctXuXWBECBDPJNDLWSbRiBVn3jeR4vHSWbKF.name: Newly Abridged Happiness Manual Vol 1
QmZWctXuXWBECBDPJNDLWSbRiBVn3jeR4vHSWbKF.description:
Conceived as a series with three volumes, the Newly Abridged Happiness Manuals are conceptual poems that explore the tension between time and mind, between what we tell ourselves and what our minds tell us. 

This first volume digs at our relationship to the present tense. The second and third volumes will probe our notions of past and future, worn down as they become with the passage of time, hour by waking or sleeping hour. 

Life happens inside our minds. To examine thought is to examine atomized bites of life. These series of poems seek to do so with humor, compassion, and straightforward honesty. 

Alternate titles for this series included: Present Tense, Past Tense, Future Tense. Or, Sketches of Singing and Failing.

QmZZRhTEMHzd3urNV1kocipGo2o7sz624Z83qPpX.description:
https://mathiasrusch-metaverse.com/

The "Our Father" - The cycle of paintings by artist Mathias Rusch (*1927-2003).

If there is a most important prayer of Christian faith, then it must be the "Our Father".

This prayer gift of Jesus to his disciples, later handed down to us Christians, has become the actual Christian self-understanding, the "prayer of the Lord". Packed into a few sentences, it has come to be regarded as the actual confession of faith and is prayed millions of times a day, both individually and in communities. The fact that this "conversation with God" has hardly ever been depicted (in contrast to the Passion) is probably due to the immense message it conveys. The fact that the painter Mathias Rusch dared to translate the "Our Father" can be explained by the fact that his daily work was based on faith, hope, and trust in God. Mathias Rusch was aware that he could only exist in the understanding of his art "as a gift of God". Most of his late works (Our Father, Live and Let Live, Sermon on the Mount, Lauretan Litany, Litany of the Sacred Heart) were written, as he confessed, under the "kind help" of the Highest, always accompanied by personal prayers, meditations or invocations. The fact that Mathias Rusch did not reveal a word for the interpretation of his works of art is to be justified by the fact that he understood himself to a large extent as a mediator of a higher power. Thus we are sometimes quite helplessly confronted with an immense abundance of Christian symbols, metaphysical allusions, concretizations, and abstractions, in unique hues and compositions. Completely in the sense of Mathias Rusch we dive before the 13 works of art into the enormous topic of earthly existence and Christian eschatology, marvel before the color power, before the hints, confessions, and convictions of the very deeply felt "Our Father's". Finally, we become humbled and ultimately grateful to be initiated into the world-prayer of a "knowing" believer, again and again, with each glance at each of these magnificent works of art. Whoever takes a longer "eye" look at this self-contained, unique complete work, consisting of 13 unique pieces in oil on canvas, 170x170cm, will not be able to resist a lasting effect and deep consternation.

QmZat54unhmUn8FegzgBUCRHmJtz8xaXXewiwJk2.name: Santorini, Greece
QmZat54unhmUn8FegzgBUCRHmJtz8xaXXewiwJk2.description:
This piece combines sketches I made of Santorini in Greece and Tremithousa in Cyprus. The Santorini sketch was used as the basis for the composition and the Paphos sketches were used for the day/night lighting and for the cat silhouettes.

The Paphos sketches were made during late night and early morning walks in the village when my daughter was a newborn.

The artwork layers three hand drawn pieces and was finalised using photoshop.

QmZbcUHtkeuQGkcuw96HUA7UGX5fNPRNneUaZtvs.name: Choose Your Own Adventure
QmZbcUHtkeuQGkcuw96HUA7UGX5fNPRNneUaZtvs.description: Every blink of your eye. Every thought through your head. Every. Single. Frame. You control. No matter what is happening, you are creating it. 'Choose Your Own Adventure' is the visual depiction of a group thought reality. Will the thoughts of others dictate how you will display your layer? Are you able to swing the tide of positivity and bring out the bright hope of the future? Can everyone be in the flow together and see the same unified, collective state of mind. I believe that we are all going down the same path and our thoughts and actions ripple throughout reality, far deeper than we might think. Our every thought can affect generations ahead of us. Let's do our part now to pave the path we are all on.

QmZfJUVvv5er86YjtG9nEWNDT5n3dNEM79yxGmWX.name: Viksate
QmZfJUVvv5er86YjtG9nEWNDT5n3dNEM79yxGmWX.description:
Viksate means ponder or observe. Viksa means the unconsciousness. 

This creation has a total of 42 variations. each variations meaning changes based on the symbols in it. It is up to you to interpret what each variation means. 

Fish symbolises our unconscious mind that holds secrets and intelligence. It shows a need to look within the deep waters of our unconsciousness to be awaken.
The crescent moon symbolises entering into new chapters in ones life while the third eye symbolises an awakened soul. 

Lotus symbolism is sacred in many religions and culture including in Hinduism. In Asia you will find the lotus prominent in various cultures.

In Hinduism, the Lotus symbolises knowledge, abundance, wealth, sexuality and spirituality. The partially bloomed lotus represents the need for us continuously learn and question our ideas and thoughts. The lotus emerges from murky waters to bloom into existence. 

Carl Jung likened the flight of birds to the spiritual development of the human soul. Like birds the soul flies upward in its search for enlightment, freeing itself from its attachment to earthly desire. 

But the process of self realization takes time and our attachments to materialistic desires don’t vanish immediately but with each flight, it brings back to us new wisdom for the soul to develop and learn. 

Like the lotus, we suffer, experience and learn to grow from the mud and bloom into enlightened souls.

QmZfc3Jo9oWZhUcZSQ5S6HnhSNninHR1DqZMLVww.name: Scenes from the Show
QmZfc3Jo9oWZhUcZSQ5S6HnhSNninHR1DqZMLVww.description:
Scenes from the Show is from a show about three women who have been hurt, reacted and consequently suffered. Their efforts were not in vain but not all were able to survive the ordeal. I should, with the blockchain as my witness, thank my daughter for being a part of this show and facilitating my presence as a photographer on site.

The photographs have been taken during the rehearsals in 2019. I had the opportunity to take a wide variety of shots out of which I have handpicked a few for Scenes from the Show. The photographs were edited multiple times during the period leading up to this artwork.

The show is about their courage. It is about their will not to be broken under adverse conditions of parents, lovers and all forms of authority that  prevent them to be with no hesitation to resort to use of brute force. All these women have broken the boundary and turned the tables on the assaulters of various kinds. The  effort was extraordinary yet human. The cost.. The cost was momentous however way you look at it.

Technically, I wished to push the bar higher with Scenes from the Show and introduced 9 layers (+1 static layer) with 16 states in each of them. I've done the whole work twice over as I tested a 16 x 16 alternative that I gave up due to screen being divided more than how I envisaged. Purely mathematically speaking the current probability outcome of different images is (9 layers with 16 states) 9 to the power of 16. The math comes out as 1,853,020,188,851,841 that is 1.8 quadrillion combinations. A 70 year life with no sleep and 1 click at every second yields 2,207,520,000 images for the life time. That is it would take 800,000 lifetimes to go through all the combinations. All the more reason to get couple of layers and decide at-will to manage the odds.

"Through dirt and over street. The dancer falls Then rises like an oriole over walls." -from Dancer: Four Poems by Paul Engle (4-2). Like this one each layer is referred by a small selection from a poem by Paul Engle. Incredibly lovely words, I am in admiration of this gentle petite work speaking soft meaning a lot. Each of the 16 states are named after female dancers that have made a mark in history. With them I took the liberty to select and the naming convention was quite random as I used first names, stage names and surnames with different dancers depending on how it sounded and looked. Last under the naming convention are the layer names which are my titles for the photographs I built this work upon.

There are at least 9 beautiful images in this vast set. I have clicked through and have come across a lot of inspiring visuals. However more than that, this work is a study in chance. The collector(s) holding this artwork will only see a fraction of possible outcomes. It sort of reminds me of the stories from The Book of Sand by Jorge Luis Borges. The same page or the same story will not be found again. Something similar will come up perhaps. Each story will take a lifetime. The book will merge with life. 

I wished this work to be outrageous. Visually artistic but numerically absurd. It gives two options to the Collector and/or the Viewer. One is to accept life aka the image as it is. Let the randomness speak and take it. The other is to make a choice, to change  the odds by the force of will - wherever and to whatever it may lead. The second is done by the choices on the collection of layers and about which states will prevail at the time.

This creation will live on the blockchain. I hope many years from now on, it will still cause some interest and a lonely only girl or boy would click a few buttons with the mind, look at it  and smile at the futility of life and the incessant desire to shape it by some of us.

June - August 2021
Hulki Okan Tabak

QmZgoQBCUiczacehRTK9sV5k8sqMoUvx1Vo7ooG3.name: SOARIN'
QmZgoQBCUiczacehRTK9sV5k8sqMoUvx1Vo7ooG3.description:
Who doesn't want to touch the sky?

SOARIN' is an augmented reality art public installation. The base image was taken at a sports complex in North Carolina, and exists on the premises as a large scale photo-mural using polytab mural fabric. 

SOARIN' has two version (Daybreak and Midnight) complete with unique animations. They come to life by scanning the QR Code and locating the image with Adobe Aero, or by finding the image through the augmented reality app "Artivive."

Collectors will have access to full resolution image, uncompressed MP4 file, and their name will be included on the augmented reality layer.

5236 x 5236 px.

QmZiKSnApfyKvUKyT91LNr2kbfXVw87CHUhJZ1sU.name: Experimental No.3 #8168
QmZiKSnApfyKvUKyT91LNr2kbfXVw87CHUhJZ1sU.description:
Artwork Title: Experimental No.3 #8168
Date of Artwork: 2021
Dimension: 2160 pixel x 1735 pixel
Type of Work: Silver Gelatin Photogram, Digital Painting
Edition: Unique
Note: This artwork is a type of digital art. The hand-made photogram is one of the subjects that compose this piece, and this photogram is not for sale separately whatever in the crypto world or the real world.

Notwithstanding, the beginning of the photography is representational, it ultimately leads to the way of the abstract. Photography has nothing to do with painting, although the thinking of abstractness renders them getting closer and closer. Photography remains the interpretation of "Light", and to express the “Light” is its inescapable responsibility. I find the "Line" could be one of the forms to present the "Light". I apply the "Line", also is the "Light", to destroy a completed and finished photograph, and change it into a new form of art and have a unique way of spreading and viewing. Through this new attempt to keep looking for balance and harmony.

QmZjwYDqCn7PCAqiAm6DA7hAHrcjXib65igddWd7.name: Steve's Golden Apples
QmZjwYDqCn7PCAqiAm6DA7hAHrcjXib65igddWd7.description:
Steve's Golden Apples reflects the charisma, anger, and brilliance of the late Steve Jobs. During the day, Steve was an incredible entrepreneur and user of trailblazing technologies. Behind closed doors, he was known for his ruthless character and polarizing attitude. This composition presents the founder's golden apples stirring in a melting pot of ideas and innovation. The piece also features the original Apple Macintosh personal computer from 1984. 

During the daytime, Steve is happy and productive. At night, anger sweeps over his mind, and the apples disappear.

"Innovation distinguishes between a leader and a follower." - Steve Jobs

QmZmdEvdycnXuDA9xEjnJZwJqmQAVEZt8pv1eFyb.name: PORTRAITS OF STRENGTH: Women in Ethnic Vietnam (Tech-Enhanced)
QmZmdEvdycnXuDA9xEjnJZwJqmQAVEZt8pv1eFyb.description:
IMPORTANT: to test the artwork (and its 512 combinations) please click on the "TEST ARTWORK" button or go to this link: https://www.tonycorocher.com/nft-digitalart/asyncart/portraits-of-strength/

DESCRIPTION:
Documentary Photography meets Illustration thanks to Technology. Could this be a new way of story telling?

This NFT programmable artwork was born from the collaboration between Tony Corocher and George Boya. We decided to start from one of Tony’s award winning photo essays and to combine the "Reality" of photography with the "Surreal" of George's illustration/collage art.

We selected "PORTRAITS OF STRENGTH: Ethnic Women in North Vietnam" (original photo essay here: https://www.tonycorocher.com/portraits-of-strength-women-in-ethnic-vietnam/). We both agreed that the theme, the images, the colors and the possible combinations were ideal for programmable art and for what was boiling in our minds.
But, the main reasons why we chose this essay was the message that came with it: these women live in rural areas up in the mountains of North Vietnam, frequently in very hard conditions and with very little help. When I was there I was struck by the strength and perseveration they showed, by their collaborative efforts and by their calmness... so I decided to spend a couple of weeks in the area, meet with a few people, get to know them and listen to their stories.

With George's mesmerising illustrations we took it a step further by introducing a possible future in which technology and decentralisation will be able to help these women directly, without any middle man or government interference. 

So I got into the original 15 photos, broke each one down into 3 parts (main subject, secondary subject and background) to see what was working and what was not. I ended up with 12 States (4 in each Layer). Then George worked his magic by creating another 12 states where his illustrations overtake the original images while keeping it real and connected with the original photos.

We ended up with 1 MASTER, 3 LAYERS and 8 STATES per layer (for a total of 512 possible combinations). It was a fun, enjoyable and very interesting collaboration and it produced an artwork with a distinct and important message behind:
THE STRENGTH OF THESE WOMEN AND THE POSSIBILITIES OFFERED BY TECHNOLOGY TO IMPROVE THEIR LIVES.

The original Photo Essay won the following Awards:

- PX3 Gran Prix De La Photographie, Paris: Honorable Mention. 2015
https://www.tonycorocher.com/px3-gran-prix-de-la-photographie-paris-2015-third-place-2-honorable-mentions/

- IPA Oneshot Competition: Honorable Mention. 2016 "Family of Man” (International Photography Awards – Los Angeles).
https://www.tonycorocher.com/ipa-2016-oneshot-competition-family-of-man/

QmZmz7LEqFsv6yHLrPjrkAA2ZwHxM9cKYBiLh5dj.name: What Time is it in My Imaginary Shanghai Right Now?
QmZmz7LEqFsv6yHLrPjrkAA2ZwHxM9cKYBiLh5dj.description:
This is a glimpse into the creative process. An attempt to show what is going on in the artist's mind. The infinite possibilities when he or she stands in front of the blank canvas in the studio. Every color pick or a brush stroke presents a
fork in the road. The artist keeps exploring, having no idea where the road might lead him/her. Composing, constructing, deconstructing, and rebuilding; brushing,
smearing, covering, and erasing; trying to get to a place that feels right.
While all 24 paintings start with the same basic idea, each ends up in a very different place. Each painting becomes a unique journey not so much about the time of the day but about the artist’s mood at that hour. There is no one painting
that is perfect; rather, each one is a unique journey.
The artist stays out of the frame most of the time. He appears only once, on one
panel, sometime late at night.

QmZnLiHigX9smmkDeHoGEc9hjXCyeQJJeUPzaRNA.description:
38 States of a Young Woman - Set 6

38 States of a Young Woman is a generative study on an image itself created by mixing photography and other generative portraits.

There are 38 derivative images of which 28 are used to create 4 sets of images. The sets themselves are created in the order of image creation except for the 3 occasions (out of 28) when an image was replaced by one from the end of the list.

There are 7 sets of 4 images Day/Night cycles to be published on Async Art.

Athena Novo, 2022
