QmZoVPGhsDr1RybFy2p2UahpZxjXp6Tr67yBfnr4.name: Magic Man on the Loose
QmZoVPGhsDr1RybFy2p2UahpZxjXp6Tr67yBfnr4.description:
Magic Man lived a long time ago in a place far far away.

Magic Man wore a hat that housed his powers. Never took it off for fear of losing it.

When he got too old to perform magic, Magic Man left his home in search of an apprentice.

During his travels, Magic Man encountered a world unknown to him. He loved and loathed what he saw. He desired and cried incessantly. His emotions were mixed, his magic wat patchy, his hat was ragged.

I've met him during his travels. It was by the inn on the High Steppes that he was so tired that he fell asleep on foot when he stumbled in. I helped the keep carry him to a room that was to be his last. 

The stories I heard from him changed my life. The brief encounter was so brief and deep at the same time that I lack words to describe it. His last words I shall take to my grave. His wishes are my wishes now. His travels were not in vain.

...

Magic Man on the Loose
by Hulki Okan Tabak

Photography by Hulki Okan Tabak, January - February 2020
Digital Painting variations and Photoshop editing by Hulki Okan Tabak, January - September 2021
Concept and the story by Hulki Okan Tabak, September 2021

QmZp67ctNtdf5ZC4MCDh3RJW26ZfrPpZWe3cSRfB.name: Kids Takeover Putin: Abstract #1
QmZp67ctNtdf5ZC4MCDh3RJW26ZfrPpZWe3cSRfB.description:
Based on Putin photography, Kids Takeover Putin is text-to-image experimentation on war, peace and leadership. It is re-creating the leadership in the eyes of a kid takeover for peace.

Stop the War. We hoped, I hoped this was already the past in Europe. We should not go back.

There is a lot of interesting material that range from childish and peaceful to satirical and dark. I will post them and perhaps I will post most of them hoping this ends as soon as possible.

This is one of the 2 4-piece somewhat abstract pieces on Async Art. There is also 1 24 piece set and 12 2-piece Nova Apartchiks on Async Art. For multi editions and some other 1/1s, please visit my collection on KnownOrigin.

by Mad Monk, 1/1 on Async Art, 2022

QmZsifzWxWEVVv4PjcAsySNahWtLgiJB5HcbAo2x.name: The Idea of Saving Aesthetics - Time Edition
QmZsifzWxWEVVv4PjcAsySNahWtLgiJB5HcbAo2x.description:
Historically, carpets play a significant role in forming Azerbaijan & Middle East’s heritage and aesthetics. Different carpet schools share the same ornamental forms, such as geometric patterns, floral motifs, and calligraphic shapes, but some of the combinations are specific to certain regions. Today, the word ‘pattern’ is often associated with machine algorithms that recognize regularities in data. Orkhan designed an AI algorithm to analyze carpet designs and traditional ornaments. After processing the collected data, the neural network system is producing imaginary patterns that could have been Azerbaijani or similar, but all of them never really existed. The installation The Idea of Saving Aesthetics explores data as a fruitful and yet thoroughly problematic resource for artistic inspiration in the turbulent epoch of global nomadism, uneven cultural diffusion, and rising nationalist movements.

According to historic data and memo records of European researchers and travelers, Mediaeval Azerbaijan was one of the major carpet hubs of the Orient, and after the Islamic Golden age, most of the middle eastern carpet patterns and ornaments became popularized by the western countries. While in Azerbaijan, carpet weaving was primarily a dominating form of art, with the traditions and skills carefully passed over from one generation to another, through developing and improving methods of making and spreading crafted symbols. By approaching these representations of our nation’s cultural history, with the help of AI, we get a dialogue between the future and the past, dystopian and utopian.

In this exhibition, the artist highlights the source and meaning of ornaments with the background history and regional source of them. During the exhibition experience, visitors will be able to witness current locations and uses of the embroideries all over the world.

Premiered at Moscow contemporary art Biennale 2019. Moscow, Russia.
This art installation has been in the collection of Russian Federation The State Tretyakov Gallery since 2020.

Various mediums and tools have been used from watercolors to sculpting in virtual reality to create the parts. QmZvVKTmd3Lw2XzRdKQgwaR8a7ufjRLpaDmzU2p1.name: Expected Behavior
QmZvVKTmd3Lw2XzRdKQgwaR8a7ufjRLpaDmzU2p1.description:
What if we had a place to send our perceived bugs in this messed up simulation we call life?

'Expected Behavior' is a dark comedy collaboration between paleh0rs3 and GPT-3 AI. It imagines a disillusioned entity responsible for our simulation using a Kafkaesque task management tool to track the terribleness all around us.

The layers in this project were designed to take full advantage of the tool's UI: on the board there are 15 cards containing bugs submitted by humans to our simulation overlords. These bugs were co-written by paleh0rs3 and GPT-3 based on extensive prompting and refining. Each ticket slot contains the title of two bugs, changeable by each owner.

There's also a right hand pane to display the expected resolution for 20 of the bugs, a left hand 'Feedback' mechanism to unleash 25 mass punishments on the simulation's inhabitants, and an upper right push notification to give swift punishment to 10 individuals confessing their darkest sins.

QmZyobT493Xfrh1CdjqiisEnBJhPoPh8pK2eGHTf.name: High on Boba
QmZyobT493Xfrh1CdjqiisEnBJhPoPh8pK2eGHTf.description:
High on Boba is originally a physical traditional oil painting on canvas, 30x40’’ (76x100 cm) made in January 2020 in Boston, Massachusetts USA, and adapted for Async on March 2021.
This piece is the first oil painting I ever made. It shows my character Milo drinking something that looks like green tea with boba.
In this programmable NFT version, the painting goes into Dark Mode during the night and can be seen glowing as if it were under UV light.
High on Boba was part of the ROX/SE Art Show at the Piano Craft Gallery in Boston, MA September 4, 2020 - September 27, 2020.

QmZyqsHgyLuJmewqPo2JwkaW9NJ62kTiKU32sCi4.name: Evil Intent - 2: The Axe is Sharper Dear
QmZyqsHgyLuJmewqPo2JwkaW9NJ62kTiKU32sCi4.description:
"Intentions are mental states in which the agent commits themselves to a course of action. Having the plan to visit the zoo tomorrow is an example of an intention. The action plan is the content of the intention while the commitment is the attitude towards this content. Other mental states can have action plans as their content, as when one admires a plan, but differ from intentions since they do not involve a practical commitment to realizing this plan. Successful intentions bring about the intended course of action while unsuccessful intentions fail to do so. Intentions, like many other mental states, have intentionality: they represent possible states of affairs." ---Wikipedia

QmZytzn4nDiArKF6szMA7VqhJZfPWZEMjgA41Bmc.name: Happy Place
QmZytzn4nDiArKF6szMA7VqhJZfPWZEMjgA41Bmc.description:
Happy Place portrays an Indian Queen sitting in front of a painting she adores, that reminds her of the serenity she seeks. At night she dreams of visiting that place to enjoy the wind and nature. As the loop continues, the women sitting in front of window now dreams of having a life of a Queen and wants to have an artwork behind her instead of a window that doesn't appeal her much. 
So the happy place keeps changing with the changing circumstances. What once might feel as a source of true happiness might lose its value with time. And thus the artwork intends to depict that happiness is not something to be attained but something to be felt.

QmZzgJj4GHCxjC6p2JZBajfub8HXAmC8y8bFdxUn.name: Experimental No.1 #5642
QmZzgJj4GHCxjC6p2JZBajfub8HXAmC8y8bFdxUn.description:
Artwork Title: Experimental No.1 #5642
Date of Artwork: 2021
Dimension: 3840 pixel x 3020 pixel
Type of Work: Silver Gelatin Photogram, Digital Darkroom
Edition: Unique
Note: This artwork is a type of digital art. The hand-made photogram is one of the subjects that compose this piece, and this photogram is not for sale separately whatever in the crypto world or the real world.

Changes is the only thing that hasn’t been changed. From time to space to the thoughts of human beings are constantly changing. I transformed a Silver Gelatin Photogram (a piece of physical photograph made of alternative photographic processes) into a digital image that even can produce endless changes. This is based on the change in my way of seeing the world. It is difficult for individuals to completely isolate themselves from their own inherent culture, this ingrained imprint not only stems from families but also social and historical influences. Besides, the rapid innovation of science and technologies directly drives the world today to inevitably facing collisions and fusions in multiculturalism. Studying classical philosophical text allows me to apply the dialectical method to tease those open questions, and finally ground on my artworks. All things complement each other and balance in the collision. Changes is the key. Isn’t the development of human civilization that come to the present evolve in indistinct ways?

Contents included #5642 Master Layer (Day), #5642 Master Invert Layer (Night), #5642 the invert version of the Master Solarize Layer (Sunrise), #5642 Master Solarize Layer (Sunset).

Qma2LEtwLfb3RZnKzPBXUL1cqdL1FEjL5SnPdTHe.name: Tunnel 916131
Qma2LEtwLfb3RZnKzPBXUL1cqdL1FEjL5SnPdTHe.description:
Deep inside the dragon's lair
lies a truth, that only some can bear
about a forgotten civilization, a worldwide nation
that lived long before the great invasion
they cherished what was given down from source
keeping up the harmony was everyone's course
and since they knew what really was important
they didn't need to hide behind the cryptic curtains
they didn't need to suppress the greatest knowledge
they didn't need to create a suspicious college that keeps the individual a hostage
but when this one mistake was made
time has stopped, it was too late
regretting that they had forgotten
the tree, that has already rotten
but since mistakes are made to learn
they started over, harmony is still what they yearn.


AO

Qma2i1uKGm1C9nQT1Nd9sVPdaEsDjKSzRrV7maBA.name: The Light House
Qma2i1uKGm1C9nQT1Nd9sVPdaEsDjKSzRrV7maBA.description:
Created in collusion with graphic designer TypeDistortDecay, as part of Copy Planet's expanding universe. 

Informed by the physical, mental, and behavioral changes that follow a 24-hour cycle. 

“Circadian Rhythms” is a pilot series comprised of 3 works for Copy Planet’s Centre for Climatology. 

The work intends to present a meditation on the sublime as a way to contemplate these natural phenomena as agents of change through emergent technology. 

As a respond to the shifts experienced within the current zeitgeist and its effects on the human and non-human participants existing in space time. 

Each work will be uploaded twice ( daytime / nighttime ) responding to the natural processes of light and dark.  

Words by James Ly

Qma3ti8Ug9HnoDPnqgdZGaxUDNhpT9DEEvV565KZ.name: Some Boxes
Qma3ti8Ug9HnoDPnqgdZGaxUDNhpT9DEEvV565KZ.description:
In a random part of the universe where the stars shine bright, there is a place in which people come together and wait for a signal, to open and close some boxes. The meaning behind this phenomenon is still unknown.

SUMMARY
Some Boxes is a social experiment about art ownership. The goal requires collectors to open and close their boxes when signaled to do so. Any collector that fails to comply with the rules will result in their box being permanently sealed with tape, removing that collectors ability to open or close their box forever.

BOX(CONTROL)
This layer is the box at the top of the artwork. It’s used to signal Box(1) through to Box(20), when it's time to open or close their respective boxes. There are only 2 rules:
- If Box(Control) is open, collectors must open their box. 
- If Box(Control) is closed, collectors must close their box. 
All collectors will have 48 hours from the transaction timestamps of any Box(Control) changes, to comply with these rules. The frequency of when Box(Control) opens or closes is currently unknown. Box(Control) cannot be purchased. 

BOXES
There are twenty boxes from Box(1) through to Box(20). Boxes can be opened or closed by their layer owners. The decision to open or close a box is decided by the owners, but signaled by Box(Control).

TAPE
There are twenty tapes from Tape(1) through to Tape(20). Tape is used to permanently seal boxes when they fail to comply with any rules.
There are four colors of tape: brown, white, black and gold. The color of tape used to seal a box will depend on how many other boxes were sealed before it.
Once tape has been used to seal a box, that tape layer will be burnt, causing those boxes to be sealed forever. Tape layers cannot be purchased. 

For a more comprehensive guide and better understand of Some Boxes, please visit: https://www.bottlesartwork.com/someboxes

Qma85AV3ZzZwHbbueKNi35fZzuzVG4XdZ5BJZCYd.name: Homo Zombie Zombiens_Bernard
Qma85AV3ZzZwHbbueKNi35fZzuzVG4XdZ5BJZCYd.description:
I set myself the task to portray the zombification of mankind.
The result is Homo Zombie Zombiens, a series of zombie portraits of the new man.
Homo Sapiens is no more, Homo Zombie Zombiens is here. You can see them
all around you or just by looking in your mirror.
We are all wounded. I hear a lot of talk about healing, but if you don’t see the wounds,
what can you heal?

I would like to investigate these wounds, cuts and holes. The decaying matter and the trident noses! 
Where are we heading? Is it into the zombie apocalypse?
If so, let’s go with some irony.
–
Homo Zombie Zombiens is going to showcase several portraits in a rich collection of designs.
The first HZZ is Bernard.
Bernard is mad about the rise of A.I.

Qma9xfiA716DbbEDYYPV2GnGNLj8vN8EH3EkzJ4Z.name: ​​OUR FATHER IN THE METAVERSE #86
Qma9xfiA716DbbEDYYPV2GnGNLj8vN8EH3EkzJ4Z.description:
https://mathiasrusch-metaverse.com/

The "Our Father" - The cycle of paintings by artist Mathias Rusch (*1927-2003).   

If there is a most important prayer of Christian faith, then it must be the "Our Father".  
 
This prayer gift of Jesus to his disciples, later handed down to us Christians, has become the actual Christian self-understanding, the "prayer of the Lord". Packed into a few sentences, it has come to be regarded as the actual confession of faith and is prayed millions of times a day, both individually and in communities. The fact that this "conversation with God" has hardly ever been depicted (in contrast to the Passion) is probably due to the immense message it conveys. The fact that the painter Mathias Rusch dared to translate the "Our Father" can be explained by the fact that his daily work was based on faith, hope, and trust in God. Mathias Rusch was aware that he could only exist in the understanding of his art "as a gift of God". Most of his late works (Our Father, Live and Let Live, Sermon on the Mount, Lauretan Litany, Litany of the Sacred Heart) were written, as he confessed, under the "kind help" of the Highest, always accompanied by personal prayers, meditations or invocations. The fact that Mathias Rusch did not reveal a word for the interpretation of his works of art is to be justified by the fact that he understood himself to a large extent as a mediator of a higher power. Thus we are sometimes quite helplessly confronted with an immense abundance of Christian symbols, metaphysical allusions, concretizations, and abstractions, in unique hues and compositions. Completely in the sense of Mathias Rusch we dive before the 13 works of art into the enormous topic of earthly existence and Christian eschatology, marvel before the color power, before the hints, confessions, and convictions of the very deeply felt "Our Father's". Finally, we become humbled and ultimately grateful to be initiated into the world-prayer of a "knowing" believer, again and again, with each glance at each of these magnificent works of art. Whoever takes a longer "eye" look at this self-contained, unique complete work, consisting of 13 unique pieces in oil on canvas, 170x170cm, will not be able to resist a lasting effect and deep consternation.

QmaBUoo7Ximij22saWFTXPNyVcrEYDHUKjXNhKVP.name: I am Us
QmaBUoo7Ximij22saWFTXPNyVcrEYDHUKjXNhKVP.description:
A reflection on how our perceived individuality is actually intertwined with everyone else around us. 
This artwork is built with five layers, each with five color choices. Four of those colors are unique to each layer, offering quantities of possibilities for the overall look of the artwork.  Black is available in all the layers. The black version of the center ellipse has a golden border, making the “whole black” version a  “gold ring on black” artwork, very different from all the other possibilities. A unique version that will be visible only if the 5 owners decide on the same choice at the same time. 
At any time, the displayed artwork is the confirmation that a “me” always affects others and, at the same time, always depends on others.

QmaCFoCW2Pb5BR9iSWfMeYi7E3k9X9SDPk1ibm15.name: Compute
QmaCFoCW2Pb5BR9iSWfMeYi7E3k9X9SDPk1ibm15.description: 'Compute' is a visual interpretation of the series of actions that is performed by a computers Central Processing Unit (CPU) when it receives information. The four distinct states are represented by the four layers in this artwork - Fetch, Decode, Execute and Writeback, basic actions are at the core of all basic computer processing. The different coloured layers represent the different software and programs that computers continuously run. This artwork forms a counterpart to the visual/audio work 'Syntax [Two]', released by Async Music, which continues a series of works based on the idea of 'computer space'.

QmaDx2qpCQVH8EzFZoRCv2UBMwcaQrUjdn7LXby5.name: Za Myr: I Have a Mouth and I Can Scream
QmaDx2qpCQVH8EzFZoRCv2UBMwcaQrUjdn7LXby5.description:
“In keeping silent about evil, in burying it so deep within us that no sign of it appears on the surface, we are implanting it, and it will rise up a thousand fold in the future. When we neither punish nor reproach evildoers, we are not simply protecting their trivial old age, we are thereby ripping the foundations of justice from beneath new generations.”

― Aleksandr I. Solzhenitsyn, The Gulag Archipelago 1918–1956

Za Myr (Ukranian) = For Peace

For Peace is a series of artworks in support of peace, based on AI assisted artworks built upon Solzhenitsyn's words, conceptualized by HoT and MM and AN.

1/1 Edition on Async Art, 2022

Za Myr: I Have a Mouth and I Can Scream builds on the footsteps of a GIF I've minted in this series on KnownOrigin titled Za Myr: Sleza .. For Peace: A Teardrop .. In Three Languages at https://knownorigin.io/gallery/7935000-za-myr-sleza-for-peace-a-teardrop-in-three -- These works have similar AI origin points, different base image files and different editing methods. What they share is concern for what's going on in Ukraine today (Feb 26, 2022).

QmaEJcH1njiZaYEkH8DCRyz5UtsFw7yFWNANkjiP.name: "Wild Compassion"
QmaEJcH1njiZaYEkH8DCRyz5UtsFw7yFWNANkjiP.description:
This piece ushers in the call for stepping up to the challenge of passion and compassion. Doctors are called to more than mere technical proficiency, but to presence and engagement that suffuses an entire conversation; compassion, a quality paramount to patient welfare. It discards the notion that doctors need to maintain a professional distance from their patients.
Combing through scientific literature reveals that doctor compassion does more than just calm the nerves; it boosts the survival chance of cancer patients , reduces post-surgery pain, and can boost the immune system, to name a few.
Compassion binds together the doctor-patient relationship, a necessary kinship in managing and seeing through one's good chance of recovery.

QmaFZCTQSchBjjGSK6NfuRzWXZHWxB3B43co2EnH.name: Nightwalking Marylebone in 24 Frames
QmaFZCTQSchBjjGSK6NfuRzWXZHWxB3B43co2EnH.description:
Nightwalking Marylebone in 24 Frames
by Hulki Okan Tabak
24 piece programmable artwork on Async Art
1/1 minted September 2021

...

Part of a series of Marylebone, London based artworks. All of these works consist of photographs taken by me in January 2020. It is the time of Lunar New Year, Wuhan lockdowns, and the very first signs of the virus in Europe.

Marylebone was originally an Ancient Parish formed to serve the manors (landholdings) of Lileston (in the west - which gives its name to modern Lisson Grove) and Tyburn in the east. The parish is likely to have been in place since at least the twelfth century and will have used the boundaries of the pre-existing manors. The boundaries of the parish were consistent from the late twelfth century to the creation of the Metropolitan Borough which succeeded it. (Wikipedia)

QmaFZzw5dUsHp7a2BX6ygGN3rTRjNwaLKbuxLuCw.name: 24h Infinite NOW
QmaFZzw5dUsHp7a2BX6ygGN3rTRjNwaLKbuxLuCw.description:
BRIEF: Minimalist stipple infinity symbols. Beginning at 01:00 with a single infinity symbol and layering another unique infinity symbol every hour; culminating with all 24 layers visible at midnight.

BACKGROUND: 

This piece evolved out of experimentation with the 24 hour format and animation. Through the use stipple & symbol I explore themes of: change & impermanence, particles & waves, quantum superposition & entanglement.

INQUIRY: 

To BE HERE NOW — ALL THE TIME — consciously CENTERED in the INFINITE NOW.

Ok....so how much do you value the paper that goes brrrrrrr?

QmaJ6jY3m6w1U6UPXrjex8ERXrp8Mm13njzASVz6.name: Orpheline d'amour
QmaJ6jY3m6w1U6UPXrjex8ERXrp8Mm13njzASVz6.description:
As a press photographer, I attended many red carpet events. Though I witnessed glamorous moments, faces and looks, I realized that I was drawn to create this world from a different perspective; one which undressed the soul, and rendered a more authentic moment. After some time, it became the same scenes, the same clichés, the same smiles, the same looks and the same photographers. As a celebrity, having to see more than 30 flashes per second every time a photographer spots them, probably makes them want to protect themselves. Seeing celebrities live in this world of excessive media coverage, I started to develop a mixed feeling of admiration and respect, but also pity, and finally detachment. 

The Personalities are decomposed and re-assembled in an abstract composition, guided by my instinct and fed by what the model inspired in me.

The original digital size of "Orpheline d'amour" portrait is 120 by 180 cm. 

This is a portrait of the tv reality star Chantelle Fraser.

QmaK8LRgPbd4jo7KzbdkYjN3hmpo1iS2sfsom8t2.name: the Remixable female Selfportrait
QmaK8LRgPbd4jo7KzbdkYjN3hmpo1iS2sfsom8t2.description:
A programmable nft art

The forever editable remix of hair and eyes, mouths, bodies and backgrounds from 10 self-portraits of female painters from 1500 to the end of the 1800s.

Caterina van Hemessen (1548)
Sofonisba Anguissola (1556)
Lavinia Fontana (1577)
Artemisia Gentileschi (1615-1617)
Rosalba Carriera (1715)
Angelika Kauffmann (1770-1775)
Elisabeth Vigée Lebrun (1781-1782)
Marie Gabrielle Capet (1783)
Mary Stevenson Cassatt (1880)
Berthe Morisot (1885)

4 remixable layers with 10 states each for a journey through the 10,000 possible portraits generated by the fusion of 10 masterpieces: unexpected faces, changing complexions under different lights and perspectives, different hairstyles and dresses through 4 centuries.
In each part of them there is the brushstroke of the artist while she mirrors in her Art.

QmaQ8yF6SHH74ZeHnyRs1KTS4CC7n3AuXJDbrgFp.description:
38 States of a Young Woman - Set 1

38 States of a Young Woman is a generative study on an image itself created by mixing photography and other generative portraits.

There are 38 derivative images of which 28 are used to create 4 sets of images. The sets themselves are created in the order of image creation except for the 3 occasions (out of 28) when an image was replaced by one from the end of the list.

There are 7 sets of 4 images Day/Night cycles to be published on Async Art.

Athena Novo, 2022

QmaT3x51NtgNshqQ4XoXUsEWxkWVb1Ng3pyryYmH.name: Into The Digital Wilderness
QmaT3x51NtgNshqQ4XoXUsEWxkWVb1Ng3pyryYmH.description:
The digital world, especially when setting foot in the blockchain terra incognita for the first time, feels strange, wonderful, filled with opportunities, risks and things you don't understand, with its diverse fauna and flora of bots, algorithms and human users. Hurt yourself, find some help, lose some gas for nothing when you trip, find treasures.

     And when the gas fees are too high, it's night on the blockchain, everyone takes it easy, things move slowly, and it's time to tell your stories, exchange with the community, show your findings, take a break or create.

QmaTiatR1isuHjWLRY7osJucRzzxkof3GAgoqM7n.name: Artefactos
QmaTiatR1isuHjWLRY7osJucRzzxkof3GAgoqM7n.description:
This artwork is a tribute to the timeless significance of ancient symbols and their enduring importance in shaping our understanding of the world.

The artwork consists of 24 individual pieces. Each one represents a specific period of ancient symbolism. As the viewer moves from one piece to the next, they are taken on a journey through time, as the symbols and patterns shift and transform to reflect the changing rhythms of the day. Whether it is the rising sun in the morning, the sparkling stars at night, or the magical creatures that inhabit the ancient landscape, every moment is infused with a sense of deep symbolism and meaning.

QmaU4YKSggfbT9DKpk3ntEBGKBVorhqmDt5o9saR.name: Regeneration #201247
QmaU4YKSggfbT9DKpk3ntEBGKBVorhqmDt5o9saR.description:
Artwork Title: Regeneration #201247
Date of Artwork: 2020-2021
Dimension: 3840 pixel x 3840 pixel
Type of Work: GANs Algorithm trained photograph
Date of Dataset: 2010-2017
Edition: Unique

The photographs in the series of Regeneration produced by using Generative Adversarial Networks. I took over three thousand photos spanned nearly a decade for a specific project and selected over a thousand photos from there as the Dataset for AI training. The photographs have been gestated by AI that integrated all the subtle emotions of the original pieces, which are the most exciting parts of this series.

QmaUT1XMdKzBY1hpsJ7TfjAmBxQ2Eia3sjjs3KqY.name: the Remixable Seascape
QmaUT1XMdKzBY1hpsJ7TfjAmBxQ2Eia3sjjs3KqY.description:
A programmable marine art.
 
The ever-changing remix of the shoreline, the sea and the sky from six artworks of famous painters from the 19th century romantic age:
 
Caspar David Friedrich - The Stages of Life (1834)
Eugène Poittevin - Les Bains de Mer, Plage d’Etretat (1864)
Gustave Courbet - The Wave (1869)
Vincent van Gogh - View of the Sea at Scheveningen (1882)
Paul Gauguin - Rocks and Sea (1886)
Winslow Homer - Saco Bay (1896)
 
3 remixable layers with 6 states each for a journey to discover lights, water's colors and shapes, unexpected atmospheres of the 216 possible combinations knowing that in every part of them there is the brushstroke and the energy of a master, with his personal view and feeling about the sea.

QmaY2im3snW8YHnWLVpKg6NizA6WBSELTLH5jCU4.name: Sketches from a Time of Conflict
QmaY2im3snW8YHnWLVpKg6NizA6WBSELTLH5jCU4.description:
This piece is about finding solace and leaning on a bit of escapism in time of stress and conflict that one can not overcome by herself / himself.

Sketches from a Time of Conflict finds its inspiration from the works of the Jewish surrealist painter Felix Nussbaum.  Loosely based on his imagery and more firmly based on the sense of foreboding creeping in to his work, the digital sketches here are an extension of Nussbaum inspired characters I have created and minted from 2020 to 2021.

The original names I had given to the underlying artworks for this final collective piece were:
Sunrise - That Which is in Limbo
Day - Limbo One Sketch
Sunset - One of the Elders
Night - Dreaming of Another One

As they are integrated in to this Async Art piece, their identity becomes a collective now as part of Sketches from a Time of Conflict. They will not appear as individual mints so I provided the names to the prospective Collector as part of the artwork's history.

I've terribly enjoyed working on this material and I hope you shall enjoy hosting for a future generation and passing on the word of peace, understanding and constructive affirmation of diversity even in times of duress.

Sketches from a Time of Conflict
Minted 2021 on Async Art by Hulki Okan Tabak

All picture frames from Hits of Steven Spielberg (Directed). Artwork from machine intelligence using a resampling algorithm that takes care of gamma correction and produces correct color averages. Color data in concentric circles in ascending order (radius) of the year they got released.

QmaZcwnigFsHSKZm9LZEeKVcRS4zddMgWy2qdxFt.name: In Search Of Color: Europe/Asia
QmaZcwnigFsHSKZm9LZEeKVcRS4zddMgWy2qdxFt.description:
An homage to a series of paintings I did starting in the early 2000's titled Urban Abstractions. I exhibited them in various cities around the world. 

"The collection of paintings portrays a landscape of color and intuition. I hope to capture the essence of modern life as we see it unfold in front of our very own eyes. The works are inspired by a struggle to make sense out of life and reflect a need for something more meaningful, something that brings out the JOY in our daily routine."

QmacXfgxkmGjd467oQmpW1qaK4XNCTWjHsbbeFgv.name: Day for Night (001)
QmacXfgxkmGjd467oQmpW1qaK4XNCTWjHsbbeFgv.description:
This is a dream.  The Washago experiment. A nautical disaster.  
He said, "It's out there most days and nights.  Those fingernails scratching on the hull between a Green River and a Cognashene." 

Day for night. 

As cinematic as our conversation is as faint a sound in my memory.  
Then the dream ends when the phone rings. 

Day: 44.92459,-79.9268445
Night: 44.7598753,-79.3307357

Day for Night (001) is a 1/1 edition genesis NFT artwork by Nolan Dubeau consisting of four images exploring the creation of hybrid landscapes from disparate locations.

Sunrise is shown from 6am to 7am.
Day is shown from 6am to 7pm.
Sunset is shown from 6pm to 7pm. 
Night is shown from 7pm to 6am.

QmadBbAT7qXrBTmLKTMbMuLnX12fN87zY24myyoQ.name: Regeneration #131212
QmadBbAT7qXrBTmLKTMbMuLnX12fN87zY24myyoQ.description:
Artwork Title: Regeneration #131212
Date of Artwork: 2020-2021
Dimension: 3840 pixel x 3840 pixel
Type of Work: GANs Algorithm trained photograph
Date of Dataset: 2010-2017
Edition: Unique

The photographs in the series of Regeneration produced by using Generative Adversarial Networks. I took over three thousand photos spanned nearly a decade for a specific project and selected over a thousand photos from there as the Dataset for AI training. The photographs have been gestated by AI that integrated all the subtle emotions of the original pieces, which are the most exciting parts of this series.

QmadP5foz9orYCrQ1zZzg9Wf3zc43VgtQtFpqrL3.name: Moth to a Flame
QmadP5foz9orYCrQ1zZzg9Wf3zc43VgtQtFpqrL3.description:
This unique piece is very important to me. 

The reason for this is that it tells how two lovers, who can never be separated from each other, take care of and protect each other despite their fate. Just like twins, they are shields of each other. 

Life tries to devalue us for the sake of testing us. However, fortunately, there is always someone who sees our true worth. At this point, what we have to do is to protect that love and to cherish it, just like the crown placed on our head, which we are obliged to carry. After all, what makes us who we are is the meaning of our lives. The meaning of life is this power that feeds us.

With my endless respect and love for all the effort he put into making me who I am...

Mitra

QmaeuDGr5tcy5HYbFmHAztCoa418o4je1v8XGVgL.name: The Gates of Delerium - Battle Scene
QmaeuDGr5tcy5HYbFmHAztCoa418o4je1v8XGVgL.description:
1976: Battle Scene – Confrontation, Attack, Impact (My View)

Each man, each side
Is fighting for a cause,
A cause they believe is right.
They believe so much
That their cause is right
That their deaths become righteous
And in their own eyes – 
Pure.
But the whiteness –
Of their fighting bodies –
Is pallid;
Of their pure, righteous acts – 
Is tinged with blackness;
Of their souls –
Is stained with blood.


The inspiration for the original 1976 painting was the song, “The Gates of Delerium” by Yes, off the album “Relayer”. The specific lyrics which relate to the painting are:

“Choose and renounce throwing chains to the floor
Kill or be killing faster sins correct the flow
Casting giant shadows off vast penetrating force
To alter via the war that’s seen
As friction spans the spirit’s wrath ascending (slowly) to redeem…

…The fist will run
Grasp metal to gun
The spirit sings in rushing tones we gain the battle drum
Our cries will shrill, the air will moan and crash into the dawn
The pen won’t stay the demon’s wings, the hour approaches
Pounding out the devil’s sermon”

QmaiYq2LXWvZQddm5Lrba8ZjVPoKx2P3etYTFuUg.name: Mother
QmaiYq2LXWvZQddm5Lrba8ZjVPoKx2P3etYTFuUg.description: If you are alive, that means you have an unbroken lineage of ancestors tracing back through the millennia - back to not only the mother of all humans on our own little branch of evolution, but back to the first creature crawling out of the sea, back to the first single celled organism, back to the first instance of matter that spontaneously coagulated in the primordial soup with the ability to replicate. From here, our biological ancestry crosses over into chemical ancestry. From the matter of this earth our ancestors were formed, and from the matter of this earth we are all born. The ever-present mother is with us in life and death. Day and night. Everywhere and always.

QmaigFMsgoJRdPGxNyHBkcKBAfe8tyMZMdUqtX7v.name: Experimental No.1 #3176
QmaigFMsgoJRdPGxNyHBkcKBAfe8tyMZMdUqtX7v.description: Changes is the only thing that hasn’t been changed. From time to space to the thoughts of human beings are constantly changing. I transformed a Silver Gelatin Photogram (a piece of physical photograph made of alternative photographic processes) into a digital image that even can produce endless changes. This is based on the change in my way of seeing the world. It is difficult for individuals to completely isolate themselves from their own inherent culture, this ingrained imprint not only stems from families but also social and historical influences. Besides, the rapid innovation of science and technologies directly drives the world today to inevitably facing collisions and fusions in multiculturalism. Studying classical philosophical text allows me to apply the dialectical method to tease those open questions, and finally ground on my artworks. All things complement each other and balance in the collision. Changes is the key. Isn’t the development of human civilization that come to the present evolve in indistinct ways?

QmajhWUo4kZm8RFPn6QRMjv3zRZDVdF6JCPCnerp.name: Warrioress | Twisted Tree No. 2
QmajhWUo4kZm8RFPn6QRMjv3zRZDVdF6JCPCnerp.description:
This is 'Warrioress'. She is the second of my Twisted Trees, and she also changes through the year's worth of seasons in 24 hours. She is a 1/1 creation. Watch for a few of the Wild Ozark critters to appear in this one: bobcat, deer, and bear. These are all critters that live here at Wild Ozark.

All of my NFT work begins with a real painting in handmade Ozark watercolor pigments. To make my paints, I gather, crush, and process rocks I find here in the creeks or on our land in northwest Arkansas USA. When I paint a Twisted Tree, I don't know how they will look until their personality reveals themselves to me. Each one is unique.

I made modifications to the painting for this NFT by adding hand-drawn or photography elements. The leaves are hand-drawn and digitally edited. The animals began as photo captures from our game camera. Other differences from the real-life original, like the flowers and weather elements, for example, are done digitally.

QmakisYTrCZz2BAy9uBdKGwLaiUHNnvRXArVJZAL.name: Om Pyramids
QmakisYTrCZz2BAy9uBdKGwLaiUHNnvRXArVJZAL.description:
https://www.freakdali.com/ompyramids

Om Pyramids is an art installation created by Freak Dali for the Rainbow Lighting Camp, in Renegade Burn 2021. 
The art piece was spray painted during the daytime and video mapped during night time. A creative process of transformation and impermanence, subject to the influence of the elements and surroundings. The final state was captured into images and composed into this NFT.

metadata.name: Om Pyramids
metadata.description:
https://www.freakdali.com/ompyramids

Om Pyramids is an art installation created by Freak Dali for the Rainbow Lighting Camp, in Renegade Burn 2021. 
The art piece was spray painted during the daytime and video mapped during night time. A creative process of transformation and impermanence, subject to the influence of the elements and surroundings. The final state was captured into images and composed into this NFT.

QmaknWNfdeXFbosgXsVAkh5YCXkgSzBS2xi7Ansc.name: Kylo Ren + the Divine Feminine
QmaknWNfdeXFbosgXsVAkh5YCXkgSzBS2xi7Ansc.description:
"Kylo Ren + the Divine Feminine" is a story in verse that unfolds hour by hour. It’s an intimate peak inside one woman’s sleepless, disheveled mind as she attempts to cope with overwhelming feelings of neglect, desire, and failure.

Each hour is in dialogue with time past and time future—both textually and visually—underlining the cyclical, convoluted nature of our thoughts. We often feel we are trapped inside a single day that repeats itself without end. But, by confining itself to the timeframe of day, my work reveals that is not time but our thoughts that entrap us. 

“Kylo Ren + the Divine Feminine” purposefully alternates between the mundane and the transcendental to reveal how the inescapable rhythm of dawn, noon, dusk, and night governs our physical and emotional hunger. 

Though any section could be the first, readers might consider starting at 6:00 am.

Qmap7TG9tHcEGJbnfwXeBTjvmZboRyNoqssKkErk.name: La ténébreuse
Qmap7TG9tHcEGJbnfwXeBTjvmZboRyNoqssKkErk.description:
Though I witnessed glamorous moments, faces and looks as a press photographer, I realized that I was drawn to create this world from a different perspective; one which undressed the soul, and rendered a more authentic moment. After some time, it became the same scenes, the same clichés, the same smiles, the same looks and the same photographers. As a celebrity, having to see more than 30 flashes per second every time a photographer spots them, probably makes them want to protect themselves. Seeing celebrities live in this world of excessive media coverage, I started to develop a mixed feeling of admiration and respect, but also pity, and finally detachment.

The Personalities are decomposed and re-assembled in an abstract composition, guided by my instinct and fed by what the model inspired in me.

This is a portrait of Sara Sampaio.

QmastWASe9B8QrKWcRqCqDqLrjrVJokWgW5wiXLs.name: (un)limited
QmastWASe9B8QrKWcRqCqDqLrjrVJokWgW5wiXLs.description:
21 prints will be produced of the two alternative states. These will be sold in a set upon completion of the "Fed Monkey Series"

Fed Monkey Series is a body of work that serves as a timestamp for our current political and economic climate. It is meant to showcase the complete loss of control by the Federal Reserve and provide us with a solution to these issues. This solution allows the people to take back control and gain independence from this broken and oppressive system. At the completion of each artwork, the current block height of bitcoin is inscribed somewhere in the piece. "(un)limited" is the first in the series.

In one state, you see the Fed Monkey injecting fiat into the system by simply painting words onto the wall using the only tools he knows, quantitative easing and bailouts. With his official federal reserve badge, he adds "Millions" "Billions" "Trillions" into the markets. None of it means anything, just writing bigger numbers on the wall until the ruling class approves. And the bailouts? Those keep getting bigger too. The bailout money is for corporations and their shareholders, not the working class. Maintaining the current System requires the rich get richer while the poor stay poor.

In another state, the previously black and white background has been colored in, while the "Millions" "Billions" "Trillions" has faded. The girl, wearing a protective bitcoin gas mask, provides a solution to the broken system. She paints directly over the quantitative easing and bailouts, with the number "21 million." This number symbolizes the hard-capped supply of bitcoin. To show the unchangeable nature of these 21 million bitcoin, she mounts an unbreakable piece of glass directly over her painting. The message is clear, opt out and start stacking sats.

Qmat1y23J3aKLbyC4duN2SghYGdeiwB61oECjcXB.name: Unity in Diversity
Qmat1y23J3aKLbyC4duN2SghYGdeiwB61oECjcXB.description:
(24 hours, 24 different colour color variations).
Difference is a necessity, created so that there is a balance of life. If color is a visual language that represents all the differences that exist, then what we see with both eyes, will not be able to represent all the differences that have been created in the universe. It takes thought, understanding and appreciation. Abstract Expressionist painting for me is a way of understanding the visible and the invisible. Freedom to cultivate imagination, empathy, to the deepest feelings. Today's life, which is all mechanical, applications and instant, often makes us forget that we are human beings who have hearts and minds. This work is based on my large scale painting on canvas.

Qmat4W2pvRiDWJdPdDZabbbQoPjmCci6dZJx4je4.name: Butterfly #1
Qmat4W2pvRiDWJdPdDZabbbQoPjmCci6dZJx4je4.description: According to one theory, the creative process is the organizing of the imagination. Judging by the colors, I have a wild imagination. Organizing it, I added wings. I got the Butterfly, but you might see something different. My butterflies turned out to be somewhat ominous. I experience this state from time to time. However, I want to learn how to control this and I am working on it. The theme of this series is self-improvement, since the butterfly is the main symbol of the transformation from crawling-ugly to soaring-sublime. This topic will be close to those who aspire to become the best version of themselves. As for the controversial black-red tandem; these have been my favorite colors for a long time. However, due to their aggressiveness, I was ashamed of this. In the Butterflies series, I gave freedom to my feelings. After that my art began to shine with a new, infinitely varied range of colors.

QmatNZL52Ls2YQzBrmWbkSMLTpd6TLR7M3e9tQSt.name: Of Masks and Memories
QmatNZL52Ls2YQzBrmWbkSMLTpd6TLR7M3e9tQSt.description:
We are made of memories, and with time, as our memories change, we change. 

When one think of 'memories', most people think of recordings, stored somehow, ready to be played back at any time, but they are so much more. They are states of mind caused by experience that are in constant flux, and which transform us. Neither our memories, nor how we feel about them, are static. They change over time and cause a process of unending transformation through which we are constantly creating and destroying ourselves.

Through all this, there are countless possible "selves" behind a mask, and the mask is the self that, finally, is presented to the world. Sometimes it is easy to forget that the mask is not who we are... Our "true self" is actually those multiple selves whom we sometimes hide, sometimes briefly reveal, sometimes try to forget...

QmavFZ6HNJf6PjcgzbmM6NGTm5oEeMSL2QWsqoLH.name: Ziggy Stardust
QmavFZ6HNJf6PjcgzbmM6NGTm5oEeMSL2QWsqoLH.description:
Born in Brixton, South London, David Bowie developed an interest in music as a child. He studied art, music and design before embarking on a professional career as a musician in 1963. Ziggy Stardust is a fictional character created by Bowie, and was Bowie's stage persona during 1972 and 1973. 

A tribute to David Robert Jones (8 January 1947 – 10 January 2016) Rip.

Qmaw6crnVafPTQNcReASgbRYdiP8rE8bYHEQB15W.description:
This artwork consists of 4 separate digital drawings in a Day/Night cycle as enabled by Async Art's technology.

...

Hearing the vocals of Fish when I was 16 was an unforgettable moment. I guess it was Warm Wet Circles the first time and soon after I discovered the early works of Marillion including a set of incredible B sides.

Now many a time later, I fed some of the lines from Script for Jester's Tear to the VQAN+CLIP software. I experimented with the results with additions, my photographs and some iterations to arrive at these images. The final edit in Photoshop was only for sizing and minor contrast curve adjustment. The artwork is pretty much AI x HoT as it came out.

...

QmawhJFkfLJRxxR8hMmWSDmdTYw1nfrAUMv3BvT8.name: Experimental No.3 #1998
QmawhJFkfLJRxxR8hMmWSDmdTYw1nfrAUMv3BvT8.description:
Artwork Title: Experimental No.3 #1998
Date of Artwork: 2021
Dimension: 1738 pixel x 2160 pixel
Type of Work: Silver Gelatin Photogram, Digital Painting
Edition: Unique
Note: This artwork is a type of digital art. The hand-made photogram is one of the subjects that compose this piece, and this photogram is not for sale separately whatever in the crypto world or the real world.

Notwithstanding, the beginning of the photography is representational, it ultimately leads to the way of the abstract. Photography has nothing to do with painting, although the thinking of abstractness renders them getting closer and closer. Photography remains the interpretation of "Light", and to express the “Light” is its inescapable responsibility. I find the "Line" could be one of the forms to present the "Light". I apply the "Line", also is the "Light", to destroy a completed and finished photograph, and change it into a new form of art and have a unique way of spreading and viewing. Through this new attempt to keep looking for balance and harmony.

Original watercolor portrait edited and transformed into collage work. I have huge love for patterns and ornaments and often I use them in my paintings and works. Pattern is sort of meditation, repeating something brings piece to my mind while working. 
Here is a small illustration of personal view over Life subject. Every layer of fabric representing one of the experiences we felt. And ornaments on them represent details that marked that specific event.

Qmb1eeFbFEw1ccDyPBNyZUCBTEojXAcKhjGvWPr9.description:
Have you ever talked to a tree?

I talked to a tree for a year. I've seen every aspect of that tree. Its first leaves, its broken branches, its anxiety for the future and the attack of people on it.

That tree endured everything in silence.

He was still alive when I left.

Qmb1gk4itHUBnGSjUM6TwNhL1bcfN7ZcPnxPZJbz.name: Moonwalk
Qmb1gk4itHUBnGSjUM6TwNhL1bcfN7ZcPnxPZJbz.description:
Moonwalk is a pop art portrait with 4 different states and color combinations associated with moods during different times in a day.

It is primarily oriented towards the theme of success and what is needed to make it, as well as the question of privacy and what it is that distinguishes an individual from others. 
Collective vs individual. Success vs failure. Fame vs anonymity. Fans vs haters.

I tried.
You didn't.
I'm done.
Have fun.

Trust your dopeness.

Qmb2vXLTNttpKGLsbyxx9bHBjkNHwGpt2qhjQkSr.name: "Vision of Persistence"
Qmb2vXLTNttpKGLsbyxx9bHBjkNHwGpt2qhjQkSr.description:
"Vision of Persistence"
Continuing on my 40 year celebration, and as a marker for this place in time, I wanted to make something very special and have some personal meaning to me and those who can appreciate how long I have persisted with this vision.

So much has changed in digital art since I started in 1981. We were only just beginning to digitize real world objects and storing images in digital format. Back then I had the good fortune to become friends with some heavy hitters in the pioneering stages of our beloved industry. Fractals, computer generated art, virtual reality, even 3d rendering were known only to the supernerds and geek club guys like me.  Even then for those with vision we saw that eventually we would be where we are now. Thanks to my contacts and their constant inspiration and moral support I spent 35+ years making cgi and everything digital media my career. Retired from professional life I am now focusing completely on my art. I can never forget a few things said to me by my mentors.

"Never worry about the technology to achieve your artistic vision. Concentrate on your art and the tech will be there whenever you are ready for it." - Cliff Johnson "The Great OZ"

"Pay no attention to what is popular or trendy. Find a style and own it. Always be willing to adapt when new tools come along but stay true to yourself and your vision." - Ken Musgrave "Doc Mojo 

"The best stuff can be found at the boundary between order and chaos. It is in this zone where the real action is." - Benoit Mandelbrot "Uncle Benny"

This dynamic 24 hour autonomous piece "Vision of Persistence" is dedicated to all the "old guys" that encouraged and mentored me all along the way. Next stop? 50 yr. anniversary and fully immersive art experiences!

Qmb4Q7hJBKDZuH6s4v1ypQmPyW4GRuyJt1LrGCzo.name: THE DREAM KEEPERS: Cover + Signed Physical Book
Qmb4Q7hJBKDZuH6s4v1ypQmPyW4GRuyJt1LrGCzo.description:
This piece is the cover art for my children’s book, THE DREAM KEEPERS.  A true one-of-a-kind, this is only time I will offer this cover art NFT with 24 changing states.

Plus, only for the collector of the primary sale, I will mail you a signed copy of the actual children’s book.  After the auction is settled, just DM my Twitter account to provide shipping information.  You can also request a hand-written message if this is a gift to the little Dreamer in your life.

THE DREAM KEEPERS was published by POW Kids Books in August of 2021, and I am the author and illustrator.  It’s a story about perseverance and positivity. Dreams can come true when you team up with these two helpers - Hard Work and Happy Thoughts!

This NFT updates each hour, in a 24-hour cycle. Small stars change location and color, and there is one state that is true to the actual book cover.  Can you find it?  Plus as a bonus at midnight, there’s a peek into my illustration process... my original sketch.  It’s not exactly the same as the final cover.  Can you find the parts that evolved throughout the creative process?  

As one of the very few children’s illustrators working in the NFT community, I feel like I’m exploring uncharted territory.  This cover art is the very beginning of introducing NFT art and blockchain technology to a new generation.  I hope you’ll join me.

Qmb5gM1oTV3kHsrWadfoKjcDjWsYuFcEpYdy22fM.name: Sean Connery
Qmb5gM1oTV3kHsrWadfoKjcDjWsYuFcEpYdy22fM.description:
The name’s Connery, Sean Connery. What better way to continue the ICON series than with 007 himself. The epitome of cool, Connery captivated audiences for decades with his portrayal of James Bond. He embodied the character so naturally, and in doing so set the benchmark for what it means to be a Gentleman. This film still, from the first scene of the first Bond movie ever released, sets the tone for the rest of the franchise.

The master is bundled with three layers. The owner of the master will receive ownership over all three layers and will be able to customize the chip count by altering the colors of the poker plaques. White = $1,000, Yellow = $2,000, Pink = $5,000, Blue = $10,000, Purple = $100,000, Orange = $500,000, and Red = $1,000,000. Right now Bond has $2,000 pushed in, but it’s up to you to decide how much he has at stake in the next hand. And if for some reason Lady Luck isn’t on your side, well there’s nothing a Vesper martini can’t cure. Shaken, not stirred of course. 

In addition to the master and all of the layers, the owner will receive the unique 1/1 framed polaroid set of the 12 original polaroids used to create this NFT. The frame measures 20'' x 15'' and will come with a signed certificate of authenticity.

Qmb5i8zQqT56hQPCtfKNicBr8D7G6zKJdSzGooda.name: Real Imaginary Async #2
Qmb5i8zQqT56hQPCtfKNicBr8D7G6zKJdSzGooda.description:
How deep would you go following the infinite patterns of The Real Imaginary Verse. Indefinite Sunsets and Sunrises, yet defeating Time and Space.
This reminds me of the spiral dynamics theory. Organisms in the universe go through a predictable set of stages of development. These stages each exhibit a set of values that the organism tries to obtain. 
Such an amazing feeling to experience this powerful moment full cycle, calm and serine, full of energy, yet stormy and intense of vibrancy. 

"If I have seen further than others, it is by standing upon the shoulders of giants."  – Isaac Newton

Qmb68wuuyh1yfrgyCtBsHcUmDAqQLPkqXTo8TaA8.name: Confluence Vol.1
Qmb68wuuyh1yfrgyCtBsHcUmDAqQLPkqXTo8TaA8.description:
(n.) the place where two or more things merge, or the act of merging.

In the serie 'Confluence' I experienced the shapes not as solitarily existing in the canvas as they are, but creating an aesthetic composition by merging and interacting within each other as a whole with an exploration of distortion, texture, and color. Besides, I tried to keep the art away from the visual expression of the real world and concentrate on the pure artistic feeling above all.

metadata.name: Confluence Vol.1
metadata.description:
(n.) the place where two or more things merge, or the act of merging.

In the serie 'Confluence' I experienced the shapes not as solitarily existing in the canvas as they are, but creating an aesthetic composition by merging and interacting within each other as a whole with an exploration of distortion, texture, and color. Besides, I tried to keep the art away from the visual expression of the real world and concentrate on the pure artistic feeling above all.

Qmb6uYXM1fsUupUTBaM8vYrr8qybfy4z4M9jprmW.name: More Than Glass
Qmb6uYXM1fsUupUTBaM8vYrr8qybfy4z4M9jprmW.description: This piece represents the virtual convening of five strangers at the start of the COVID-19 pandemic, each of us responding to the reality of suddenly being plunged into a life of almost total isolation. We squinted at each other through flat grids on glass screens. Over the course of months, gathering in a back alley of a digital megalopolis, we typed columns of words about philosophy, symbolism and identity, Bruce Lee and King’s Cross, poetry, the I Ching, Ancient Kemet... We typed our frustrations and joys and obsessions at each other. Time passed. Time is still passing – and meanwhile we weave together our experience living walled off from the world we could touch, creating from our reciprocal estrangement this ever-shifting tapestry.

Qmb74eFAqhXkEb893ZzECiJb7GqFgV7SFPvfivsS.name: Street Photography, Japan - ストリートフォトグラフィー
Qmb74eFAqhXkEb893ZzECiJb7GqFgV7SFPvfivsS.description:
A series of 6 black and white street photos I took during my time in Japan (full descriptions below). 
The idea was to use the 24 hours autonomous template with only 6 images which change every hour. This way wherever you are you'll be able to enjoy the full set of images. 
The 6 photos are part of the series: "WABI-SABI: Acceptance of transience... The Beauty of things that are Imperfect, Impermanent, Incomplete." 
There are lots of details in these images. It is ideal to show this artwork on a large 4K screen. Please take the time to look at them on full screen. Thank you.

DESCRIPTION OF PHOTOS:

1. "Wa": Harmony. The harmonious heart of the Japanese value system | Reflections... Into The Depth Of Life.
KYOTO - I was standing behind the man with the umbrella taking a picture of his reflection on the window while he was looking into the shop at the two women working. The idea was to create something like a double exposure but within a single shot. Many layers in this image. 

2. “Satori”: Enlightenment. 
TOKYO - To attain Satori a person must get rid of all their desires and enmities at the source... This monk in the middle of the busy streets of Tokyo was completely detached from the chaos of daily life.

3. "Reflect On Yourself, The Dance Of Man And God"
KAMAKURA - The idea was to show "Man" as the small entity he is in comparison to the greater powers at play such as nature/universe/energy. The little man seems to be dancing in front of his God, which in reality is just a reflection of what he does not fully understand.
I took this photograph with certain elements in mind:
- the small man is in direct contrast with the large reflection of the Buddha (to balance it out).
- the part of the Buddha at the top is the one missing in the reflection.
- The "leading" lines of the pavements have been used to direct the viewer's attention to the "real" subject... the little man. 

4. “Mono no Aware”: Pathos. Contemplating the Fleeting Beauty and elegance in action. 
YOKOHAMA - My objective was to freeze the moment yet retain some movement on the main subject (the hair of the woman, the dress, the shoe) to make the photo more dynamic and interesting. Also, the woman walking out of frame was part of the intention, so that it appears she is leaving (this is not a crop but the full image). Please note that there is no model in this image - it is just someone walking by.
All of these elements were combined to convey the idea of Fleeting Beauty and Elegance... no beauty will last forever, and the Sakura/Hanami itself is a symbol of the transience of beauty in Japanese culture.

5. "Setsu": Transition. An important turning point in life.
TOKYO - When I saw this couple leaving each other, I composed the shot using the phone boot to balance the white rectangle where the two people are standing.

6. “Uchi to Soto:” Inside and outside social relationships. Who to share your feeling with.
KYOTO - A street photography composition.

Qmb7Mtq1SnowaeokWzGMv2SSxyKMB1X7yFaTgTdQ.name: Kids Takeover Putin: Nova Apartchik #3
Qmb7Mtq1SnowaeokWzGMv2SSxyKMB1X7yFaTgTdQ.description:
Based on Putin photography, Kids Takeover Putin is text-to-image experimentation on war, peace and leadership. It is re-creating the leadership in the eyes of a kid takeover for peace.

Stop the War. We hoped, I hoped this was already the past in Europe. We should not go back.

There is a lot of interesting material that range from childish and peaceful to satirical and dark. I will post them and perhaps I will post most of them hoping this ends as soon as possible.

This is one of the 12 2-piece Nova Apartchiks on Async Art. There is also 1 24 piece set and some 4-piece somewhat more abstract pieces on Async Art. For multi editions and some other 1/1s, please visit my collection on KnownOrigin.

by Mad Monk, 1/1 on Async Art, 2022

QmbB2Q3dC5rXFKV9ySx4sMjLKA3SXAHbX4v366vp.name: Satoshi's Desk
QmbB2Q3dC5rXFKV9ySx4sMjLKA3SXAHbX4v366vp.description:
The enigma that is Satoshi Nakamoto may well never be solved, Many believe it to be a pseudonym, but for who? A mysterious Group of idividuals ? A lone Cyhper Punk ?  The answer is unclear , However, Many Theories have circled the internet. 
Dorian Nakamoto is a cult legend in the bitcoin 
Community and a face many recognise, Then there is a long list of OG Cyhper Punks that were 
experimenting with early Internet Money Payment Systems  , Such as 
Wei Da - B-Money, Adam Back - Hash Cash,
 Nick Szabo - Bitgold
Hal Finney was the first person to work with Satoshi on Bitcoins Creation and many sight the possibility that Hal may well have been the creator of the 
cryptocurrency , Which ever way you look there are more theories on origins of the number 1 
cryptocurrency. 
Satoshi’s Desk is a programmable piece of Art that places the viewer in the seat of Satoshi, Surrounded by many changable layers, symbolic items representative of Bitcoins 
History Can be displayed along with choices of 
Wallpaper, Cypher Punk Posters and much more.

QmbCGQQFjKbKt1M12Lx7aU1uGJnpXsg8Sn4urhsw.name: A Love Unspoken
QmbCGQQFjKbKt1M12Lx7aU1uGJnpXsg8Sn4urhsw.description:
This genesis work features a strong, solo feminine character presented in 4 different lighting situations and styles. It serves as a focal point to highlight some of the following traits that I admire in the women that I have the honour of calling mothers, sisters, friends, lovers and leaders. 

● Individuality
● Imagination
● Independence
● Intelligence

Know that you hold extremely special places in my heart and soul.
May we cherish our women and inspire them to greater futures than the past that they have been subjected to.
It starts with you ♥

QmbCawQ2Jtdb6kMqoUoqeAJv7nPZBskTM9JvKubt.name: Exit
QmbCawQ2Jtdb6kMqoUoqeAJv7nPZBskTM9JvKubt.description:
ABOUT THE ARTIST
------
Hello there, 

I am Gabor Molnar a 3D artist from Budapest, Hungary, and this is my first ever tokenized, NFT artwork. Following my creative passion, I started to learn digital techniques back in 2010 and worked as a graphic designer for a decade. In 2019 I decided to share my personal work and emotions with a wider audience via social medial channels which served as the foundation of a contemporary visual project called Dformer.  The positive welcome from the people was incredible to me as a result my work was featured 250+ times on curator pages. In my opinion, my biggest achievement so far that some of my works got exhibited in Madrid last year. 

The digital version of the exhibition is still available here:
https://supercorp.work/virtual-gallery


ABOUT THE ARTWORK
------
I've been working on this artwork since 2019. I have revamped once a year to see my skills sharpen and helped me through difficult times. This is an end of a long journey and also a nice start of something new: this is my first ever tokenized, NFT artwork.  

1st version - https://www.instagram.com/p/B7tTXAJndIB/
2nd version - https://www.instagram.com/p/B-LIA4jnR57/

----- 
I would love to meet if somebody buys this piece via a call or chat session!
Wishing you all the best, 
Gabor Molnar / Dformer

QmbCppDgAGw4A8MvZbHvaMfYBf61wpSfc9Qq68QV.name: The Spiritual Connection
QmbCppDgAGw4A8MvZbHvaMfYBf61wpSfc9Qq68QV.description: We are all one and the same, one of many, many of one, one of many, many as one. That is what defines life. That is what defines the bond, the connection between each of us, no matter what form we are, no matter what being we are, no matter where we are from, no matter when we are from. The Spiritual Connection embodies spiritually inspired art resulting from a look within and outward across and beyond the multiverse that can lead us to realize that we are part of the same, infinite consciousness; a realization that can surpass any of our individual or collective insecurities to reach and appreciate a sense of love, peace, and harmony.

QmbEN4YuHuTuPMGMgLp2JUS3bjypwhcaiQKwjS8s.name: Relief with Purpose
QmbEN4YuHuTuPMGMgLp2JUS3bjypwhcaiQKwjS8s.description:
Relief with Purpose
by Hulki Okan Tabak
minted 2021 on Async Art

2 artworks based on World War I propaganda posters from the US. Relief is the sister piece to From The Plain People on Async Art. It is a piece derived from the same working material I've used in the KnownOrigin mints titled Belgian Relief Uncle Sam Arrives and Belgian Relief On the Ground. Relief with Purpose takes the same material and further glitches and complicates the situation on one larger canvas. It is the darker starker and also more experimental offshoot of this sub-heading in the greater World War I posters series.

...

The Great War, history, politics, art, posters and propaganda are topics of interest for me. It was kind of natural that I wanted to incorporate that in my cryptoart creations. The desire led to a selection of public domain pieces out of copyright from the Library of Congress archives. I created all sorts of derivative pacifist and tongue-in-cheek works. So far I have only minted a handful on KnownOrigin. Starting September 2021, I will mint a more comprehensive set on Async Art and KO depending on the nature of the final artwork. The artwork presented here is part of that World War I Posters set.

QmbEagUaUTgDJW4hkDAXTr2SspadGdj8PDrN7WkQ.name: So many
QmbEagUaUTgDJW4hkDAXTr2SspadGdj8PDrN7WkQ.description:
So many hands, so many people, so many planets, so many stars, so many galaxies.
The project investigates the universal scale and the correlation between the small and the big. 
The Universe is in our hands and our hands hold the Cosmos, a complex and orderly system or entity; the opposite of chaos.
We are so many but we all co-exist and constitute One Universe.
Based on the artwork "The waiting hands" / 2010
Digital 3d, created in 2021

QmbEcn9TDGgzLmdu4Uw6dmbAvWDjVppeT7CR7Wkx.name: One Day in the Mind Garden
QmbEcn9TDGgzLmdu4Uw6dmbAvWDjVppeT7CR7Wkx.description:
It was the summer of 2019, I took a set of macro photographs over the course of two days in a beautiful small island garden. It was my intention to photograph beyond what I see and to do this I deep dived in to the macro world. The resulting outputs were then processed with filters I developed for the project on Photoshop. Afterwards I used some of the photographs in a Google Books project and minted couple of items on the ETH blockchain. One Day in the Mind Garden is the most significant artwork idea undertaken using these photographs. I have used 24 separate photographs for the project. 

One Day in the Mind Garden by Hulki Okan Tabak
Minted in the middle of the 2021 summer on Async Art

metadata.name: One Day in the Mind Garden
metadata.description:
It was the summer of 2019, I took a set of macro photographs over the course of two days in a beautiful small island garden. It was my intention to photograph beyond what I see and to do this I deep dived in to the macro world. The resulting outputs were then processed with filters I developed for the project on Photoshop. Afterwards I used some of the photographs in a Google Books project and minted couple of items on the ETH blockchain. One Day in the Mind Garden is the most significant artwork idea undertaken using these photographs. I have used 24 separate photographs for the project. 

One Day in the Mind Garden by Hulki Okan Tabak
Minted in the middle of the 2021 summer on Async Art

QmbG2Mmwa6pmbavNuLXTvFo3c9ykJaDVNrLkznLK.name: Extracts from The Mystical Microzoology of Mathematics
QmbG2Mmwa6pmbavNuLXTvFo3c9ykJaDVNrLkznLK.description:
The expert consensus on “The Mystical Microzoology of Mathematics” is that it is a late 20th century hoax manuscript of mixed anonymous authorship, scans of which were first unveiled at a private, invitation-only America Online forum catering to Esperanto enthusiasts in 2001.

The origin story that captured the popular imagination is based on the codex’s internal claim that it is a faithful recreation of documents, themselves reproductions of earlier medieval tomes, entrusted to Zamenhof during the inaugural World Esperanto Congress of 1905.

The primary thesis of the text is that there exist an infinitude of “animalcules” on the immortal mathematical plane, and they have inscrutable sympathetic connections to the other planes of reality, allowing their arcane placement into specialized configurations to reify mystical pre-human prayers of supplication on behalf of the arranger, thus being akin to immobile prayer wheels of sorts.

Of course, the endotextual claims of the manuscript’s pre-modern origins along with its other propositions are contradicted by the very focus of their mystical enquiries, as the microbial-looking forms featured on its illustrated folios are fractal figures more commonly known as Pickover biomorphs, only discovered in the late 1980s.

Nonetheless, this programmable cryptoart work is intended to facilitate the digital reification of all possible valid patterns within the limits stated and implied by extant fragments of the codex, well in excess of the handful of surviving illustrated pages believed to be authentic.

150 billion unique combinations of the biomorph figures, spread through 5 trees, are possible, and taking all other parameters into account, there exist precisely 6.75 trillion visually unique configurations that layer owners can bring to life.

The folio number in the left corner uniquely identifies every single possible variant.

QmbHLXpYrpVVoMSiFDahMCMWhHvX6dzCfeoFQwoE.name: Digital Distance
QmbHLXpYrpVVoMSiFDahMCMWhHvX6dzCfeoFQwoE.description:
Of all of the obstacles we must overcome to build a flourishing community, it is the distance between us that demands the most energy but that also inspires and excites. Many of us have discovered new friends on the far side of the world, distance many will never traverse, physically, but that is digitally just seconds away. We build these relationships in a digital world. Not unlike the physical world, we also need to learn to cope with this digital distance. 

This work is based on the series "Distance", Monotype prints in ink on paper. As an active member of the NFT community, I've discovered the many parallels between the physical and digital distances that impact our relationships; for better and worse. Not only are territorial distances that impact time zones but also cultural, generational and gender distances that must be carefully and thoughtfully navigated. Each of these have kept us separate from each other at times, everyone retreating to a safe distance, due to lack of mutual understanding. Here in the NFT space we've learned from each other's individual experiences, appreciating and inspiring everyone and inevitably reducing the distance between us. 

That's how we are building a strong community and a better future.

QmbHge7C2ELSr2YewUch5Ye8GejYqXVJwgtgQzDX.name: ​​OUR FATHER IN THE METAVERSE #77
QmbHge7C2ELSr2YewUch5Ye8GejYqXVJwgtgQzDX.description:
https://mathiasrusch-metaverse.com/

The "Our Father" - The cycle of paintings by artist Mathias Rusch (*1927-2003)   

If we speak of the most important prayer of Christian faith, then of the "Our Father".  
 
This prayer gift of Jesus to his disciples, later handed down to us Christians, has become the actual Christian self-understanding, the "prayer of the Lord". Packed into a few sentences, it has come to be regarded as the actual confession of faith and is prayed millions of times a day, both individually and in communities. The fact that this "conversation with God" has hardly ever been depicted (in contrast to the Passion) is probably due to the immense message it conveys. The fact that the painter Mathias Rusch dared to translate the "Our Father" can be explained by the fact that his daily work was based on faith, hope, and trust in God. Mathias Rusch was aware that he could only exist in the understanding of his art "as a gift of God". Most of his late works (Our Father, Live and Let Live, Sermon on the Mount, Lauretan Litany, Litany of the Sacred Heart) were written, as he confessed, under the "kind help" of the Highest, always accompanied by personal prayers, meditations or invocations. The fact that Mathias Rusch did not reveal a word for the interpretation of his works of art is to be justified by the fact that he understood himself to a large extent as a mediator of a higher power. Thus we are sometimes quite helplessly confronted with an immense abundance of Christian symbols, metaphysical allusions, concretizations, and abstractions, in unique hues and compositions. Completely in the sense of Mathias Rusch we dive before the 13 works of art into the enormous topic of earthly existence and Christian eschatology, marvel before the color power, before the hints, confessions, and convictions of the very deeply felt "Our Father's". Finally, we become humbled and ultimately grateful to be initiated into the world-prayer of a "knowing" believer, again and again, with each glance at each of these magnificent works of art. Whoever takes a longer "eye" look at this self-contained, unique complete work, consisting of 13 unique pieces in oil on canvas, 170x170cm, will not be able to resist a lasting effect and deep consternation.

QmbJCj8kmiAuKEqVEYQkbBTK6fGD9fYsJ1YLqDWv.name: The 25th message
QmbJCj8kmiAuKEqVEYQkbBTK6fGD9fYsJ1YLqDWv.description:
24 women. 24 messages. Every hour you get a message from time zones covering the entire planet. They use characters from their own languages to write the universal word: peace. A multicultural, multiethnic, and multilingual planetary request: PEACE.

But seems there is an error: UTC +05:00 is the Universal Standard Time for Kazakhstan, Tajikistan, Pakistan, Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan… but not Afghanistan, which is the only country in the world UTC+04:30. 
…
The Sharia law started half an hour ago. 
Once again, we were late. Again system error. 
This “undercover” message from Kabul is the 25th message.
Details here: 
https://www.theneimus.com/neimu-ludovico/the-25th-message

QmbKSRjBbiVHgZxTVj1gJeL3nZUnzUjvYTzCbjJy.name: Weeping Rose
QmbKSRjBbiVHgZxTVj1gJeL3nZUnzUjvYTzCbjJy.description: My heart, along with this rose, weeps for the people of Afghanistan, particularly the women and girls thrust into the medieval darkness of totalitarian dictatorship and gender apartheid.  As an adolescent I first read, in a novel of 19th century romance, the term, Hindu Kush.  The phrase washed over me like a strong perfume and my imagination was fired.  Afghanistan became a kind of Eden - a lush and exotic garden inhabited by beautiful and heroic people - for beyond my reach but enriching my world.  Would that I could today enrich the real world of my unknown, but beloved sisters there.  I weep, and pray that Afghanistan may see a new dawn.  Artist proceeds from the sale of this artwork will be donated to the Malala Fund: https://malala.org.

QmbKy9MiEEzkDuNnFk45JnhhaXK3UacATiUXogDA.name: Cubic Matrix
QmbKy9MiEEzkDuNnFk45JnhhaXK3UacATiUXogDA.description:
There are 64 layers and 256 states of cubes with different heights which you can change if you own the layer.
  The master itself is as simple as canvas at the beginning. After you own the layers separately, the master artwork will start to change and act dynamically and create different artworks in a randomized way.
  Also you can achieve colors according to your cube's position if you get the maximum height, which also create an extra layer of dynamism on the master artwork.

QmbL8Bi9VemCxsSbNmGUjgLUjmTS9MDF5PYYcboE.name: Chess and Addicts
QmbL8Bi9VemCxsSbNmGUjgLUjmTS9MDF5PYYcboE.description: Chess and Addicts portrays the beauty of chess game and the love for it which isn't confined to any boundaries, be it place, age, gender, time, physical presence, life, death and many more represented in metaphorical ways. With every layer of the piece adding to the emotional factors surrounding the match, it also symbolises how a very small change can create a whole new story and perspective shown by the piece.

QmbLKTGqYYJBB8PF1YvxEhosA1BkhCixcJRoTaU9.name: Mental DNA
QmbLKTGqYYJBB8PF1YvxEhosA1BkhCixcJRoTaU9.description:
We believe that alongside a real DNA there exists a mental one. One of the mental DNA’s components is our dreams. They include common dreams that all people share and a small part of dreams that make each person unique, just like that one percent of distinctive genes that make one an individual with unparalleled features.
   A collector or a DAO led by their own mindset randomly combines and selects a sequence of images close to them and has a chance to create various mental DNA paragraphs referring to their own unique ideas and dreams.
   Dreaming is a natural human condition. A human cannot live without dreaming. A true dream is very much like the horizon. Very often it is almost inaccessible, which does not make it less real though. That is why each of us always has an impetus to go on living and creating.

QmbLSABHwLPBjUyBff3bMxgtaib8WhFGADmFyauf.name: Planet Earth
QmbLSABHwLPBjUyBff3bMxgtaib8WhFGADmFyauf.description:
Planet Earth, my home, my place
A capricious anomaly, in the sea of space
Planet Earth, are you just
Floating by, a cloud of dust
A minor globe, about to bust
A piece of metal bound to rust
A speck of matter in a mindless void
A lonely spaceship, a large asteroid

Cold as a rock without a hue
Held together with a bit of glue
Something tells me this isn't true
You are my sweetheart, soft and blue
Do you care, have you a part
In the deepest emotions of my own heart
Tender with breezes, caressing and whole
Alive with music, haunting my soul

In my veins I've felt the mystery
Of corridors of time, books of history
Life songs of ages throbbing in my blood
Have danced to the rhythm of the tide and flood
Your misty clouds, your electric storm
Were turbulent tempests in my own form

I've licked the salt, the bitter, the sweet
Of every encounter, of passion, of heat
Your riotous color, your fragrance, your taste
Have thrilled my senses beyond all haste

In your beauty I've known the how
Of timeless bliss, this moment of now

Planet Earth, are you just
Floating by, a cloud of dust
A minor globe, about to bust
A piece of metal bound to rust
A speck of matter in a mindless void
A lonely spaceship, a large asteroid

Cold as a rock without a hue
Held together with a bit of glue
Something tells me this isn't true
You are my sweetheart, gentle and blue
Do you care, have you a part
In the deepest emotions of my own heart
Tender with breezes, caressing and whole
Alive with music, haunting my soul

Planet Earth, gentle and blue
With all my heart, I love you

(MJ - 1995)
