QmbMAhiWRuccQj13pXLzo7iCQQNhPUFGTC58YJzS.name: The Duchess Theatre Variety Show of Kittywood
QmbMAhiWRuccQj13pXLzo7iCQQNhPUFGTC58YJzS.description:
When Duchess retired from Kittywood, she bought an old prop house from a friend. Even though she made the decision not to take another acting job, she wanted to remain in the Business in some way. It had been her life since she was a kitten! 

One morning at sunrise, Duchess was loading some furniture into her van at the back of the building, when she noticed 5 sleepy kittens huddled in the cold. She knew that homelessness was a problem in Kittywood (having experienced it firsthand herself) and decided to build a shelter at the prop house. 

Kitty Tent City facilitates the adoptions and ensures that the kittens are neutered or spayed and receive their vaccines. Over the years, many of Duchess' clients have adopted her kittens. Many of the kittens have stayed on to work in the prop house, help her run the shelter or have gone into the Business themselves.

Once a year, Duchess hosts and emcees the Duchess Theatre Variety Show featuring all the kittens-in-residence. It is a fundraiser for all the homeless kittens in Kittywood. You can usually find agents and managers in the audience, scouting for an up-and-coming starlet. Sometimes Duchess even performs!

The 24 hour images are a rotation of The Duchess Theatre Variety Show in two 12 hour cycles. It is always night in Kittywood, so no matter what time it is where you are, you are part of the party. 

1   Sunset Boulevard
2   House Party
3   By the Light of the Silvery Moon
4   Into the Night
5   Midnight Express
6   The Dark Side of the Moon
7   LA Confidential
8   Through the Glass Darkly
9   Eyes Wide Shut
10 Sunrise: A Song of Two Humans
11 The World's a Little Blurry
12 I gotta go to bed, it's too bright out

QmbQzkqxH3pgNcfLbSnMubusf79uLeRr4cufaDN4.name: War Clouds Gather
QmbQzkqxH3pgNcfLbSnMubusf79uLeRr4cufaDN4.description:
War Clouds Gather 
by Hulki Okan Tabak
minted 2021 on Async Art

24 artworks based on a World War I US Navy propaganda poster - "WAR CLOUDS GATHER! / Manhood Willing But Unarmed / Help The Navy / Join The Navy League / Local Headquarters"

One hidden surprise image embedded somewhere for fun.

...

The Great War, history, politics, art, posters and propaganda are topics of interest for me. It was kind of natural that I wanted to incorporate that in my cryptoart creations. The desire led to a selection of public domain pieces out of copyright from the Library of Congress archives. I created all sorts of derivative pacifist and tongue-in-cheek works. So far I have only minted a handful on KnownOrigin. Starting September 2021, I will mint a more comprehensive set on Async Art and KO depending on the nature of the final artwork. The artwork presented here is part of that World War I Posters set.

QmbR3GfSKWJrz5m9TajAe1yfAam9kmii6hNXGRNF.description:
Based on Putin photography, Kids Takeover Putin is text-to-image experimentation on war, peace and leadership. It is re-creating the leadership in the eyes of a kid takeover for peace.

Stop the War. We hoped, I hoped this was already the past in Europe. We should not go back.

There is a lot of interesting material that range from childish and peaceful to satirical and dark. I will post them and perhaps I will post most of them hoping this ends as soon as possible.

This is one of the 12 2-piece Nova Apartchiks on Async Art. There is also 1 24 piece set and some 4-piece somewhat more abstract pieces on Async Art. For multi editions and some other 1/1s, please visit my collection on KnownOrigin.

by Mad Monk, 1/1 on Async Art, 2022

Transition is psychological; Change is situational. 

It is not events, but rather the inner reorientation and self-redefinition that you have to go through in order to incorporate any changes into your life.”

Transition is the internal process of gradual psychological orientation to change.
 
Transition can result from actual change and/or from the awareness of forthcoming change.

Change is hard and it challenges us at fundamental levels, bringing into question all sorts of fixed ideas that we have about ourselves, our identity and our capabilities.

Change Transition is created by WINCHAWA ///

QmbUkLB14f54WYAqsQAwciUzCH31rSy81sgcMrxJ.name: Questgiver
QmbUkLB14f54WYAqsQAwciUzCH31rSy81sgcMrxJ.description:
Questgiver is a satirical app developed by paleh0rs3 to ask the question:

"What if mid-conversation we could pull up an Uber-style app to break free from the imposed limits on acceptable thoughts?"

In almost any social situation we're implicitly forced to choose from a set of response options as if we're non-playable characters, or quest givers, in a video game. And often this is for good reason: the human mind harbors darkness and despair that our fellow citizens are usually best left unaware of.

We often joke about living in a simulation to conjure apprehension, but on some axes, we're most comfortable when the options are limited and predictable.

Questgiver's UI was handcrafted for the 16:9 aspect ratio optimal for displaying Async pieces on televisions and digital frames. The concept for a "Questgiver Terminal" was inspired by the "expected waiting time" screens for public transport / ridesharing apps in high-end lobbies. It gives a publicly observable screen on which passersby can view nearby Questgivers engaging in uncomfortable conversations.

Each conversation features completely fake yet convincing human portraits generated via AI on ThisPersonDoesNotExist.com. In addition, the conversations utilize a stylized "dialog tree," which is actually a method employed to model NPC interactions in video games. Each dialog tree is spawned by a remark from the non-Questgiver. The first column of the tree contains two "socially acceptable" responses that have been greyed out in favor of the transgressive response. The app then generates a predicted counter-response to the Questgiver's unacceptably choice words, which prompts three more even worse options to become available.

Since it was designed to be shown on a public display in a well-trafficked area, the concept was a natural fit for the 24H Async template. At each hour of the day, a new Questgiver is highlighted to emulate the dynamic nature of conversations occurring 24/7.

So go find your nearest Questgiver Terminal today.

Maybe you'll even strike up a conversation over what you both witness...

MAP ATTRIBUTION
Questgiver utilizes a static snapshot of a map from Mapbox
To learn more, visit https://www.mapbox.com/about/maps/ and http://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
© Mapbox, © OpenStreetMap

QmbWWm5AE6knBpxKASk2T2VPuuhaeHA9N8kLieL2.name: Unfairground monthly report
QmbWWm5AE6knBpxKASk2T2VPuuhaeHA9N8kLieL2.description:
Denizen shadow is the natural-born winner. He wasn't born in this place and nobody remembers when he appeared; seems like he has been living here his whole life. He has a special gift to convince people to believe in whatever he comes up with. Every day he has a new follower. As days are passing and more and more shadows gather around him, also the gossip starts to spread. The month is nearing its end, critical mass is growing bigger and bigger and on the last day of the month, they unmask him. Everybody leaves him and he is alone again. But not for a long. Shadows quickly forget and start to gather around him again. This cycle repeats itself month after month, till the end of the internet...  
The first twenty protagonists of this artwork are tokenized under Marko Zubak contract, using Mintbase and Arweave (https://opensea.io/collection/marko-zubak-2).
MLIBTY Shadows represent people in general but also shadows behind the curtains, invisible inhabitants you never meet, but you feel their presence. Sometimes they are watching you, sometimes they smile, black and white, no hands and no legs, shadows with faces. One day, this shadow may become a famous protagonist of one of MLIBTY Shadows art pieces. More about the artist: http://www.markozubak.com

QmbaDDUicQJ3D8ZH98ExY6qKgp5ZRmHTiC91aUYK.name: Taking Memories
QmbaDDUicQJ3D8ZH98ExY6qKgp5ZRmHTiC91aUYK.description:
"...I could leave these shores,
I could sail home, I could
take something with me,
I could leave something in
return, and at that word
it came back, alive."
---from Vapor Wake by Mary Ruefle

This is a 2 x 2 x 2 series. 2 states, 2 photographs, 2 artworks. Making Memories and Taking Memories are  out of town fun on the road. Photographs are  from 1997. 

As I've read or heard somewhere not that long ago, possibly by Slavoj Zizek or my mind plays with me -- he was saying that memories are meaningful only if photographed. It would not mean much to have memories if there was no way store them. 

He of whoever it was meant to say that memory making, memory taking and memory recalling are interlinked. Logically, emotionally, socially and economically.

QmbakY8owStPiw1XQYKFK1t3KkjZLCyjqNvj7ha6.name: / THE MERMEID & LAMIA /
QmbakY8owStPiw1XQYKFK1t3KkjZLCyjqNvj7ha6.description:
After a shipwreck, an exhausted survivor struggles to reach shore by clinging to an algae-covered rock to climb out of the dark waters. Exhausted, he cannot resist the undertow and treacherous currents that threaten to carry him under the waves. At this critical moment, he is struck by the beautiful vision of a young woman sitting on the rock with pearly white skin and parted lips singing a song :


“Who would be

A mermaid fair,

Singing alone,

Combing her hair…”


-----------------------------------------------------------------------


Después de un naufragio, un superviviente exhausto lucha por alcanzar la costa aferrándose a una roca cubierta de algas para salir de las aguas oscuras. Agotado, no puede resistirse a la resaca y las corrientes traicioneras que amenazan con arrastrarlo bajo las olas. En este momento crítico, le sorprende la hermosa visión de una joven sentada en la roca con la piel de un color blanco nacarado y los labios abiertos entonando una canción. Su expresión es enigmática y no sabemos si le ayudará o le hará daño, pero no hay duda de que el marinero está hechizado por su pálida belleza y su mágica melodía.


“ Who would be

A mermaid fair,

Singing alone,

Combing her hair…”

------------------------------------------------------------------------------

· Inspired in John William Waterhouse

QmbiebbyisNzzxHHBMZPUcbeyYqspGHDuhqHPJNo.name: "Mashup 821"
QmbiebbyisNzzxHHBMZPUcbeyYqspGHDuhqHPJNo.description: "Mashup 821" - When I first started making digital art in 1980 I captured images with a video camera and then composited them together in collages. Today we call them mashups. Since this is my first submission to Async I decided to return to my origins but with the dynamic twist! It changes every hour! This is a mashup of some of my favorite and most influential artists and pieces. Stylized and then blended to make a image that changes every hour always giving the viewer something new to look at. I have injected subpixel detail into the pieces so there is lots of detail to examine in every change.

QmbjbS8F42A9T3hMMjUj7EZ1DamNw3ygzb7CnFAF.name: Oneiric Ripples
QmbjbS8F42A9T3hMMjUj7EZ1DamNw3ygzb7CnFAF.description: A generative art piece where each layer has been created using the same algorithm with a slight variation of the base parameters. The layers change automatically each hour and the intensity of the pattern in the image varies from softer during the evening/night to more intense during daylight. For this creation I chose two set of colours: blue/violet and red. The contrast between cold and warm colours, their continuously changing position and the wavy pattern tend to create the same sensory experience I get when I’m dreaming or in deep sleep.

QmbkujEnoV8XgNQJ6g4DreHZT4tL18G9KHfvxbcA.name: Seven Chakras
QmbkujEnoV8XgNQJ6g4DreHZT4tL18G9KHfvxbcA.description: The Sanskrit word “Chakra” means “Disk” or “Wheels” and refers to the 7 points of energy in the human body. The 7 Chakras of spinning energy, each corresponds to certain nerves and major organs of the body. The Chakras are an ancient energy systems dating back to 1000 BC. With the passage of time and increased significance of alignment of mind and body the Chakras have gained a lot of importance in modern day fitness and health programs. It is believed there are around 114 Chakras in the human body, but the major influence is through the 7 chakras. The Chakras in our body defined our personality, health and lifestyle in general. By choosing your individual personality traits you can design a unique NFT that aligns with your persona & energy. The 7 Chakra NFT isn’t merely a digital art form but a unique representation of your personality.

QmbnrepM8gJZ8vwC4HNxXnNAeo9MT7nq7W5n5zZJ.name: The Volunteer
QmbnrepM8gJZ8vwC4HNxXnNAeo9MT7nq7W5n5zZJ.description:
The Volunteer
by Hulki Okan Tabak
4 piece programmable artwork on Async Art
1/1 minted September 2021

...

Part of a series of Marylebone, London based artworks. All of these works consist of photographs taken by me in January 2020. It is the time of Lunar New Year, Wuhan lockdowns, and the very first signs of the virus in Europe.

Marylebone was originally an Ancient Parish formed to serve the manors (landholdings) of Lileston (in the west - which gives its name to modern Lisson Grove) and Tyburn in the east. The parish is likely to have been in place since at least the twelfth century and will have used the boundaries of the pre-existing manors. The boundaries of the parish were consistent from the late twelfth century to the creation of the Metropolitan Borough which succeeded it. (Wikipedia)

QmbrJzaTaZszJ79w5K6rop1aeoVuYvQgvQkJikNw.description: Working with an A.I. can create some beautiful and chaotic pieces. A single tweak to a gene can drastically change the art that is produced. Crimson Awaiting was conceived after the G.A.N. I use gave me the first image of this piece. I enjoyed it but decided to change a few elements here and there. That gave me the second image. From there I kept up this process. The changes are meant to be subtle so that the core of the first image is always present but each image is still distinct from the one that came before it. Initially Crimson Awaiting was a project I worked on for fun but it feels like the ideal piece to list on Async using their 24 hour template.

Qmbrh68wkSNPDXa9gw3gHHG56cj8TK3ZySDsA11f.name: CodeSpace #1
Qmbrh68wkSNPDXa9gw3gHHG56cj8TK3ZySDsA11f.description: These geometric structures are created by conception at the intersection of the purely mathematical structure of figures and the cultural perspectives. Also, the lines in the structure are influenced by the creator's intention, as well as unconscious intervention elements to generate and deliver contemporary insights. In addition, individual geometric shape combined with each other can expand the possibilities of new spatial interpretation. ‘Found line', ‘Selected line', ‘Discovered line', ‘Intersected line', ‘Line with unstable proportions', ‘Curved line', ‘Sharp line', ‘Complex line' etc… These various kinds of 'lines' intersected each other, may enable us to get new aesthetic interpretations and appreciation. Those geometric forms could be harmonic traces  between the unpredictable lines of intuition and the lines with a rule. This CODESPACE project is for experimental question : the operability between the imperfection of the physical world and the perfection of the mathematical world, or on the contrary.

Qmbs9YnRKFRQmvyHoLKpKWYEUdWZpRytXdVGqx9n.name: Labor of Love | Mixed Media Collage
Qmbs9YnRKFRQmvyHoLKpKWYEUdWZpRytXdVGqx9n.description:
This project began as a tactile, mixed media collage series using the simple, geometric, heart shape, a symbol of love and joy and used quite heavily as an emoji these days. These works were created to manifest and channel love into this physical world directly from the source of all that is through the creative process, using found paper and reinterpreted digitally through the use of clipping masks and vector graphics and yet again through blockchain technology and generative art processes. Some of the found paper for these works include; shopping bags, 1970's toy catalogs, food packaging, kids' activity books, newspaper and magazine pages, and more.

Mr.Brian Design has been using found paper and tactile materials as a rendering technique in his mixed media portraiture for several years and has exhibited those works throughout Japan. This series is a paired down result of those efforts in pure form.

Mr.Brian Design's Mixed Media Portraiture may be viewed here: https://mrbd-at-good-neighbors-gallery.tumblr.com/

QmbtoU22cNMUMqdDHCHHH1iuYFokromksEqD4jVM.name: La titanesque
QmbtoU22cNMUMqdDHCHHH1iuYFokromksEqD4jVM.description:
This is a portrait of Heidi Klum. 

Though I witnessed glamorous moments, faces and looks as a press photographer, I realized that I was drawn to create this world from a different perspective; one which undressed the soul, and rendered a more authentic moment. After some time, it became the same scenes, the same clichés, the same smiles, the same looks and the same photographers. As a celebrity, having to see more than 30 flashes per second every time a photographer spots them, probably makes them want to protect themselves. Seeing celebrities live in this world of excessive media coverage, I started to develop a mixed feeling of admiration and respect, but also pity, and finally detachment.

The Personalities are decomposed and re-assembled in an abstract composition, guided by my instinct and fed by what the model inspired in me.

QmbtyHogtVUZ9K7snXwkXDjgwmAzX7N6bDsYrV2K.name: Monsters & Mythology: Vodenjak
QmbtyHogtVUZ9K7snXwkXDjgwmAzX7N6bDsYrV2K.description:
Monsters & Mythology: Vodenjak by Mad Monk

4 pieces minted as 1/1 on Async Art

Conceptualized, Created and Minted 2022

...

Vodenjak (Vodenyak or Vodyanoy) is creature from Eastern and Western Slavic stories that lives in water, especially close to watermills. They are created from souls of drowned people, especially ones that didn't meet funerary rites. Some people believed that Vodenjak is soul of very evil human that is punished by Gods to live in water. It is represented as human with long claws and tail, covered in moss or grass, or as old man with green beard and hair or as fish covered in mud. During day, he rests in decorated lair, while at night he pulls down unlucky people down into water, especially married men, so they can steal their women and make them into servants. He often damages watermills, bridges and fishing nets. People appeased Vodenjak by throwing rooster, chicken or sheep. Sometimes, people sacrificed and well-fed horse by throwing into water with stone tied to their neck.

https://mythus.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_Slavic_creatures#Vodenjak

Qmbu3R7DSPKDSeoBzJbcTB5rf2K6NZUCCErSKSCT.name: Blockchain likeness of the soul
Qmbu3R7DSPKDSeoBzJbcTB5rf2K6NZUCCErSKSCT.description:
We believe that alongside a real DNA there exists a mental one. One of the mental DNA’s components is our dreams. They include common dreams that all people share and a small part of dreams that make each person unique, just like that one percent of distinctive genes that make one an individual with unparalleled features.
   A collector or a DAO led by their own mindset randomly combines and selects a sequence of images close to them and has a chance to create various mental DNA paragraphs referring to their own unique ideas and dreams.
   Dreaming is a natural human condition. A human cannot live without dreaming. A true dream is very much like the horizon. Very often it is almost inaccessible, which does not make it less real though. That is why each of us always has an impetus to go on living and creating.

Digital painting
3840 x 2160 px

QmbwvVPoNw1VS2d7qUsBqBm26z5Boa6uMPmmcNTi.name: Bob Marley
QmbwvVPoNw1VS2d7qUsBqBm26z5Boa6uMPmmcNTi.description:
Bob Marley is a shining beacon of happiness for people all over the world.  Throughout his life he channeled his aura into his music and shared it with millions of people worldwide. Growing up listening to his music had a huge influence on my perspective on life and on my artwork. He encouraged people to spread love and to enjoy the little things in life, like a beautiful sun setting over the ocean or birds flying against a bright blue sky. 

For this piece, I tried to channel Bob Marley's positive energy and carefree essence, complimenting his portrait with beautiful scenes I've snapped around the world, melding his spirit with nature, where it belongs and now rests. Bob Marley lives on in so many others through his positive influence, as he said himself "My richness is life, forever".

QmbxRdCLD1hvjojt1XRTjyUuCHDyBYBZ8LanQfHi.name: Voluttuose
QmbxRdCLD1hvjojt1XRTjyUuCHDyBYBZ8LanQfHi.description:
In this artwork, my subject looks at and through the viewer in her search for light. Streams of air swirl around her just so slightly to give her enough opportunity to see things clearly.
I integrated my hand-painted and then digitalised paisley patterns to enhance the overall look of the portrait and to accentuate several details I deem important. I played a lot with skin tone varitations,  shading and the general colour scheme. As always, I tried to get rid of all that is is non-essential in my work, leaving just my conceptual triangle as a visible composition: eye - lips - art.

Qmc6XNuARxjnf1dyiKdQRz28DJUrfX27TomP53jT.name: La Passion
Qmc6XNuARxjnf1dyiKdQRz28DJUrfX27TomP53jT.description:
This work has a backstory that I would like to share, as it has struck a chord with me. A couple of years ago, I was strolling along an embankment with my artist friend, while we discussed art and its creators. One question in particular drove a wedge between us - what is more important for the creator, passion or patience? After a long discussion, we parted, each with his own opinion. A month later, I made this piece and sent it to him. Unfortunately, our communication has come to naught, however this discussion remains important to me.

In 2021, I completely reworked this piece, changing the shades and shapes, while only the essence remained the same. I also created a black & white version especially to show the detail and volume, as colour distracts attention from them.

Qmc6i7fC9SGY3WFpWbjWEy2aQhQMDLZbPCdqtByF.name: Colour, as a Measure of Time.
Qmc6i7fC9SGY3WFpWbjWEy2aQhQMDLZbPCdqtByF.description: Working with a grid and a Hex colour wheel, I wanted to use colour as a measurement of time. In this piece, each hour is represented by the clockwise movement around the colour wheel, fading from one colour to the next as the day progresses and we transition through the hours, from morning to afternoon to night. The colour’s of each hour are offset next their complementary colours, suggesting the notion that time zones have their own complementary times. The piece progresses inwards, around the clock, measured in hours, to the moment this day ends and a new one begins and it's time to say GM again.

Qmc6xFRNvkg1CCqhyT1JJTsjtkUTEf2SadNoAxUd.name: Don Quixote: Sketches - I
Qmc6xFRNvkg1CCqhyT1JJTsjtkUTEf2SadNoAxUd.description:
Don Quixote: Sketches - I by Hulki Okan Tabak, minted 1/1 on Async Art, 2022

2 artworks in a daily cycle..

...

Don Quixote project is a highly personal interpretation of the hero and his world. Various photographic and AI tools are used to create, manipulate and recreate the images. The story will be numbered for all of us to track down what we hold essentially. Beyond ease of use, the numbers are not sequential. Each image is independent but some images will be interdependent parts of smaller stories which I will mention. I would also mint some editions outside of Manifold. Note that editions of this project could be 1/1s or multi editions. The mints on Async Art will not be numbered as they each contain multiple images in themselves.

...

Don Quixote is a Spanish epic novel by Miguel de Cervantes. Originally published in two parts, in 1605 and 1615, its full title is The Ingenious Gentleman Don Quixote of La Mancha.

A founding work of Western literature, it is often labeled as the first modern novel and one of the greatest ever written. Don Quixote is also one of the most-translated books in the world.

When first published, Don Quixote was usually interpreted as a comic novel. After the French Revolution, it was better known for its central ethic that individuals can be right while society is quite wrong and was seen as a story of disenchantment. In the 19th century, it was seen as social commentary, but no one could easily tell "whose side Cervantes was on". Many critics came to view the work as a tragedy in which Don Quixote's idealism and nobility are viewed by the post-chivalric world as insane, and are defeated and rendered useless by common reality. By the 20th century, the novel had come to occupy a canonical space as one of the foundations of modern literature and a formidable example of what letters can do. (wikipedia)

Qmc8Zvuuu14BujTxbyy7nQgGkNJL8tpbX8aVupxX.name: Pahadi Farmer Portrait
Qmc8Zvuuu14BujTxbyy7nQgGkNJL8tpbX8aVupxX.description:
Most Garhwali cultivators are poor, some are very poor. And yet these are very cheerful people. Somehow they manage to wrest a precarious living from the unhelpful soil.

Mountains and these people have stood the test of time like no other. And I have been always grateful to them. I have put together some of my best creativity to work that the mountains have inspired me to think. For if you cannot come up here, I hope these artworks will at least give you a glimpse into lives of Garhwal. 
With this artwork I hope to create a charming little portrait of our life in the hills, where we live in a quiet, unhurried manner at our own pace. And I hope that it would inspire you to come visit us too someday.

Qmc9oJEgkZj9N3aB57GopjVGtCLp84RXfCC9siKQ.description:

QmcBXLYbF7CqQn3wUazv36qQmWjZEpNpJVj8y9m3.name: Sonder Vol.2
QmcBXLYbF7CqQn3wUazv36qQmWjZEpNpJVj8y9m3.description:
“Sonder. You are the main character—the protagonist—the star at the center of your own unfolding story. You're surrounded by your supporting cast: friends and family hanging in your immediate orbit.

Scattered a little further out, a network of acquaintances who drift in and out of contact over the years.

But there in the background, faint and out of focus, are the extras. The random passersby. Each living a life as vivid and complex as your own.

They carry on invisibly around you, bearing the accumulated weight of their own ambitions, friends, routines, mistakes, worries, triumphs and inherited craziness.

When your life moves on to the next scene, theirs flickers in place, wrapped in a cloud of backstory and inside jokes and characters strung together with countless other stories you'll never be able to see. That you'll never know exists.

In which you might appear only once. As an extra sipping coffee in the background. As a blur of traffic passing on the highway. As a lighted window at dusk.”

― The Dictionary of Obscure Sorrows - John Koenig

QmcCYVf9jnVpfMW8vbqGJ9gESLpYGWgejW8jeku4.name: Chromology
QmcCYVf9jnVpfMW8vbqGJ9gESLpYGWgejW8jeku4.description: Chromology is a play of colours. It is a generative, participatory and interactive artwork intended to create a collaboration between the artist and the audience. The final generative artwork rests at https://nurecas.github.io/chromology/ . The link takes you to a blank canvas. Use your mouse or touch to start drawing and playing with colours. The concept of the artwork was to break away from set forms, and engage in creations which are abstract in nature. In this way, the artwork is intended for "play" as opposed to "make". There are 4 styles of creations controlled by the "Expression" layer. There are 5 colour themes controlled by the "Theme" layer.  I believe that a true artist starts by creating/curating his tools of creation. In the same spirit, many of my works hitherto have been on creating tools, digital or otherwise, and then using those tools to create art. Chromology is also created with the same concept in mind.

Erik has  a passion for the dark yet vibrant creative pallet, Erik Matson is an abstract artist, musician and animation designer. Credits include Netflix, Steam/Valve, FUEL TV, Wave and Blaze, Levi's and many others

QmcD6x29Swsho1V3X7dX7URRjMUJEMCLVJL5r93w.name: The Undertaking
QmcD6x29Swsho1V3X7dX7URRjMUJEMCLVJL5r93w.description:
This artwork changes every hour of the day for 24 hours.
This project incorporates 24 surreal artworks each one of them revolving around a heart. I was inspired to create this piece(s) regarding my experienced struggles of the heart. Some people are monsters, some are nice, some are just evil and some just want to be with you. They all try to reach your heart, whether they want to love it or poison it. My imagination ran wild thus I was able to recreate these artworks with passion and a tiny bit of narcissism. I have put them all into one grand master piece. Here are the names for each piece:

12:00. Quiet, 13:00. The Break, 14:00.  I keep forgetting, 15:00. Who needs a heart when you got a frog. 16:00. Invasion, 17:00. Forgotten, 18:00. They all love me, 19:00. Reaching High 20:00. Finally I am warm. 21:00. Mother, where did you go?, 22:00. Keep away, 23:00. Whispering, 24:00. Light under the water. 1:00. Drowning Church, 2:00. Cold, 3:00. Judgement, 4:00. Grandfather, 5:00. I am lost, 6:00. Here, Kitty..., 7:00. Protection, 8:00. Narcolepsy, 9:00. Heart Attack, 10:00. My love, I am all yours, 11:00. Broken Heart.


“The Heart wants what it wants - or else it does not care”
― Emily Dickinson

QmcFrM7tbUA5XMQJUa7QrHeEW2WZz9UqXi5WcWMR.name: The Unfolding Dream
QmcFrM7tbUA5XMQJUa7QrHeEW2WZz9UqXi5WcWMR.description:
Collaborative interactive artwork by Coldie and John Van Hamersveld, this composition explores the shared life experiences of both artists as they come together in a highly customizable, living art format. This artwork was created in real-time for the Bonham's auction in November 2021. Elements of this project were captured days prior to minting the artwork including New York City landscapes captured by Coldie. We believe that important experiences can be from long ago as well as a day ago and they hold the same historical significance. The visual vernacular of John Van Hamersveld shares both a realistic and surrealistic vision of what is possible in the real world, as well as the dream world.

The artwork created is meant to bring the viewer and collector inside of our shared dream reality and allow for the story to be visually told through the collector who owns each layer. The variety of options give the opportunity for the layer owner to express their current feelings about the artwork and share in real-time how it affects the total artwork.

QmcG7r1oBgWaLrRKzWDDQh9amU4VCRjpSADLJWDG.name: Say It's Possible
QmcG7r1oBgWaLrRKzWDDQh9amU4VCRjpSADLJWDG.description:
15 years ago I wrote a song called “Say It’s Possible,” and the song changed my life. 

I went from an unknown artist to the most subscribed musician on YouTube at the time. Thousands of people around the world created their own cover videos of my song. I won the inaugural YouTube Award for Best Music Video, signed deals with Universal Music Publishing and Island Records, played solo at Wembley Stadium, toured all over Europe and the UK. My experience in the major label music industry was a whirlwind ride that ultimately did not serve my best interests, and it took years of dismantling, reprogramming, and letting go of painful experiences and toxic relationships in order to find my way back to my pure love of music and the joy that comes from sharing it. 

This year I reclaimed the rights to my earliest songs from Universal Music, with the intention of recording new versions and giving these songs a life they never had. I am starting with my Async Music project: an interactive, collaborative version of my song "Say It's Possible." There are 460 possible configurations of the song and corresponding visual art, ranging from pure acoustic guitar and vocals to a lush arrangement with 13 different layers of sound.

I wrote, played, and recorded all of the music in my home studio, creating the parts in a modular way, like a puzzle, knowing the track would have to make sense in any configuration. My dear friend MG O’Shea helped with the mix, carving out frequencies to ensure all the parts would sound excellent together, in any combination. Every mix begins in the same way, like the song itself began, with acoustic guitar and vocals, evolving into something more after the first verse. Some of the changes can be subtle and some can be striking. 

The visual art is a series of self-portraits I created in the process of freeing myself from the expectations and demands placed on me by an industry that did not support me as the innovative and individualistic artist that I am.

One collector can own the Master. Up to five collectors of the individual stems (vocals, guitar, drums + percussion, bass + strings, bells + synths) will control the master mix and album cover art. A limited number of “blank records”(2,000 silver, 10 gold, 3 platinum) are also available. You can collect a blank record in advance and mint your version as soon as you hear something you love. And if you do hear something you love, mint it at that time, because we might never stumble upon that particular mix again! 

These song versions and cover art will not be released anywhere outside of this project, and the NFT you collect will be a rare and unique piece of my history and evolution as a self-actualized, independent artist.

QmcGV1Uo7dTAZ43822eNkxzit3Ki5KJ1ecLPvq8k.name: ''Wand of Serenity
QmcGV1Uo7dTAZ43822eNkxzit3Ki5KJ1ecLPvq8k.description:
The human soul whines at the threat of a pained unhealthful existence. For the elderly and the symptomatic, a slight pinch of pain can land one contemplating something worse, an imminent ghastly swoop into death's gluttonous catacombs. Growing up as a Ndebele kid, there was a popular Grandma joke which went like, "Dokotela, uGogo uyagula, mhlabe ngejekiseni elilamanzi kayi kukwazi umehluko", a joking statement which translates as, "Doc, Granny is sick, inject her with water, she won't know the difference." The joke funnily alluded to the fact that, Granny’s being diagnosed and administered to by the doctor gave her a strong belief that had her thinking and believing that she was already healing. It was magical; the volumes of trust and the extent of willful vulnerability were astounding for our young minds.
This much confidence invested in doctors exists in no other profession.The pressure to deliver well on this much faith invested requires expert containment and the humane skill of radiating positive energy to the patients during their healing process.
Perhaps this saying is true; a caring, present, and devoted doctor has the job done half-done.

QmcL61FJ9dF6vRRsj8TbRU5v6QJQBwWS8SRYo9ii.name: The Mask
QmcL61FJ9dF6vRRsj8TbRU5v6QJQBwWS8SRYo9ii.description:
The Mask is a physical traditional oil painting on canvas, 36x36’’ (91x91 cm) made between January and July 2020 in Boston, Massachusetts USA, and adapted for Async on April 2021.
This piece portraits a mask typical from the Diablada carnival from the Andes in South America. As a child I found these masks very scary but as I grew up I found that they were fascinating, specially because of the colors and the teatrical design.
In this programmable NFT version, the painting goes into Dark Mode during the night and can be seen glowing as if it were under UV light.
The Mask was part of the Alien Citizen Solo Art Show at the SoWa Galleries in Boston, MA September 4, 2020 - September 13, 2020.

QmcLULUEm4n78UYbZRUmS7p5KU7V1PWorpcKJyYw.description:
Der Letzte Hier
aka The Last One Here
by Hulki Okan Tabak
minted 2021 on Async Art

4 artworks based on World War I propaganda posters from Germany.   

...

The Great War, history, politics, art, posters and propaganda are topics of interest for me. It was kind of natural that I wanted to incorporate that in my cryptoart creations. The desire led to a selection of public domain pieces out of copyright from the Library of Congress archives. I created all sorts of derivative pacifist and tongue-in-cheek works. So far I have only minted a handful on KnownOrigin. Starting September 2021, I will mint a more comprehensive set on Async Art and KO depending on the nature of the final artwork. The artwork presented here is part of that World War I Posters set.

Based on Putin photography, Kids Takeover Putin is text-to-image experimentation on war, peace and leadership. It is re-creating the leadership in the eyes of a kid takeover for peace.

Stop the War. We hoped, I hoped this was already the past in Europe. We should not go back.

QmcNFPyZLjHsfhSxKwdGy49YyXeVaZ8afQvSscRh.name: La fureteuse
QmcNFPyZLjHsfhSxKwdGy49YyXeVaZ8afQvSscRh.description:
Though I witnessed glamorous moments, faces and looks as a press photographer, I realized that I was drawn to create this world from a different perspective; one which undressed the soul, and rendered a more authentic moment. After some time, it became the same scenes, the same clichés, the same smiles, the same looks and the same photographers. As a celebrity, having to see more than 30 flashes per second every time a photographer spots them, probably makes them want to protect themselves. Seeing celebrities live in this world of excessive media coverage, I started to develop a mixed feeling of admiration and respect, but also pity, and finally detachment.

The Personalities are decomposed and re-assembled in an abstract composition, guided by my instinct and fed by what the model inspired in me.

The original digital size of "La fureteuse" portrait is 180 by 120 cm. 

This is a portrait of the entrepreneur, Angela Simmons. 
If you set it on "sunrise", it will display the original photography.

QmcNpCsEkjjhmmxkMJy5TvjWoszNCzUNoqBySy2y.name: Fall From Grace
QmcNpCsEkjjhmmxkMJy5TvjWoszNCzUNoqBySy2y.description:
"Fall From Grace" is my genesis Async Art piece. It's a play on the story of Icarus. How ambition and the pursuit of our desires can easily be convoluted or distorted by greed and lust. How it's ok to aspire and dream, but that there's a delicate line between desire and foolishness. Enjoying and being grateful for the journey itself is part of the dream, and ascending too high just means that there can ultimately be an even larger fall to the bottom.
.
.
.
DETAILS:
•Layers: 34 Background Layers, 12 Middle Layers, 20 Top Layers
•Resolution: 1620x2160 (Async), 5400x7200 (High Res)
•Medium: Multimedia, Programmable
•Software: Tilt Brush, Cinema 4D, Octane Render, Substance Painter, ProCreate, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop
•Physical Canvas/Prints: If they so choose, the original buyer of the Master Layer can get in touch with me on social media to have a free physical 18"x24" Canvas Print or Fine Art Print sent to their address of choice.
.
.
.
PROCESS:
This piece was created with an intention to use as many of my different creative skills / software knowledge as possible, while also iterating on years and years of personal aesthetic research and design theory. The first step involved sculpting the base mesh, rigging the model, splitting out the designated sections/pieces of the body, and then resuming sculpting and detail using VR & Tilt Brush. From VR, the 3D model was taken back and cleaned up in Cinema 4D and textured externally in Substance Painter. Once the model and texturing was to my liking, I consolidated my textures and set up my render scene/lighting using Octane Render in C4D. I exported a 2D still that I could paint and embellish with the floral pattern tattooed on the model's body. The still render was then hand-painted using my iPad/Procreate. The final step included me creating alternate background layers, hair/wire layers, and skin layers using bits and pieces from the previous processes. All the variants and pieces were composited in Photoshop, tweaked, color corrected, and styled to create the final composition consisting of 34 background layers, 13 mid ground layers, and 20 foreground layers.

QmcPmkVqGmUBdyKhWbDGYuxVYy6NzE1zrX9JLHio.name: London Traffic
QmcPmkVqGmUBdyKhWbDGYuxVYy6NzE1zrX9JLHio.description:
London Traffic
by Hulki Okan Tabak
4 piece programmable artwork on Async Art
1/1 minted September 2021

...

Part of a series of Marylebone, London based artworks. All of these works consist of photographs taken by me in January 2020. It is the time of Lunar New Year, Wuhan lockdowns, and the very first signs of the virus in Europe.

Marylebone was originally an Ancient Parish formed to serve the manors (landholdings) of Lileston (in the west - which gives its name to modern Lisson Grove) and Tyburn in the east. The parish is likely to have been in place since at least the twelfth century and will have used the boundaries of the pre-existing manors. The boundaries of the parish were consistent from the late twelfth century to the creation of the Metropolitan Borough which succeeded it. (Wikipedia)

QmcQR95Np7nWLbDEA6JihbfhiBXQR6M5ZkwV3qxs.name: Jellyfish
QmcQR95Np7nWLbDEA6JihbfhiBXQR6M5ZkwV3qxs.description:
Jellyfish are very ancient animals.

Jellyfish fossils have been found dating back more than 550 million years ago (Cambrian period), 250 million years before dinosaurs appeared on earth.

Some of them are considered eternal animals, being able to transform themselves from jellyfish to polyps, in an eternal life cycle.

When man and all other animals will be extinct on earth, jellyfish will be the only living beings that will populate our planet and, perhaps, will also learn to fly, living not only in the water but also in the air.

And when jellyfish sleep, they often dream of music...


Jellyfish is a project in 3 parts :

- 3 music NFTs published on Makersplace : https://makersplace.com/wayang/gallery/created

- 1 NFT formed by 24 images that changes during the 24 hours of the day, published on Async art

- A musical NFT published on Catalog.work : https://beta.catalog.works/robertomusci


For information about the project , visit : https://sites.google.com/view/jellyfishnft

For more information about my Nft and my music , visit : https://sites.google.com/view/robertomusci

QmcSd5RJvqpcabGHVvsEbTXFx85PYm9c3HpkZiiZ.description:

Will the ominous depictions of the future from movies, novels and video games come to fruition? One nation under tech.

metadata.name: January 1st 2021 - One nation under tech
metadata.description:
2020 saw a generation of people experience two recessions and a pandemic. We now sit at the fringe of post-humanism connected to a future of uncertainty driven by tech systems. We are indoctrinate now. There is no going back. The cyber punk fantasy is fast becoming reality.

Will the ominous depictions of the future from movies, novels and video games come to fruition? One nation under tech.

QmcaTj3pnK366SCK8J68GoRmvuPVnsECtWKeqJag.description:
Her name is Pix3l M3lody. She is an artist who creates pixel worlds and mixes her visual creations with music, interacting in them through choreography and dance.

Equipment: Her glove allows her to create pixel worlds and music. Her headset allows her to listen to music mixes and bring the sound to the audience.

Talisman: Talisman is a blue AI virtual companion which is connected to the glove with a strand. The companion is a good luck talisman. It exalts Pix3l M3lody´s interpretations.

Logo: The logo can be seen on her T-shirt, a pixel art version of her.

Qmcamd4Gf3NDJt8ux8UiYJ42UEXCDnqkpBkYpN3M.name: Fly Files
Qmcamd4Gf3NDJt8ux8UiYJ42UEXCDnqkpBkYpN3M.description:
The work deals both with the question of the ethical limits and dangers of scientific research (as in the film "The Fly"), the philosophical and sociological consequences of a transformation (as in Kafka's "The Metamorphosis"), and not least with the question of what actually distinguishes us humans from insects.

"Little Fly
Thy summers play,
My thoughtless hand
Has brush'd away.
Am not I
A fly like thee?
Or art not thou
A man like me?
For I dance
And drink & sing:
Till some blind hand
Shall brush my wing.
If thought is life
And strength & breath:
And the want
Of thought is death;
Then am I
A happy fly,
If I live,
Or if I die."

- William Blake (1794)

QmceMnwJpMJY5Cjh7jr5EbQn4fpcPr6Y9BgMccJv.name: LOST HOME
QmceMnwJpMJY5Cjh7jr5EbQn4fpcPr6Y9BgMccJv.description:
Acrylic on Canson Montval 300gsm size A3 (30x42 cm)
Year: 2018

QmchBYFmtwidpgzosC5zkSxF4z2yiwatPjm5Mxdt.name: Don Quixote: Sketches - III
QmchBYFmtwidpgzosC5zkSxF4z2yiwatPjm5Mxdt.description:
Don Quixote: Sketches - III by Hulki Okan Tabak, minted 1/1 on Async Art, 2022

2 artworks in a daily cycle..

...

Don Quixote project is a highly personal interpretation of the hero and his world. Various photographic and AI tools are used to create, manipulate and recreate the images. The story will be numbered for all of us to track down what we hold essentially. Beyond ease of use, the numbers are not sequential. Each image is independent but some images will be interdependent parts of smaller stories which I will mention. I would also mint some editions outside of Manifold. Note that editions of this project could be 1/1s or multi editions. The mints on Async Art will not be numbered as they each contain multiple images in themselves.

...

Don Quixote is a Spanish epic novel by Miguel de Cervantes. Originally published in two parts, in 1605 and 1615, its full title is The Ingenious Gentleman Don Quixote of La Mancha.

A founding work of Western literature, it is often labeled as the first modern novel and one of the greatest ever written. Don Quixote is also one of the most-translated books in the world.

When first published, Don Quixote was usually interpreted as a comic novel. After the French Revolution, it was better known for its central ethic that individuals can be right while society is quite wrong and was seen as a story of disenchantment. In the 19th century, it was seen as social commentary, but no one could easily tell "whose side Cervantes was on". Many critics came to view the work as a tragedy in which Don Quixote's idealism and nobility are viewed by the post-chivalric world as insane, and are defeated and rendered useless by common reality. By the 20th century, the novel had come to occupy a canonical space as one of the foundations of modern literature and a formidable example of what letters can do. (wikipedia)

QmchbbD9DXLocGGKedrYbfefQa8nzLezxHwqRqma.name: Fractal Expanse
QmchbbD9DXLocGGKedrYbfefQa8nzLezxHwqRqma.description:
This is a 3d piece comprised of  surrealistic landscapes,  fractal geometric patterns, and strange attractor textures. It is an exploration of form, colour, and texture.


The process I used was  RTX  path tracing in Nvidia Omniverse, and unreal landscape engine to make the terrain. For the geometric patterns, and strange attractors I worked with Jwildfire. It was then colour graded in Davinci Resolve. Finally  I whittled down the best combinations which made a significant diverse difference to the master layer. All the layers are meant to be mixed and matched. Enjoy playing with it!

QmckFL3DaVbLP1ucjjn18XEepkXxeF3zVZX6664y.name: Uttarakhand
QmckFL3DaVbLP1ucjjn18XEepkXxeF3zVZX6664y.description:
Located on the shivalik range of Himalayas. Uttarakhand is a state in northern part of India. It is often referred to as the "Devbhumi" (literally "Land of the Gods").
Uttarakhand's name is derived from the Sanskrit words uttara (उत्तर) meaning 'north', and khaṇḍa (खण्ड) meaning 'land', altogether simply meaning 'Northern Land'.

The native people of Uttarakhand are generally called Uttarakhandi and sometimes specifically either Garhwali or Kumaoni depending on their place of origin in either the Garhwal or Kumaon region. Regional languages of Uttarakhand are Garhwali, which is spoken by 23% of the population mostly in the western half of the state, Kumaoni, spoken in the eastern half and native to 20%, both closely related languages of the Central Pahari languages, and the Jaunsari of the Western Pahari family, whose speakers are concentrated in Dehradun district in the southwest and make up 1.3% of the state's population. 

There are many ancient temples, forest reserves, national parks, hill stations, and mountain peaks that draw large number of tourists. There are 44 nationally protected monuments in the state.
Also many regional festivals are celebrated here, Harela is one of them. Harela has a great significance in Kumaon. This symbolizes a new harvest and the rainy season. It has become common practice to attribute a slogan of – "Save The Environment" to Harela. Schools in Uttarakhand often encourage their students to plant saplings, either at home, in the school or with the support of local officials. In Kumaun, the two celebrations during Navratri – first during Chaitra Navratri in the month of Chaitra, and second during Sharad Navratri in the month of Ashwin, is also considered to be connected to Harela.

The scarcity of water is still a major problem in Uttarakhand. Agricultural land remains barren because of a lack of irrigation facilities in the state, while water is not even available for everyday household chores. In villages, women have to walk for miles every day to fetch water.
The need for responsible tourism and construction in the mountains has long been overlooked. Besides unemployment and migration, lack of power and other infrastructures like road constitute major electoral issues in the state. 

Out-migration in Uttarakhand can primarily be attributed to a combination of push and pull factors like the lack of employment, low income, subsistence agriculture, better opportunities for employment and children's education, etc.
I sometimes feel these hills of Uttarakhand wants to speak something to me.
They want me to tell their story . They want me to describe the condition of Uttarakhand and hope I can bring a change in its developing community.

To the cruel world who only thinks about themselves, I wanted to be something else.
To change lifestyle of people of my Uttarakhand by improving economy through Crypto.
Because when you realize art is not just in canvas but if your art can change/improve someone lifestyle that is the real art and I am continuously striking myself to achieve that level of perfection.

Artists - 1. Shivansh Rawat
2. Shubham Bisht (https://www.behance.net/bhishtibis975b)
3. Avi Bisht (https://makersplace.com/psybot/)
4. Dipika Negi (https://www.instagram.com/unrealshot_/?hl=en)

Cryptosculptures are digitally created contemporary sculptures.
With these works I develop and deepen artistic understanding of how industrial design approach might be used for creation the unique pieces of art. This practice aims to merge design with art, thus erasing the line between them. I think in the future there will be no readable difference between these two disciplines whereas any functional object or device will look as a piece of art the same way as in art we’ll see a design elements used as a normal practice.

QmckrUoMuSPAr3nxgHtHZHKJRqw3WL7AHd9atcd7.name: Generic Landscape, Lofoten, A Snow Storm Passing
QmckrUoMuSPAr3nxgHtHZHKJRqw3WL7AHd9atcd7.description:
The artist Trygve Skogrand has lived for several years in the arctic Lofoten islands in the North of Norway, documenting the changing of the seasons, the drifting weather over the dramatic polar landscape. In this work, he has trained an ai-algorithm on a large series of photographs of the wintery mountains surrounding his house. The algorithm learns from statistics on colours, angles, shapes and textures in the photographs to generate new, virtual views of something not quite unlike the Lofoten mountains. 

The artist calls these generated, synthetic landscapes for "Generic Landscapes". In the work "Generic Landscape, Lofoten, A Snow Storm Passing", a snowstorm drifts over the mountains, obscuring and revealing them as it passes. The work changes each hour of the day, to reveal a different aspect of the winterly storm.

QmcpyGgQ9PZBnoRwd9hKKDBEWRxvwiWK19oZcfgy.name: In Search Of Color: Here And There
QmcpyGgQ9PZBnoRwd9hKKDBEWRxvwiWK19oZcfgy.description:
An homage to a series of paintings I did starting in the early 2000's titled Urban Abstractions. I exhibited them in various cities around the world.

"The collection of paintings portrays a landscape of color and intuition. I hope to capture the essence of modern life as we see it unfold in front of our very own eyes. The works are inspired by a struggle to make sense out of life and reflect a need for something more meaningful, something that brings out the JOY in our daily routine."

Qmcr5gsnEbrnZWifb4QYCzLKu8tSeu2iyk5Byki6.name: A Money Tree from the Cedar Tavern
Qmcr5gsnEbrnZWifb4QYCzLKu8tSeu2iyk5Byki6.description:
A 'Money Tree', or Pachira Aquatica is said to bring good financial fortune and positive 'chi', or energy, into a home.
I'm interested in plants and organic structures, here from an artistic perspective and as a means of (abstract) expression in various media including photographic art, also to confront both a seasonal (winter) and social (covid/omicron) mood.
We still have so much to learn from plants: architecturally, spiritually, scientifically... 
A main objective is simply to take the viewer closer or 'inside' the houseplant over 24 hours and to explore and appreciate its details via unusual perspectives, perhaps finding inspiration in the organic design. The 24 individually-enhanced, selected images are not tied to the hours from any single day but have been chosen to follow a loose progression; my own adventure or preoccupation. You could say this Money Tree is a reflection of its unique growth and my small mission to find out (or 'see') the details of this growth. Why do we strive to explore and enhance Nature? Perhaps we want to make it more attractive than it is, to increase its appeal, and energy, and to impress the passive viewer (within) somehow through our diverse bids for control and freedom? The result: this new form of 'super' Money Tree as a dynamic NFT. The  process of art can be as obsessive as studying money markets, or finding global cures for viruses, and it's a question which relates to an ongoing series titled  'Organic Metaverse'. It aims to explore our need for being lost in the natural world, already present, right before our eyes, and where 'a fool sees not the same tree that a wise man sees.' (Blake). Most of art is a safe form of exploring, so let's set out again, and possibly reveal more of the less familiar and hidden things, or just find sanctuary there.

QmctDnb2v3t73GUF7PotXcTpfso163mdRDXzbUP7.name: Kate Moss
QmctDnb2v3t73GUF7PotXcTpfso163mdRDXzbUP7.description:
For the newest addition to my ICON series, I present to you Kate Moss. Kate has been at the forefront of fashion and art since the early 1990s. I wanted to pay homage to her timeless beauty in the form of a beautiful clock. 

Each of the 12 polaroids that comprise this mosaic is given a time slot of one hour. At midnight Kate is shown in deep blue, but as each hour passes, another polaroid will shift color, starting at the top left and going through the hours of the day from left to right. So when it is 4am, the first four polaroids will be lit up in color. At noon, when all of the polaroids have changed colors, the piece will begin to reverse and shift gradually back to deep blue, with the amount of blue polaroids now dictating the hour. I have signed the piece with my initials AM on the bottom right corner for the AM hours, and left it blank for PM. Like a clock, you will be able to see what hour of the day it is based on how many of the polaroids have shifted color. 

The first owner of this NFT will also be gifted the 1/1 physical polaroid set used to create this digital clock. The piece will come framed in a sleek white frame measuring 20'' x 15'' and have a unique color combination not seen here on Async. It will be accompanied by a signed certificate of authenticity.

QmcutKZnLANQFgQHhkjmsBbywFxxBjdoXGU6rcEr.name: Our Mind is a Multiverse
QmcutKZnLANQFgQHhkjmsBbywFxxBjdoXGU6rcEr.description:
The MIND is a power entity and it is more alive than we ever know, more alive than we can ever imagine. 
Every time we delve into the depths of our mind, we are essentially traversing through a MULTIVERSE. 
And the more we traverse, the more we discover ourselves in the process.

This piece has four states, each reflecting the state of our mind at that time of day. 

During the day we are mostly filled with LIGHT, but the dark zone is just lurking in the middle just out of reach of the light.
When we wake up at day break we are filled with a FIRE to make things happen during the day. 
And by Sunset we have reached a state of NIRVANA, or so we think only to recognise that the DARK is just starting to creep in the replace the Light, until daybreak.
... Until Daybreak.

Qmcvm5ddzgwQvdubTNoKRwJpUitLFT5Wo2PvWets.name: The Moon Aloof
Qmcvm5ddzgwQvdubTNoKRwJpUitLFT5Wo2PvWets.description:
As the hours pass the moon will slowly reveal itself becoming a bright light in the nights sky before eventually shrouding itself in darkness again!


A little about how I  created this:
Started with images taken from the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO) and modeled them in After Effects from there I added points of light that gradually come towards the camera. After I was happy with the look here I edited it further on my phone using an app called Glitch Studio to bring out some of the blues and reds. This was also where I layered in some noise, dithering, and got the overall aesthetic down. For this piece I imported the finished video which was almost 2 minutes long  back into AE and sped it up to be 24 secs long and exported a frame every 60 frames which ended out working out to a complete loop!

QmcwBsrHboMFRYNDpPwZSqJMCxmvJ65Jt98uRubC.name: PI-nocchio
QmcwBsrHboMFRYNDpPwZSqJMCxmvJ65Jt98uRubC.description:
Being truthful to one's self.
Going to pleasure island is in no way the solution. Escaping the roots of our problems only escalades the situation. Fear is the enemy itself. Fear of being prosecuted for our mistakes. Living in fear creates the misery one will suffer. Creating a problem is never a solution. Admitting mistakes is a process one has to go through and it comes with honesty.

This artwork is inspired by the pleasure island. Coming back from it. Accepting the monster it created and killing it for my own good.

Qmcx6wnLUTn3p1ZzesbtBAc4DawTHEdqRSa67AU5.name: Faces of Transformation
Qmcx6wnLUTn3p1ZzesbtBAc4DawTHEdqRSa67AU5.description:
The core of the transformation, however, were the insects, which stared at the spectators with their huge fly eyes. Although they tried to hide behind masks and wigs (and thus appear somewhat human-like), they only felt comfortable when they were replaced by an artificially created creature.

But what they seemed to enjoy visibly was the great power to fly around, to change their size and position and thus to question the aesthetics of the whole work.

QmcxRqG1kZUt3ZfyMxzuSQzADMu3PXNYpu3BB1LV.name: Don Quixote: Windmills of My Childhood
QmcxRqG1kZUt3ZfyMxzuSQzADMu3PXNYpu3BB1LV.description:
Don Quixote: Windmills of My Childhood by Hulki Okan Tabak, minted 1/1 on Async Art, 2022

2 artworks in a daily cycle..

...

Don Quixote project is a highly personal interpretation of the hero and his world. Various photographic and AI tools are used to create, manipulate and recreate the images. The story will be numbered for all of us to track down what we hold essentially. Beyond ease of use, the numbers are not sequential. Each image is independent but some images will be interdependent parts of smaller stories which I will mention. I would also mint some editions outside of Manifold. Note that editions of this project could be 1/1s or multi editions. The mints on Async Art will not be numbered as they each contain multiple images in themselves.

...

Don Quixote is a Spanish epic novel by Miguel de Cervantes. Originally published in two parts, in 1605 and 1615, its full title is The Ingenious Gentleman Don Quixote of La Mancha.

A founding work of Western literature, it is often labeled as the first modern novel and one of the greatest ever written. Don Quixote is also one of the most-translated books in the world.

When first published, Don Quixote was usually interpreted as a comic novel. After the French Revolution, it was better known for its central ethic that individuals can be right while society is quite wrong and was seen as a story of disenchantment. In the 19th century, it was seen as social commentary, but no one could easily tell "whose side Cervantes was on". Many critics came to view the work as a tragedy in which Don Quixote's idealism and nobility are viewed by the post-chivalric world as insane, and are defeated and rendered useless by common reality. By the 20th century, the novel had come to occupy a canonical space as one of the foundations of modern literature and a formidable example of what letters can do. (wikipedia)

QmcxnkcyYa8vSAYi2taYQBP3XUXL51u3UfryXj4R.name: Old Ethereum Art
QmcxnkcyYa8vSAYi2taYQBP3XUXL51u3UfryXj4R.description:
Addition to my quest for visualising complexity of computational thinking and using data as my paint. With the service of AI (artificial intelligence) such as generative adversarial network (GAN) and many other to create amalgamations to analyse form by an artistic thinking with the help of machine intelligence. Not a single source from any original art is used to create these paintings. All images used for training are beautiful google earth satellite shots . The model itself ended up giving it vibes of unique historic art movement styles. Just to get philosophical, As we have not yet figured out what conscious itself is, then how can we define what art should be.

Ref: https://www.flatarc.io/crypto-art
​
Also a unique opportunity when you need to think about parametric form with unusual physics which cannot exist in reality, this is where machine intelligence services you with power of exploring unusual and other-worldly forms and experiences. Refer my other 'Data Art' project pages for more about inspirations. This current piece of work was a tribute to the fascinating, daring Ethereum-crypto-community and people who love decentralisation. Unbelievable paradigm shift that will change everything that we know as norms.

QmcyL5Cfvgf9shxVz5w7hx8VXpShJ8mMHx4JvXEM.name: Abstract Dissolution of Lord Gravity
QmcyL5Cfvgf9shxVz5w7hx8VXpShJ8mMHx4JvXEM.description:
Lord Gravity is a Master of the Space Age, a contemporary superhero who floats in space.

He is able to dissolve himself as the day evolves, from sunrise to sunset and then again every day and night.

This superpower helps Him to discover new worldwide issues, to help humans overcome their struggles, to meditate and to find peace in His work by making Himself invisible to human eyes.

His critics have mistakenly named this power 'Abstract Dissolution', emphasising the artistic nature of his existence. In fact, dissolving in colours also recharges Lord Gravity energy levels and assists Him in the fight against natural forces.

Qmd2KszXEANaH4KWSiG3fytiVKEKoHqKKx2jDdFr.name: Dig Boy Dig
Qmd2KszXEANaH4KWSiG3fytiVKEKoHqKKx2jDdFr.description:
My earliest memory of an excavator is from our summer cabin with
my father is next to me as I am in the sandbox playing with a green metal toy excavator, which was just a mechanical digging arm with a seat on it. You would operate it by pushing and pulling on the handles you were holding on to. I remember the joy of discovering how it worked after the initial struggle, and how satisfying it was just to dig and move the sand around.
Much later in art school, I started doing ink drawing between painting sessions. I did a little bit of it in my teens when I was enthusiastic about making comics, though without much patience for it. And then, few years after my graduation I would pick the pens again, with more definite goals.
I was often drawing just random things in my sketchbooks. I did not think much of them then. They were an excuse for the line as I wrote on a notebook once. I was trying to learn the medium. It was awkward first. I had wrong kind of paper, and the ink would splatter as the nibs scratched the paper. Then again, I cherished it and often abused my pens on purpose creating a big mess.
Looking back, I see frustration of all kinds. I remember that my eyes got very tired quickly from drawing. I was not very good with expressing myself with words and especially dreaded writing, It is all in there.
At some point the excavators started to appear. I found them fascinating to look at, If saw one on a construction on my way to college. They reminded me of some ancient dinosaur, perhaps because of association from the Flintstones cartoon. I still stop to admire them sometimes. 
The drawings were not trying to be actual representations of the machinery, though I did study them a little bit. The excavators were turning out to become a part of a system of symbols, same as with the repeating letter “a”, I was drawing with something of a built obsession as method to discover meaning with absurdity.
The idea began with the launch of the 24h feature on AsyncArt. It has changed a lot since, but it was always going to be something with excavators. 
Some of the watercolor works were made for this piece in particular. Though I forgot about them for a while until finding them in box stored away. Some are old ones all the way from my first exhibition. I put them all together and arranged them randomly. The runes I painted myself just for fun, let’s say, not intended to be used in art. As the time arose, I felt compelled to use them. I cast them randomly for each picture, as a symbolic gesture. The runes can be representing many things, from actual letters to wisdom and magic. There are many things we can see but don’t understand and then ignore until we learn their meaning, like words of a foreign language. 
The old drawings from my sketchbooks were placed on the image transparently showing the inverted colors of what is below. I still feel ashamed about a lot of them, the silly puns and visual jokes, mundane scribbles, desires, and struggles contained within the pages, but it was necessary to the turn the ground for this work. Some of it I can appreciate more now and feel proud of things that I have made progress with.
This makes me think of history and archaeology. the act in time, digging in the present to gain knowledge of our past and creating it for the future, while we are constantly producing new material to be dug up later.
The feel for material is very important to me. whether digital or traditional, it takes time to get acquainted with it. With this piece my material is beyond the changing images and the technology making it possible - it is almost as if it is time itself that I am digging away.

Dig Boy Dig
Mikko Lyytinen 
2023

Qmd2TAx7ehPGAdBrXXvu8mS7mnfBbuVHQCgZYtDx.name: Evolutions of Belief
Qmd2TAx7ehPGAdBrXXvu8mS7mnfBbuVHQCgZYtDx.description:
This piece seeks to connect our separate journeys in one place.  Our faith, and sometimes even the lack thereof.  Each layer is an expression waiting to be shared.  Each layer having a variety of at least 4 options that also tell a story...

Life is a journey both distant and tall.  
Many seeking a purpose.  A reason for it all. 
There comes a time where our resolve is strong.
As well as times where it is dissolved and gone.
Belief is beyond religion.
It is faith in your heart's mission.

Qmd3GUzsr2gYtsmrWbNRRwJL3HQ7jww3r3sfhPkF.name: Per Unitatem Vis
Qmd3GUzsr2gYtsmrWbNRRwJL3HQ7jww3r3sfhPkF.description:
“What we call the beginning is often the end. And to make an end is to make a beginning. The end is where we start from.”
-T.S. Eliot

"Lo que llamamos el principio es a menudo el final. Y hacer un final es hacer un comienzo. El final es donde comenzamos." 
-T.S. Eliot

This is my first piece created to change every hour and it is a part of a transmedia exploration that consist of a series of sculptures, paintings, drawings and also a Virtual/immersive exhibit that I made as an app for Apple, Android and Windows called "Amor Fati Exhibit". I used T.S Eliot to explain the theme of the piece but every hour has a different meaning.

Qmd54Xre2Y18oGnbHf6c31qLSe18HcBGRV95U7dy.name: 24 Hours of Skulls | Physical Collection
Qmd54Xre2Y18oGnbHf6c31qLSe18HcBGRV95U7dy.description:
---This NFT represents the sale of 24 physical ink paintings of animal skulls and skeletons created by Skeenee. These paintings were first featured on Makersplace (https://makersplace.com/skeenee/). Skeenee will personally deliver this physical collection to the winner of this auction on first sale---


Spend a day in the company of Skeenee’s Skull and Skeleton creations in your own space in the metaverse. Venture inside CryptoVoxels to your very own parcel where “24 hours of Skulls” awaits.  With each hour spent there, an exciting new artwork is displayed, revealing 24 unique creations. Understand the creation process behind each piece as it is brought to life through video.
Finally come back to reality as you take ownership of each of the 24 physical artworks, delivered in person by Skeenee. (Buyers in the International Space Station may need to wait to take delivery).

Buy this and you’ll receive:

-The NFT, "24 hours of Skulls"

-24 ink paintings created by Skeenee with fountain pen and ink on Arches paper

-A central CryptoVoxels Parcel featuring the NFT, the paintings and process videos. (https://www.cryptovoxels.com/parcels/281)

-A meural of the artwork

Each artwork comes from the Skull & Skeleton ink painting series which was started by Skeenee in 2018 to study anatomy & contrast and was inspired by renaissance drawings; a demonstration of a time where art and science were seen as one. The paintings are drawn with fountain pens on Arches paper, painted & shaded with Sumi ink and watercolors.

Remember, the clock is ticking…

Qmd7LeB6Fb3aAB3XNwhRhfih1VMfb1sLPpifk9zY.name: Euphoria
Qmd7LeB6Fb3aAB3XNwhRhfih1VMfb1sLPpifk9zY.description:
Euphoria was born in 2087. A golden child. Being fascinated by Ethereum from a young age, she grew up to become an excavator, looking for hidden messages within the blockchain. There was a time when on-chain messaging was unnecessary and inefficient compared to centralized services. Most messages Euphoria came across were meaningless, until one day she stumbled upon a message embedded in block 14276155. The message read “In the future, things will be”. Feeling excited, she investigated further. To her surprise she found multiple messages within the same Ethereum address, in some sort of formation. 

To read about her discovery, please visit: https://www.bottlesartwork.com/pagetwo

Qmd8d9rdAWue9UYw5Fieip3D6nxc5ZvDN2Y2MngP.name: "Untitled #2", from "Slits in Depth" series (2020/ 2021)
Qmd8d9rdAWue9UYw5Fieip3D6nxc5ZvDN2Y2MngP.description:
This is the second work from the series of 3D anaglyph images “Slits in Depth”. 
“Untitled #2” was created and edited during The Great Lockdown. It has five layers: four dynamic and one static.

The background layer (“Exteriors”) presents landscapes photographed during some of my walks in the forest. The middle layer (“Resistance Band”) was shot in my studio with artificial light. And the top three layers (“Interior #1”, “#2” and “#3”) depict geometric architectural details from the place I live.

10% of the sales of the master and its layers is reserved for Acerola Fund (acerola.eth), intended for the purchase of NFTs created by other artists.

Pedro Victor Brandão
March, 2021

Qmd9sxtRPhbks68tyGYVf179rWPVaKDoaSgKyjdy.name: The WARRIOR
Qmd9sxtRPhbks68tyGYVf179rWPVaKDoaSgKyjdy.description:
The WARRIOR

The spirit of a Warrior is not geared to indulging and complaining, nor is it geared to winning or losing. 

The spirit of a Warrior is geared only to struggle, and every struggle is a Warrior's last battle on earth. 

Thus the outcome matters very little to him. In his last battle on earth a Warrior lets his spirit flow free and clear. 

And as he wages his battle, knowing that his intent is impeccable, a Warrior laughs and laughs.

A Warrior considers himself already dead, so there is nothing to lose. 

The worst has already happened to him, therefore he's clear and calm; judging him by his acts or by his words, one would never suspect that he has witnessed everything.

-Carlos Castaneda

Created by WINCHAWA ///

QmdBCUWiZrtkx3ziRXbhQ3Vgqbsn3i7FFncPLQrd.name: 24h Mardi / Pony
QmdBCUWiZrtkx3ziRXbhQ3Vgqbsn3i7FFncPLQrd.description:
BRIEF: “Hot, Hot, Hot!” is a collection of static and animated digital art reflecting on love, longing, and existential loneliness. A self-exploration of the feminine form; an introspective odyssey upon the digital seas only touching briefly the sensual shores of the real world. Named after each of the 7 days of the week in French &  English words/phrases; this piece represents 1 day consisting of: 1 primary static image + 5 alternate glitch states (used to create a separate animation). 

BACKGROUND: 

For millennia the feminine form has been appropriated, commodified, objectified, curated, policed, and brutalized by men and for the male gaze. 

Today, unconditional self-acceptance of feminine bodies remains an act of radical self-love and still carries risk of violence in a deeply misogynist culture. The luxury of safe self-expression is elusive; only further complicated by age, color, creed, sex, gender, ability, sexuality, and class. Whether it be in real or digital spaces, feminine bodies are treated with a spectrum of toxic hostile reactions from self-appointed patriarchal enforcers who take it upon themselves to steal joy, love, life, and happiness from any female (sex or gendered) persons that exercise their self-sovereignty in public or private; real or digital spaces. Despite the culture of terror, the feminine aspect of humanity is asserting herself and sisters are embodying in their power.

INQUIRY: 

When the last grain of dust settles on the digital frontier what will the real world look and feel like? Will NFB’s (non-fungible-beings) and their fleshy forms be treasured or despised? Will the real world lay in rubble? Does a world still reeling from the pandemic return to desperately pressing flesh against flesh; or will glass, silicone, and electricity be the sole comforts accessible to those inside of a deepening dystopian nightmare? 

What does love, intimacy, and vulnerability look and feel like in the future? How does it feel in the present? Will the essential need of skin to skin contact between human beings drive our species to create teleportation devices out of sheer desperation? As HD gives way to 4K, 6K, 8K, Augmented Reality, and Virtual Reality, how far can we, and will we, push ourselves across the world; across the universe — at the speed of light — in search of love?

QmdCoyFgP5kwNBcXeihkk787enYJy8sJXF1GfUJJ.name: B9 Early Works VII
QmdCoyFgP5kwNBcXeihkk787enYJy8sJXF1GfUJJ.description:
Bulbasaur 9 series on Async Art is a collaboration between Hulki Okan Tabak and Bulbasaur 9 as a father - son team. Unless extra information is given, all drawings are by B9 and editing is by HoT. 

Bulbasaur 9 is an emerging artist, YouTuber and storyteller. You can find more about him on his YouTube channel at https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCRjLXhHKyBpI813vFvMiMVQ.

This series is a result of library search by the duo. Some of the works were previously minted and burned afterwards. Some of them are minted for the first time. The series runs through 7 sets of 4 artworks, 1 HoT influenced special collaboration and 1 set titled Falling into the Tree. 

Due to the programmable nature of Async Art's canvas which enables multiple artworks to coalesce into one, this platform was chosen for minting.  

Early Works VII consists of:
Animation Time New Year Upgrade
Lipservice
Monkey in the Middle
Stacked Up

QmdDcgqwfFKfuYfo8DDUx1F4YWtypH93u3XBwaZS.name: The code tablet
QmdDcgqwfFKfuYfo8DDUx1F4YWtypH93u3XBwaZS.description:
The classic laptop becomes the tablet of the law, as if to say: everything was already written. On the screen it appears the following citation from The Rape of Lucrece by William Shakespeare:

Time's glory is to calm contending kings
To unmask falsehood, and bring truth to light
To stamp the seal of time in aged things
To wake the morn, and sentinel the night
To wrong the wronger till he render right

As well as this one by Juvenal (Satire VI, lines 347–348, circa 100 A.D.):

But who will guard the guards themselves?

and the original Latin:

Sed quis custodiet ipsos Custodes?

Both citations are contained is the seminal paper of Stuart Haber and Scott Stornetta (How to Time-Stamp a Digital Document, The Journal of Cryptography, 1991) proposing for the very first time the idea of blockchain.

Both citations are contained is the seminal paper of Stuart Haber and Scott Stornetta (How to Time-Stamp a Digital Document, The Journal of Cryptography, 1991) proposing for the very first time the idea of blockchain.

QmdEL8kNQfgpVkP5nBNVp2cZo7g797KedsJEkZ2N.description:
Welcome to the Barnyard! It's a place where mayhem and madness rule the days. The citizens of the barnyard think WAGMI, but I'm not so sure about that. Goat is likely NGMI, for sure. And let's hope that balloon stays aloft.

The background for this work is one of my original paintings in Ozark pigments. It's a real scene from a real barnyard in Weesatche, TX in a little German settlement that is now a ghost town. I used pics from my husband's photo album to recreate the scene. For this NFT I embellished it. A lot. I hope you enjoy it. I had a ton of fun creating it.

QmdEVT924vwmWsZgdmAZ82Xe3jqeajbV1oBjCRqB.name: 'Attack'
QmdEVT924vwmWsZgdmAZ82Xe3jqeajbV1oBjCRqB.description:
An abstract study based on the understanding of the ADSR envelope and its underlying principles of 'Attack, Decay, Sustain & Release'.

My ideas are borne in midflight on ethereal planes of existence and brought into life within the first impulse. We have to strike when creativity hits, when the gift of the ultra present presents itself to us or watch it drift off into the ether.

'Attack' is the first in the series of 4 works and features a 24hr cycle of 24 artworks.
It is inspired by the minimalist aesthetic of Japanese Ukiyo-e prints and my fascination with fragmented forms.
Created using 3D techniques, 2D illustration methods and zero AI. 

Future enhancements include AR connectivity that provide access to original audio compositions and more.
