QmdFN9wZ2WZ93RysBamWqGzpEigqjTQ6amowTqDK.name: "Selfless"
QmdFN9wZ2WZ93RysBamWqGzpEigqjTQ6amowTqDK.description:
The thought of handling the span and fate of people's lives can often be very overwhelming and intimidating. The hefty task is not alone in dealing with the intense pressure; it also lies in gradually cultivating the in-grown patience necessary to withstand one from stepping away from the many health catastrophes of people's lives. The instinct impels many to try one last time, to continue probing the solution. Here, the cause is greater than the burden of duty. Loads of empathy are requisites to rightly attuning mind and body for
work. It calls for perspective as to how life can easily pun out difficult for anyone, for our dear friend or loved, for anyone, ourselves included.
I respect the courage and the character it takes to uphold this personal value; this art piece extends my recognition and lauds their commendable spirit of humanity.

QmdRiMz8eRjn2xPrwhwQDdx9BW3bExf3XkptYrsY.name: Cosmic Buddha
QmdRiMz8eRjn2xPrwhwQDdx9BW3bExf3XkptYrsY.description:
In every moment, the illusion of “me” renews itself.

24 unique images – taken one every hour – remind us of the stars, the big bang, the beauty we recognize in chaos and our own position within.

This dynamic piece is eternally linked to the time zone of the Himalayan Mountains. 

The images have been created with vvv.org, a live-programming environment.

Each frame is unique, saved from a real-time rendering environment influenced by multiple real-time variables.

QmdTv7imXtf5NpcrmRYTY1vwgMX78744oEkbQZAS.name: dFATE.
QmdTv7imXtf5NpcrmRYTY1vwgMX78744oEkbQZAS.description:
​dCREATION. is the first artistic attempt to represent and idealize the origin of humanity following the new evolutionary theories. Fine Art history meets the Sci-fi worldwide trend in a unique atmosphere of emotions and colors, leaving a window for every kind of personal interpretation. A fantastic series of four different Art Pieces to describe the unknown feeling between the Creator and his born, all connected by a third element, the “God Particle” or the Higgs-Boson, which plays an essential role in this metaphysical relationship. The three parts of the whole, the sacred Trinity, all those essences find a place to exist in this abstract world, a reality full of mysteries and secrets, which will reveal a new vision of human evolution myth. A dualism of specific colors characterizes each piece to describe all feelings involved in this ancient and primordial love, where is essential to find your own truth to explain the whole.

Illustration n.1: dFATE.

QmdW3EQuqkG1eRmLdptD2K17EeB4HgsRrPwDLZEy.name: HaCKittieZ
QmdW3EQuqkG1eRmLdptD2K17EeB4HgsRrPwDLZEy.description:
Who will be the most Meowfool of the Meowfoolest?! 

6 HaCKittieZ are fighting for the crown of madness! 

It is time for crowns to change their history: people, this is the crown of insanity we are talking about. 
So tell us, who is insaner than the insanest of collectors? 
Only the artists - the creators - would know, while crowning the one who is brave enough to play with the craziest possibilities of Async programmable art, on these 6 HaCKittieZ.
Welcome to the feast of fools. 

HaCKittieZ is a collaboration of Hackatao, CryptoKitties and Async. 


The 6 KittieZ are a reinterpretation by Hackatao of the CryptoKitties’ classic elements, following their own style and getting inspiration from their own art pieces.

QmdWX2xNt9APD4WobtM74MeZ3BVdwXPMAi9J4gad.name: New York Polaroids: Metamorphosis of a Different Kind
QmdWX2xNt9APD4WobtM74MeZ3BVdwXPMAi9J4gad.description:
New York Polaroids: Metamorphosis of a Different Kind

2 Artworks in 1 Daily Cycle

New York Polaroids by Athena Novo, Summer of 2022, An Alternative New York during the NFT Summit, Minted 1/1 on Async Art

While everyone was enjoying the NFT Summit, a different group of visitors were in New York. Some call them demons, monsters and zombies while I would prefer more neutral terms but nonetheless here are some of the photographs I've taken of them which I release with full disclosure and their cooperation. The prospective collectors should acknowledge the existence of "undead" and some even more exotic characters might cause some alarm among the general population. Therefore viewer caution is warranted even though most of these peoples I met during the NFT Summit seemed to be of absolutely good character (not sure about some demonic entities that did not respond) and interested in art and its manifestation with the technologies branded aptly as NFT and what not.

QmdZpVSz3K3KZYJb2ejZuNgaDKaML6MPaSA49ApH.name: Night Lights Ad Infinitum
QmdZpVSz3K3KZYJb2ejZuNgaDKaML6MPaSA49ApH.description:
Night Lights Ad Infinitum is based on my night photography. It is consists of 4 layers and 8 states making 4096 unique possible final combinations. Underlying the final work are 8 separate photographs of actual night lights edited and re-created as I imagined them to be.

The purpose of this work is to experiment with images. The outcome of the experiment is dependent on the observers, contributors, collectors and their relationship with the art. For in solitude, the absolute meaning, even if it exists, is not decipherable or at the very least not transferrable. But with the pieces all relating to each other, the observer creates meanings of her his own.

QmdaNAxAyDj3ci2UeTJtn2uysYD4tpapgnPWreEV.name: Yorick's Box
QmdaNAxAyDj3ci2UeTJtn2uysYD4tpapgnPWreEV.description:
Merging self-portraiture with Shakespeare this is Yorick's Box. The work explores the ideas of the multi-faceted self via self-portraiture, depicting the spiritual self as a 100 handed triplet. The skulls each have their own unique temperament and story, as Yorick's in Shakespeare's 'Hamlet'. Just as Hamlet contemplated his own fate as melancholic Prince of Denmark, pondering the life of former court jester Yorick, so each head encourages introspection. As the day moves from morning to night the image rotates to reveal new aspects and intricate detailing.
 "Alas, poor Yorick! I knew him, Horatio, a fellow of infinite jest, of most excellent fancy." William Shakespeare, Hamlet, V:I.

QmdcYwvZhqUquLYxEjwuJZ6rRUR4j48fH9Z12VU1.name: Landscape Study #2 (with Creatures)
QmdcYwvZhqUquLYxEjwuJZ6rRUR4j48fH9Z12VU1.description:
A departure from the grounded tranquillity found in Study #1, this programmable painting presents far more dramatic and diverse scenes. These take inspiration from a variety of themes - often blending fiction and reality. 

The artist has challenged themselves to create a set of extraordinary creatures and exquisite frames that succeeded in complimenting, contrasting, or otherwise enhancing each unique landscape.

Each combination of layers allows plenty of room for interpretation - highlighted in part by their cryptic (or outright vague) state titles.

Qmdd76JHiYqAwB5vUf2EUZREycpVkZedRSsjq9E2.name: Brigitte Bardot
Qmdd76JHiYqAwB5vUf2EUZREycpVkZedRSsjq9E2.description: This polaroid mosaic depicting French actress and singer Brigitte Bardot is the first of my ICON series. Bardot, one of the first popular culture icons, captivated a generation with her beauty and sense of freedom. She paved the way for countless others to follow and so it made sense to begin my series with her. My piece has 24 different color variations, which change automatically on the hour, like a clock. I designed the colorways specifically for the different times of the day in which they will be active. Let this beautiful and iconic image accompany you through the different stages of your day, no matter where in the world you may be. Bardot illuminated in pink and orange hues will help you ease your way into the day, more muted tones will ensure you stay focused during working hours, and the vibrant colors that play into the night will set the vibes to party the way Bardot did in the 50s. The owner of this token will also receive the 1/1 physical framed polaroid set that I used to create this digital time-lapse. 12 original polaroids in a secret colorway not seen here on Async, framed in a beautiful white frame that measures 20’’ x 15’’ and lets the polaroids do all the talking.

QmddWLGRWdFYjAs4JVdQ2pLrvyMKZaqiPbB4c4iF.name: Under Construction
QmddWLGRWdFYjAs4JVdQ2pLrvyMKZaqiPbB4c4iF.description:
What the “Modern” human describes as the “primitive” human, has long used or re-used places that are suitable for living without leaving for thousands of years, which has resulted in multi-layered hill like structures which we call “mounds”. Mounds are the usage of living spaces that are constructed from the ashes of what has been destroyed by wars or natural causes, a rebirth.

It is possible to examine the distant past through archeological methods. But how can we examine the current moment we live in and the process of these “modern mounds”?

Throughout history and today, we see these layered structures rapidly moving towards both the sky and the undergrounds while transforming, breaking, accumulating, and mixing. In this context, the project works to strip away from the real plane, and move towards the plane of an image while creating a new space that offers contemplation through the examination of overtime. Also the project challenges the concept of “a moment” while examining a long stretch of time and works to keep an up to date record of these modern mounds.

QmdgcsLfRtSu96Yxs6EQzu8QtBg1dUTsgq7TQGcG.name: Eternity
QmdgcsLfRtSu96Yxs6EQzu8QtBg1dUTsgq7TQGcG.description:
"Eternity is in love with the productions of time."

Night layer: "For man has closed himself up, till he sees all things thro' narrow chinks of his cavern"

Sunrise layer:
"He who binds to himself a joy
Does the wingèd life destroy;
But he who kisses the joy as it flies
Lives in eternity's sunrise."

Day layer: "If the doors of perception were cleansed every thing would appear to man as it is, infinite."

Sunset layer: 
"The moon like a flower
In heaven's high bower,
With silent delight,
Sits and smiles on the night."

All quotes from William Blake, who has taught me much about The Self, identity, and being in the world.  I turned to Blake to get inspiration for what it means to be in these new virtual worlds we are creating.

Everyone dreams about getting into space, discover new worlds, and extend their boundaries. We wanted to offer this journey to you through art. To perceive these galaxies, planets, moons, and stars!

1. You can select the galaxy.
2. You can define the existing status quo (to be peaceful or at war) 
3. You can add the North Star or a Moon state
4. You can pick the visited planet.

QmdkYhy1MMYegcCW5LqENz2hpQcPEMaK3dJFixeR.name: OUR FATHER IN THE METAVERSE #1
QmdkYhy1MMYegcCW5LqENz2hpQcPEMaK3dJFixeR.description:
https://mathiasrusch-metaverse.com/

The "Our Father" - The cycle of paintings by artist Mathias Rusch (*1927-2003)   

If we speak of the most important prayer of Christian faith, then of the "Our Father".  
 
This prayer gift of Jesus to his disciples, later handed down to us Christians, has become the actual Christian self-understanding, the "prayer of the Lord". Packed into a few sentences, it has come to be regarded as the actual confession of faith and is prayed millions of times a day, both individually and in communities. The fact that this "conversation with God" has hardly ever been depicted (in contrast to the Passion) is probably due to the immense message it conveys. The fact that the painter Mathias Rusch dared to translate the "Our Father" can be explained by the fact that his daily work was based on faith, hope and trust in God. Mathias Rusch was aware that he could only exist in the understanding of his art "as a gift of God". Most of his late works (Our Father, Live and Let Live, Sermon on the Mount, Lauretan Litany, Litany of the Sacred Heart) were written, as he confessed, under the "kind help" of the Highest, always accompanied by personal prayers, meditations or invocations. The fact that Mathias Rusch did not reveal a dying word for the interpretation of his works of art is to be justified by the fact that he understood himself to a large extent as a mediator of a higher power. Thus we are sometimes quite helplessly confronted with an immense abundance of Christian symbols, metaphysical allusions, concretizations and abstractions, in unique hues and compositions. Completely in the sense of Mathias Rusch we dive before the 13 works of art into the enormous topic of earthly existence and Christian eschatology, marvel before the color power, before the hints, confessions and convictions of the very deeply felt "Our Father's". Finally, we become humbled and ultimately grateful to be initiated into the world-prayer of a "knowing" believer, again and again, with each glance at each of these magnificent works of art. Whoever takes a longer "eye" look at this self-contained, unique complete work, consisting of 13 unique pieces in oil on canvas, 170x170cm, will not be able to resist a lasting effect and deep consternation.

Qmdm5BPvpPhQZRURxEFhkS5sc4RuYmDo2U9bMmAW.name: Dance: To Break Free
Qmdm5BPvpPhQZRURxEFhkS5sc4RuYmDo2U9bMmAW.description:
Day begins with Fluid Prophecy where the dancer is enjoying a solo spot under the spotlights. Daylight follows Together under the Spotlights where two lead dancers are in a duet of colorful lights.

Night commences with Pull which is taken from the third act and the protagonist is being wound up metaphorically and physically. Rest of the night is the disturbing image of To Break Free with scant hope of escape for the leading woman of the third act.

Photography by Hulki Okan Tabak from 2019. Photoshoot from dress rehearsals of a dance project about three women and the hardships they endured. Edited various times with final edit on June 2021 to be minted on Async Art.

This has been a very intense photoshoot and gorgeous performance by the whole group. Further chapters in the series may be released depending on collector interest.

Qmdm8rhP8oEQaKY8FBerQ2EpU3PChi9BDXkpWF31.name: Experimental No.3 #2008
Qmdm8rhP8oEQaKY8FBerQ2EpU3PChi9BDXkpWF31.description:
Artwork Title: Experimental No.3 #2008
Date of Artwork: 2021
Dimension: 1674 pixel x 2160 pixel
Type of Work: Silver Gelatin Photogram, Digital Painting
Edition: Unique
Note: This artwork is a type of digital art. The hand-made photogram is one of the subjects that compose this piece, and this photogram is not for sale separately whatever in the crypto world or the real world.

Notwithstanding, the beginning of the photography is representational, it ultimately leads to the way of the abstract. Photography has nothing to do with painting, although the thinking of abstractness renders them getting closer and closer. Photography remains the interpretation of "Light", and to express the “Light” is its inescapable responsibility. I find the "Line" could be one of the forms to present the "Light". Through this new attempt to keep looking for balance and harmony.

QmdnBdeFG7SpFC6fCMS2hErRCiPkch85gKeC1cBT.name: Who's The Controller Now?
QmdnBdeFG7SpFC6fCMS2hErRCiPkch85gKeC1cBT.description:
An update of Diego Rivera’s famous fresco, Man at the Crossroads.  Destroyed for political reasons in 1934 by the Rockefeller family.  Repainted in Mexico City and renamed - Man, Controller of the Universe.

In a time of global economic distress, an oligarch's contracts came with the right to silence an artist, and erase an enormous physical work from one of the world's most famous locations - 30 Rockefeller Center.  Pressured by client and peers alike, Rivera found himself at that familiar crossroads - can I remain the captain of my own artistic destiny in a world of commerce?

Qmdo7kMWe8kCUjTS7ENjTFkGbUqMhQiA6csKFbra.name: Abeona
Qmdo7kMWe8kCUjTS7ENjTFkGbUqMhQiA6csKFbra.description:
Our sun is about to die. It might happen a thousand years from now, but it might happen tomorrow - we can't risk it. We've waited far too long. 

Abeona has been ready for centuries. She has been our guide, our administrator, our savior, and now she will be our womb - our glorious mother, who will travel a distance unimaginable until ideal conditions for human life are found. Perhaps they never will be, in which case those of us who remain will sleep until the end of the universe itself.

I allow myself a little pride. It was my ancestor who programmed the original iteration of Abeona and my ancestral line that kept up these archives after she became self-aware (and more than capable of improving her own programming beyond anything any human brain could achieve).

It is time.

QmdoTECjTjLeEjKzrGR1ksPMNJr5wJLdtVSM3wCo.name: STOP!
QmdoTECjTjLeEjKzrGR1ksPMNJr5wJLdtVSM3wCo.description:
STOP!
by Hulki Okan Tabak
4 piece programmable artwork on Async Art
1/1 minted September 2021

...

Part of a series of Marylebone, London based artworks. All of these works consist of photographs taken by me in January 2020. It is the time of Lunar New Year, Wuhan lockdowns, and the very first signs of the virus in Europe.

Marylebone was originally an Ancient Parish formed to serve the manors (landholdings) of Lileston (in the west - which gives its name to modern Lisson Grove) and Tyburn in the east. The parish is likely to have been in place since at least the twelfth century and will have used the boundaries of the pre-existing manors. The boundaries of the parish were consistent from the late twelfth century to the creation of the Metropolitan Borough which succeeded it. (Wikipedia)

QmdqfLHrCjAqS4yxwTa6eC6MMALWyuTYXHLRk7GM.name: Asteroid
QmdqfLHrCjAqS4yxwTa6eC6MMALWyuTYXHLRk7GM.description:
Asteroid

AsyncArt Genesis
Consists of two 1 of 1 unique panoramic views of a digitally hand carved metamorphic architectural space, that represent day and night cycles.

Gentle lines hide among intense meshes, flowing freely they create a fabric of space or maybe a landscape of a distant asteroid from an outer space? In this art work we invite your imagination to travel outside of human perception or maybe even outside of this world. We invite you on a journey that explores the idea of architectural space. Follow the day and night cycles to become a space explorer and make new discoveries. 

Coming from years of architectural research in depth, each digital painting is a carefully crafted abstract architectural landscape, that explores spatial qualities of landscape, surface and texture.
Each art work comes from a process that involves hand sculpting in different mediums, starting from physical sculpting and into a 3D digital hand sculpting.
The art work comes from the project Interface, that took more than 7500 hours to develop the project and methodology plus more than 250 hrs to finish one digitally hand sculpted landscape.

2021
MABLAB

QmdtmXR9VjpmZkXgw3CEs7Q8X5UkpLWJvrqnWh27.name: Ardor Sublime
QmdtmXR9VjpmZkXgw3CEs7Q8X5UkpLWJvrqnWh27.description:
Created in collusion with graphic designer TypeDistortDecay, as part of Copy Planet's expanding universe. 

Informed by the physical, mental, and behavioral changes that follow a 24-hour cycle. 

“Circadian Rhythms” is a pilot series comprised of 3 works for Copy Planet’s Centre for Climatology. 

The work intends to present a meditation on the sublime as a way to contemplate these natural phenomena as agents of change through emergent technology. 

As a respond to the shifts experienced within the current zeitgeist and its effects on the human and non-human participants existing in space time. 

Each work will be uploaded twice ( daytime / nighttime ) responding to the natural processes of light and dark.  

Words by James Ly

QmdtvsQwLjfUCSR8pRg98bFvZFdXxC2VsbUUTeKY.name: La fille de joie
QmdtvsQwLjfUCSR8pRg98bFvZFdXxC2VsbUUTeKY.description:
As a press photographer, I attended many red carpet events. Though I witnessed glamorous moments, faces and looks, I realized that I was drawn to create this world from a different perspective; one which undressed the soul, and rendered a more authentic moment. After some time, it became the same scenes, the same clichés, the same smiles, the same looks and the same photographers. As a celebrity, having to see more than 30 flashes per second every time a photographer spots them, probably makes them want to protect themselves. Seeing celebrities live in this world of excessive media coverage, I started to develop a mixed feeling of admiration and respect, but also pity, and finally detachment. 

The Personalities are decomposed and re-assembled in an abstract composition, guided by my instinct and fed by what the model inspired in me.

The original digital size of "La fille de joie" portrait is 120 by 180 cm. 

This is a portrait of the singer Janelle Monáe.

QmdwLoKQ9qwJZpfmMN25GRQaXNn7ss94SGULzNZT.name: ​​OUR FATHER IN THE METAVERSE #89
QmdwLoKQ9qwJZpfmMN25GRQaXNn7ss94SGULzNZT.description:
https://mathiasrusch-metaverse.com/

The "Our Father" - The cycle of paintings by artist Mathias Rusch (*1927-2003).   

If there is a most important prayer of Christian faith, then it must be the "Our Father".  
 
This prayer gift of Jesus to his disciples, later handed down to us Christians, has become the actual Christian self-understanding, the "prayer of the Lord". Packed into a few sentences, it has come to be regarded as the actual confession of faith and is prayed millions of times a day, both individually and in communities. The fact that this "conversation with God" has hardly ever been depicted (in contrast to the Passion) is probably due to the immense message it conveys. The fact that the painter Mathias Rusch dared to translate the "Our Father" can be explained by the fact that his daily work was based on faith, hope, and trust in God. Mathias Rusch was aware that he could only exist in the understanding of his art "as a gift of God". Most of his late works (Our Father, Live and Let Live, Sermon on the Mount, Lauretan Litany, Litany of the Sacred Heart) were written, as he confessed, under the "kind help" of the Highest, always accompanied by personal prayers, meditations or invocations. The fact that Mathias Rusch did not reveal a word for the interpretation of his works of art is to be justified by the fact that he understood himself to a large extent as a mediator of a higher power. Thus we are sometimes quite helplessly confronted with an immense abundance of Christian symbols, metaphysical allusions, concretizations, and abstractions, in unique hues and compositions. Completely in the sense of Mathias Rusch we dive before the 13 works of art into the enormous topic of earthly existence and Christian eschatology, marvel before the color power, before the hints, confessions, and convictions of the very deeply felt "Our Father's". Finally, we become humbled and ultimately grateful to be initiated into the world-prayer of a "knowing" believer, again and again, with each glance at each of these magnificent works of art. Whoever takes a longer "eye" look at this self-contained, unique complete work, consisting of 13 unique pieces in oil on canvas, 170x170cm, will not be able to resist a lasting effect and deep consternation.

QmdwVxfG9fRpGeZm4NJbTK4qtTf3ajPDCZbdPDwe.name: LORD OF COLOURS
QmdwVxfG9fRpGeZm4NJbTK4qtTf3ajPDCZbdPDwe.description:
Long time ago, the rainbow was actually a very poor man. So poor that he had no money to buy clothes and wandered the streets naked.
One stormy day, lightning lit up everything, and the naked man thought that the lightning must be very powerful and maybe it could help him solve his problem.
The ray felt very sorry for that man who had also come to him for help, so ray had an idea:
– “I will give you something better than my clothes: the possibility of living here in heaven with me. I will give you seven colors and you could cover your body with them. When my work is done, you will display all your colors in the sky. Men will admire you and fall in love with your beauty. They will love you because they will know that you herald the arrival of the sun.”
And so it was that from then on, the lord of the seven colors began to act in the sky, announcing the end of a storm and how men fell in love with him ever since.

QmdwdksVJGLVXwd5MmkvXVLDXWw6oTq8TkpmunEi.name: Logos
QmdwdksVJGLVXwd5MmkvXVLDXWw6oTq8TkpmunEi.description:
Logos is the second programmable Art NFT by Italian artist Francesca Fini.
In this works she recreates and re-prototypes in 3D the Art lamps conceived in the 70s by her father designer, and produced in limited edition by the visionary Italian company New Lamp. A few very rare examples of these Art lamps / light sculptures, now out of production, have recently become collector's items in the modernism market, and sold for tens of thousands of dollars at Christie's and other major auction houses.
This project, animated by the artist’s desire to celebrate the genius of her father, digitally brings back to life a lost piece of Italian design from one of the most innovative and brilliant periods in recent history.

Logos
by Gianfranco Fini
New Lamp, 1971

​This Art lamp was made of polymer semi-transparent parallelepipeds of various sizes, resting on a chromium-plated steel base measuring 30 x 30 cm. The base had a luminous inner side creating interesting optical effects. The piece is featured in Luce lampade 1968-1973: il nuovo design italiano, Fulvio Ferrari e Napoleone Ferrari, Allemandi Editore.

The collector of this NFT will receive as a reward a hand-drawn sketch of the lamp signed by Gianfranco Fini.

QmdxynN4cyXJPM5ZSTjTNaV1ak3KSAmu1KK4rRce.name: 24h Mercredi / Backup
QmdxynN4cyXJPM5ZSTjTNaV1ak3KSAmu1KK4rRce.description:
BRIEF: “Hot, Hot, Hot!” is a collection of static and animated digital art reflecting on love, longing, and existential loneliness. A self-exploration of the feminine form; an introspective odyssey upon the digital seas only touching briefly the sensual shores of the real world. Named after each of the 7 days of the week in French &  English words/phrases; this piece represents 1 day consisting of: 1 primary static image + 5 alternate glitch states (used to create a separate animation). 

BACKGROUND: 

For millennia the feminine form has been appropriated, commodified, objectified, curated, policed, and brutalized by men and for the male gaze. 

Today, unconditional self-acceptance of feminine bodies remains an act of radical self-love and still carries risk of violence in a deeply misogynist culture. The luxury of safe self-expression is elusive; only further complicated by age, color, creed, sex, gender, ability, sexuality, and class. Whether it be in real or digital spaces, feminine bodies are treated with a spectrum of toxic hostile reactions from self-appointed patriarchal enforcers who take it upon themselves to steal joy, love, life, and happiness from any female (sex or gendered) persons that exercise their self-sovereignty in public or private; real or digital spaces. Despite the culture of terror, the feminine aspect of humanity is asserting herself and sisters are embodying in their power.

INQUIRY: 

When the last grain of dust settles on the digital frontier what will the real world look and feel like? Will NFB’s (non-fungible-beings) and their fleshy forms be treasured or despised? Will the real world lay in rubble? Does a world still reeling from the pandemic return to desperately pressing flesh against flesh; or will glass, silicone, and electricity be the sole comforts accessible to those inside of a deepening dystopian nightmare? 

What does love, intimacy, and vulnerability look and feel like in the future? How does it feel in the present? Will the essential need of skin to skin contact between human beings drive our species to create teleportation devices out of sheer desperation? As HD gives way to 4K, 6K, 8K, Augmented Reality, and Virtual Reality, how far can we, and will we, push ourselves across the world; across the universe — at the speed of light — in search of love?

Qme29ZJEVS8h3qkDQ67R8BMrtYFyQoMYzz9zFydf.name: SPINAL
Qme29ZJEVS8h3qkDQ67R8BMrtYFyQoMYzz9zFydf.description:
SPINAL is a piece I originally created during the summer of 2021. It was born not unlike any of my other creations. After a long day at work and getting the kids tucked in for the night, I sat down at my desk, put on the headphones, and got to work. If I recall correctly, there was a mix of Soundgarden, Alice in Chains, and Pearl Jam streaming from the playlist that night. And, as usually happens, a couple of hours later, the piece was complete. I'm honestly not sure what happens during that time, I just let the music lead the way and eventually push the shapes and colors into a form that speaks to me. There's something about the symmetry and the mix of hard and soft lines in this one that give it a great mood I think.

For this updated version of SPINAL, I chose to bring the artwork to life on Async and reveal the power of adding and removing the various layers to create 24 unique versions of the artwork that update every hour of the day. Each has its own minimalist vibe while simultaneously tying itself back to the original creation.

Qme4zogC9PBaoEafCCcxAvhbvqq1WzE57v6Wb7th.name: Don Quixote: Travels
Qme4zogC9PBaoEafCCcxAvhbvqq1WzE57v6Wb7th.description:
Don Quixote: Travels by Hulki Okan Tabak, minted 1/1 on Async Art, 2022

4 artworks in a daily cycle..

...

Don Quixote project is a highly personal interpretation of the hero and his world. Various photographic and AI tools are used to create, manipulate and recreate the images. The story will be numbered for all of us to track down what we hold essentially. Beyond ease of use, the numbers are not sequential. Each image is independent but some images will be interdependent parts of smaller stories which I will mention. I would also mint some editions outside of Manifold. Note that editions of this project could be 1/1s or multi editions. The mints on Async Art will not be numbered as they each contain multiple images in themselves.

...

Don Quixote is a Spanish epic novel by Miguel de Cervantes. Originally published in two parts, in 1605 and 1615, its full title is The Ingenious Gentleman Don Quixote of La Mancha.

A founding work of Western literature, it is often labeled as the first modern novel and one of the greatest ever written. Don Quixote is also one of the most-translated books in the world.

When first published, Don Quixote was usually interpreted as a comic novel. After the French Revolution, it was better known for its central ethic that individuals can be right while society is quite wrong and was seen as a story of disenchantment. In the 19th century, it was seen as social commentary, but no one could easily tell "whose side Cervantes was on". Many critics came to view the work as a tragedy in which Don Quixote's idealism and nobility are viewed by the post-chivalric world as insane, and are defeated and rendered useless by common reality. By the 20th century, the novel had come to occupy a canonical space as one of the foundations of modern literature and a formidable example of what letters can do. (wikipedia)

Don Quixote project is a highly personal interpretation of the hero and his world. Various photographic and AI tools are used to create, manipulate and recreate the images. The story will be numbered for all of us to track down what we hold essentially. Beyond ease of use, the numbers are not sequential. Each image is independent but some images will be interdependent parts of smaller stories which I will mention. I would also mint some editions outside of Manifold. Note that editions of this project could be 1/1s or multi editions. The mints on Async Art will not be numbered as they each contain multiple images in themselves.

...

Don Quixote is a Spanish epic novel by Miguel de Cervantes. Originally published in two parts, in 1605 and 1615, its full title is The Ingenious Gentleman Don Quixote of La Mancha.

A founding work of Western literature, it is often labeled as the first modern novel and one of the greatest ever written. Don Quixote is also one of the most-translated books in the world.

When first published, Don Quixote was usually interpreted as a comic novel. After the French Revolution, it was better known for its central ethic that individuals can be right while society is quite wrong and was seen as a story of disenchantment. In the 19th century, it was seen as social commentary, but no one could easily tell "whose side Cervantes was on". Many critics came to view the work as a tragedy in which Don Quixote's idealism and nobility are viewed by the post-chivalric world as insane, and are defeated and rendered useless by common reality. By the 20th century, the novel had come to occupy a canonical space as one of the foundations of modern literature and a formidable example of what letters can do. (wikipedia)

Qme5KmUeugs8B19JdMs9E91hYLiHmQs3nD2SZ5Gk.description:
"...were we led all that way for
Birth or Death? There was a Birth, certainly,
We had evidence and no doubt. I had seen birth and death,
But had thought they were different; this Birth was
Hard and bitter agony for us, like Death, our death.
We returned to our places, these Kingdoms,
But no longer at ease here, in the old dispensation,
With an alien people clutching their gods.
I should be glad of another death."

--from Journey of the Magi by T.S.Eliot

...

Qme91hvQ3pD1K9gKDRHZJLLxobmpMB7zjoLqCrNz.name: ​​OUR FATHER IN THE METAVERSE #76
Qme91hvQ3pD1K9gKDRHZJLLxobmpMB7zjoLqCrNz.description:
https://mathiasrusch-metaverse.com/

The "Our Father" - The cycle of paintings by artist Mathias Rusch (*1927-2003).

If there is a most important prayer of Christian faith, then it must be the "Our Father".  
 
This prayer gift of Jesus to his disciples, later handed down to us Christians, has become the actual Christian self-understanding, the "prayer of the Lord". Packed into a few sentences, it has come to be regarded as the actual confession of faith and is prayed millions of times a day, both individually and in communities. The fact that this "conversation with God" has hardly ever been depicted (in contrast to the Passion) is probably due to the immense message it conveys. The fact that the painter Mathias Rusch dared to translate the "Our Father" can be explained by the fact that his daily work was based on faith, hope, and trust in God. Mathias Rusch was aware that he could only exist in the understanding of his art "as a gift of God". Most of his late works (Our Father, Live and Let Live, Sermon on the Mount, Lauretan Litany, Litany of the Sacred Heart) were written, as he confessed, under the "kind help" of the Highest, always accompanied by personal prayers, meditations or invocations. The fact that Mathias Rusch did not reveal a word for the interpretation of his works of art is to be justified by the fact that he understood himself to a large extent as a mediator of a higher power. Thus we are sometimes quite helplessly confronted with an immense abundance of Christian symbols, metaphysical allusions, concretizations, and abstractions, in unique hues and compositions. Completely in the sense of Mathias Rusch we dive before the 13 works of art into the enormous topic of earthly existence and Christian eschatology, marvel before the color power, before the hints, confessions, and convictions of the very deeply felt "Our Father's". Finally, we become humbled and ultimately grateful to be initiated into the world-prayer of a "knowing" believer, again and again, with each glance at each of these magnificent works of art. Whoever takes a longer "eye" look at this self-contained, unique complete work, consisting of 13 unique pieces in oil on canvas, 170x170cm, will not be able to resist a lasting effect and deep consternation.

QmeAht6y7hB17sduyH9Ckim7M7J6EtVvPfN6CYcp.name: gN(dReaM^16)Gm
QmeAht6y7hB17sduyH9Ckim7M7J6EtVvPfN6CYcp.description:
Man is a great puzzle, the top of which lies in the human subconscious - dreams.

"Dreams are the representation of instinctive desires." Sigment Freud said once.

"Dreams are the collective subconscious, the bloodline memories of our ancestors." Carl Gustav Jung expressed similarly. 

gN(dReaM^16)Gm - a complex, interesting and thoughtful work created by WeirDao's 16 artists based on their own experiences and feelings. The confliction of multiple elements constitutes a large number of Day&Night transformations, representing the dreams' from shallow to deep, from surface to inside, from still to movement.
Each element is the intention of an artist's deep perception, so that dreams are no longer dreams or not only dreams. This is a journey from symbol to reality, an awakening of the collective subconscious.

QmeC3ti3uB2qwLqeQ4y3VYLAFebVpSdyqTVX3Kaj.name: The World is Confusing
QmeC3ti3uB2qwLqeQ4y3VYLAFebVpSdyqTVX3Kaj.description:
While the world is made up of many different levels of perception, which intersect and overlap, it is increasingly difficult to see the big picture. 

At night you are less distracted by bright colors and it is easier to see the patterns and connections. Therefore this work of art automatically changes to day or night mode every 12 hours.

The work is part of my series of digital remasters of my old drawings. It is based on a drawing from 1990, that I digitally recreated by accurately following the lines using a graphics drawing tablet before I filled the shapes with single colors.

QmeCiswiXPsZQigBBVFFHYnQz4mqKeA2Efm33Xhf.name: Aditi of the Kung Paw
QmeCiswiXPsZQigBBVFFHYnQz4mqKeA2Efm33Xhf.description:
Wind swept through the temple and for a brief moment, the damp smell transported him to the fields as a young kit, chasing mice through cattail and clover by the edge of the Lower Frisk.  Master Aditi suddenly shook his head like a cat in the rain.  Days long gone cannot touch me now.

He bent low over strange clawings on weathered bone, whiskers sweeping dust as the writings unwound their secrets and ancient curses worked into his tongue.  The Emperor had forsaken him and he had wandered the wilderness without honor and without purpose.  Ronin.

As dark spiraling energies rose in his throat, Aditi knew here was a purpose.  Power.  Not political or even physical.  No, here was power at its most raw - the Power of the Breath!  Drawing all his shame and anger, Aditi focused on the rough fibers collecting in his throat, his voice long silenced, his name unspoken.  Let me speak it now!  Kuuuuuuuuuuung PAW!

This is the only species in the multiverse that has preserved characteristics from humans, the form and the emotions. They are considered the most superior species in existence due to the emotional capabilities which were implemented by the oracle when the developers found a lost capsule containing the last records from human civilization.

QmeGZUsLjZgc3nptS7FXHQ2pGPcQUsk1SWNijAWe.name: Rock Paper Scissors
QmeGZUsLjZgc3nptS7FXHQ2pGPcQUsk1SWNijAWe.description:
Rock paper scissors is a simple little game we played as kids; whether to pass time or to call dibs on the bigger slice of pie. Under the hood, it’s a rudimentary and confrontational form of communication; three words caught in a triangular relationship of domination and submission.

A closed fist represents rock: heavy, solid, and capable of crushing scissors. An extended index and middle finger resemble scissors: sharp, sophisticated, and destined to cut paper. An open palm mimics paper: candid, transparent, and clever enough to bind rock. The only moment of truce is when matching gestures are thrown; a brief release of tension and glimpse into a mirror. 

More could be said with the three expressions. A closed fist is handing a concealed gift to an open palm; the extended index and middle fingers are calling for peace. The relationship doesn’t need to be contentious.

‘Rock Paper Scissors’ frames an ongoing conversation between two strangers. Limited to three signals, the strangers may decide whether their dialog is a never-ending chase for power, a mutual armistice, or something deeper altogether.

A third participant narrates my own relationship with my hands. As an artist, my hands mean the world to me - they allow me to express my thoughts and materialize my imagination. Perhaps a cosmic joke, my hands suffer from chronic eczema. Whenever I create art, my hands become fragile, dry husks – as though I channel life from my hands into the work. Despite all this, I choose my art to be about joy and play. In the end, it’s a fun little game.

QmeHLux5mynWuvyLRt6ADNnz5K5zcu62N4HMvQR5.name: One Day, We'll Fly Away
QmeHLux5mynWuvyLRt6ADNnz5K5zcu62N4HMvQR5.description:
"So with her eyes wide open my mother dreamed and dreamed some more, describing what life could be for us. She wasn’t talking about a postmortem world, some kind of heaven or afterlife; and she was not speaking of reincarnation (which she believes in, by the way). She dreamed of land, a spacious house, fresh air, organic food, and endless meadows without boundaries, free of evil and violence, free of toxins and environmental hazards, free of poverty, racism, and sexism . . . just free. She never talked about how we might create such a world, nor had she connected her vision to any political ideology. But she convinced my siblings and me that change is possible and that we didn’t have to be stuck there forever."

DG Kelley- "Freedom Dreams"

Featuring Ky'ri  and Ka'mauri

Do you remember the colourful PEZ dispensers with the different faces? When we were kids we used to stack candy, and today we stack satoshis because we have a plan B. That is why we are giving the middle finger to the existing system.

QmeLShctvqk7SCpwhur7ejRp5jcnELeWrTxT3BPK.name: The Revenge of Kim (2012-2021)
QmeLShctvqk7SCpwhur7ejRp5jcnELeWrTxT3BPK.description:
Presenting to the viewer a dramatically charged scene of a killer robot. Based off of a painting of Rubens with the theme of the legend of a Saint, this painting becomes more than a critic of art history. Influenced also by the Artist's recent tours of Japan and China, multiple meanings can be extracted from the contemporary work originally titled,  "The Revenge of Asia"
The viewer is confronted with an armed robot and a fire breathing dragon, both reminiscent of mythology and legend that combine story elements from the west and east. This work of art also becomes part of a larger critique on current issues revolving around the relationship between these two powers. Combining also the past and present, the modern technologically advanced robot rides waves that remind the viewer of ancient Asian scroll paintings. Today, these waves could symbolize rising ocean levels. The horizon which is made gold, reminds us not only of the commerce of art history but also becomes a reflection of Asia's current pollution problems as it obscures the sun in its haze. The ruthless dictator and human rights violator Kim Jong-un placed alongside new and amazing technological advancements give rise to questions about the true purpose of this new technology and also which political leaders that could control them.

Set to Tokyo time, in observance of the Olympic Games of 2021.
This artwork, which was originally created in 2012, and added to the blockchain a decade later, represents a shift from the immortal history of great painting as we move to a digital creator's economy.
Ironically, this artwork was conceived before the pandemic and the great rising tides that plague our earth and human condition.  Will the block-chain give rise to a larger awareness of the pressing issues of man-kind?

QmeMd2sr4tPQENataSDQptruXLLyxrwGumHVrg8Q.name: Our Meditation
QmeMd2sr4tPQENataSDQptruXLLyxrwGumHVrg8Q.description:
Meditation has the ability to reveal that which unifies all things... a shared existence. "Our Meditation" is a reflection of our Oneness. When you change, we change together, This singular work changes for us the moment you change it for you. Your moment is our moment, in time and outside of it. 

As a Collector of this work, you are invited to be a Collaborator. 
As a Collaborator in this work, you are invited to change its Vision, Body, Awareness, Energy, and Setting to reflect what you are experiencing moment to moment.
As a Viewer of this work, you are invited to reflect on what has changed... in it, in you, in us.

QmeNLNm1oxtSByk3oVoXtzD3P3pChNRDGTmz2R8K.name: Newly Abridged Happiness Manual, Vol I
QmeNLNm1oxtSByk3oVoXtzD3P3pChNRDGTmz2R8K.description:
Newly Abridged Happiness Manual, Vol I is a conceptual poem that explores the tension between time and mind, between what we tell ourselves and what our minds tell us. How to construct a sense of self when our senses are constantly under assault?

This work expands on Caballero’s exploration of the storytelling potential of Async’s 24 hour canvas. The collector of the piece will also receive an airdropped video version of the poem in which the 24 frames/verses of the text change every few seconds. 

Do our thoughts change from hour to hour, day to day? Or, are we trapped by the same thoughts, and, thus, essentially reliving a single day?

Debuted at the Digital Francisco Carolinum in April 2022.

--

Newly Abridged Happiness Manual, Vol I

what comes first
the word or the image
in the kitchen the scent of thawed meat
prefaces the raw sweat of noon
where I reside it smolders
despite the promise of shade
I resolve it's senseless to worry
the pink muscle of mind
draws me nowhere closer 
tomorrow
charts an unreal circle
why must I choose
between language or bread
the moral of the story is to want less
panoramic thoughts
like everything that eats time
if habitual will inhabit my day
meanwhile simple is not simplistic
strings stretched in separate ways
a wonderful day
is conceived
produced like chilled fruit
the moral of the story is to want more
every waking hour

QmeNucx6os7NwCgSJ4wNmiBYBza4vbaqYpgu5a3J.name: Exquisite Genesis
QmeNucx6os7NwCgSJ4wNmiBYBza4vbaqYpgu5a3J.description:
"Exquisite Genesis" was inspired by The Exquisite Corpse. A game the surrealist used to play in which a piece of paper would be passed around and each member would draw a portion of the body.  The result was a combination of styles and ideas held together by the figurative form.  The more random each artist's interpretation was, the more interesting the result would be. 

"Exquisite Genesis" is my first exploration of this concept within the NFT space.  It includes 4 heads, 3 bodies, 3 legs and 3 objects of desire.  In total this piece has the potential to create 108 unique combinations.

Qmeam2RPtsGmuEZsTpf1Vg2nFYRpVaJEM3quA7hY.name: Looking for Fairies
Qmeam2RPtsGmuEZsTpf1Vg2nFYRpVaJEM3quA7hY.description:
The work "Looking for Fairies" is about daring to love and hope in the face of prejudice and prosecution. 

The work is based on two Victorian picture genres. Most important is the photographs of "Romantic Friendships", a photographic trend where men went to a photographer to have their photo taken holding hands, embracing, sitting on each others lap, even hugging and kissing. This in a period of time when homosexuality was forbidden by law. But friendship wasn't. 

A disparaging name used on feminine men in this period was "fairies", and the other pictoral genre used in the work, is the innocent, childlike Fairy Paintings, a strange Victorian trend of painting fairies, with wings and crowns, dancing in the forest in a summerly night.

When it was forbidden for a queer man to have a partner, cruising in parks and forests was often one of the few options available to meet. In the work "Looking for Fairies", I've cut out single men from the romantic friendship photographs, and placed them as hopeful fairies in an idyllic summer forest, hunting for their future beloved friend.

Qmeb6GEfTZ5cvFkD9ztuYyb9oUdmkRNg7EHxDnEi.name: MozartBeats
Qmeb6GEfTZ5cvFkD9ztuYyb9oUdmkRNg7EHxDnEi.description:
Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s masterpiece *Eine kleine Nachtmusik* ("a little night music") was completed in Vienna on 10 August 1787 while he worked on the opera Don Giovanni, but the work was not published until about 1827, long after his death. The occasion and the patron for Mozart’s composition remains unknown today and it was probably never performed within the span of his lifetime.

Almost 200 years later and in the same city of Vienna, the world’s musical capital, Mozart’s masterpiece has been remoulded to reflect society’s evolution into today’s postmodern artistic landscape, with the incorporation of bold and futuristic cutting-edge technologies.

The structure of the Mastertrack consists of four stems: Violin 1, Violin 2, Viola and Cello, with a total of five variations per stem. Layering different stem variations over one another leads to the creation of personally crafted, magical and unique tapestries of sound, closely related to Mozart’s original.

Qmec1zf3Ji2THPTQWN425WjTru3GZeNxPhuUU3ow.name: Don Quixote: Sketches - II
Qmec1zf3Ji2THPTQWN425WjTru3GZeNxPhuUU3ow.description:
Don Quixote: Sketches - I by Hulki Okan Tabak, minted 1/1 on Async Art, 2022

2 artworks in a daily cycle..

...

Don Quixote project is a highly personal interpretation of the hero and his world. Various photographic and AI tools are used to create, manipulate and recreate the images. The story will be numbered for all of us to track down what we hold essentially. Beyond ease of use, the numbers are not sequential. Each image is independent but some images will be interdependent parts of smaller stories which I will mention. I would also mint some editions outside of Manifold. Note that editions of this project could be 1/1s or multi editions. The mints on Async Art will not be numbered as they each contain multiple images in themselves.

...

Don Quixote is a Spanish epic novel by Miguel de Cervantes. Originally published in two parts, in 1605 and 1615, its full title is The Ingenious Gentleman Don Quixote of La Mancha.

A founding work of Western literature, it is often labeled as the first modern novel and one of the greatest ever written. Don Quixote is also one of the most-translated books in the world.

When first published, Don Quixote was usually interpreted as a comic novel. After the French Revolution, it was better known for its central ethic that individuals can be right while society is quite wrong and was seen as a story of disenchantment. In the 19th century, it was seen as social commentary, but no one could easily tell "whose side Cervantes was on". QmecvYY1YHAWmLTSenqVWTq4TNo9NG8i4x9krx4e.name: Hash In Space
QmecvYY1YHAWmLTSenqVWTq4TNo9NG8i4x9krx4e.description:
Hash in Space is a mix of Programmable + Generative Art inspired by Ethereum and Outer Space. The idea is to create a visual representation of Ethereum Network hash rate throughout the past 5 years from 2016 to 2020.

To create this, daily Ethereum average hash rate data was collected (source: Etherscan.io) and converted to values consisting of a whole year's total, median and average.
The interaction between data and graphics was done through associating the entire year's values to pre-defined range modifiers into a graphic particles system.

A javascript math script was created to convert the hash rate year values in GH/s  to 6 particles system modifiers values: Particles Count X, Particles Count Y, Displacement, Fractal Scale, Random Swirl Y and Force Relative Position X.

The result is a mix of reality and sci-fi, present and future, precise data and visual satisfaction. Maybe this is the way we will visualize data in the future. Or maybe, by that time, the space is the place where we will be.

QmeeBZiHiov3ENgg5S4jQv6ntn7xJ2u2cCHAXfeW.name: Kids Takeover Putin: 24 Hours on Freedom Duty
QmeeBZiHiov3ENgg5S4jQv6ntn7xJ2u2cCHAXfeW.description:
Based on Putin photography, Kids Takeover Putin is text-to-image experimentation on war, peace and leadership. It is re-creating the leadership in the eyes of a kid takeover for peace.

Stop the War. We hoped, I hoped this was already the past in Europe. We should not go back.

There is a lot of interesting material that range from childish and peaceful to satirical and dark. I will post them and perhaps I will post most of them hoping this ends as soon as possible.

This is the only 24 piece in this project, I will also be minting 2-piece Nova Apartchik and 4-piece somewhat more abstract pieces on Async Art. For multi editions and some other 1/1s, please visit my collection on KnownOrigin.

by Mad Monk, 1/1 on Async Art, 2022

QmeewPHPFVmkFFdeGLtHH7xXemD6cfTpokspoWoB.name: Be Yourself
QmeewPHPFVmkFFdeGLtHH7xXemD6cfTpokspoWoB.description:
It's simple logic, if you ask me. Be yourself. Don't strive to be anything other than who you are. YOU are a unicorn, amazing and unique in all that is you. Whenever you need a reminder of how incredible you are, look at this image. 

Every hour, for 24 hours, new words of encouragement appear to inspire you until the image is complete. Then it starts over again to help guide you. While it may change throughout the day, one thing stays consistent. It always begins and ends with the same two words.

BE YOURSELF.

Like I said, simple logic.

"God" is the energy of all questions and quests; and thus the only essentially source of all action and volition.
👀

QmehZcBsc2FxkAs4gaLNKPYzGFNcEsGfErsw7qsj.description:
The project is using the day/night feature on AsyncArt.
It is consisted of a transparent digital sculpture formation and the impact that its environment has on the substance and essence of the forms.
Humans refract (and reflect) their own enviroment in many ways and they become transparent to the influence of their personality. Humans are affected by the environment and are part of the nature of the surrundings for the others.
This artwork is also a part of a bigger project which is using traced images of famous artworks from the past as a background visual layer in a very subtle way.
In "UPrise", the day layer is using an artwork by Jean-Michel Basquiat and the night an artwork by Lewis Norman and are a reminder that the past and its products are a part of the enviroment we live in now.

QmehsTTmfdWhJFBp8k2KEYL988YoXTaNnNeL2zcw.name: In Other News
QmehsTTmfdWhJFBp8k2KEYL988YoXTaNnNeL2zcw.description:
The pandemic has shaken the world. It has made us all to stay at home. It did not discriminate between the privileged or the nots. The news is flooded with reports of things which are hitherto unheard of. The situation is particularly worse for a part of society - the creators. The creators - the artists, the artisans, the craftsmen, the street-side sellers of handicrafts, each of them have faced the wrath of the pandemic. It has gotten so worse, that they have started consuming their own produce. The hungry sweet-maker started eating his own sweets. In the dearth of clothing, they started wearing their own handmade fabrics. Thus, this vicious circle of the “creator consuming the creation” has started. “In Other News” is an artwork, an outcry from all these invisible members of the society, who are usually neglected by regular media. It tries to throw light at their situation and tries to say - we also exist.
I photographed each of these photographs as part of an exhibition 5 years back in Hyderabad, showing how the creator consumes his creation. I found this the right time to use these photographs to show the situation of these people whom we see and ignore in everyday life. The innate evil underlying this tendency was symbolised by the 10 heads of the evil king Ravana. The head in each photograph tilts slightly from left to right, image to image - thus showcasing the 10-headed Ravana, with the Photographer at the centre. There are only 9 images in the artwork. The 10th head is invisible, which is me myself as the artist. I will be buying one of the pieces of my creation and thus completing this circle.

Qmej9dGHJQMQdwxNYjRHQHWcmbugkWRGkwcDtb12.name: Riflessa
Qmej9dGHJQMQdwxNYjRHQHWcmbugkWRGkwcDtb12.description:
Riflessa is the genesis programmable Art NFT by Italian artist Francesca Fini. In this work she recreates and re-prototypes in 3D the Art lamps conceived in the 70s by her father designer, and produced in limited edition by the visionary Italian company New Lamp. A few very rare examples of these Art lamps / light sculptures, now out of production and almost all lost, have recently become collector's items in the modernism market, and sold for tens of thousands of dollars by Christie's and other major auction houses.
This project, animated by the artist’s desire to celebrate the genius of her father, digitally brings back to life a lost piece of Italian design from one of the most innovative and brilliant periods in recent history.

Riflessa
by Gianfranco Fini
New Lamp, 1970

A luminous panel in stainless steel with white lacquered metal. The steel cubes are magnetic and can be interactively re-arranged to create infinite light patterns. This was originally a very large wall lamp, measuring 81 x 81 x 10 cm. The piece is featured in Luce lampade 1968-1973: il nuovo design italiano, Fulvio Ferrari e Napoleone Ferrari, Allemandi Editore.

The collector of this NFT will receive as a reward a hand-drawn sketch of the lamp signed by Gianfranco Fini.

QmemC8RmdEgSbUt6qc4cwMDNVmv3R4W9kRfW9zbQ.name: Lonely Space Journey
QmemC8RmdEgSbUt6qc4cwMDNVmv3R4W9kRfW9zbQ.description:
A lonely figure in a room on a spaceship, with a book as solo companion. Reading, reflecting, meditating, wondering.  Different states that this human figure has to pass the time on this journey into the unknown. A journey where the landscape changes but it seems not to affect this person that is oblivion to it. What is this journey? What are these parts in the universe that she is passing? What is written on the book? 

A lonely journey that could be also a journey to our inner self, to the stars that we are made of.

Each layers can be changed according to the mood of the owner. The Spaceship room with different colors; The Human Figure in the different positions and mindsets; and the Space Window Background to present different parts of the Universe.

Are you gonna make your Lonely Space Journey into the unknown?

All made on Ipad with Procreate.

Author Twitter and Instagram: magusz_art

Qmeo59KzrD6MNjaUM32EddU69zt3dkydVVT7GC1h.description:
Artwork Title: Experimental No.3 #1037
Date of Artwork: 2021
Dimension: 3840 pixel x 2989 pixel
Type of Work: Silver Gelatin Photogram, Digital Darkroom
Edition: Unique
Note: This artwork is a type of digital art. The hand-made photogram is one of the subjects that compose this piece, and this photogram is not for sale separately whatever in the crypto world or the real world.

The photograph on 00:00 is the original photogram, and the image on 23:00 is the digital-inverted version of the original piece. I am concerned about are the rest of the twenty-two images in this piece. They can be deemed as the procedures of the chemical reaction in the darkroom. I reversed the habitual way of seeing the photograph and applied an unexpected, counterintuitive but logical method based on the new techs to view a photogram and its Contact Print.

QmeovqNzFRLqu2qdxSv5cqX8Vr9P6sG2vPLHuvHz.name: Khôra's Monolith
QmeovqNzFRLqu2qdxSv5cqX8Vr9P6sG2vPLHuvHz.description:
Jacques Derrida uses khôra to name a radical otherness that "gives place" for being. Khôra is the place where everything passes but in which nothing remains. The monolith exists in the center of the frame and its powers lift the space. It's a character that holds the space together and uplifts the whole world around it. The algorithmically generated terrain is here to represent the liminality of a space. Where is this place ? Does it have an essence ? It is a space without being a space. It is the other. The Monolith is the hero of this sensible realm.

A generated world, which is perceptible by sight and all the senses, by the name of earth or air or fire or water, or any aggregates or constituents there of: rather, if we describe her as a Kind invisible and unshaped, all-receptive, and in some most perplexing and most baffling way partaking of the intelligible, we shall describe her truly.
— Plato, Timaeus, 51a

QmepLNcj9mCDaTjVvmCM6ocr9xtjvMbWNTmaCSoa.name: பண் (Pann)
QmepLNcj9mCDaTjVvmCM6ocr9xtjvMbWNTmaCSoa.description:
The seed of all melodies, "பண்" is the truest representation of Tamil music, culture, land and its people. A voyage that connects the past, beholds the present and accompanies into the future, Pann is the beginning of a journey into the world of performed, programmable art. This 30-minute piece of music written in Tamil, was commissioned and produced by Metapurse and is a first of its kind NFT from India. It had its premiere in New York’s Terminal 5 on the 4th of November 2021 at Dreamverse, the world’s largest NFT exhibition curated by Metapurse. Pann became the ambient music for this historic event that merged the physical and digital realms for the first time, showcasing the pinnacle of NFT art of more than 150 artists from around the world.

Woven from nine layers of music, each having several variants within it, the Pann master track captures a fresh collaborative performance of 40 musicians and visual artists.  It can be heard in 19440 different combinations, making it a dynamic piece of music with artwork done by Susha, Ghana N B and Vidhya Vijay that evolve along with every changing state of music. While most of the variants were recorded at 2barQ Studios, Chennai, Tamil Nadu by Sujith Sreedhar and Divine Joseph, the cherry on the cake is the live performance of some of the musical and art variants captured during the Dreamverse experience.

QmesnDLA3KoAuKMKwaqMxC8Gsu58Ta98DeB8Wo3d.name: silence and nothingness
QmesnDLA3KoAuKMKwaqMxC8Gsu58Ta98DeB8Wo3d.description: The indifference of civilization and institutions is so fragile and absurd. What is more terrifying than life in human society is the fatal flaw of "dehumanization". Victims abandoned by modern civilization have become demons who will do anything to survive, and they are also an indictment of the oppression of external authorities. In reality, the demons and desires that have been sleeping in everyone's heart drive the tragic history of mankind to repeat itself. In the face of disaster, perhaps only love and mutual help are the way to coexist.

QmevnfTxNPJuaDZPtHFXDCcTzKK8e6WcshiXHmuB.name: Trixel CryptoAngels Genesis
QmevnfTxNPJuaDZPtHFXDCcTzKK8e6WcshiXHmuB.description:
Collab between Domacollective (ig domacollective) and marcsparkss (ig msparkss_art) on the birth of the Trixel CryptoAngel movement.

The artists are going befond the pfp pixel craze and exploring new forms of digitally inspired respresentations.  We got tired of pixels and went for triangles, hence "the Trixel"
Day : based on 180x130 acrylic painting 
Night: Mixed media 

The angels in Raphael's Sisitine Madonna have long time represented youth, innocence, a promise for a better world.  They are superstars, known to so many around the world, but  we feel their global fame outgrew the physical aspect of how they were initially conceived. So, we took them out of their original version and suggested a new representation of diversity, fluidity, creativity, as in new form of hope. 

Proceeds of the sale towards research & building a smart-contract platform bringing further transparency of ngos accepting eth donations.

Qmew7pzFYKQRTP4WiW3UKpiuKfxzGgTcHDBZiSNA.name: The Jackpot
Qmew7pzFYKQRTP4WiW3UKpiuKfxzGgTcHDBZiSNA.description:
“The Jackpot” is a collaboration between https://async.art/u/rutgervandertas (0x84300dCc7ca9Cf447e886fA17C11fa22557d1AF0) and Ytje Veenstra. They share a studio in Haarlem, the Netherlands,  where they found mutual artistic ground.

“The Jackpot” is loosely based on William Gibson's book “The Peripheral”. It's about two timelines, set apart 70 years, on different continents. These timelines converge and characters on both sides of  time find themselves interacting, strategizing and plotting to ward off a greater danger, called the jackpot.

Ytje Veenstra is a longtime fan of Gibson's cyberpunk and speculative fiction. Her clear-lined drawings intersect and merge with Rutger van der Tas' mind bending, psychedelic style. Like the two timelines in Gibson's story, Rutger and Ytje weave their art and vision into an organic, yet collage-like dream world, a universe where future nightmares and virtual worlds fold in around themselves.

Qmex98fox5yYb49pdNMwBA1U7PxKceFa3CvaSGya.name: Divided
Qmex98fox5yYb49pdNMwBA1U7PxKceFa3CvaSGya.description:
This artwork is composed of two cycles day and night.
The day represents a happy setting while the dark a more gloomy abstract place.
A surrealism setting formed around this skeleton of our inner helper reaching for the divided.

Sometimes all is divided. The struggle happens in day and night. A man wants to speak but is afraid. He thinks, sinking into his thoughts, imagining scenarios in which they are in love... The women believes she is at fault, as the man does not speak to her, but struggles to engage herself to break to the root. Love deteriorates, and the push becomes greater. Help then. This artwork stems from the society that we today live in. Should the women make the move first and accept to get rejected, or should the man do so accepting that he might get rejected? Both should be seen as signs of encouragement.  Maybe there is a third hand helping.

QmeynKN7C9uiq9tV9vzcTnNK2ghU3gDmF2rFucjy.name: New York Commuter Sunrise
QmeynKN7C9uiq9tV9vzcTnNK2ghU3gDmF2rFucjy.description:
This is a series of images depicting the sun rising over New York City, and the ramp that leads into the Lincoln Tunnel, as photographed from Weehawken, NJ -taken on 1.1.2017

The timing of the series is based on the Eastern Standard Time zone (New York)- the sun rises slowly into the morning hours and then goes back down slowly into the hours of the night based on 24 images, each assigned to a specific hour of the day.

The curved road-ramp pictured in the bottom left of the image is essentially the busiest half-a-mile stretch in the whole East Coast, every single morning of the year, as it is the main route that commuters take into New York City for work if they are travelling by vehicle.  "The Lincoln Tunnel, named after President Abraham Lincoln, is one of the busy roadways, with upwards of 120,000 cars passing through every day. The Tunnel’s separate bus lane sees about 1,700 buses every morning." (2017)

These images of the ramp leading into the Lincoln Tunnel are especially unique because they were taken on the morning of New Years Day, 2017.  New Years Day each year is the only time of the year that this ramp is not entirely backed up with traffic by vehicles travelling into New York City.  One day every year, this roadway can be found in a quiet and peaceful state, and only for a few hours- if you're awake to catch it from the night before.

Another unique quality of this image is that this view will absolutely never be seen again- and that is because after 2017, the building that is seen being constructed in the foreground of the Empire State building was completed, and now blocks the view of the Empire State Building from Weehawken, NJ, and the Lincoln tunnel ramp.  Many other buildings have also been constructed which now take away from a lot of the beauty that I once attributed to this skyline as seen from Weehawken and the Lincoln Tunnel.

Generations of my family and myself have used this ramp and tunnel countless times to travel into the city, and this view will always hold a special place in my heart.

QmeyppVBoEqCYhSuoYigWUBFaYA2V84W5jQiqqeT.name: The Nature of Impostor Syndrome
QmeyppVBoEqCYhSuoYigWUBFaYA2V84W5jQiqqeT.description:
It doesn't matter how long you've been here. It will happen. Your face will float in this space, with many others, trying not to be devoured by whales or scammers, enduring pointing fingers, scrutinizing eyes, complacent or prickly comments... Doing everything possible to keep that creative magic alive. 

And many times, for a while, you will fail. The tongues and fingers and eyes, oftentimes your own, will overwhelm you and you'll cower in fear and self-doubt.

But eventually you will grow the wings you were told were impossible, and learn to fly. Many times you will feel that you do not deserve the flight, and that the wings do not belong to you. But the more you use them, the more familiar they will become.

You will use many masks, but remember that they are not you- they do not even belong to you, and they will fall off sooner or later. Keep enough of them to perform your act, but not too many, so that everyone can recognize you.

Qmf165ANzjj7p9i39NVpes5ZHrL8QuKhVH7cgmVj.name: Devilish Thieves and Sad Teardrops
Qmf165ANzjj7p9i39NVpes5ZHrL8QuKhVH7cgmVj.description:
24 collaborative drawings in a single artwork that changes by the hour.

Devilish Thieves and Sad Teardrops is a collaboration between Bulbasaur 9 and Hulki Okan Tabak.

The primary drawing comes from a personal project by B9 and HoT has expanded on the subject matter with different degrees and methods of reimagination.

There are three 24 piece collaborations as a part of this project which will be all minted on Async Art. The drawings are from October 2021, reimagination took place in November 2021 and expected time of minting is early 2022. Meanwhile collaboration also created GIFs based on individual stills and they will be minted on other cryptoart platforms.

Qmf2eKhTJU64ojRnpWpc77Me2HVVpCcUFQJuMsnq.name: Year of the 0x
Qmf2eKhTJU64ojRnpWpc77Me2HVVpCcUFQJuMsnq.description:
The Guild began this project as a tribute to the Lunar Ox Year that coincides with the Ethereum bull run and astronomical explosion of NFTs as a medium. It is a work of struggle, of celebration, of premonition and of jubilation. 

An initial composition of color was created by Shinji Akhirah which helped to inform the delegation of sections via a randomizer. Each artist was randomly assigned an area on the canvas to complete their part. This collaboration captures original artwork by 38 different artists - infusing each part of the piece with their own unique style to complete the 12 different animals and setting with the central focus being placed on the Ox ("0x" or "ZeroX" as he's occasionally referred to). 

We present you with the "Year of The 0x" - a celebration of creativity, Chinese astrology and the globally collaborative CryptoArt movement.

Qmf5eZS9gAT7KbkcnbSLEHg8vwbxxh2qsNYy8KC7.name: Newly Abridged Happiness Manual, Vol I
Qmf5eZS9gAT7KbkcnbSLEHg8vwbxxh2qsNYy8KC7.description:
Newly Abridged Happiness Manual, Vol I is a conceptual poem that explores the tension between time and mind, between what we tell ourselves and what our thoughts tell us. 

Our emotional states are underpinned by the unspoken words that traverse our minds as thought. To examine these words is to examine the intimate scaffolding that sustains our outward-facing selves. This poem does so with humor, compassion, and straightforward honesty, highlighting both the mundane and contradictory nature of thought. 

Consisting of twenty-four short verses, each of which is displayed independently on a frame for sixty minutes, this piece takes advantage of Async Art’s 24hour canvas to explore the evolution–or lack thereof–of thought along the vast axis of time. Sloganeering statements of self-improvement and assertive grasps for the transcendental interrupt expressions of routine, of place, of physicality. In one breath, we conceive of an ideal tomorrow, in the next we abruptly reach for a peach. How to construct a meaningful sense of self when our senses are constantly under assault?

This artwork functions as a diptych–its collector will receive an airdropped video version in which the same twenty-four frames rotate in under a minute. The slow and fast versions of the poem work together to show how our thoughts cycle and recycle from second to second, hour to hour, moment to moment. 

By rethinking the same thoughts, are we essentially reliving a single day?

Debuted at the Digital Francisco Carolinum in April 2022.

--

Newly Abridged Happiness Manual, Vol I

what comes first 
the word or the image 
in the kitchen the scent of thawed meat 
prefaces the raw sweat of noon 
where I reside it smolders 
despite the promise of shade 
I resolve it's senseless to worry 
the pink muscle of mind 
draws me nowhere closer 
tomorrow 
charts an unreal circle 
why must I choose 
between language or bread 
the moral of the story is to want less 
panoramic thoughts 
like everything that eats time 
if habitual inhabit my day 
though simple and simplistic 
wrench me with separate strings 
a wonderful day 
is conceived 
produced like chilled fruit 
the moral of the story is to want more 
every waking hour

Qmf7kckbkJ8fxepYcR3FG7x89yyevNLcsfr8J7Ym.name: Experimental No.1 #9796
Qmf7kckbkJ8fxepYcR3FG7x89yyevNLcsfr8J7Ym.description: Changes is the only thing that hasn’t been changed. From time to space to the thoughts of human beings are constantly changing. I transformed a Silver Gelatin Photogram (a piece of physical photograph made of alternative photographic processes) into a digital image that even can produce endless changes. This is based on the change in my way of seeing the world. It is difficult for individuals to completely isolate themselves from their own inherent culture, this ingrained imprint not only stems from families but also social and historical influences. Besides, the rapid innovation of science and technologies directly drives the world today to inevitably facing collisions and fusions in multiculturalism. Studying classical philosophical text allows me to apply the dialectical method to tease those open questions, and finally ground on my artworks. All things complement each other and balance in the collision. Changes is the key. Isn’t the development of human civilization that come to the present evolve in indistinct ways?

QmfBF9Rex1yW6EUHg6FYZgsQFgNZvjRoLUcDVqQ6.name: Corps malade
QmfBF9Rex1yW6EUHg6FYZgsQFgNZvjRoLUcDVqQ6.description:
Though I witnessed glamorous moments, faces and looks as a press photographer, I realized that I was drawn to create this world from a different perspective; one which undressed the soul, and rendered a more authentic moment. After some time, it became the same scenes, the same clichés, the same smiles, the same looks and the same photographers. As a celebrity, having to see more than 30 flashes per second every time a photographer spots them, probably makes them want to protect themselves. Seeing celebrities live in this world of excessive media coverage, I started to develop a mixed feeling of admiration and respect, but also pity, and finally detachment.

The Personalities are decomposed and re-assembled in an abstract composition, guided by my instinct and fed by what the model inspired in me.

The original digital size of "Corps malade" portrait is 50 by 40 inch.

This is a portrait of the singer Nasir Jones aka "NAS". ¨
If you set it on "sunrise", it will display the original photography.

QmfBajmirLfo64aaGWmuqf8xZ4AiPW59Z8ryxy62.name: Evil Intent - 1: I Knew You Would Do It
QmfBajmirLfo64aaGWmuqf8xZ4AiPW59Z8ryxy62.description:
"Intentions are mental states in which the agent commits themselves to a course of action. Having the plan to visit the zoo tomorrow is an example of an intention. The action plan is the content of the intention while the commitment is the attitude towards this content. Other mental states can have action plans as their content, as when one admires a plan, but differ from intentions since they do not involve a practical commitment to realizing this plan. Successful intentions bring about the intended course of action while unsuccessful intentions fail to do so. Intentions, like many other mental states, have intentionality: they represent possible states of affairs." ---Wikipedia

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Intention

Note: This artwork is a type of digital art. The hand-made photogram is one of the subjects that compose this piece, and this photogram is not for sale separately whatever in the crypto world or the real world.

Notwithstanding, the beginning of the photography is representational, it ultimately leads to the way of the abstract. Photography has nothing to do with painting, although the thinking of abstractness renders them getting closer and closer. Photography remains the interpretation of "Light", and to express the “Light” is its inescapable responsibility. I find the "Line" could be one of the forms to present the "Light". I apply the "Line", also is the "Light", to destroy a completed and finished photograph, and change it into a new form of art and have a unique way of spreading and viewing. Through this new attempt to keep looking for balance and harmony.

Photography remains the interpretation of "Light", and to express the “Light” is its inescapable responsibility. I find the "Line" could be one of the forms to present the "Light". I apply the "Line", also is the "Light", to destroy a completed and finished photograph, and change it into a new form of art and have a unique way of spreading and viewing. Through this new attempt to keep looking for balance and harmony.

QmfL6fxWrpqowjZAept1hU8kybAuRtdzksoHVsaC.name: Still Life on Niche
QmfL6fxWrpqowjZAept1hU8kybAuRtdzksoHVsaC.description:
Using three recurring elements from my work, I set out to develop another exercise on light and how it affects the mood of a scene, through a year of iterations. 

Given the impossibility of representing the 'light' of a specific month, I tried to capture the atmosphere through the light, with its colours, it's shadows or its vibrancy. Even though the elements remain the same, each month there's a new scene manifesting changes related to a certain month; wether by reason (the known angles of the sun on specific times for ex.) or emotion (the use of a symbolic colour to express a season), the scene is always changing in accordance to an idealized seasonal cycle (taking place in a temperate climate of the northern hemisphere.)

The images change at the 21st of each month, and during each season the camera focus will incide on one of the elements: an egg for the Winter Solstice and a skull for the Summer Solstice, while the Equinoxes are marked by a focus on the idol standing in between them. 

It's a still life, but also a meta-shrine that connects us to another form of time.

Together we can move forward in harmony and together mankind can have a brighter future.

QmfSd6xTqWGS5LhTGACWhzMr3FycN31egMYnqh5e.name: Elusive childhood, 2012
QmfSd6xTqWGS5LhTGACWhzMr3FycN31egMYnqh5e.description:
Digital photography, light painting. 
Exhibited during the Fifth Annual Exposure Award, Art Photography collection, the Louvre Museum, Paris, July 2015. 
"I photographed a boy running away from me down the street. He reminded me of my childhood going further and further into the past from me. Childhood is a wonderful time when the foundations of our psyche and our attitude to the world are formed. However, according to Eric Berne, our psyche includes three different states: child, parent and adult. It turns out that our inner child does not disappear anywhere, but lives in us to the end. This work is dedicated to him and all of our inner children"
